   47: function isOverdue(
   48:   assignment: ResourceAssignment,
   49:   progress: StudentAssignmentProgress,
   50: ): boolean {
   51:   if (
   52:     !assignment.dueDate ||
   53:     progress.status === "completed"
   54:   ) {
   55:     return false;
   56:   }
   57: 
   58:   const dueDate = new Date(
   59:     assignment.dueDate,
   60:   );
   61: 
   62:   dueDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
   63: 
   64:   return dueDate.getTime() < Date.now();
   65: }

   40: function toStringList(
   41:   value: unknown,
   42: ): string[] {
   43:   if (typeof value === "string") {
   44:     return value.trim()
   45:       ? [value.trim()]
   46:       : [];
   47:   }
   48: 
   49:   if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
   50:     return [];
   51:   }
   52: 
   53:   return value
   54:     .map((item) => {
   55:       if (
   56:         typeof item === "string"
   57:       ) {
   58:         return item.trim();
   59:       }
   60: 
   61:       if (
   62:         item &&
   63:         typeof item === "object"
   64:       ) {
   65:         const candidate =
   66:           item as Record<
   67:             string,
   68:             unknown
   69:           >;
   70: 
   71:         const text =
   72:           candidate.description ??
   73:           candidate.text ??
   74:           candidate.point;
   75: 
   76:         return typeof text ===
   77:           "string"
   78:           ? text.trim()
   79:           : "";
   80:       }
   81: 
   82:       return "";
   83:     })
   84:     .filter(Boolean);
   85: }
   86: 
   87: function getQuestionExtras(
   88:   question: unknown,
   89: ) {
   90:   const candidate =
   91:     question as Record<
   92:       string,
   93:       unknown
   94:     >;
   95: 
   96:   return {
   97:     examinerGuidance:
   98:       toStringList(
   99:         candidate.examinerGuidance,
  100:       ),
  101: 
  102:     misconceptions:
  103:       toStringList(
  104:         candidate.misconceptions,
  105:       ),
  106:   };
  107: }

  130: function matchesFilter(
  131:   assignment: UnifiedAssignment,
  132:   filter: AssignmentFilter,
  133: ): boolean {
  134:   if (filter === "all") return true;
  135:   if (filter === "overdue") return isUnifiedAssignmentOverdue(assignment);
  136: 
  137:   if (filter === "resources") {
  138:     return assignment.kind === "resource" || assignment.kind === "programming";
  139:   }
  140: 
  141:   if (filter === "quizzes") return assignment.kind === "quiz";
  142:   if (filter === "exams") return assignment.kind === "exam";
  143: 
  144:   if (filter === "completed") {
  145:     return isUnifiedAssignmentComplete(assignment);
  146:   }
  147: 
  148:   if (filter === "submitted") {
  149:     return (
  150:       assignment.kind === "exam" &&
  151:       (assignment.status === "submitted" || assignment.status === "marking")
  152:     );
  153:   }
  154: 
  155:   return assignment.status === filter;
  156: }

  203:         "submitted" ||
  204:         assignment.status ===
  205:           "marking")
  206:     );

  208:

  210:     assignment.status === filter
  211:   );

  377:     useState(true);

  379:     useState("");

  381:     useState("");
  382:   const [filter, setFilter] =
  383:     useState<AssignmentFilter>("all");

  386:     useCallback(async () => {

  402:           ),
  403:         );

   29:     ? topic.lessons.findIndex((item: Lesson) => item.id === requestedLessonId)
   30:     : 0;
   31: 
   32:   if (lessonIndex === -1) {
   33:     notFound();
   34:   }
   35: 
   36:   const currentLesson = topic.lessons[lessonIndex];
   37:   const previousLesson = topic.lessons[lessonIndex - 1];
   38:   const nextLesson = topic.lessons[lessonIndex + 1];
   39: 
   40:   if (!currentLesson) {
   41:     notFound();
   42:   }
   43: 
   44:   return (
   45:     <div className="space-y-8">
   46:       <LessonNavigation
   47:         topicId={topicId}
   48:         currentIndex={lessonIndex}
   49:         totalLessons={topic.lessons.length}
   50:         previousLessonId={previousLesson?.id}
   51:         nextLessonId={nextLesson?.id}
   52:       />
   53: 
   54:       <LessonRenderer
   55:         lesson={currentLesson}
   56:         topicId={topicId}
   57:         nextLessonId={nextLesson?.id}
   58:         topicSimulator={topic.simulator}
   59:       />
   60:     </div>
   61:   );
   62: }

   36: type SavedQuizQuestion = {
   37:   id?: string;
   38:   type?: string;
   39:   question?: string;
   40:   options?: string[];
   41:   correctAnswer?: string;
   42:   explanation?: string;

   46: function normaliseLookupValue(
   47:   value: string,
   48: ): string {
   49:   return value
   50:     .trim()
   51:     .toLowerCase()
   52:     .replace(/&/g, "and")
   53:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ")
   54:     .trim();
   55: }
   56: 
   57: /*
   58:  * Query strings may contain either:
   59:  *
   60:  *   /quiz?topic=binary
   61:  *
   62:  * or a human-readable adaptive-learning topic:
   63:  *
   64:  *   /quiz?topic=Binary%20Numbers
   65:  *
   66:  * Resolve both forms through the canonical curriculum registry.
   67:  */
   68: function resolveCurriculumTopicId(
   69:   value: string,
   70: ): string | null {
   71:   const cleaned =
   72:     normaliseLookupValue(value);
   73: 
   74:   if (!cleaned) {
   75:     return null;
   76:   }
   77: 
   78:   const match =
   79:     curriculumRegistry.find(
   80:       (topic) => {
   81:         const searchable = [
   82:           topic.id,
   83:           topic.title,
   84:           ...(topic.aliases || []),
   85:         ].map(
   86:           normaliseLookupValue,
   87:         );
   88: 
   89:         return searchable.includes(
   90:           cleaned,
   91:         );
   92:       },
   93:     );
   94: 
   95:   return match?.id || null;
   96: }
   97:

  100:   const searchParams =
  101:     useSearchParams();
  102: 
  103:   const {
  104:     profile,

    1: "use client";

    3: import { useMemo } from "react";
    4: 
    5: import Link from "next/link";
    6: 
    7:

    9: import { getCurriculumCoverage } from "@/services/curriculumCoverageService";
   10: 
   11: import type { SimulatorType } from "@/types/curriculum";
   12: 
   13: type VisualiserEntry = {
   14:   key: string;
   15:   simulator: SimulatorType;
   16:   title: string;
   17:   topicTitle: string;
   18:   lessonTitle: string;
   19:   href: string;
   20: };
   21: 
   22: function simulatorTitle(
   23:   simulator: SimulatorType,
   24: ): string {
   25:   return simulator
   26:     .split("-")
   27:     .map(
   28:       (word) =>
   29:         word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() +
   30:         word.slice(1),
   31:     )
   32:     .join(" ");
   33: }
   34: 
   35: export default function VisualisersPage() {
   36:   const { profile } = useAuth();
   37: 
   38:   const coverage =
   39:     profile?.qualification && profile.examBoard
   40:       ? getCurriculumCoverage(
   41:           profile.qualification,
   42:           profile.examBoard,
   43:         )
   44:       : null;
   45: 
   46:   const entries =
   47:     useMemo<VisualiserEntry[]>(() => {
   48:       if (!coverage) {
   49:         return [];
   50:       }
   51: 
   52:       const seen =
   53:         new Set<string>();
   54: 
   55:       const result:
   56:         VisualiserEntry[] = [];
   57: 
   58:       for (
   59:         const unitCoverage of
   60:         coverage.units
   61:       ) {
   62:         for (
   63:           const topic of
   64:           unitCoverage.topics
   65:         ) {
   66:           const firstLesson =
   67:             topic.lessons[0];
   68: 
   69:           if (
   70:             topic.simulator &&
   71:             firstLesson
   72:           ) {
   73:             const key =
   74:               `${topic.id}:${topic.simulator}:${firstLesson.id}`;
   75: 
   76:             if (!seen.has(key)) {
   77:               seen.add(key);
   78: 
   79:               result.push({
   80:                 key,
   81:                 simulator:
   82:                   topic.simulator,
   83:                 title:
   84:                   simulatorTitle(
   85:                     topic.simulator,
   86:                   ),
   87:                 topicTitle:
   88:                   topic.title,
   89:                 lessonTitle:
   90:                   firstLesson.title,

   94:             }

    1: "use client";
    2: 
    3: import Card from "@/components/ui/Card";
    4: import ProgressBar from "@/components/ui/ProgressBar";
    5: import { achievements } from "@/data/achievements";
    6: 
    7: type Props = {
    8:   unlockedBadges: string[];
    9:   xp?: number;
   10:   completedLessons?: string[];
   11: };
   12: 
   13: export default function AchievementsCard({
   14:   unlockedBadges,
   15:   xp = 0,
   16:   completedLessons = [],
   17: }: Props) {
   18:   function getProgress(achievement: (typeof achievements)[number]) {
   19:   if (achievement.condition.type === "xp") {
   20:     const targetValue = Number(achievement.condition.value);
   21: 
   22:     if (!Number.isFinite(targetValue) || targetValue <= 0) {
   23:       return 0;
   24:     }
   25: 
   26:     return Math.min(
   27:       100,
   28:       Math.round((xp / targetValue) * 100),
   29:     );
   30:   }
   31: 
   32:   if (achievement.condition.type === "completedLessons") {
   33:     const targetValue = Number(achievement.condition.value);
   34: 
   35:     if (!Number.isFinite(targetValue) || targetValue <= 0) {
   36:       return 0;
   37:     }
   38: 
   39:     return Math.min(
   40:       100,
   41:       Math.round(
   42:         (completedLessons.length / targetValue) * 100,
   43:       ),
   44:     );
   45:   }
   46: 
   47:   if (achievement.condition.type === "lessonCompleted") {
   48:     const lessonId = String(achievement.condition.value);
   49: 
   50:     return completedLessons.includes(lessonId) ? 100 : 0;
   51:   }
   52: 
   53:   return 0;
   54: }
   55:   return (
   56:     <Card>
   57:       <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
   58:         <div>
   59:           <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-blue-600">

   68:           {unlockedBadges.length} unlocked
   69:         </div>
   70:       </div>
   71: 
   72:       <div className="mt-6 grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
   73:         {achievements.map((achievement) => {
   74:           const unlocked = unlockedBadges.includes(achievement.id);
   75:           const progress = getProgress(achievement);
   76: 
   77:           return (
   78:             <div
   79:               key={achievement.id}
   80:               className={`rounded-2xl border p-5 transition-all duration-300 ${
   81:                 unlocked
   82:                   ? "border-yellow-300 bg-yellow-50 shadow-sm"
   83:                   : "border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 opacity-80"
   84:               }`}
   85:             >
   86:               <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
   87:                 <div className="text-5xl">
   88:                   {unlocked ? achievement.icon : "ÃƒÂ°Ã…Â¸Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â‚¬â„¢"}
   89:                 </div>
   90: 
   91:                 <span
   92:                   className={`rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold ${
   93:                     unlocked
   94:                       ? "bg-green-100 text-green-700"
   95:                       : "bg-slate-200 text-slate-600"

   98:                   {unlocked ? "Unlocked" : "Locked"}

    1: import Card from "@/components/ui/Card";
    2: import ProgressBar from "@/components/ui/ProgressBar";
    3: import { achievements } from "@/data/achievements";
    4: 
    5: type Props = {
    6:   unlockedBadges: string[];
    7:   xp: number;
    8:   completedLessons: string[];
    9: };
   10: 
   11: export default function NextBadgeCard({
   12:   unlockedBadges,
   13:   xp,
   14:   completedLessons,
   15: }: Props) {
   16:   const nextBadge = achievements.find(
   17:     (achievement) => !unlockedBadges.includes(achievement.id),
   18:   );
   19: 
   20:   if (!nextBadge) {
   21:     return (
   22:       <Card>
   23:         <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900">
   24:           ðŸ† All Badges Unlocked
   25:         </h2>
   26:         <p className="mt-2 text-slate-600">Legend status achieved.</p>
   27:       </Card>
   28:     );
   29:   }
   30: 
   31:   let progress = 0;
   32: 
   33:   if (nextBadge.condition.type === "xp") {
   34:     progress = Math.min(
   35:       100,
   36:       Math.round((xp / Number(nextBadge.condition.value)) * 100),
   37:     );
   38:   }
   39: 
   40:   if (nextBadge.condition.type === "completedLessons") {
   41:     progress = Math.min(
   42:       100,
   43:       Math.round(
   44:         (completedLessons.length / Number(nextBadge.condition.value)) * 100,
   45:       ),
   46:     );
   47:   }
   48: 
   49:   if (nextBadge.condition.type === "lessonCompleted") {
   50:     progress = completedLessons.includes(String(nextBadge.condition.value))
   51:       ? 100
   52:       : 0;
   53:   }
   54: 
   55:   return (
   56:     <Card>
   57:       <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-blue-600">
   58:         Next Badge
   59:       </p>
   60: 
   61:       <div className="mt-4 text-5xl">ðŸ”’</div>

   64:         {nextBadge.title}
   65:       </h2>

   70:         <div className="mb-2 flex justify-between text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600">

   89:           error,
   90:         );
   91: 
   92:         if (!cancelled) {
   93:           setAnalytics(null);
   94:         }
   95:       } finally {
   96:         if (!cancelled) {

   98:         }

   55:   const secondsRemaining = attempt?.secondsRemaining ?? 0;
   56:   const currentQuestion = questions[currentIndex];
   57:

   60:       examTrainerQuestionBank.filter((question) => {
   61:         const topicMatches = topic === "all" || question.topic === topic;
   62:         const difficultyMatches =
   63:           difficulty === "all" || question.difficulty === difficulty;
   64: 
   65:         return topicMatches && difficultyMatches;
   66:       }).length,
   67:     [difficulty, topic],

   84:

FILE: components\lesson\PracticeQuestionCard.tsx
==============================================================================================================

    1: "use client";
    2: 
    3: import { useState } from "react";
    4: import Card from "@/components/ui/Card";
    5: import Button from "@/components/ui/Button";
    6: 
    7: type Props = {
    8:   question: string;
    9:   answer: string;
   10: };
   11: 
   12: export default function PracticeQuestionCard({ question, answer }: Props) {
   13:   const [userAnswer, setUserAnswer] = useState("");
   14:   const [checked, setChecked] = useState(false);
   15:   const [showAnswer, setShowAnswer] = useState(false);
   16: 
   17:   const isCorrect =
   18:     userAnswer.trim().toLowerCase() === answer.trim().toLowerCase();
   19: 
   20:   function handleCheckAnswer() {
   21:     setChecked(true);
   22:   }
   23: 
   24:   return (
   25:     <Card>
   26:       <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">{question}</h3>
   27: 
   28:       <input
   29:         type="text"
   30:         value={userAnswer}
   31:         onChange={(e) => setUserAnswer(e.target.value)}
   32:         placeholder="Type your answer..."
   33:         className="mt-4 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 focus:border-blue-500 focus:outline-none"
   34:       />
   35: 
   36:       <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-3">
   37:         <Button onClick={handleCheckAnswer}>Check Answer</Button>
   38: 
   39:         <Button onClick={() => setShowAnswer((prev) => !prev)}>
   40:           {showAnswer ? "Hide Answer" : "Show Answer"}
   41:         </Button>
   42:       </div>
   43: 
   44:       {checked && (
   45:         <div className="mt-4">
   46:           {isCorrect ? (
   47:             <div className="rounded-xl bg-green-50 p-4">
   48:               <p className="font-semibold text-green-700">âœ… Correct!</p>
   49: 
   50:               <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-green-600">Excellent work!</p>
   51:             </div>
   52:           ) : (
   53:             <div className="rounded-xl bg-red-50 p-4">
   54:               <p className="font-semibold text-red-700">âŒ Not quite.</p>
   55: 
   56:               <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600">
   57:                 Check the explanation above and try again.
   58:               </p>
   59:             </div>
   60:           )}
   61:         </div>
   62:       )}
   63: 
   64:       {showAnswer && (
   65:         <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 p-4">
   66:           <h4 className="font-semibold text-blue-700">Correct Answer</h4>
   67: 
   68:           <p className="mt-2 text-slate-700">{answer}</p>
   69:         </div>
   70:       )}
   71:     </Card>
   72:   );
   73: }

   61:             >
   62:               {skill}
   63:             </span>
   64:           ))}
   65:         </div>
   66:       </section>
   67: 
   68:       <section className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6">
   69:         <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-slate-950">
   70:           Visible tests
   71:         </h3>
   72: 
   73:         <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
   74:           {challenge.visibleTests.map((test) => (
   75:             <article
   76:               key={test.id}
   77:               className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 p-4"
   78:             >
   79:               <p className="font-black text-slate-800">
   80:                 {test.label}
   81:               </p>
   82:

   84:                 <div>
   85:                   <p className="font-bold text-slate-500">Input</p>

   87:                     {test.input || "(none)"}

   90:

   92:                   <p className="font-bold text-slate-500">
   93:                     Expected output

   96:                     {test.expectedOutput}
   97:                   </pre>
   98:                 </div>
   99:               </div>
  100:             </article>
  101:           ))}
  102:         </div>
  103:

  105:           <p className="mt-4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-500">
  106:             + {challenge.hiddenTests.length} hidden test
  107:             {challenge.hiddenTests.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}
  108:           </p>
  109:         )}
  110:       </section>
  111: 
  112:       {hintLevel >= 1 && (
  113:         <section className="rounded-3xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-5">
  114:           <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-amber-700">
  115:             Hint 1
  116:           </p>
  117:           <p className="mt-2 leading-7 text-amber-950">
  118:             {challenge.hint}
  119:           </p>
  120:         </section>
  121:       )}
  122: 
  123:       {hintLevel >= 2 && challenge.secondHint && (
  124:         <section className="rounded-3xl border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 p-5">
  125:           <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-orange-700">
  126:             Hint 2
  127:           </p>
  128:           <p className="mt-2 leading-7 text-orange-950">
  129:             {challenge.secondHint}
  130:           </p>

  172:               {challenge.examinerTip}
  173:             </p>
  174:           </section>
  175:         </>

  177:     </div>

    4:

    7: import ProgrammingEditor from "@/components/programming/ProgrammingEditor";

    9: import ProgrammingStats from "@/components/programming/ProgrammingStats";
   10: import SimulatorDifficulty from "@/components/Simulators/common/SimulatorDifficulty";
   11: import { useAuth } from "@/contexts/AuthContext";
   12: import { getProgrammingChallengeById } from "@/data/programming/challenges";
   13: import { useProgrammingProgress } from "@/hooks/useProgrammingProgress";
   14: import { evaluateProgrammingChallenge } from "@/lib/programming/evaluator";
   15: import { recordProgrammingAssignmentAttempt } from "@/services/programmingAssignmentService";
   16: import {
   17:   chooseNextProgrammingChallenge,
   18:   getProgrammingChallenges,

   21:

   23:   ProgrammingChallenge,
   24:   ProgrammingDifficulty,

   34:   assignmentId?: string | null;
   35:   assignmentTitle?: string;
   36: };
   37: 
   38: const exploreStarter = `name = input()
   39: print(f"Hello, {name}!")
   40: 
   41: for number in range(1, 4):
   42:     print(number)
   43: `;
   44: 
   45: const emptyRun: PythonRunResult = {
   46:   stdout: "",
   47:   stderr: "",
   48:   error: "",
   49:   timedOut: false,
   50:   durationMs: 0,
   51: };
   52: 
   53: function toQualification(
   54:   value: string | null | undefined,
   55: ): ProgrammingQualification {
   56:   return value === "A_LEVEL"
   57:     ? "A_LEVEL"
   58:     : "GCSE";
   59: }
   60: 
   61: function toExamBoard(
   62:   value: string | null | undefined,
   63: ): ProgrammingExamBoard | null {
   64:   if (
   65:     value === "AQA" ||
   66:     value === "OCR" ||
   67:     value === "EDEXCEL"
   68:   ) {
   69:     return value;
   70:   }
   71: 
   72:   return null;
   73: }
   74: 
   75: export default function ProgrammingWorkspace({
   76:   assignedChallengeId = null,
   77:   assignmentId = null,
   78:   assignmentTitle = "",
   79: }: ProgrammingWorkspaceProps = {}) {
   80:   const { user, profile } = useAuth();
   81: 
   82:   const qualification =
   83:     toQualification(
   84:       profile?.qualification,
   85:     );
   86: 
   87:   const examBoard =
   88:     toExamBoard(profile?.examBoard);
   89: 
   90:   const assignedChallenge =
   91:     useMemo(
   92:       () =>
   93:         assignedChallengeId
   94:           ? getProgrammingChallengeById(
   95:               assignedChallengeId,
   96:             )
   97:           : null,
   98:       [assignedChallengeId],
   99:     );
  100: 
  101:   const assignedMode =
  102:     Boolean(
  103:       assignmentId &&
  104:         assignedChallengeId,
  105:     );
  106: 
  107:   const [mode, setMode] =
  108:     useState<ProgrammingMode>(
  109:       assignedChallenge?.mode ??
  110:         "practice",
  111:     );
  112: 
  113:   const [difficulty, setDifficulty] =
  114:     useState<ProgrammingDifficulty>(
  115:       assignedChallenge?.difficulty ??
  116:         "foundation",
  117:     );
  118: 
  119:   const [
  120:     currentChallengeId,
  121:     setCurrentChallengeId,
  122:   ] = useState<string | null>(
  123:     assignedChallenge?.id ?? null,
  124:   );
  125: 
  126:   const progress =
  127:     useProgrammingProgress();
  128: 
  129:   useEffect(() => {
  130:     if (!assignedChallenge) return;
  131: 
  132:     let active = true;
  133: 
  134:     void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
  135:       if (!active) return;
  136: 
  137:       setMode(assignedChallenge.mode);
  138:       setDifficulty(
  139:         assignedChallenge.difficulty,
  140:       );
  141:       setCurrentChallengeId(
  142:         assignedChallenge.id,
  143:       );
  144:     });
  145: 
  146:     return () => {
  147:       active = false;
  148:     };
  149:   }, [assignedChallenge]);
  150: 
  151:   const availableChallenges =
  152:     useMemo(() => {
  153:       if (assignedMode) {
  154:         return assignedChallenge
  155:           ? [assignedChallenge]
  156:           : [];
  157:       }
  158: 
  159:       if (mode === "explore") {
  160:         return [];
  161:       }
  162: 
  163:       return getProgrammingChallenges({
  164:         qualification,
  165:         examBoard,
  166:         difficulty,
  167:         mode,
  168:       });
  169:     }, [
  170:       assignedChallenge,
  171:       assignedMode,
  172:       difficulty,
  173:       examBoard,
  174:       mode,
  175:       qualification,
  176:     ]);
  177: 
  178:   const challenge =
  179:     useMemo<ProgrammingChallenge | null>(
  180:       () => {
  181:         if (assignedMode) {
  182:           return assignedChallenge;
  183:         }
  184: 
  185:         if (mode === "explore") {
  186:           return null;
  187:         }
  188: 
  189:         const existing =
  190:           availableChallenges.find(
  191:             (item) =>
  192:               item.id ===
  193:               currentChallengeId,
  194:           ) ?? null;
  195: 
  196:         if (existing) return existing;
  197: 
  198:         return chooseNextProgrammingChallenge({
  199:           qualification,
  200:           examBoard,
  201:           difficulty,
  202:           mode,
  203:           completedChallengeIds:
  204:             progress.completedChallengeIds,
  205:           recentChallengeIds:
  206:             progress.history
  207:               .slice(0, 5)
  208:               .map(
  209:                 (item) =>
  210:                   item.challengeId,
  211:               ),
  212:           preferredWeakSkills:
  213:             progress.weakSkills,
  214:         });
  215:       },
  216:       [
  217:         assignedChallenge,
  218:         assignedMode,
  219:         availableChallenges,
  220:         currentChallengeId,
  221:         difficulty,
  222:         examBoard,
  223:         mode,
  224:         progress.completedChallengeIds,
  225:         progress.history,
  226:         progress.weakSkills,
  227:         qualification,
  228:       ],
  229:     );
  230: 
  231:   const [code, setCode] =
  232:     useState(exploreStarter);
  233: 
  234:   const [stdin, setStdin] =
  235:     useState("Ada");
  236: 
  237:   const [runResult, setRunResult] =
  238:     useState<PythonRunResult>(
  239:       emptyRun,
  240:     );
  241: 
  242:   const [
  243:     evaluation,
  244:     setEvaluation,
  245:   ] =
  246:     useState<ProgrammingEvaluation | null>(
  247:       null,
  248:     );
  249: 
  250:   const [running, setRunning] =
  251:     useState(false);
  252: 
  253:   const [checking, setChecking] =
  254:     useState(false);
  255: 
  256:   const [hintLevel, setHintLevel] =
  257:     useState<0 | 1 | 2>(0);
  258: 
  259:   const [
  260:     showExplanation,
  261:     setShowExplanation,
  262:   ] = useState(false);
  263: 
  264:   const [
  265:     statusMessage,
  266:     setStatusMessage,
  267:   ] = useState(
  268:     assignedMode
  269:       ? "Complete the assigned challenge and use Check solution when you are ready."
  270:       : "The first Python run may take longer while the browser loads the runtime.",
  271:   );
  272: 
  273:   useEffect(() => {
  274:     if (assignedMode) return;
  275: 
  276:     void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
  277:       setCurrentChallengeId(null);
  278:     });
  279:   }, [
  280:     assignedMode,
  281:     difficulty,
  282:     examBoard,
  283:     mode,
  284:     qualification,
  285:   ]);
  286: 
  287:   useEffect(() => {
  288:     void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
  289:       if (
  290:         mode === "explore" &&
  291:         !assignedMode
  292:       ) {
  293:         setCode(exploreStarter);
  294:         setStdin("Ada");
  295:       } else if (challenge) {
  296:         setCode(
  297:           challenge.starterCode,
  298:         );
  299: 
  300:         setStdin(
  301:           challenge.stdin ??
  302:             challenge.visibleTests[0]
  303:               ?.input ??
  304:             "",
  305:         );
  306: 
  307:         if (
  308:           challenge.id !==
  309:           currentChallengeId
  310:         ) {
  311:           setCurrentChallengeId(
  312:             challenge.id,
  313:           );
  314:         }
  315:       }
  316: 
  317:       setRunResult(emptyRun);
  318:       setEvaluation(null);
  319:       setHintLevel(0);
  320:       setShowExplanation(false);
  321:     });
  322:   }, [
  323:     assignedMode,
  324:     challenge,
  325:     currentChallengeId,
  326:     mode,
  327:   ]);
  328: 
  329:   async function handleRun() {
  330:     if (!code.trim()) return;
  331: 
  332:     setRunning(true);
  333:     setRunResult(emptyRun);
  334: 
  335:     setStatusMessage(
  336:       "Running Python in the browser...",
  337:     );
  338: 
  339:     try {
  340:       const result =
  341:         await runPython({
  342:           code,
  343:           stdin,
  344:           timeoutMs: 3000,
  345:         });
  346: 
  347:       setRunResult(result);
  348: 
  349:       if (result.timedOut) {
  350:         setStatusMessage(
  351:           "Execution stopped because it exceeded the time limit.",
  352:         );
  353:       } else if (
  354:         result.error ||
  355:         result.stderr
  356:       ) {
  357:         setStatusMessage(
  358:           "Python returned an error. Use the console to debug it.",
  359:         );
  360:       } else {
  361:         setStatusMessage(
  362:           "Run complete.",
  363:         );
  364:       }
  365:     } catch (error) {
  366:       setRunResult({
  367:         ...emptyRun,
  368:         error:
  369:           error instanceof Error
  370:             ? error.message
  371:             : "Python could not run.",
  372:       });
  373: 
  374:       setStatusMessage(
  375:         "The Python runtime could not start.",
  376:       );
  377:     } finally {
  378:       setRunning(false);
  379:     }
  380:   }
  381: 
  382:   async function handleCheck() {
  383:     if (
  384:       !challenge ||
  385:       !code.trim()
  386:     ) {
  387:       return;
  388:     }
  389: 
  390:     setChecking(true);
  391:     setEvaluation(null);
  392:     setShowExplanation(false);
  393: 
  394:     setStatusMessage(
  395:       "Checking visible and hidden tests...",
  396:     );
  397: 
  398:     try {
  399:       const result =
  400:         await evaluateProgrammingChallenge(
  401:           challenge,
  402:           code,
  403:         );
  404: 
  405:       setEvaluation(result);
  406: 
  407:       const awarded =
  408:         progress.recordAttempt(
  409:           challenge,
  410:           result.passed,
  411:         );
  412: 
  413:       if (
  414:         assignedMode &&
  415:         assignmentId &&
  416:         user?.uid
  417:       ) {
  418:         await recordProgrammingAssignmentAttempt(

   35: const DEFAULT_QUIZ_DURATION_SECONDS = 8 * 60;
   36: const FULLSCREEN_EXIT_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS = 5;
   37: 
   38: function parseQuizDurationSeconds(value: string): number {
   39:   const normalised = value.trim().toLowerCase();
   40: 
   41:   if (!normalised) {
   42:     return DEFAULT_QUIZ_DURATION_SECONDS;
   43:   }
   44: 
   45:   const hoursMatch = normalised.match(
   46:     /(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:hours?|hrs?|hr|h)\b/,
   47:   );
   48: 
   49:   const minutesMatch = normalised.match(
   50:     /(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:minutes?|mins?|min|m)\b/,
   51:   );
   52: 
   53:   const secondsMatch = normalised.match(
   54:     /(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*(?:seconds?|secs?|sec|s)\b/,
   55:   );
   56: 
   57:   const hours = hoursMatch ? Number(hoursMatch[1]) : 0;
   58:   const minutes = minutesMatch ? Number(minutesMatch[1]) : 0;
   59:   const seconds = secondsMatch ? Number(secondsMatch[1]) : 0;
   60: 
   61:   const totalSeconds = Math.round(
   62:     hours * 60 * 60 +
   63:       minutes * 60 +
   64:       seconds,
   65:   );
   66: 
   67:   return totalSeconds > 0
   68:     ? totalSeconds
   69:     : DEFAULT_QUIZ_DURATION_SECONDS;
   70: }
   71: 
   72: function getGrade(scorePercent: number) {
   73:   if (scorePercent >= 90) return "Grade 9";
   74:   if (scorePercent >= 80) return "Grade 8";
   75:   if (scorePercent >= 70) return "Grade 7";
   76:   if (scorePercent >= 60) return "Grade 6";
   77:   if (scorePercent >= 50) return "Grade 5";
   78:   if (scorePercent >= 40) return "Grade 4";
   79:   if (scorePercent >= 30) return "Grade 3";
   80:   if (scorePercent >= 20) return "Grade 2";
   81:   return "Grade 1";
   82: }
   83: 
   84: function getMessage(scorePercent: number) {
   85:   if (scorePercent >= 90) return "Outstanding performance!";
   86:   if (scorePercent >= 75) return "Excellent work!";
   87:   if (scorePercent >= 60) return "Good progress!";
   88:   if (scorePercent >= 40) return "You are getting there.";
   89:   return "Keep practising. You can improve this.";
   90: }

   92: function createIncident(
   93:   type: QuizIntegrityIncident["type"],
   94:   questionNumber: number | null,
   95:   detail: string,
   96: ): QuizIntegrityIncident {
   97:   return {
   98:     id: `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9)}`,
   99:     type,
  100:     occurredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  101:     questionNumber,
  102:     detail,
  103:   };
  104: }

  106: export default function QuizPlayer({ quiz }: Props) {
  107:   const { user } = useAuth();

  112:   const quizDurationSeconds = useMemo(
  113:     () => parseQuizDurationSeconds(quiz.estimatedTime),
  114:     [quiz.estimatedTime],
  115:   );
  116: 
  117:   const assessmentRootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  119:   const assignmentSaveInProgress = useRef(false);
  120:   const finishingRef = useRef(false);
  121: 
  122:   /*

  128:   const integrityTerminatedRef = useRef(false);
  129: 
  130:   const fullscreenExitActiveRef = useRef(false);

  132:   const integrityIncidentsRef = useRef<QuizIntegrityIncident[]>([]);
  133:

  136:   const [showResults, setShowResults] = useState(false);
  137:   const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState(() => quizDurationSeconds);
  138:   const [resultSaved, setResultSaved] = useState(false);
  139:   const [assignmentResultSaved, setAssignmentResultSaved] = useState(false);

  142:     useState<LinkedAssignment | null>(null);

  144:   const [assignmentError, setAssignmentError] = useState("");

  146:   const [integrityStarted, setIntegrityStarted] = useState(false);
  147:   const [integritySessionStartedAt, setIntegritySessionStartedAt] =
  148:     useState<string | null>(null);
  149:   const [fullscreenCountdown, setFullscreenCountdown] =
  150:     useState<number | null>(null);

  153:   const [integrityTerminationReason, setIntegrityTerminationReason] =
  154:     useState("");

  156:   const deliveryMode: QuizDeliveryMode =
  157:     linkedAssignment?.deliveryMode ?? "practice";

  159:     Boolean(assignmentId) && deliveryMode === "assessment";
  160: 
  161:   const currentQuestion = quiz.questions[currentIndex];
  162:   const selectedAnswer = currentQuestion
  163:     ? answers[currentQuestion.id] || ""
  164:     : "";
  165: 
  166:   const currentQuestionNumber = currentIndex + 1;
  167: 
  168:   const progress = Math.round(
  169:     ((currentIndex + 1) / Math.max(1, quiz.questions.length)) * 100,
  170:   );
  171: 
  172:   const totalXP = useMemo(() => {
  173:     return quiz.questions.reduce(
  174:       (total, question) => total + question.xpReward,
  175:       0,
  176:     );
  177:   }, [quiz.questions]);
  178: 
  179:   const correctCount = quiz.questions.filter((question) => {
  180:     const userAnswer = answers[question.id]?.trim().toLowerCase();
  181:     const correctAnswer = question.correctAnswer.trim().toLowerCase();
  182:     return userAnswer === correctAnswer;
  183:   }).length;
  184: 
  185:   const scorePercent = Math.round(
  186:     (correctCount / Math.max(1, quiz.questions.length)) * 100,
  187:   );
  188: 
  189:   const earnedXP = quiz.questions.reduce((total, question) => {
  190:     const userAnswer = answers[question.id]?.trim().toLowerCase();
  191:     const correctAnswer = question.correctAnswer.trim().toLowerCase();
  192: 
  193:     return userAnswer === correctAnswer
  194:       ? total + question.xpReward
  195:       : total;
  196:   }, 0);
  197: 
  198:   /*
  199:    * Integrity-terminated assessment attempts retain their raw score for
  200:    * teacher evidence, but do not award XP.
  201:    */
  202:   const awardedXP = integrityTerminated ? 0 : earnedXP;
  203: 
  204:   const strengths = quiz.questions
  205:     .filter((question) => {
  206:       const userAnswer = answers[question.id]?.trim().toLowerCase();
  207:       const correctAnswer = question.correctAnswer.trim().toLowerCase();
  208:       return userAnswer === correctAnswer;
  209:     })
  210:     .slice(0, 3);
  211: 
  212:   const needsPractice = quiz.questions
  213:     .filter((question) => {
  214:       const userAnswer = answers[question.id]?.trim().toLowerCase();
  215:       const correctAnswer = question.correctAnswer.trim().toLowerCase();
  216:       return userAnswer !== correctAnswer;
  217:     })
  218:     .slice(0, 3);
  219: 
  220:   useEffect(() => {
  221:     let cancelled = false;
  222: 
  223:     async function loadLinkedAssignment() {
  224:       if (!assignmentId) {
  225:         setLinkedAssignment(null);
  226:         setAssignmentLoading(false);
  227:         return;
  228:       }
  229: 
  230:       try {
  231:         setAssignmentLoading(true);
  232:         setAssignmentError("");
  233: 
  234:         const snapshot = await getDoc(doc(db, "assignments", assignmentId));
  235: 
  236:         if (!snapshot.exists()) {
  237:           throw new Error("The linked quiz assignment could not be found.");
  238:         }
  239: 
  240:         const data = snapshot.data();
  241: 
  242:         if (data.type !== "quiz") {
  243:           throw new Error("This assignment is not a quiz assignment.");
  244:         }
  245: 
  246:         if (!data.classId || !data.teacherId) {
  247:           throw new Error(
  248:             "The assignment is missing its class or teacher information.",
  249:           );
  250:         }
  251: 
  252:         if (!cancelled) {
  253:           setLinkedAssignment({

  255:             classId: data.classId,
  256:             teacherId: data.teacherId,
  257:             resourceId: data.resourceId || quiz.topicId,
  258:             deliveryMode:
  259:               data.deliveryMode === "assessment" ? "assessment" : "practice",
  260:           });
  261:         }
  262:       } catch (error) {
  263:         console.error("Quiz assignment load error:", error);
  264: 
  265:         if (!cancelled) {
  266:           setAssignmentError(
  267:             error instanceof Error
  268:               ? error.message
  269:               : "The linked quiz assignment could not be loaded.",
  270:           );
  271:         }
  272:       } finally {
  273:         if (!cancelled) {
  274:           setAssignmentLoading(false);
  275:         }
  276:       }
  277:     }
  278: 
  279:     void loadLinkedAssignment();
  280: 
  281:     return () => {
  282:       cancelled = true;
  283:     };
  284:   }, [assignmentId, quiz.topicId]);
  285: 
  286:   useEffect(() => {
  287:     void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
  288:       setTimeLeft(quizDurationSeconds);
  289:     });
  290:   }, [quiz.id, quizDurationSeconds]);
  291: 
  292:   useEffect(() => {
  293:     return () => {
  294:       if (countdownTimerRef.current) {
  295:         clearInterval(countdownTimerRef.current);
  296:       }
  297:     };

  316:   async function leaveFullscreenSafely() {

  322:   async function finishQuiz({
  323:     terminated = false,
  324:     reason = "",
  325:   }: {
  326:     terminated?: boolean;
  327:     reason?: string;
  328:   } = {}) {
  329:     if (finishingRef.current || showResults) {
  330:       return;
  331:     }
  332: 
  333:     finishingRef.current = true;
  334: 
  335:     if (countdownTimerRef.current) {
  336:       clearInterval(countdownTimerRef.current);
  337:       countdownTimerRef.current = null;
  338:     }

  341:     setFullscreenCountdown(null);
  342: 
  343:     if (terminated) {
  344:       /*
  345:        * Set the ref first so save effects see termination synchronously,
  346:        * before React finishes applying the state update.
  347:        */
  348:       integrityTerminatedRef.current = true;
  349:       setIntegrityTerminated(true);
  350:       setIntegrityTerminationReason(reason);
  351: 
  352:       appendIntegrityIncident(
  353:         "auto_submit",
  354:         reason || "The assessment was automatically submitted.",
  355:       );
  356:     }
  357: 
  358:     await leaveFullscreenSafely();
  359:     setShowResults(true);
  360:   }

  362:   const finishQuizFromTimer = useEffectEvent(
  363:     (options: { terminated?: boolean; reason?: string }) => {
  364:       void finishQuiz(options);
  365:     },
  366:   );

  368:   useEffect(() => {

  378:       setTimeLeft((previousTime) => {

  382:           finishQuizFromTimer({
  383:             terminated: assessmentMode,
  384:             reason: assessmentMode
  385:               ? "The assessment timer expired and the quiz was automatically submitted."
  386:               : "",
  387:           });
  388: 
  389:           return 0;
  390:         }
  391: 
  392:         return previousTime - 1;
  393:       });
  394:     }, 1000);
  395: 
  396:     return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  397:   }, [

  404:   function beginFullscreenCountdown() {
  405:     if (
  406:       !assessmentMode ||
  407:       !integrityStarted ||
  408:       showResults ||
  409:       finishingRef.current ||
  410:       fullscreenExitActiveRef.current
  411:     ) {
  412:       return;
  413:     }

  416: 
  417:     setFullscreenCountdown(FULLSCREEN_EXIT_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS);
  418: 
  419:     appendIntegrityIncident(
  420:       "fullscreen_exit",
  421:       `Fullscreen was exited. A ${FULLSCREEN_EXIT_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS}-second return countdown started.`,
  422:     );
  423: 
  424:     let remaining = FULLSCREEN_EXIT_COUNTDOWN_SECONDS;
  425: 
  426:     countdownTimerRef.current = setInterval(() => {
  427:       remaining -= 1;
  428:       setFullscreenCountdown(Math.max(remaining, 0));
  429: 
  430:       if (remaining <= 0) {
  431:         if (countdownTimerRef.current) {
  432:           clearInterval(countdownTimerRef.current);
  433:           countdownTimerRef.current = null;
  434:         }
  435: 
  436:         void finishQuiz({
  437:           terminated: true,
  438:           reason:
  439:             "The learner exited fullscreen and did not return within 5 seconds.",
  440:         });
  441:       }
  442:     }, 1000);
  443:   }
  444: 
  445:   function resolveFullscreenExit() {
  446:     if (!fullscreenExitActiveRef.current) {
  447:       return;
  448:     }
  449: 
  450:     fullscreenExitActiveRef.current = false;
  451: 
  452:     if (countdownTimerRef.current) {
  453:       clearInterval(countdownTimerRef.current);
  454:       countdownTimerRef.current = null;
  455:     }
  456: 
  457:     setFullscreenCountdown(null);
  458: 
  459:     appendIntegrityIncident(
  460:       "fullscreen_restored",
  461:       "Fullscreen was restored before the five-second termination countdown expired.",
  462:     );
  463:   }
  464: 
  465:   const handleFullscreenChange = useEffectEvent(() => {
  466:     if (finishingRef.current) {
  467:       return;
  468:     }
  469: 
  470:     if (
  471:       document.fullscreenElement ===
  472:       assessmentRootRef.current
  473:     ) {
  474:       resolveFullscreenExit();
  475:     } else {
  476:       beginFullscreenCountdown();
  477:     }
  478:   });
  479: 
  480:   const handleVisibilityChange = useEffectEvent(() => {
  481:     if (finishingRef.current) {
  482:       return;
  483:     }
  484: 
  485:     if (document.visibilityState === "hidden") {
  486:       appendIntegrityIncident(
  487:         "page_hidden",
  488:         "The assessment page became hidden.",
  489:       );

  491:       setIntegrityWarning(
  492:         "The assessment page was hidden. This incident has been recorded.",
  493:       );
  494:     } else {
  495:       appendIntegrityIncident(
  496:         "page_visible",
  497:         "The assessment page became visible again.",
  498:       );
  499:     }
  500:   });
  501: 
  502:   useEffect(() => {
  503:     if (
  504:       !assessmentMode ||
  505:       !integrityStarted ||
  506:       showResults
  507:     ) {
  508:       return;
  509:     }
  510: 
  511:     function onFullscreenChange() {
  512:       handleFullscreenChange();
  513:     }
  514: 
  515:     function onVisibilityChange() {
  516:       handleVisibilityChange();
  517:     }
  518: 
  519:     document.addEventListener(
  520:       "fullscreenchange",
  521:       onFullscreenChange,
  522:     );
  523:     document.addEventListener(
  524:       "visibilitychange",
  525:       onVisibilityChange,
  526:     );
  527: 
  528:     return () => {
  529:       document.removeEventListener(
  530:         "fullscreenchange",
  531:         onFullscreenChange,
  532:       );
  533:       document.removeEventListener(
  534:         "visibilitychange",
  535:         onVisibilityChange,
  536:       );
  537:     };
  538:   }, [

  540:     integrityStarted,
  541:     showResults,

  544:   async function enterAssessmentMode() {
  545:     if (!assessmentRootRef.current) {
  546:       return;

  548:

  562:       setIntegrityWarning("");

  572:         "Unable to enter monitored assessment mode:",

  577:         "Fullscreen assessment mode could not be started.",
  578:       );
  579:     }

  742:

  744:       .toString()
  745:       .padStart(2, "0")}`;

  748:   function saveAnswer(answer: string) {
  749:     if (assessmentMode && !integrityStarted) {
  750:       return;
  751:     }
  752: 
  753:     setAnswers((previousAnswers) => ({
  754:       ...previousAnswers,

  759:   function goNext() {
  760:     if (currentIndex < quiz.questions.length - 1) {
  761:       setCurrentIndex((previousIndex) => previousIndex + 1);
  762:       setIntegrityWarning("");
  763:       return;
  764:     }
  765: 
  766:     void finishQuiz();

  769:   function goPrevious() {

  771:       setCurrentIndex((previousIndex) => previousIndex - 1);
  772:       setIntegrityWarning("");
  773:     }
  774:   }
  775: 
  776:   if (assignmentLoading) {

  778:       <Card>

  780:           Preparing your assigned quiz...
  781:         </p>
  782:       </Card>
  783:     );
  784:   }
  785: 
  786:   if (assignmentError) {

  789:         <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-950">
  790:           Quiz assignment unavailable
  791:         </h1>
  792: 
  793:         <p className="mt-3 text-red-700">
  794:           {assignmentError}
  795:         </p>
  796:       </Card>
  797:     );
  798:   }
  799: 
  800:   if (
  801:     assessmentMode &&

   39: ): number =>
   40:   typeof value === "number" &&
   41:   Number.isFinite(value)
   42:     ? value
   43:     : 0;
   44: 
   45: const average = (
   46:   values: number[],
   47: ): number =>
   48:   values.length
   49:     ? Math.round(
   50:         values.reduce(
   51:           (sum, value) =>
   52:             sum + value,
   53:           0,
   54:         ) / values.length,
   55:       )
   56:     : 0;
   57: 
   58: function groupEvidence(
   59:   evidence: AdaptiveEvidence[],
   60: ) {
   61:   const groups =
   62:     new Map<
   63:       string,
   64:       AdaptiveEvidence[]
   65:     >();
   66: 
   67:   evidence.forEach((item) => {
   68:     const normalised =
   69:       normaliseTopic(item.topic);
   70: 
   71:     const existing =
   72:       groups.get(
   73:         normalised.topicTitle,
   74:       ) || [];
   75: 
   76:     groups.set(
   77:       normalised.topicTitle,
   78:       [
   79:         ...existing,
   80:         {
   81:           ...item,
   82:           topic:
   83:             normalised.topicTitle,
   84:         },
   85:       ],
   86:     );
   87:   });
   88: 
   89:   return Array.from(
   90:     groups.entries(),
   91:   ).map(
   92:     ([topic, items]) => ({
   93:       topic,
   94:       evidence: items,
   95:     }),
   96:   );
   97: }
   98: 
   99: function resolveRawTopic(
  100:   data: Record<string, unknown>,
  101:   fallback = "",
  102: ): string {
  103:   return (
  104:     safeString(
  105:       data.topicTitle,
  106:     ) ||
  107:     safeString(
  108:       data.topic,
  109:     ) ||
  110:     safeString(
  111:       data.curriculumTopic,
  112:     ) ||
  113:     safeString(
  114:       data.quizTitle,
  115:     ) ||
  116:     safeString(
  117:       data.title,
  118:       fallback,
  119:     )
  120:   );
  121: }
  122: 
  123: /*
  124:  * Generic labels describe an assessment type rather than
  125:  * an actual Computer Science curriculum topic.
  126:  *
  127:  * These must never become mastery topics.
  128:  */
  129: function isGenericAssessmentTopic(
  130:   value: string,
  131: ): boolean {
  132:   const normalised = value
  133:     .trim()
  134:     .toLowerCase()
  135:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ")
  136:     .trim();
  137: 
  138:   return [
  139:     "",
  140:     "quiz",
  141:     "assigned quiz",
  142:     "ai quiz",
  143:     "assessment",
  144:     "assigned assessment",
  145:     "practice quiz",
  146:     "exam",
  147:     "written exam",
  148:   ].includes(normalised);
  149: }
  150: 
  151: /*
  152:  * Assignment titles frequently contain presentational suffixes,
  153:  * for example:
  154:  *
  155:  * "character encoding Demo Quiz"
  156:  * "memory and storage Demo Quiz"
  157:  * "merge sort Demo Quiz"
  158:  *
  159:  * Removing those suffixes gives topicNormalisationService a much
  160:  * cleaner curriculum phrase to resolve.
  161:  */
  162: function cleanAssignmentTitle(
  163:   value: string,
  164: ): string {
  165:   return value
  166:     .trim()
  167:     .replace(
  168:       /\s+(demo\s+)?quiz$/i,
  169:       "",
  170:     )
  171:     .replace(
  172:       /\s+practice\s+quiz$/i,
  173:       "",
  174:     )
  175:     .replace(
  176:       /\s+assessment$/i,
  177:       "",
  178:     )
  179:     .trim();
  180: }
  181: 
  182: type AssignmentTopicMetadata = {
  183:   topic: string;
  184:   title: string;
  185: };
  186: 
  187: async function loadAssignmentTopicMetadata(
  188:   assignmentIds: string[],
  189: ): Promise<
  190:   Map<
  191:     string,
  192:     AssignmentTopicMetadata
  193:   >
  194: > {
  195:   const uniqueIds =
  196:     Array.from(
  197:       new Set(
  198:         assignmentIds
  199:           .map((id) =>
  200:             id.trim(),
  201:           )
  202:           .filter(Boolean),
  203:       ),
  204:     );
  205: 
  206:   const entries =
  207:     await Promise.all(
  208:       uniqueIds.map(
  209:         async (
  210:           assignmentId,
  211:         ) => {
  212:           try {
  213:             const snapshot =
  214:               await getDoc(
  215:                 doc(
  216:                   db,
  217:                   "assignments",
  218:                   assignmentId,
  219:                 ),
  220:               );
  221: 
  222:             if (
  223:               !snapshot.exists()
  224:             ) {
  225:               return [
  226:                 assignmentId,
  227:                 {
  228:                   topic: "",
  229:                   title: "",
  230:                 },
  231:               ] as const;
  232:             }
  233: 
  234:             const data =
  235:               snapshot.data();
  236: 
  237:             return [
  238:               assignmentId,
  239:               {
  240:                 topic:
  241:                   resolveRawTopic(
  242:                     data,
  243:                   ),
  244:                 title:
  245:                   safeString(
  246:                     data.title,
  247:                   ),
  248:               },
  249:             ] as const;
  250:           } catch (
  251:             caughtError
  252:           ) {
  253:             /*
  254:              * A missing/legacy assignment should not prevent the
  255:              * rest of the student's adaptive plan from loading.
  256:              */
  257:             console.warn(
  258:               `Unable to resolve adaptive topic for assignment ${assignmentId}:`,
  259:               caughtError,
  260:             );
  261: 
  262:             return [
  263:               assignmentId,
  264:               {
  265:                 topic: "",
  266:                 title: "",
  267:               },
  268:             ] as const;
  269:           }
  270:         },
  271:       ),
  272:     );
  273: 
  274:   return new Map(entries);
  275: }
  276: 
  277: function resolveAssignedQuizTopic({
  278:   resultData,
  279:   assignmentMetadata,
  280: }: {
  281:   resultData: Record<
  282:     string,
  283:     unknown
  284:   >;
  285: 
  286:   assignmentMetadata:
  287:     AssignmentTopicMetadata | null;
  288: }): string | null {
  289:   /*
  290:    * First preference:
  291:    * explicit curriculum/topic metadata stored directly on
  292:    * the result.
  293:    */
  294:   const resultTopic =
  295:     resolveRawTopic(
  296:       resultData,
  297:     );
  298: 
  299:   if (
  300:     resultTopic &&
  301:     !isGenericAssessmentTopic(
  302:       resultTopic,
  303:     )
  304:   ) {
  305:     return cleanAssignmentTitle(
  306:       resultTopic,
  307:     );
  308:   }
  309: 
  310:   /*
  311:    * Second preference:
  312:    * topic metadata on the original assignment.
  313:    */
  314:   const assignmentTopic =
  315:     assignmentMetadata?.topic ||
  316:     "";
  317: 
  318:   if (
  319:     assignmentTopic &&
  320:     !isGenericAssessmentTopic(
  321:       assignmentTopic,
  322:     )
  323:   ) {
  324:     return cleanAssignmentTitle(
  325:       assignmentTopic,
  326:     );
  327:   }
  328: 
  329:   /*
  330:    * Third preference:
  331:    * derive the curriculum topic from the original assignment
  332:    * title.
  333:    *
  334:    * Example:
  335:    * "character encoding Demo Quiz"
  336:    *          ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Â Ã¢â‚¬Å“
  337:    * "character encoding"
  338:    *          ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬Â Ã¢â‚¬Å“
  339:    * topicNormalisationService
  340:    */
  341:   const assignmentTitle =
  342:     cleanAssignmentTitle(
  343:       assignmentMetadata?.title ||
  344:         "",
  345:     );
  346: 
  347:   if (
  348:     assignmentTitle &&
  349:     !isGenericAssessmentTopic(
  350:       assignmentTitle,
  351:     )
  352:   ) {
  353:     return assignmentTitle;
  354:   }
  355: 
  356:   /*
  357:    * Do NOT create fake mastery evidence such as "Assigned Quiz".
  358:    *
  359:    * The result remains stored normally in Firestore and can still
  360:    * contribute to assignment history/markbooks. It simply cannot
  361:    * be attributed to curriculum mastery until a real topic can be
  362:    * identified.
  363:    */
  364:   return null;
  365: }
  366: 
  367: export async function getAdaptiveLearningPlan(
  368:   studentId: string,
  369: ): Promise<AdaptiveLearningPlan> {
  370:   const id =
  371:     studentId.trim();
  372: 
  373:   if (!id) {
  374:     throw new Error(
  375:       "A valid student account is required.",
  376:     );
  377:   }
  378: 
  379:   const [
  380:     profile,
  381:     quizSnapshot,
  382:     assignedQuizSnapshot,
  383:     examAssignments,
  384:     interventions,
  385:   ] = await Promise.all([
  386:     getUserProfile(id),
  387: 
  388:     getDocs(
  389:       query(
  390:         collection(
  391:           db,
  392:           "users",
  393:           id,
  394:           "quizResults",
  395:         ),
  396:         orderBy(
  397:           "createdAt",
  398:           "desc",
  399:         ),
  400:       ),
  401:     ),
  402: 
  403:     getDocs(
  404:       query(
  405:         collection(
  406:           db,
  407:           "assignmentResults",
  408:         ),
  409:         where(
  410:           "studentId",
  411:           "==",
  412:           id,
  413:         ),
  414:       ),
  415:     ),
  416: 
  417:     getStudentExamAssignments(
  418:       id,
  419:     ),
  420: 
  421:     getStudentInterventions(
  422:       id,
  423:     ),
  424:   ]);
  425: 
  426:   if (!profile) {
  427:     throw new Error(
  428:       "The student profile could not be loaded.",
  429:     );
  430:   }
  431: 
  432:   const evidence:
  433:     AdaptiveEvidence[] = [];
  434: 
  435:   /*
  436:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  437:    * NORMAL QUIZ EVIDENCE
  438:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  439:    */
  440:   quizSnapshot.docs.forEach(
  441:     (document) => {
  442:       const data =
  443:         document.data();
  444: 
  445:       const topic =
  446:         resolveRawTopic(
  447:           data,
  448:           "Quiz",
  449:         );
  450: 
  451:       /*
  452:        * Avoid producing a generic "Quiz" mastery topic.
  453:        */
  454:       if (
  455:         isGenericAssessmentTopic(
  456:           topic,
  457:         )
  458:       ) {
  459:         return;
  460:       }
  461: 
  462:       evidence.push({
  463:         id:
  464:           `quiz-${document.id}`,
  465: 
  466:         topic:
  467:           cleanAssignmentTitle(
  468:             topic,
  469:           ),
  470: 
  471:         source: "quiz",
  472: 
  473:         score:
  474:           safeNumber(
  475:             data.scorePercent,
  476:           ),
  477: 
  478:         completedAt:
  479:           data.createdAt instanceof
  480:           Timestamp
  481:             ? data.createdAt.toDate()
  482:             : null,
  483: 
  484:         weight: 1,
  485:       });
  486:     },
  487:   );
  488: 
  489:   /*
  490:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  491:    * ASSIGNED QUIZ EVIDENCE
  492:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  493:    *
  494:    * assignmentResults often contain score/result information but
  495:    * not enough curriculum metadata. Resolve the original assignment
  496:    * so its real topic/title can be used.
  497:    */
  498:   const assignedQuizAssignmentIds =
  499:     assignedQuizSnapshot.docs
  500:       .map((document) =>
  501:         safeString(
  502:           document.data()
  503:             .assignmentId,
  504:         ),
  505:       )
  506:       .filter(Boolean);
  507: 
  508:   const assignmentMetadata =
  509:     await loadAssignmentTopicMetadata(
  510:       assignedQuizAssignmentIds,
  511:     );
  512: 
  513:   assignedQuizSnapshot.docs.forEach(
  514:     (document) => {
  515:       const data =
  516:         document.data();
  517: 
  518:       const assignmentId =
  519:         safeString(
  520:           data.assignmentId,
  521:         );
  522: 
  523:       const topic =
  524:         resolveAssignedQuizTopic({
  525:           resultData: data,
  526: 
  527:           assignmentMetadata:
  528:             assignmentMetadata.get(
  529:               assignmentId,
  530:             ) || null,
  531:         });
  532: 
  533:       if (!topic) {
  534:         console.warn(
  535:           `Assigned quiz result ${document.id} has no resolvable curriculum topic and was excluded from topic mastery.`,
  536:         );
  537: 
  538:         return;
  539:       }
  540: 
  541:       evidence.push({
  542:         id:
  543:           `assigned-quiz-${document.id}`,
  544: 
  545:         topic,
  546: 
  547:         source: "quiz",
  548: 
  549:         score:
  550:           safeNumber(
  551:             data.percentage,
  552:           ),
  553: 
  554:         completedAt:
  555:           data.completedAt instanceof
  556:           Timestamp
  557:             ? data.completedAt.toDate()
  558:             : null,
  559: 
  560:         weight: 1.1,
  561:       });
  562:     },
  563:   );
  564: 
  565:   /*
  566:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  567:    * WRITTEN EXAM EVIDENCE
  568:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  569:    */
  570:   const submissions =
  571:     await Promise.all(
  572:       examAssignments.map(
  573:         (assignment) =>
  574:           getExamSubmission(
  575:             assignment.id,
  576:             id,
  577:           ),
  578:       ),
  579:     );
  580: 
  581:   examAssignments.forEach(
  582:     (
  583:       assignment,
  584:       index,
  585:     ) => {
  586:       const submission =
  587:         submissions[index];
  588: 
  589:       if (
  590:         !submission ||
  591:         submission.status !==
  592:           "marked"
  593:       ) {
  594:         return;
  595:       }
  596: 
  597:       const examTopic =
  598:         assignment
  599:           .questionSetSnapshot
  600:           .topic ||
  601:         assignment
  602:           .questionSetTitle ||
  603:         assignment.title;
  604: 
  605:       if (
  606:         isGenericAssessmentTopic(
  607:           examTopic,
  608:         )
  609:       ) {
  610:         return;
  611:       }
  612: 
  613:       evidence.push({
  614:         id:
  615:           `exam-${assignment.id}`,
  616: 
  617:         topic:
  618:           cleanAssignmentTitle(
  619:             examTopic,
  620:           ),
  621: 
  622:         source: "exam",
  623: 
  624:         score:
  625:           submission.percentage,
  626: 
  627:         completedAt:
  628:           submission.markedAt,
  629: 
  630:         weight: 1.4,
  631:       });
  632:     },
  633:   );
  634: 
  635:   /*
  636:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  637:    * INTERVENTION EVIDENCE
  638:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  639:    */
  640:   interventions.forEach(
  641:     (intervention) => {
  642:       const completedSteps =
  643:         intervention.steps.filter(
  644:           (step) =>
  645:             step.status ===
  646:             "completed",
  647:         ).length;
  648: 
  649:       if (!completedSteps) {
  650:         return;
  651:       }
  652: 
  653:       if (
  654:         isGenericAssessmentTopic(
  655:           intervention.topic,
  656:         )
  657:       ) {
  658:         return;
  659:       }
  660: 
  661:       evidence.push({
  662:         id:
  663:           `intervention-${intervention.id}`,
  664: 
  665:         topic:
  666:           intervention.topic,
  667: 
  668:         source:
  669:           "intervention",
  670: 
  671:         score:
  672:           intervention.currentScore ||
  673:           intervention.baselineScore,
  674: 
  675:         completedAt:
  676:           intervention.updatedAt ||
  677:           intervention.completedAt,
  678: 
  679:         weight: 0.8,
  680:       });
  681:     },
  682:   );
  683: 
  684:   /*
  685:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  686:    * LESSON EVIDENCE
  687:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  688:    */
  689:   profile.completedLessons.forEach(
  690:     (
  691:       lessonId,
  692:       index,
  693:     ) => {
  694:       if (
  695:         !lessonId.trim()
  696:       ) {
  697:         return;
  698:       }
  699: 
  700:       evidence.push({
  701:         id:
  702:           `lesson-${index}-${lessonId}`,
  703: 
  704:         topic: lessonId,
  705: 
  706:         source: "lesson",
  707: 
  708:         score: 60,
  709: 
  710:         completedAt: null,
  711: 
  712:         weight: 0.25,
  713:       });
  714:     },
  715:   );
  716: 
  717:   /*
  718:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  719:    * MASTERY + RECOMMENDATIONS
  720:    * ------------------------------------------------------------
  721:    */
  722:   const topics =
  723:     buildTopicMastery(
  724:       groupEvidence(
  725:         evidence,
  726:       ),
  727:     );
  728: 
  729:   const actions =
  730:     buildAdaptiveActions(
  731:       topics,
  732:     );
  733: 
  734:   const assessedTopics =
  735:     topics.filter(
  736:       (topic) =>
  737:         topic.attempts > 0,
  738:     );
  739: 
  740:   const overallMastery =
  741:     average(
  742:       assessedTopics.map(
  743:         (topic) =>
  744:           topic.masteryScore,
  745:       ),
  746:     );
  747: 
  748:   const confidence =
  749:     average(
  750:       assessedTopics.map(
  751:         (topic) =>
  752:           topic.confidenceScore,
  753:       ),
  754:     );
  755: 
  756:   const examReadiness =
  757:     average(
  758:       assessedTopics.map(
  759:         (topic) =>
  760:           Math.round(
  761:             topic.masteryScore *
  762:               0.75 +
  763:               topic.confidenceScore *
  764:                 0.25,
  765:           ),
  766:       ),
  767:     );
  768: 
  769:   const recentTrend =
  770:     average(
  771:       assessedTopics.map(
  772:         (topic) =>
  773:           topic.trend,
  774:       ),
  775:     );
  776: 
  777:   const predictedScore =
  778:     Math.max(
  779:       0,
  780:       Math.min(
  781:         100,
  782:         examReadiness +
  783:           Math.round(
  784:             recentTrend *
  785:               0.25,
  786:           ),
  787:       ),
  788:     );
  789: 
  790:   return {
  791:     studentId: id,
  792: 
  793:     generatedAt:
  794:       new Date(),
  795: 
  796:     overallMastery,
  797: 
  798:     examReadiness,
  799: 
  800:     confidence,
  801: 
  802:     currentGrade:
  803:       indicativeGradeFromPercentage(
  804:         examReadiness,
  805:         profile?.qualification,
  806:       ),
  807: 
  808:     predictedGrade:
  809:       indicativeGradeFromPercentage(
  810:         predictedScore,
  811:         profile?.qualification,
  812:       ),
  813: 
  814:     dueForReviewCount:
  815:       topics.filter(
  816:         (topic) =>
  817:           topic.nextReviewAt.getTime() <=
  818:           Date.now(),
  819:       ).length,
  820: 
  821:     priorityTopicCount:
  822:       topics.filter(
  823:         (topic) =>
  824:           topic.state ===
  825:             "priority" ||
  826:           topic.state ===
  827:             "forgetting-risk",
  828:       ).length,
  829: 
  830:     secureTopicCount:
  831:       topics.filter(
  832:         (topic) =>
  833:           topic.state ===
  834:             "secure" ||
  835:           topic.state ===
  836:             "mastered",
  837:       ).length,
  838: 
  839:     nextAction:
  840:       actions[0] || null,
  841: 
  842:     actions,
  843: 
  844:     topics,
  845:   };
  846: }

   10:   calculateDaysSince,
