   14: 
   15: type TopicEvidenceGroup = {
   16:   topic: string;
   17:   evidence: AdaptiveEvidence[];
   18: };
   19: 
   20: const clamp = (
   21:   value: number,
   22: ) =>
   23:   Math.max(
   24:     0,
   25:     Math.min(
   26:       100,
   27:       value,
   28:     ),
   29:   );
   30: 
   31: function weightedAverage(
   32:   evidence: AdaptiveEvidence[],
   33: ): number {
   34:   const scored =
   35:     evidence.filter(
   36:       (item) =>
   37:         typeof item.score ===
   38:         "number",
   39:     );
   40: 
   41:   const totalWeight =
   42:     scored.reduce(
   43:       (sum, item) =>
   44:         sum + item.weight,
   45:       0,
   46:     );
   47: 
   48:   if (
   49:     !scored.length ||
   50:     totalWeight === 0
   51:   ) {
   52:     return 0;
   53:   }
   54: 
   55:   return Math.round(
   56:     scored.reduce(
   57:       (sum, item) =>
   58:         sum +
   59:         (item.score || 0) *
   60:           item.weight,
   61:       0,
   62:     ) /
   63:       totalWeight,
   64:   );
   65: }
   66: 
   67: function scoreSequence(
   68:   evidence: AdaptiveEvidence[],
   69: ): number[] {
   70:   return evidence
   71:     .filter(
   72:       (item) =>
   73:         typeof item.score ===
   74:           "number" &&
   75:         item.completedAt,
   76:     )
   77:     .sort(
   78:       (
   79:         first,
   80:         second,
   81:       ) =>
   82:         (
   83:           first.completedAt?.getTime() ||
   84:           0
   85:         ) -
   86:         (
   87:           second.completedAt?.getTime() ||
   88:           0
   89:         ),
   90:     )
   91:     .map(
   92:       (item) =>
   93:         item.score || 0,
   94:     );
   95: }
   96: 
   97: function calculateTrend(
   98:   evidence: AdaptiveEvidence[],
   99: ): number {
  100:   const scores =
  101:     scoreSequence(
  102:       evidence,
  103:     );
  104: 
  105:   if (
  106:     scores.length < 2
  107:   ) {
  108:     return 0;
  109:   }
  110: 
  111:   const midpoint =
  112:     Math.ceil(
  113:       scores.length / 2,
  114:     );
  115: 
  116:   const average = (
  117:     values: number[],
  118:   ) =>
  119:     values.length
  120:       ? values.reduce(
  121:           (
  122:             sum,
  123:             value,
  124:           ) =>
  125:             sum + value,
  126:           0,
  127:         ) /
  128:         values.length
  129:       : 0;
  130: 
  131:   return Math.round(
  132:     average(
  133:       scores.slice(
  134:         midpoint,
  135:       ),
  136:     ) -
  137:       average(
  138:         scores.slice(
  139:           0,
  140:           midpoint,
  141:         ),
  142:       ),
  143:   );
  144: }
  145: 
  146: function latestEvidence(
  147:   evidence: AdaptiveEvidence[],
  148: ): AdaptiveEvidence | null {
  149:   return (
  150:     [...evidence]
  151:       .filter(
  152:         (item) =>
  153:           item.completedAt,
  154:       )
  155:       .sort(
  156:         (
  157:           first,
  158:           second,
  159:         ) =>
  160:           (
  161:             second.completedAt?.getTime() ||
  162:             0
  163:           ) -
  164:           (
  165:             first.completedAt?.getTime() ||
  166:             0
  167:           ),
  168:       )[0] ||
  169:     null
  170:   );
  171: }
  172: 
  173: function determineState({
  174:   masteryScore,
  175:   attempts,
  176:   daysSincePractice,
  177:   trend,
  178: }: {
  179:   masteryScore: number;
  180:   attempts: number;
  181:   daysSincePractice: number;
  182:   trend: number;
  183: }): AdaptiveTopicState {
  184:   if (
  185:     attempts === 0
  186:   ) {
  187:     return "new";
  188:   }
  189: 
  190:   if (
  191:     masteryScore >= 85 &&
  192:     attempts >= 3 &&
  193:     daysSincePractice <= 21
  194:   ) {
  195:     return "mastered";
  196:   }
  197: 
  198:   if (
  199:     masteryScore >= 70 &&
  200:     daysSincePractice > 14
  201:   ) {
  202:     return "forgetting-risk";
  203:   }
  204: 
  205:   if (
  206:     masteryScore >= 70
  207:   ) {
  208:     return "secure";
  209:   }
  210: 
  211:   if (
  212:     masteryScore < 50 ||
  213:     trend <= -15
  214:   ) {
  215:     return "priority";
  216:   }
  217: 
  218:   return "developing";
  219: }
  220: 
  221: function difficultyFor(
  222:   masteryScore: number,
  223: ): AdaptiveDifficulty {
  224:   if (
  225:     masteryScore < 45
  226:   ) {
  227:     return "foundation";
  228:   }
  229: 
  230:   if (
  231:     masteryScore < 75
  232:   ) {
  233:     return "standard";
  234:   }
  235: 
  236:   return "higher";
  237: }
  238: 
  239: function confidence({
  240:   attempts,
  241:   sources,
  242:   averageScore,
  243: }: {
  244:   attempts: number;
  245:   sources: AdaptiveEvidenceSource[];
  246:   averageScore: number;
  247: }): number {
  248:   return clamp(
  249:     Math.min(
  250:       55,
  251:       attempts * 12,
  252:     ) +
  253:       Math.min(
  254:         25,
  255:         sources.length * 10,
  256:       ) +
  257:       (
  258:         averageScore >= 70
  259:           ? 20
  260:           : averageScore >= 50
  261:             ? 12
  262:             : 6
  263:       ),
  264:   );
  265: }
  266: 
  267: function priority({
  268:   masteryScore,
  269:   daysSincePractice,
  270:   trend,
  271:   attempts,
  272:   state,
  273: }: {
  274:   masteryScore: number;
  275:   daysSincePractice: number;
  276:   trend: number;
  277:   attempts: number;
  278:   state: AdaptiveTopicState;
  279: }): number {
  280:   const stateBoost =
  281:     state === "priority"
  282:       ? 15
  283:       : state ===
  284:           "forgetting-risk"
  285:         ? 12
  286:         : state === "new"
  287:           ? 10
  288:           : 0;
  289: 
  290:   return clamp(
  291:     Math.round(
  292:       (
  293:         100 -
  294:         masteryScore
  295:       ) *
  296:         0.55 +
  297:         Math.min(
  298:           25,
  299:           daysSincePractice *
  300:             1.5,
  301:         ) +
  302:         (
  303:           trend < 0
  304:             ? Math.min(
  305:                 20,
  306:                 Math.abs(
  307:                   trend,
  308:                 ),
  309:               )
  310:             : 0
  311:         ) +
  312:         (
  313:           attempts < 2
  314:             ? 10
  315:             : 0
  316:         ) +
  317:         stateBoost,
  318:     ),
  319:   );
  320: }
  321: 
  322: function reason({
  323:   state,
  324:   masteryScore,
  325:   trend,
  326:   daysSincePractice,
  327: }: {
  328:   state: AdaptiveTopicState;
  329:   masteryScore: number;
  330:   trend: number;
  331:   daysSincePractice: number;
  332: }): string {
  333:   if (
  334:     state === "new"
  335:   ) {
  336:     return "This topic has not yet been assessed, so an initial learning check is needed.";
  337:   }
  338: 
  339:   if (
  340:     state ===
  341:     "forgetting-risk"
  342:   ) {
  343:     return `Mastery is ${masteryScore}%, but the topic has not been practised for ${daysSincePractice} days. Retrieval is due.`;
  344:   }
  345: 
  346:   if (
  347:     state === "priority"
  348:   ) {
  349:     return trend < 0
  350:       ? `Mastery is ${masteryScore}% and recent performance has fallen by ${Math.abs(
  351:           trend,
  352:         )} percentage points.`
  353:       : `Mastery is currently ${masteryScore}%, so this topic needs immediate support.`;
  354:   }
  355: 
  356:   if (
  357:     state === "developing"
  358:   ) {
  359:     return `Mastery is ${masteryScore}%. Further guided practice is needed.`;
  360:   }
  361: 
  362:   if (
  363:     state === "mastered"
  364:   ) {
  365:     return `Mastery is ${masteryScore}% across repeated evidence. Use occasional retrieval to maintain it.`;
  366:   }
  367: 
  368:   return `Mastery is ${masteryScore}%. Continue spaced retrieval to keep the topic secure.`;
  369: }
  370: 
  371: export function buildTopicMastery(
  372:   groups: TopicEvidenceGroup[],
  373: ): AdaptiveTopicMastery[] {
  374:   return groups
  375:     .map(
  376:       (
  377:         group,
  378:         index,
  379:       ) => {
  380:         const attempts =
  381:           group.evidence.filter(
  382:             (item) =>
  383:               typeof item.score ===
  384:               "number",
  385:           ).length;
  386: 
  387:         const averageScore =
  388:           weightedAverage(
  389:             group.evidence,
  390:           );
  391: 
  392:         const trend =
  393:           calculateTrend(
  394:             group.evidence,
  395:           );
  396: 
  397:         const latest =
  398:           latestEvidence(
  399:             group.evidence,
  400:           );
  401: 
  402:         const latestScore =
  403:           typeof latest?.score ===
  404:           "number"
  405:             ? latest.score
  406:             : averageScore;
  407: 
  408:         const lastPractisedAt =
  409:           latest?.completedAt ||
  410:           null;
  411: 
  412:         const daysSincePractice =
  413:           calculateDaysSince(
  414:             lastPractisedAt,
  415:           );
  416: 
  417:         /*
  418:          * After seven days without graded practice, gradually
  419:          * reduce mastery to represent forgetting.
  420:          *
  421:          * The penalty remains capped at 20 percentage points.
  422:          */
  423:         const recencyPenalty =
  424:           Math.min(
  425:             20,
  426:             Math.max(
  427:               0,
  428:               daysSincePractice -
  429:                 7,
  430:             ) * 1.2,
  431:           );
  432: 
  433:         /*
  434:          * Base mastery must use a complete 100% weighting.
  435:          *
  436:          * Historical weighted evidence contributes 75%.
  437:          * The latest result contributes 25%, giving recent
  438:          * evidence extra influence without replacing the
  439:          * student's broader evidence history.
  440:          *
  441:          * Trend and recency are then applied as adjustments.
  442:          *
  443:          * Previous implementation used 70% + 20% = 90%,
  444:          * unintentionally reducing stable scores by 10%.
  445:          * Example: 20% evidence became 18% mastery.
  446:          */
  447:         const masteryScore =
  448:           clamp(
  449:             Math.round(
  450:               averageScore *
  451:                 0.75 +
  452:                 latestScore *
  453:                   0.25 +
  454:                 Math.max(
  455:                   -10,
  456:                   Math.min(
  457:                     10,
  458:                     trend *
  459:                       0.2,
  460:                   ),
  461:                 ) -
  462:                 recencyPenalty,
  463:             ),
  464:           );
  465: 
  466:         const evidenceSources =
  467:           Array.from(
  468:             new Set(
  469:               group.evidence.map(
  470:                 (item) =>
  471:                   item.source,
  472:               ),
  473:             ),
  474:           );
  475: 
  476:         const state =
  477:           determineState({
  478:             masteryScore,
  479:             attempts,
  480:             daysSincePractice,
  481:             trend,
  482:           });
  483: 
  484:         const reviewIntervalDays =
  485:           calculateReviewInterval({
  486:             masteryScore,
  487:             attempts,
  488:             state,
  489:           });
  490: 
  491:         const nextReviewAt =
  492:           calculateNextReviewDate({
  493:             lastPractisedAt,
  494:             intervalDays:
  495:               reviewIntervalDays,
  496:           });
  497: 
  498:         return {
  499:           id:
  500:             `mastery-${index}`,
  501: 
  502:           topic:
  503:             group.topic,
  504: 
  505:           masteryScore,
  506: 
  507:           confidenceScore:
  508:             confidence({
  509:               attempts,
  510:               sources:
  511:                 evidenceSources,
  512:               averageScore,
  513:             }),
  514: 
  515:           priorityScore:
  516:             priority({
  517:               masteryScore,
  518:               daysSincePractice,
  519:               trend,
  520:               attempts,
  521:               state,
  522:             }),
  523: 
  524:           attempts,
  525: 
  526:           averageScore,
  527: 
  528:           latestScore,
  529: 
  530:           trend,
  531: 
  532:           lastPractisedAt,
  533: 
  534:           nextReviewAt,
  535: 
  536:           daysSincePractice,
  537: 
  538:           reviewIntervalDays,
  539: 
  540:           state,
  541: 
  542:           recommendedDifficulty:
  543:             difficultyFor(
  544:               masteryScore,
  545:             ),
  546: 
  547:           evidenceSources,
  548: 
  549:           reason:
  550:             reason({
  551:               state,
  552:               masteryScore,
  553:               trend,
  554:               daysSincePractice,
  555:             }),
  556:         };
  557:       },
  558:     )
  559:     .sort(
  560:       (
  561:         first,
  562:         second,
  563:       ) =>
  564:         second.priorityScore -
  565:         first.priorityScore,
  566:     );
  567: }

    1: import { curriculumRegistry } from "@/data/curriculum/curriculumRegistry";

    3: import type {
    4:   AdaptiveLearningAction,
    5:   AdaptiveTopicMastery,
    6: } from "@/types/adaptiveLearning";
    7: 
    8: const encoded = (value: string) =>
    9:   encodeURIComponent(value);
   10: 
   11: function normaliseLookupValue(
   12:   value: string,
   13: ): string {
   14:   return value
   15:     .trim()
   16:     .toLowerCase()
   17:     .replace(/&/g, "and")
   18:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, " ")
   19:     .trim();
   20: }
   21: 
   22: function resolveCurriculumTopicId(
   23:   topic: AdaptiveTopicMastery,
   24: ): string | null {
   25:   const candidates = [
   26:     topic.topic,
   27:     topic.id,
   28:   ]
   29:     .map(normaliseLookupValue)
   30:     .filter(Boolean);
   31: 
   32:   if (candidates.length === 0) {
   33:     return null;
   34:   }
   35: 
   36:   const match =
   37:     curriculumRegistry.find(
   38:       (curriculumTopic) => {
   39:         const searchableValues = [
   40:           curriculumTopic.id,
   41:           curriculumTopic.title,
   42:           ...(curriculumTopic.aliases || []),
   43:         ].map(normaliseLookupValue);
   44: 
   45:         return candidates.some(
   46:           (candidate) =>
   47:             searchableValues.includes(
   48:               candidate,
   49:             ),
   50:         );
   51:       },
   52:     );
   53: 
   54:   return match?.id || null;
   55: }
   56: 
   57: function learningHref(
   58:   topic: AdaptiveTopicMastery,
   59: ): string {
   60:   const curriculumTopicId =
   61:     resolveCurriculumTopicId(topic);
   62: 
   63:   /*
   64:    * Preferred route:
   65:    * resolve the adaptive topic through the curriculum registry.
   66:    *
   67:    * Example:
   68:    * Character Encoding
   69:    *     â†“
   70:    * curriculumRegistry alias/title match
   71:    *     â†“
   72:    * id: "characters"
   73:    *     â†“
   74:    * /learn/characters
   75:    */
   76:   if (curriculumTopicId) {
   77:     return `/learn/${encoded(
   78:       curriculumTopicId,
   79:     )}`;
   80:   }
   81: 
   82:   /*
   83:    * Defensive fallback.
   84:    *
   85:    * If a topic has not yet been registered in the curriculum,
   86:    * return to the searchable Learn catalogue rather than creating
   87:    * a broken /learn/[topicId] route.
   88:    */
   89:   return `/learn?search=${encoded(
   90:     topic.topic,
   91:   )}`;
   92: }
   93: 
   94: export function buildAdaptiveActions(
   95:   topics: AdaptiveTopicMastery[],
   96: ): AdaptiveLearningAction[] {
   97:   const actions: AdaptiveLearningAction[] =
   98:     [];
   99: 
  100:   topics
  101:     .filter(
  102:       (topic) =>
  103:         topic.state !== "mastered",
  104:     )
  105:     .slice(0, 3)
  106:     .forEach((topic, index) => {
  107:       const priority: AdaptiveLearningAction["priority"] =
  108:         topic.priorityScore >= 70
  109:           ? "high"
  110:           : topic.priorityScore >= 45
  111:             ? "medium"
  112:             : "low";
  113: 
  114:       /*
  115:        * New or weak topics should take the learner directly
  116:        * into the corresponding curriculum topic wherever one
  117:        * exists.
  118:        */
  119:       if (
  120:         topic.state === "new" ||
  121:         topic.masteryScore < 45
  122:       ) {
  123:         actions.push({
  124:           id: `lesson-${topic.id}`,
  125:           type: "lesson",
  126:           title: `Review ${topic.topic}`,
  127:           description: topic.reason,
  128:           topic: topic.topic,
  129:           href: learningHref(topic),
  130:           estimatedMinutes: 12,
  131:           xpReward: 25,
  132:           priority,
  133:         });
  134:       }
  135: 
  136:       /*
  137:        * Retrieval practice remains topic-specific.
  138:        */
  139:       actions.push({
  140:         id: `quiz-${topic.id}`,
  141:         type: "quiz",
  142:         title:
  143:           `Retrieval quiz: ${topic.topic}`,
  144:         description:
  145:           `Use ${topic.recommendedDifficulty} difficulty to check recall and update mastery.`,
  146:         topic: topic.topic,
  147:         href:
  148:           `/quiz?topic=${encoded(
  149:             topic.topic,
  150:           )}&difficulty=${encoded(
  151:             topic.recommendedDifficulty,
  152:           )}`,
  153:         estimatedMinutes: 8,
  154:         xpReward: 30,
  155:         priority,
  156:       });
  157: 
  158:       /*
  159:        * Written exam practice remains assignment-driven.
  160:        * The student can only attempt papers that have actually
  161:        * been assigned to them.
  162:        */
  163:       if (
  164:         index === 0 ||
  165:         topic.masteryScore >= 40
  166:       ) {
  167:         actions.push({
  168:           id: `exam-${topic.id}`,
  169:           type: "exam",
  170:           title:
  171:             `Exam practice: ${topic.topic}`,
  172:           description:
  173:             "Apply knowledge in a written response and compare it with the mark scheme.",
  174:           topic: topic.topic,
  175:           href:
  176:             "/assignments?filter=exams",
  177:           estimatedMinutes: 12,
  178:           xpReward: 40,
  179:           priority:
  180:             priority === "high"
  181:               ? "high"
  182:               : "medium",
  183:         });
  184:       }
  185:     });
  186: 
  187:   return actions.slice(0, 6);
  188: }

    1: import type {
    2:   AnalyticsEvidence,
    3:   EvidenceConfidenceAnalytics,
    4: } from "@/types/analytics";
    5: 
    6: export function calculateEvidenceConfidence({
    7:   evidence,
    8:   totalActivityCount,
    9:   completedActivityCount,
   10: }: {
   11:   evidence: AnalyticsEvidence[];
   12:   totalActivityCount: number;
   13:   completedActivityCount: number;
   14: }): EvidenceConfidenceAnalytics {
   15:   const graded = evidence.filter(
   16:     (item) =>
   17:       item.graded &&
   18:       typeof item.percentage === "number",
   19:   );
   20: 
   21:   const writtenExamCount = graded.filter(
   22:     (item) => item.type === "written_exam",
   23:   ).length;
   24: 
   25:   const quizCount = graded.filter(
   26:     (item) =>
   27:       item.type === "quiz" ||
   28:       item.type === "ai_quiz",
   29:   ).length;
   30: 
   31:   const curriculumCoverage =
   32:     totalActivityCount > 0
   33:       ? Math.round(
   34:           (completedActivityCount /
   35:             totalActivityCount) *
   36:             100,
   37:         )
   38:       : 0;
   39: 
   40:   let score = 0;
   41: 
   42:   score += Math.min(40, graded.length * 8);
   43:   score += Math.min(30, writtenExamCount * 15);
   44:   score += Math.min(15, quizCount * 3);
   45:   score += Math.min(
   46:     15,
   47:     Math.round(curriculumCoverage * 0.15),
   48:   );
   49: 
   50:   let level: EvidenceConfidenceAnalytics["level"] =
   51:     "insufficient";
   52: 
   53:   if (graded.length >= 1) level = "low";
   54:   if (score >= 45) level = "medium";
   55:   if (
   56:     score >= 70 &&
   57:     writtenExamCount >= 2 &&
   58:     graded.length >= 5
   59:   ) {
   60:     level = "high";
   61:   }
   62: 
   63:   const explanation =
   64:     level === "high"
   65:       ? "The working grade is supported by multiple graded activities, including written assessment evidence."
   66:       : level === "medium"
   67:         ? "The working grade has a reasonable evidence base but would benefit from more written assessment evidence."
   68:         : level === "low"
   69:           ? "The current grade estimate is based on limited graded evidence and should be treated cautiously."
   70:           : "There is not yet enough graded evidence to calculate a reliable working grade.";
   71: 
   72:   return {
   73:     level,
   74:     score: Math.min(100, score),
   75:     gradedEvidenceCount: graded.length,
   76:     writtenExamCount,
   77:     quizCount,
   78:     curriculumCoverage,
   79:     explanation,
   80:   };
   81: }

   14: function roundPercentage(
   15:   value: number,
   16: ): number {
   17:   return Math.round(value * 1000000) / 1000000;
   18: }
   19: 
   20: function validateInput(
   21:   input: ExamBoundaryConfigurationInput,
   22: ): void {
   23:   if (!input.assignmentId.trim()) {
   24:     throw new Error("A valid exam assignment is required.");
   25:   }
   26: 
   27:   if (!input.teacherId.trim()) {
   28:     throw new Error("A signed-in teacher is required.");
   29:   }
   30: 
   31:   if (!input.title.trim()) {
   32:     throw new Error("Enter a boundary-set title.");
   33:   }
   34: 
   35:   if (
   36:     !Number.isFinite(input.totalMarks) ||
   37:     input.totalMarks <= 0
   38:   ) {
   39:     throw new Error("The assessment must have a valid total mark.");
   40:   }
   41: 
   42:   if (!input.boundaries.length) {
   43:     throw new Error("Enter at least one grade boundary.");
   44:   }
   45: 
   46:   const seenGrades = new Set<string>();
   47: 
   48:   for (const boundary of input.boundaries) {
   49:     if (seenGrades.has(boundary.grade)) {
   50:       throw new Error(`Duplicate boundary for grade ${boundary.grade}.`);
   51:     }
   52: 
   53:     seenGrades.add(boundary.grade);
   54: 
   55:     if (
   56:       !Number.isFinite(boundary.minimumMark) ||
   57:       boundary.minimumMark < 0 ||
   58:       boundary.minimumMark > input.totalMarks
   59:     ) {
   60:       throw new Error(
   61:         `The minimum mark for grade ${boundary.grade} must be between 0 and ${input.totalMarks}.`,
   62:       );
   63:     }
   64:   }
   65: 
   66:   if (
   67:     input.source === "official" &&
   68:     (!input.examBoard.trim() ||
   69:       !input.academicYear.trim() ||
   70:       !input.assessmentTitle.trim())
   71:   ) {
   72:     throw new Error(
   73:       "Official boundaries require an exam board, academic year/series and assessment title.",
   74:     );
   75:   }
   76: }
   77: 
   78: async function assertTeacherOwnsAssignment({
   79:   assignmentId,
   80:   teacherId,
   81: }: {
   82:   assignmentId: string;
   83:   teacherId: string;
   84: }): Promise<void> {
   85:   const reference = doc(
   86:     db,
   87:     "examAssignments",
   88:     assignmentId,
   89:   );

   99:     teacherId.trim()
  100:   ) {

  103:     );
  104:   }

  107: export async function saveExamBoundaryConfiguration(
  108:   input: ExamBoundaryConfigurationInput,
  109: ): Promise<void> {
  110:   validateInput(input);
  111: 
  112:   await assertTeacherOwnsAssignment({
  113:     assignmentId: input.assignmentId,
  114:     teacherId: input.teacherId,
  115:   });
  116: 
  117:   const embeddedBoundarySet = {
  118:     id: `assignment-${input.assignmentId}-boundaries`,
  119:     title: input.title.trim(),
  120:     qualification: input.qualification,
  121:     examBoard: input.examBoard.trim(),
  122:     academicYear: input.academicYear.trim(),
  123:     assessmentTitle: input.assessmentTitle.trim(),
  124:     source: input.source,
  125:     sourceNote: input.sourceNote.trim(),

  128:       grade: boundary.grade,

  133:     })),
  134:   };
  135: 
  136:   await updateDoc(
  137:     doc(
  138:       db,
  139:       "examAssignments",
  140:       input.assignmentId,
  141:     ),
  142:     {
  143:       "questionSetSnapshot.gradeBoundarySet":
  144:         embeddedBoundarySet,
  145:       updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  146:     },
  147:   );

   32: function normaliseQualification(
   33:   value: unknown,
   34: ): AnalyticsQualification {
   35:   const text =
   36:     typeof value === "string"
   37:       ? value.trim().toUpperCase()
   38:       : "";
   39: 
   40:   return text === "A_LEVEL" ||
   41:     text === "A LEVEL" ||
   42:     text === "A-LEVEL"
   43:     ? "A_LEVEL"
   44:     : "GCSE";
   45: }

   51:     value === "teacher" ||

   57: function validGrade(
   58:   value: unknown,
   59:   qualification: AnalyticsQualification,
   60: ): GradeLabel | null {
   61:   if (typeof value !== "string") {
   62:     return null;
   63:   }
   64: 
   65:   const grade = value.trim().toUpperCase();
   66: 
   67:   const valid =
   68:     qualification === "A_LEVEL"
   69:       ? ["A*", "A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "U"]
   70:       : ["9", "8", "7", "6", "5", "4", "3", "2", "1", "U"];
   71: 
   72:   return valid.includes(grade)
   73:     ? (grade as GradeLabel)
   74:     : null;
   75: }

   77: function boundarySetFromSnapshot(
   78:   assignment: ExamAssignment,
   79:   qualification: AnalyticsQualification,
   80: ): ResolvedBoundarySet | null {
   81:   const snapshot =
   82:     assignment.questionSetSnapshot as unknown as
   83:       Record<string, unknown>;
   84: 
   85:   const candidate =
   86:     snapshot.gradeBoundarySet;
   87: 
   88:   if (
   89:     !candidate ||
   90:     typeof candidate !== "object"
   91:   ) {
   92:     return null;
   93:   }
   94: 
   95:   const data =
   96:     candidate as Record<string, unknown>;
   97: 
   98:   if (!Array.isArray(data.boundaries)) {
   99:     return null;
  100:   }
  101: 
  102:   const totalMarks =
  103:     assignment.totalMarks > 0
  104:       ? assignment.totalMarks
  105:       : assignment.questionSetSnapshot.totalMarks;
  106: 
  107:   const boundaries: GradeBoundary[] =
  108:     data.boundaries
  109:       .map((item) => {
  110:         if (
  111:           !item ||
  112:           typeof item !== "object"
  113:         ) {
  114:           return null;
  115:         }
  116: 
  117:         const row =
  118:           item as Record<string, unknown>;
  119: 
  120:         const grade =
  121:           validGrade(
  122:             row.grade,
  123:             qualification,
  124:           );
  125: 
  126:         let minimumPercentage =
  127:           typeof row.minimumPercentage === "number" &&
  128:           Number.isFinite(row.minimumPercentage)
  129:             ? row.minimumPercentage
  130:             : null;
  131: 
  132:         if (
  133:           minimumPercentage === null &&
  134:           typeof row.minimumMark === "number" &&
  135:           Number.isFinite(row.minimumMark) &&
  136:           totalMarks > 0
  137:         ) {
  138:           minimumPercentage =
  139:             (row.minimumMark / totalMarks) * 100;
  140:         }
  141: 
  142:         if (
  143:           !grade ||
  144:           minimumPercentage === null ||
  145:           minimumPercentage < 0 ||
  146:           minimumPercentage > 100
  147:         ) {
  148:           return null;
  149:         }
  150: 
  151:         return {
  152:           grade,
  153:           minimumPercentage,
  154:         };
  155:       })
  156:       .filter(
  157:         (
  158:           item,
  159:         ): item is GradeBoundary =>
  160:           Boolean(item),
  161:       );
  162: 
  163:   if (!boundaries.length) {
  164:     return null;
  165:   }
  166: 
  167:   return {
  168:     id:
  169:       typeof data.id === "string" &&
  170:       data.id.trim()
  171:         ? data.id.trim()
  172:         : "embedded-exam-boundaries",
  173:     title:
  174:       typeof data.title === "string" &&
  175:       data.title.trim()
  176:         ? data.title.trim()
  177:         : "Embedded exam grade boundaries",
  178:     qualification,
  179:     examBoard:
  180:       typeof data.examBoard === "string"
  181:         ? data.examBoard
  182:         : undefined,
  183:     academicYear:
  184:       typeof data.academicYear === "string"
  185:         ? data.academicYear
  186:         : undefined,
  187:     assessmentTitle:
  188:       typeof data.assessmentTitle === "string"
  189:         ? data.assessmentTitle
  190:         : undefined,
  191:     source:
  192:       validBoundarySource(
  193:         data.source,
  194:       ) || "teacher",
  195:     boundaries,
  196:     sourceNote:
  197:       typeof data.sourceNote === "string"
  198:         ? data.sourceNote
  199:         : undefined,
  200:     verifiedAt:
  201:       typeof data.verifiedAt === "string"
  202:         ? data.verifiedAt
  203:         : undefined,
  204:   };
  205: }

  207: function resolveBoundarySet(

  222: function orderedBoundaries(
  223:   boundarySet: GradeBoundarySet,
  224:   qualification: AnalyticsQualification,
  225: ): GradeBoundary[] {
  226:   const order =
  227:     getGradeOrder(qualification);
  228: 
  229:   return [...boundarySet.boundaries].sort(
  230:     (first, second) =>
  231:       order.indexOf(second.grade) -
  232:       order.indexOf(first.grade),
  233:   );
  234: }

  236: function gradeFromPercentage(
  237:   percentage: number,
  238:   boundarySet: GradeBoundarySet,
  239:   qualification: AnalyticsQualification,
  240: ): GradeLabel {
  241:   const boundaries =
  242:     orderedBoundaries(
  243:       boundarySet,
  244:       qualification,
  245:     );
  246: 
  247:   return (
  248:     boundaries.find(
  249:       (boundary) =>
  250:         percentage >=
  251:         boundary.minimumPercentage,
  252:     )?.grade || "U"
  253:   );
  254: }
  255: 
  256: function nextGradeInformation({
  257:   grade,
  258:   awardedMarks,
  259:   totalMarks,
  260:   boundarySet,
  261:   qualification,
  262: }: {
  263:   grade: GradeLabel;
  264:   awardedMarks: number;
  265:   totalMarks: number;
  266:   boundarySet: GradeBoundarySet;
  267:   qualification: AnalyticsQualification;
  268: }): {
  269:   nextGrade: GradeLabel | null;
  270:   nextGradeMinimumMark: number | null;
  271:   marksToNextGrade: number | null;
  272:   percentagePointsToNextGrade: number | null;
  273: } {
  274:   const order =
  275:     getGradeOrder(qualification);
  276: 
  277:   const gradeIndex =
  278:     order.indexOf(grade);
  279: 
  280:   if (
  281:     gradeIndex < 0 ||
  282:     gradeIndex >=
  283:       order.length - 1
  284:   ) {
  285:     return {
  286:       nextGrade: null,
  287:       nextGradeMinimumMark: null,
  288:       marksToNextGrade: null,
  289:       percentagePointsToNextGrade: null,
  290:     };
  291:   }
  292: 
  293:   const nextGrade =
  294:     order[gradeIndex + 1];
  295: 
  296:   const nextBoundary =
  297:     boundarySet.boundaries.find(
  298:       (boundary) =>
  299:         boundary.grade === nextGrade,
  300:     );
  301: 
  302:   if (!nextBoundary) {
  303:     return {
  304:       nextGrade,
  305:       nextGradeMinimumMark: null,
  306:       marksToNextGrade: null,
  307:       percentagePointsToNextGrade: null,
  308:     };
  309:   }
  310: 
  311:   const nextGradeMinimumMark =
  312:     Math.ceil(
  313:       (nextBoundary.minimumPercentage /
  314:         100) *
  315:         totalMarks -
  316:         1e-9,
  317:     );
  318: 
  319:   const currentPercentage =
  320:     totalMarks > 0
  321:       ? (awardedMarks / totalMarks) * 100
  322:       : 0;
  323: 
  324:   return {
  325:     nextGrade,
  326:     nextGradeMinimumMark,
  327:     marksToNextGrade:
  328:       Math.max(
  329:         0,
  330:         nextGradeMinimumMark -
  331:           awardedMarks,
  332:       ),
  333:     percentagePointsToNextGrade:
  334:       round(
  335:         Math.max(
  336:           0,
  337:           nextBoundary.minimumPercentage -
  338:             currentPercentage,
  339:         ),
  340:       ),
  341:   };
  342: }
  343: 
  344: function scoreForSubmission(
  345:   submission: ExamSubmission,
  346:   assignment: ExamAssignment,
  347: ): {
  348:   awardedMarks: number;
  349:   availableMarks: number;
  350:   percentage: number;
  351: } {
  352:   const availableMarks =
  353:     submission.totalAvailableMarks > 0
  354:       ? submission.totalAvailableMarks
  355:       : assignment.totalMarks;
  356: 
  357:   const awardedMarks =
  358:     submission.totalAwardedMarks;
  359: 
  360:   return {
  361:     awardedMarks,
  362:     availableMarks,
  363:     percentage:
  364:       availableMarks > 0
  365:         ? round(
  366:             (awardedMarks /
  367:               availableMarks) *
  368:               100,
  369:           )
  370:         : submission.percentage,
  371:   };
  372: }

  374: export function buildExamGradeIntelligence(
  375:   assignment: ExamAssignment,
  376:   submissions: ExamSubmission[],
  377: ): ExamGradeIntelligence {
  378:   const qualification =
  379:     normaliseQualification(
  380:       assignment.questionSetSnapshot
  381:         .qualification,
  382:     );
  383: 
  384:   const boundarySet =
  385:     resolveBoundarySet(
  386:       assignment,
  387:       qualification,
  388:     );
  389: 
  390:   const totalMarks =
  391:     assignment.totalMarks > 0
  392:       ? assignment.totalMarks
  393:       : assignment.questionSetSnapshot
  394:           .totalMarks;
  395: 
  396:   const marked =
  397:     submissions.filter(
  398:       (submission) =>
  399:         submission.status === "marked",
  400:     );
  401: 
  402:   const provisionalOutcomes =
  403:     marked.map((submission) => {
  404:       const score =
  405:         scoreForSubmission(
  406:           submission,
  407:           assignment,
  408:         );
  409: 
  410:       const grade =
  411:         gradeFromPercentage(
  412:           score.percentage,
  413:           boundarySet,
  414:           qualification,
  415:         );
  416: 
  417:       const next =
  418:         nextGradeInformation({
  419:           grade,
  420:           awardedMarks:
  421:             score.awardedMarks,
  422:           totalMarks:
  423:             score.availableMarks,
  424:           boundarySet,
  425:           qualification,
  426:         });
  427: 
  428:       return {
  429:         submission,
  430:         score,
  431:         grade,
  432:         next,
  433:       };
  434:     });
  435: 
  436:   const classAveragePercentage =
  437:     provisionalOutcomes.length
  438:       ? round(
  439:           provisionalOutcomes.reduce(
  440:             (sum, item) =>
  441:               sum +
  442:               item.score.percentage,
  443:             0,
  444:           ) /
  445:             provisionalOutcomes.length,
  446:         )
  447:       : null;
  448: 
  449:   const classAverageMark =
  450:     provisionalOutcomes.length
  451:       ? round(
  452:           provisionalOutcomes.reduce(
  453:             (sum, item) =>
  454:               sum +
  455:               item.score.awardedMarks,
  456:             0,
  457:           ) /
  458:             provisionalOutcomes.length,
  459:         )
  460:       : null;
  461: 
  462:   const studentOutcomes: ExamStudentGradeOutcome[] =
  463:     provisionalOutcomes.map(
  464:       ({
  465:         submission,
  466:         score,
  467:         grade,
  468:         next,
  469:       }) => ({
  470:         studentId:
  471:           submission.studentId,
  472:         studentName:
  473:           submission.studentName,
  474:         studentEmail:
  475:           submission.studentEmail,
  476:         awardedMarks:
  477:           score.awardedMarks,
  478:         availableMarks:
  479:           score.availableMarks,
  480:         percentage:
  481:           score.percentage,
  482:         grade,
  483:         nextGrade:
  484:           next.nextGrade,
  485:         nextGradeMinimumMark:
  486:           next.nextGradeMinimumMark,
  487:         marksToNextGrade:
  488:           next.marksToNextGrade,
  489:         percentagePointsToNextGrade:
  490:           next.percentagePointsToNextGrade,
  491:         differenceFromClassAverage:
  492:           classAveragePercentage === null
  493:             ? null
  494:             : round(
  495:                 score.percentage -
  496:                   classAveragePercentage,
  497:               ),
  498:         nearNextGradeBoundary:
  499:           next.marksToNextGrade !== null &&
  500:           next.marksToNextGrade > 0 &&
  501:           next.marksToNextGrade <= 2,
  502:       }),
  503:     );
  504: 
  505:   const classAverageGrade =
  506:     classAveragePercentage === null
  507:       ? null
  508:       : gradeFromPercentage(
  509:           classAveragePercentage,
  510:           boundarySet,
  511:           qualification,
  512:         );
  513: 
  514:   const classNext =
  515:     classAverageGrade === null ||
  516:     classAverageMark === null
  517:       ? {
  518:           nextGrade: null,
  519:           nextGradeMinimumMark: null,
  520:           marksToNextGrade: null,
  521:           percentagePointsToNextGrade: null,
  522:         }
  523:       : nextGradeInformation({
  524:           grade: classAverageGrade,
  525:           awardedMarks:
  526:             Math.round(
  527:               classAverageMark,
  528:             ),
  529:           totalMarks,
  530:           boundarySet,
  531:           qualification,
  532:         });
  533: 
  534:   const gradeOrder =
  535:     getGradeOrder(
  536:       qualification,
  537:     ).reverse();
  538: 
  539:   const gradeDistribution: ExamGradeDistributionItem[] =
  540:     gradeOrder
  541:       .map((grade) => {
  542:         const count =
  543:           studentOutcomes.filter(
  544:             (student) =>
  545:               student.grade === grade,
  546:           ).length;
  547: 
  548:         return {
  549:           grade,
  550:           count,
  551:           percentage:
  552:             studentOutcomes.length > 0
  553:               ? round(
  554:                   (count /
  555:                     studentOutcomes.length) *
  556:                     100,
  557:                 )
  558:               : 0,
  559:         };
  560:       })
  561:       .filter(
  562:         (item) =>
  563:           item.count > 0,
  564:       );
  565: 
  566:   const boundaries: ExamGradeBoundaryRow[] =
  567:     orderedBoundaries(
  568:       boundarySet,
  569:       qualification,
  570:     ).map((boundary) => ({
  571:       grade: boundary.grade,
  572:       minimumPercentage:
  573:         round(boundary.minimumPercentage),
  574:       minimumMark:
  575:         Math.ceil(
  576:           (boundary.minimumPercentage /
  577:             100) *
  578:             totalMarks -
  579:             1e-9,
  580:         ),
  581:     }));
  582: 
  583:   return {
  584:     qualification,
  585:     examBoard:
  586:       assignment.questionSetSnapshot
  587:         .examBoard || null,
  588: 
  589:     boundarySetId:
  590:       boundarySet.id,
  591:     boundarySetTitle:
  592:       boundarySet.title,
  593:     boundarySource:
  594:       boundarySet.source,
  595:     boundarySourceNote:
  596:       boundarySet.sourceNote || null,
  597:     boundaryVerifiedAt:
  598:       boundarySet.verifiedAt || null,
  599:     boundaryAcademicYear:
  600:       boundarySet.academicYear ||
  601:       null,
  602:     boundaryAssessmentTitle:
  603:       boundarySet.assessmentTitle ||
  604:       null,
  605:     isOfficialBoundarySet:
  606:       boundarySet.source === "official",
  607: 
  608:     totalMarks,
  609:     boundaries,
  610: 
  611:     classAverageMark,
  612:     classAveragePercentage,
  613:     classAverageGrade,
  614:     classNextGrade:
  615:       classNext.nextGrade,
  616:     classNextGradeMinimumMark:
  617:       classNext.nextGradeMinimumMark,
  618:     classMarksToNextGrade:
  619:       classNext.marksToNextGrade,
  620:     classPercentagePointsToNextGrade:
  621:       classNext.percentagePointsToNextGrade,
  622: 
  623:     studentOutcomes,
  624:     nearBoundaryStudents:
  625:       studentOutcomes.filter(
  626:         (student) =>
  627:           student.nearNextGradeBoundary,
  628:       ),
  629:     gradeDistribution,
  630:   };
  631: }

   35: 
   36: function median(
   37:   values: number[],
   38: ): number | null {
   39:   if (!values.length) return null;
   40: 
   41:   const sorted = [...values].sort(
   42:     (a, b) => a - b,
   43:   );
   44: 
   45:   const middle =
   46:     Math.floor(sorted.length / 2);
   47: 
   48:   return sorted.length % 2 === 0
   49:     ? round(
   50:         (sorted[middle - 1] +
   51:           sorted[middle]) /
   52:           2,
   53:       )
   54:     : sorted[middle];
   55: }
   56: 
   57: function questionRecord(
   58:   question: unknown,
   59: ): Record<string, unknown> {
   60:   return question &&
   61:     typeof question === "object"
   62:     ? (question as Record<string, unknown>)
   63:     : {};
   64: }
   65: 
   66: function questionTopic(
   67:   question: unknown,
   68:   fallback: string,
   69: ): string {
   70:   const data = questionRecord(question);
   71: 
   72:   for (const value of [
   73:     data.topic,
   74:     data.topicFocus,
   75:     data.subtopic,
   76:     data.curriculumTopic,
   77:   ]) {
   78:     if (
   79:       typeof value === "string" &&
   80:       value.trim()
   81:     ) {
   82:       return value.trim();
   83:     }
   84:   }
   85: 
   86:   return fallback;
   87: }
   88: 
   89: function assessmentObjective(
   90:   question: unknown,
   91: ): "AO1" | "AO2" | "AO3" | null {
   92:   const value =
   93:     questionRecord(
   94:       question,
   95:     ).assessmentObjective;
   96: 
   97:   return value === "AO1" ||
   98:     value === "AO2" ||
   99:     value === "AO3"
  100:     ? value
  101:     : null;
  102: }
  103: 
  104: function commandWord(
  105:   question: unknown,
  106: ): string | null {
  107:   const value =
  108:     questionRecord(
  109:       question,
  110:     ).commandWord;
  111: 
  112:   return typeof value === "string" &&
  113:     value.trim()
  114:     ? value.trim()
  115:     : null;
  116: }
  117: 
  118: function priorityFromPercentage(
  119:   successPercentage: number | null,
  120: ): "high" | "medium" | "low" {
  121:   if (successPercentage === null) return "low";
  122:   if (successPercentage < 50) return "high";
  123:   if (successPercentage < 70) return "medium";
  124:   return "low";
  125: }
  126: 
  127: function questionDifficulty(
  128:   successPercentage: number | null,
  129:   markedStudents: number,
  130: ): ExamQuestionDifficulty {
  131:   if (
  132:     markedStudents === 0 ||
  133:     successPercentage === null
  134:   ) {
  135:     return "insufficient";
  136:   }
  137: 
  138:   if (successPercentage >= 70) return "secure";
  139:   if (successPercentage >= 50) return "developing";
  140:   return "priority";
  141: }
  142: 
  143: function discriminationLabel(
  144:   value: number | null,
  145: ): ExamDiscriminationLabel {
  146:   if (value === null) return "insufficient";
  147:   if (value < 0) return "negative";
  148:   if (value < 0.2) return "weak";
  149:   if (value < 0.3) return "moderate";
  150:   return "strong";
  151: }
  152: 
  153: function questionDiscrimination({
  154:   questionId,
  155:   availableMarks,
  156:   marked,
  157: }: {
  158:   questionId: string;
  159:   availableMarks: number;
  160:   marked: ExamSubmission[];
  161: }): number | null {
  162:   /*
  163:    * Small cohorts produce unstable discrimination statistics.
  164:    * Wait until at least 10 marked submissions are available.
  165:    */
  166:   if (
  167:     marked.length < 10 ||
  168:     availableMarks <= 0
  169:   ) {
  170:     return null;
  171:   }
  172: 
  173:   const sorted = [...marked].sort(
  174:     (first, second) =>
  175:       second.percentage -
  176:       first.percentage,
  177:   );
  178: 
  179:   const groupSize =
  180:     Math.max(
  181:       2,
  182:       Math.floor(
  183:         sorted.length * 0.27,
  184:       ),
  185:     );
  186: 
  187:   const top = sorted.slice(
  188:     0,
  189:     groupSize,
  190:   );
  191: 
  192:   const bottom = sorted.slice(
  193:     -groupSize,
  194:   );
  195: 
  196:   function groupFacility(
  197:     group: ExamSubmission[],
  198:   ): number {
  199:     const awarded =
  200:       group.reduce(
  201:         (sum, submission) => {
  202:           const answer =
  203:             submission.answers.find(
  204:               (item) =>
  205:                 item.questionId ===
  206:                 questionId,
  207:             );
  208: 
  209:           return (
  210:             sum +
  211:             (answer?.awardedMarks ?? 0)
  212:           );
  213:         },
  214:         0,
  215:       );
  216: 
  217:     return (
  218:       awarded /
  219:       (group.length *
  220:         availableMarks)
  221:     );
  222:   }
  223: 
  224:   return round2(
  225:     groupFacility(top) -
  226:       groupFacility(bottom),
  227:   );
  228: }
  229: 
  230: function analysisConfidence(
  231:   markedCount: number,
  232: ): {
  233:   confidence: ExamAnalysisConfidence;
  234:   warnings: string[];
  235: } {
  236:   if (markedCount === 0) {
  237:     return {
  238:       confidence: "insufficient",
  239:       warnings: [
  240:         "No marked submissions are available, so class-level QLA interpretation is not yet possible.",
  241:       ],
  242:     };
  243:   }
  244: 
  245:   if (markedCount < 5) {
  246:     return {
  247:       confidence: "limited",
  248:       warnings: [
  249:         `Only ${markedCount} marked submission${markedCount === 1 ? " is" : "s are"} available. Treat class-level percentages and priorities cautiously.`,
  250:         "Question discrimination is withheld until at least 10 marked submissions are available.",
  251:       ],
  252:     };
  253:   }
  254: 
  255:   if (markedCount < 10) {
  256:     return {
  257:       confidence: "developing",
  258:       warnings: [
  259:         `${markedCount} marked submissions provide useful early class evidence, but question discrimination is withheld until the sample reaches 10.`,
  260:       ],
  261:     };
  262:   }
  263: 
  264:   return {
  265:     confidence: "robust",
  266:     warnings: [],
  267:   };
  268: }
  269: 
  270: type StudentExamWeakness = {
  271:   topic: string | null;
  272:   questionNumber: number | null;
  273:   successPercentage: number | null;
  274: };
  275: 
  276: function getStudentExamWeakness(
  277:   assignment: ExamAssignment,
  278:   submission: ExamSubmission,
  279:   fallbackTopic: string,
  280: ): StudentExamWeakness {
  281:   if (
  282:     submission.status !== "marked"
  283:   ) {
  284:     return {
  285:       topic: null,
  286:       questionNumber: null,
  287:       successPercentage: null,
  288:     };
  289:   }
  290: 
  291:   const scored =
  292:     assignment.questionSetSnapshot
  293:       .questions
  294:       .map((question) => {
  295:         const answer =
  296:           submission.answers.find(
  297:             (item) =>
  298:               item.questionId ===
  299:               question.id,
  300:           );
  301: 
  302:         if (
  303:           !answer ||
  304:           answer.awardedMarks === null ||
  305:           question.marks <= 0
  306:         ) {
  307:           return null;
  308:         }
  309: 
  310:         return {
  311:           topic: questionTopic(
  312:             question,
  313:             fallbackTopic,
  314:           ),
  315:           questionNumber:
  316:             question.questionNumber,
  317:           successPercentage: round(
  318:             (answer.awardedMarks /
  319:               question.marks) *
  320:               100,
  321:           ),
  322:         };
  323:       })
  324:       .filter(
  325:         (
  326:           value,
  327:         ): value is NonNullable<
  328:           typeof value
  329:         > => Boolean(value),
  330:       )
  331:       .sort(
  332:         (first, second) =>
  333:           first.successPercentage -
  334:           second.successPercentage,
  335:       );
  336: 
  337:   const weakest = scored[0];
  338: 
  339:   if (!weakest) {
  340:     return {
  341:       topic: null,
  342:       questionNumber: null,
  343:       successPercentage: null,
  344:     };
  345:   }
  346: 
  347:   return {
  348:     topic: weakest.topic,
  349:     questionNumber:
  350:       weakest.questionNumber,
  351:     successPercentage:
  352:       weakest.successPercentage,
  353:   };
  354: }
  355: 
  356: function buildStudentPriority(
  357:   assignment: ExamAssignment,
  358:   submission: ExamSubmission,
  359:   classAverage: number | null,
  360:   fallbackTopic: string,
  361: ): ExamStudentPriority {
  362:   const reasons: string[] = [];
  363:   let priority: ExamStudentPriority["priority"] =
  364:     "none";
  365: 
  366:   if (submission.integrityTerminated) {
  367:     priority = "high";
  368:     reasons.push(
  369:       "The attempt was automatically submitted by an integrity rule.",
  370:     );
  371:   }
  372: 
  373:   if (
  374:     submission.integrityIncidents.length >= 3
  375:   ) {
  376:     if (priority !== "high") {
  377:       priority = "medium";
  378:     }
  379: 
  380:     reasons.push(
  381:       `${submission.integrityIncidents.length} integrity-monitoring events were recorded for teacher review.`,
  382:     );
  383:   } else if (
  384:     submission.integrityIncidents.length > 0 &&
  385:     priority === "none"
  386:   ) {
  387:     priority = "monitor";
  388: 
  389:     reasons.push(
  390:       `${submission.integrityIncidents.length} integrity-monitoring event${submission.integrityIncidents.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} recorded.`,
  391:     );
  392:   }
  393: 
  394:   const percentage =
  395:     submission.status === "marked"
  396:       ? submission.percentage
  397:       : null;
  398: 
  399:   if (
  400:     percentage !== null &&
  401:     percentage < 40
  402:   ) {
  403:     priority = "high";
  404: 
  405:     reasons.push(
  406:       `Marked result is ${percentage}%, below the 40% intervention threshold.`,
  407:     );
  408:   } else if (
  409:     percentage !== null &&
  410:     classAverage !== null &&
  411:     percentage <=
  412:       classAverage - 15
  413:   ) {
  414:     if (priority !== "high") {
  415:       priority = "medium";
  416:     }
  417: 
  418:     reasons.push(
  419:       `Result is ${round(classAverage - percentage)} percentage points below the current class average.`,
  420:     );
  421:   }
  422: 
  423:   if (
  424:     [
  425:       "submitted",
  426:       "marking",
  427:     ].includes(
  428:       submission.status,
  429:     ) &&
  430:     priority === "none"
  431:   ) {
  432:     priority = "monitor";
  433: 
  434:     reasons.push(
  435:       "The paper is submitted but not yet fully marked, so attainment evidence is incomplete.",
  436:     );
  437:   }
  438: 
  439:   const weakness =
  440:     getStudentExamWeakness(
  441:       assignment,
  442:       submission,
  443:       fallbackTopic,
  444:     );
  445: 
  446:   if (
  447:     weakness.topic &&
  448:     weakness.successPercentage !== null &&
  449:     weakness.successPercentage < 50
  450:   ) {
  451:     if (priority === "none") {
  452:       priority = "monitor";
  453:     }
  454: 
  455:     reasons.push(
  456:       `Weakest marked exam evidence is ${weakness.topic} at ${weakness.successPercentage}% on Q${weakness.questionNumber}.`,
  457:     );
  458:   }
  459: 
  460:   return {
  461:     studentId:
  462:       submission.studentId,
  463:     studentName:
  464:       submission.studentName,
  465:     studentEmail:
  466:       submission.studentEmail,
  467:     status: submission.status,
  468:     percentage,
  469:     integrityIncidentCount:
  470:       submission.integrityIncidents.length,
  471:     integrityTerminated:
  472:       submission.integrityTerminated,
  473:     priority,
  474:     reasons,
  475:     weakestExamTopic:
  476:       weakness.topic,
  477:     weakestQuestionNumber:
  478:       weakness.questionNumber,
  479:     weakestQuestionSuccessPercentage:
  480:       weakness.successPercentage,
  481:   };
  482: }
  483: 
  484: function buildQuestionIntelligence(
  485:   assignment: ExamAssignment,
  486:   marked: ExamSubmission[],
  487:   fallbackTopic: string,
  488: ): ExamQuestionIntelligence[] {
  489:   return assignment.questionSetSnapshot
  490:     .questions.map((question) => {
  491:       let attemptedStudents = 0;
  492:       let omittedStudents = 0;
  493:       let zeroMarkStudents = 0;
  494:       let fullMarkStudents = 0;
  495:       let totalAwardedMarks = 0;
  496: 
  497:       for (const submission of marked) {
  498:         const answer =
  499:           submission.answers.find(
  500:             (item) =>
  501:               item.questionId ===
  502:               question.id,
  503:           );
  504: 
  505:         const response =
  506:           answer?.response?.trim() || "";
  507: 
  508:         if (response) {
  509:           attemptedStudents += 1;
  510:         } else {
  511:           omittedStudents += 1;
  512:         }
  513: 
  514:         const awarded =
  515:           answer?.awardedMarks ?? 0;
  516: 
  517:         totalAwardedMarks += awarded;
  518: 
  519:         if (awarded === 0) {
  520:           zeroMarkStudents += 1;
  521:         }
  522: 
  523:         if (
  524:           question.marks > 0 &&
  525:           awarded >= question.marks
  526:         ) {
  527:           fullMarkStudents += 1;
  528:         }
  529:       }
  530: 
  531:       const markedStudents =
  532:         marked.length;
  533: 
  534:       const totalPossibleClassMarks =
  535:         question.marks *
  536:         markedStudents;
  537: 
  538:       const averageAwardedMarks =
  539:         markedStudents > 0
  540:           ? round(
  541:               totalAwardedMarks /
  542:                 markedStudents,
  543:             )
  544:           : null;
  545: 
  546:       const successPercentage =
  547:         totalPossibleClassMarks > 0
  548:           ? round(
  549:               (totalAwardedMarks /
  550:                 totalPossibleClassMarks) *
  551:                 100,
  552:             )
  553:           : null;
  554: 
  555:       const marksLost =
  556:         Math.max(
  557:           0,
  558:           totalPossibleClassMarks -
  559:             totalAwardedMarks,
  560:         );
  561: 
  562:       const discriminationIndex =
  563:         questionDiscrimination({
  564:           questionId: question.id,
  565:           availableMarks:
  566:             question.marks,
  567:           marked,
  568:         });
  569: 
  570:       return {
  571:         questionId: question.id,
  572:         questionNumber:
  573:           question.questionNumber,
  574:         questionText:
  575:           question.question,
  576:         topic: questionTopic(
  577:           question,
  578:           fallbackTopic,
  579:         ),
  580:         assessmentObjective:
  581:           assessmentObjective(question),
  582:         commandWord:
  583:           commandWord(question),
  584: 
  585:         availableMarks:
  586:           question.marks,
  587:         markedStudents,
  588:         attemptedStudents,
  589:         omittedStudents,
  590:         zeroMarkStudents,
  591:         fullMarkStudents,
  592: 
  593:         totalAwardedMarks,
  594:         totalPossibleClassMarks,
  595:         marksLost,
  596: 
  597:         averageAwardedMarks,
  598:         successPercentage,
  599: 
  600:         attemptPercentage:
  601:           markedStudents > 0
  602:             ? round(
  603:                 (attemptedStudents /
  604:                   markedStudents) *
  605:                   100,
  606:               )
  607:             : null,
  608: 
  609:         omissionPercentage:
  610:           markedStudents > 0
  611:             ? round(
  612:                 (omittedStudents /
  613:                   markedStudents) *
  614:                   100,
  615:               )
  616:             : null,
  617: 
  618:         zeroMarkPercentage:
  619:           markedStudents > 0
  620:             ? round(
  621:                 (zeroMarkStudents /
  622:                   markedStudents) *
  623:                   100,
  624:               )
  625:             : null,
  626: 
  627:         fullMarkPercentage:
  628:           markedStudents > 0
  629:             ? round(
  630:                 (fullMarkStudents /
  631:                   markedStudents) *
  632:                   100,
  633:               )
  634:             : null,
  635: 
  636:         marksLostPercentage:
  637:           totalPossibleClassMarks > 0
  638:             ? round(
  639:                 (marksLost /
  640:                   totalPossibleClassMarks) *
  641:                   100,
  642:               )
  643:             : null,
  644: 
  645:         discriminationIndex,
  646:         discriminationLabel:
  647:           discriminationLabel(
  648:             discriminationIndex,
  649:           ),
  650: 
  651:         difficulty:
  652:           questionDifficulty(
  653:             successPercentage,
  654:             markedStudents,
  655:           ),
  656:       };
  657:     });
  658: }
  659: 
  660: function buildTopicIntelligence(
  661:   questions: ExamQuestionIntelligence[],
  662: ): ExamTopicIntelligence[] {
  663:   const map = new Map<
  664:     string,
  665:     ExamQuestionIntelligence[]
  666:   >();
  667: 
  668:   for (const question of questions) {
  669:     const current =
  670:       map.get(question.topic) || [];
  671: 
  672:     current.push(question);
  673:     map.set(question.topic, current);
  674:   }
  675: 
  676:   return Array.from(map.entries())
  677:     .map(
  678:       (
  679:         [topic, items],
  680:       ): ExamTopicIntelligence => {
  681:         const awardedMarks =
  682:           items.reduce(
  683:             (sum, item) =>
  684:               sum +
  685:               item.totalAwardedMarks,
  686:             0,
  687:           );
  688: 
  689:         const possibleMarks =
  690:           items.reduce(
  691:             (sum, item) =>
  692:               sum +
  693:               item.totalPossibleClassMarks,
  694:             0,
  695:           );
  696: 
  697:         const marksLost =
  698:           Math.max(
  699:             0,
  700:             possibleMarks -
  701:               awardedMarks,
  702:           );
  703: 
  704:         const averageSuccessPercentage =
  705:           possibleMarks > 0
  706:             ? round(
  707:                 (awardedMarks /
  708:                   possibleMarks) *
  709:                   100,
  710:               )
  711:             : null;
  712: 
  713:         return {
  714:           topic,
  715:           questionCount:
  716:             items.length,
  717:           availableMarks:
  718:             items.reduce(
  719:               (sum, item) =>
  720:                 sum +
  721:                 item.availableMarks,
  722:               0,
  723:             ),
  724:           averageSuccessPercentage,
  725:           awardedMarks,
  726:           possibleMarks,
  727:           marksLost,
  728:           marksLostPercentage:
  729:             possibleMarks > 0
  730:               ? round(
  731:                   (marksLost /
  732:                     possibleMarks) *
  733:                     100,
  734:                 )
  735:               : null,
  736:           priority:
  737:             priorityFromPercentage(
  738:               averageSuccessPercentage,
  739:             ),
  740:         };
  741:       },
  742:     )
  743:     .sort((first, second) => {
  744:       if (
  745:         first.averageSuccessPercentage ===
  746:         null
  747:       ) {
  748:         return 1;
  749:       }
  750: 
  751:       if (
  752:         second.averageSuccessPercentage ===
  753:         null
  754:       ) {
  755:         return -1;
  756:       }
  757: 
  758:       return (
  759:         first.averageSuccessPercentage -
  760:         second.averageSuccessPercentage
  761:       );
  762:     });
  763: }
  764: 
  765: function buildAssessmentObjectiveIntelligence(
  766:   questions: ExamQuestionIntelligence[],
  767: ): ExamAssessmentObjectiveIntelligence[] {
  768:   const objectives: (
  769:     | "AO1"
  770:     | "AO2"
  771:     | "AO3"
  772:   )[] = ["AO1", "AO2", "AO3"];
  773: 
  774:   return objectives
  775:     .map((objective) => {
  776:       const items =
  777:         questions.filter(
  778:           (question) =>
  779:             question.assessmentObjective ===
  780:             objective,
  781:         );
  782: 
  783:       if (!items.length) {
  784:         return null;
  785:       }
  786: 
  787:       const awardedMarks =
  788:         items.reduce(
  789:           (sum, item) =>
  790:             sum +
  791:             item.totalAwardedMarks,
  792:           0,
  793:         );
  794: 
  795:       const possibleMarks =
  796:         items.reduce(
  797:           (sum, item) =>
  798:             sum +
  799:             item.totalPossibleClassMarks,
  800:           0,
  801:         );
  802: 
  803:       const marksLost =
  804:         Math.max(
  805:           0,
  806:           possibleMarks -
  807:             awardedMarks,
  808:         );
  809: 
  810:       const averageSuccessPercentage =
  811:         possibleMarks > 0
  812:           ? round(
  813:               (awardedMarks /
  814:                 possibleMarks) *
  815:                 100,
  816:             )
  817:           : null;
  818: 
  819:       return {
  820:         assessmentObjective:
  821:           objective,
  822:         questionCount:
  823:           items.length,
  824:         availableMarks:
  825:           items.reduce(
  826:             (sum, item) =>
  827:               sum +
  828:               item.availableMarks,
  829:             0,
  830:           ),
  831:         awardedMarks,
  832:         possibleMarks,
  833:         averageSuccessPercentage,
  834:         marksLost,
  835:         marksLostPercentage:
  836:           possibleMarks > 0
  837:             ? round(
  838:                 (marksLost /
  839:                   possibleMarks) *
  840:                   100,
  841:               )
  842:             : null,
  843:         priority:
  844:           priorityFromPercentage(
  845:             averageSuccessPercentage,
  846:           ),
  847:       } satisfies ExamAssessmentObjectiveIntelligence;
  848:     })
  849:     .filter(
  850:       (
  851:         value,
  852:       ): value is ExamAssessmentObjectiveIntelligence =>
  853:         Boolean(value),
  854:     )
  855:     .sort((a, b) => {
  856:       if (
  857:         a.averageSuccessPercentage ===
  858:         null
  859:       ) {
  860:         return 1;
  861:       }
  862: 
  863:       if (
  864:         b.averageSuccessPercentage ===
  865:         null
  866:       ) {
  867:         return -1;
  868:       }
  869: 
  870:       return (
  871:         a.averageSuccessPercentage -
  872:         b.averageSuccessPercentage
  873:       );
  874:     });
  875: }
  876: 
  877: export function buildExamClassIntelligence(
  878:   assignment: ExamAssignment,
  879:   submissions: ExamSubmission[],
  880: ): ExamClassIntelligence {
  881:   const submitted =
  882:     submissions.filter(
  883:       (submission) =>
  884:         [
  885:           "submitted",
  886:           "marking",
  887:           "marked",
  888:         ].includes(
  889:           submission.status,
  890:         ),
  891:     );
  892: 
  893:   const marked =
  894:     submissions.filter(
  895:       (submission) =>
  896:         submission.status === "marked",
  897:     );
  898: 
  899:   const started =
  900:     submissions.filter(
  901:       (submission) =>
  902:         submission.status !==
  903:         "not_started",
  904:     );
  905: 
  906:   const markedPercentages =
  907:     marked.map(
  908:       (submission) =>
  909:         submission.percentage,
  910:     );
  911: 
  912:   const classAverage =
  913:     markedPercentages.length > 0
  914:       ? round(
  915:           markedPercentages.reduce(
  916:             (sum, value) =>
  917:               sum + value,
  918:             0,
  919:           ) /
  920:             markedPercentages.length,
  921:         )
  922:       : null;
  923: 
  924:   const highestPercentage =
  925:     markedPercentages.length > 0
  926:       ? Math.max(...markedPercentages)
  927:       : null;
  928: 
  929:   const lowestPercentage =
  930:     markedPercentages.length > 0
  931:       ? Math.min(...markedPercentages)
  932:       : null;
  933: 
  934:   const medianPercentage =
  935:     median(markedPercentages);
  936: 
  937:   const confidence =
  938:     analysisConfidence(
  939:       marked.length,
  940:     );
  941: 
  942:   const fallbackTopic =
  943:     assignment.questionSetSnapshot
  944:       .topic ||
  945:     assignment.questionSetTitle ||
  946:     "General Computer Science";
  947: 
  948:   const questionIntelligence =
  949:     buildQuestionIntelligence(
  950:       assignment,
  951:       marked,
  952:       fallbackTopic,
  953:     );
  954: 
  955:   const topicIntelligence =
  956:     buildTopicIntelligence(
  957:       questionIntelligence,
  958:     );
  959: 
  960:   const assessmentObjectiveIntelligence =
  961:     buildAssessmentObjectiveIntelligence(
  962:       questionIntelligence,
  963:     );
  964: 
  965:   const assessedQuestions =
  966:     questionIntelligence
  967:       .filter(
  968:         (question) =>
  969:           question.successPercentage !==
  970:           null,
  971:       )
  972:       .sort(
  973:         (first, second) =>
  974:           (first.successPercentage || 0) -
  975:           (second.successPercentage || 0),
  976:       );
  977: 
  978:   const integrityByType =
  979:     Object.fromEntries(
  980:       INCIDENT_TYPES.map(
  981:         (type) => [type, 0],
  982:       ),
  983:     ) as Record<
  984:       ExamIntegrityIncidentType,
  985:       number
  986:     >;
  987: 
  988:   let totalIncidents = 0;
  989: 
  990:   for (const submission of submissions) {
  991:     for (
  992:       const incident of
  993:       submission.integrityIncidents
  994:     ) {
  995:       integrityByType[
  996:         incident.type
  997:       ] += 1;
  998: 
  999:       totalIncidents += 1;
 1000:     }
 1001:   }
 1002: 
 1003:   const studentPriorities =
 1004:     submissions
 1005:       .map((submission) =>
 1006:         buildStudentPriority(
 1007:           assignment,
 1008:           submission,
 1009:           classAverage,
 1010:           fallbackTopic,
 1011:         ),
 1012:       )
 1013:       .sort((first, second) => {
 1014:         const order = {
 1015:           high: 0,
 1016:           medium: 1,
 1017:           monitor: 2,
 1018:           none: 3,
 1019:         };
 1020: 
 1021:         return (
 1022:           order[first.priority] -
 1023:           order[second.priority]
 1024:         );
 1025:       });
 1026: 
 1027:   const gradeIntelligence =
 1028:     buildExamGradeIntelligence(
 1029:       assignment,
 1030:       submissions,
 1031:     );
 1032: 
 1033:   const analysisWarnings = [
 1034:     ...confidence.warnings,
 1035:   ];
 1036: 
 1037:   if (
 1038:     gradeIntelligence.boundarySource ===
 1039:     "indicative"
 1040:   ) {
 1041:     analysisWarnings.push(
 1042:       "The assessment grade uses CS Master indicative boundaries, not an official exam-series boundary set.",
 1043:     );
 1044:   }
 1045: 
 1046:   if (
 1047:     questionIntelligence.every(
 1048:       (question) =>
 1049:         question.assessmentObjective ===
 1050:         null,
 1051:     )
 1052:   ) {
 1053:     analysisWarnings.push(
 1054:       "Assessment-objective metadata is unavailable for this paper, so AO analysis cannot be produced.",
 1055:     );
 1056:   }
 1057: 
 1058:   return {
 1059:     studentCount:
 1060:       assignment.studentIds.length,
 1061:     startedCount: started.length,
 1062:     submittedCount:
 1063:       submitted.length,
 1064:     markedCount: marked.length,
 1065: 
 1066:     submissionPercentage:
 1067:       assignment.studentIds.length > 0
 1068:         ? Math.round(
 1069:             (submitted.length /
 1070:               assignment.studentIds.length) *
 1071:               100,
 1072:           )
 1073:         : 0,
 1074: 
 1075:     markingPercentage:
 1076:       submitted.length > 0
 1077:         ? Math.round(
 1078:             (marked.length /
 1079:               submitted.length) *
 1080:               100,
 1081:           )
 1082:         : 0,
 1083: 
 1084:     classAverage,
 1085:     highestPercentage,
 1086:     lowestPercentage,
 1087:     medianPercentage,
 1088: 
 1089:     analysisConfidence:
 1090:       confidence.confidence,
 1091:     analysisWarnings,
 1092: 
 1093:     questionIntelligence,
 1094:     topicIntelligence,
 1095:     assessmentObjectiveIntelligence,
 1096:     studentPriorities,
 1097: 
 1098:     gradeIntelligence,
 1099: 
 1100:     integrity: {
 1101:       cleanSubmissionCount:
 1102:         submitted.filter(
 1103:           (submission) =>
 1104:             submission.integrityIncidents.length === 0 &&
 1105:             !submission.integrityTerminated,
 1106:         ).length,
 1107: 
 1108:       submissionsWithIncidents:
 1109:         submitted.filter(
 1110:           (submission) =>
 1111:             submission.integrityIncidents.length > 0,
 1112:         ).length,
 1113: 
 1114:       integrityTerminatedCount:
 1115:         submitted.filter(
 1116:           (submission) =>
 1117:             submission.integrityTerminated,
 1118:         ).length,
 1119: 
 1120:       totalIncidents,
 1121:       incidentsByType:
 1122:         integrityByType,
 1123:     },
 1124: 
 1125:     hardestQuestion:
 1126:       assessedQuestions[0] || null,
 1127: 
 1128:     easiestQuestion:
 1129:       assessedQuestions.length > 0
 1130:         ? assessedQuestions[
 1131:             assessedQuestions.length - 1
 1132:           ]
 1133:         : null,
 1134: 
 1135:     weakestTopic:
 1136:       topicIntelligence.find(
 1137:         (topic) =>
 1138:           topic.averageSuccessPercentage !==
 1139:           null,
 1140:       ) || null,
 1141: 
 1142:     strongestTopic:
 1143:       [...topicIntelligence]
 1144:         .reverse()
 1145:         .find(
 1146:           (topic) =>
 1147:             topic.averageSuccessPercentage !==
 1148:             null,
 1149:         ) || null,
 1150: 
 1151:     weakestAssessmentObjective:
 1152:       assessmentObjectiveIntelligence.find(
 1153:         (item) =>
 1154:           item.averageSuccessPercentage !==
 1155:           null,
 1156:       ) || null,
 1157: 
 1158:     strongestAssessmentObjective:
 1159:       [
 1160:         ...assessmentObjectiveIntelligence,
 1161:       ]
 1162:         .reverse()
 1163:         .find(
 1164:           (item) =>
 1165:             item.averageSuccessPercentage !==
 1166:             null,
 1167:         ) || null,
 1168:   };
