FILE: services\analytics\gradeAnalyticsService.ts
==============================================================================================================

    1: import { getRecencyMultiplier } from "@/data/analytics/analyticsConfig";
    2: import { getGradeOrder } from "@/data/analytics/gradeBoundaries";
    3: import type {
    4:   AnalyticsEvidence,
    5:   GradeBoundarySet,
    6:   GradeLabel,
    7:   GradeProgressAnalytics,
    8: } from "@/types/analytics";
    9: 
   10: function clampPercentage(value: number): number {
   11:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, value));
   12: }
   13: 
   14: export function calculateWeightedPercentage(
   15:   evidence: AnalyticsEvidence[],
   16: ): number | null {
   17:   const graded = evidence.filter(
   18:     (item) =>
   19:       item.graded &&
   20:       typeof item.percentage === "number",
   21:   );
   22: 
   23:   if (graded.length === 0) return null;
   24: 
   25:   let weightedTotal = 0;
   26:   let weightTotal = 0;
   27: 
   28:   for (const item of graded) {
   29:     const recency = getRecencyMultiplier(item.completedAt);
   30:     const finalWeight = item.weight * recency;
   31: 
   32:     weightedTotal +=
   33:       clampPercentage(item.percentage as number) *
   34:       finalWeight;
   35: 
   36:     weightTotal += finalWeight;
   37:   }
   38: 
   39:   if (weightTotal <= 0) return null;
   40: 
   41:   return Math.round(weightedTotal / weightTotal);
   42: }
   43: 
   44: export function gradeFromPercentage(
   45:   percentage: number,
   46:   boundarySet: GradeBoundarySet,
   47: ): GradeLabel {
   48:   const sorted = [...boundarySet.boundaries].sort(
   49:     (a, b) => b.minimumPercentage - a.minimumPercentage,
   50:   );
   51: 
   52:   return (
   53:     sorted.find(
   54:       (boundary) =>
   55:         percentage >= boundary.minimumPercentage,
   56:     )?.grade || "U"
   57:   );
   58: }
   59: 
   60: export function nextGrade(
   61:   currentGrade: GradeLabel,
   62:   boundarySet: GradeBoundarySet,
   63: ): GradeLabel | null {
   64:   const order = getGradeOrder(boundarySet.qualification);
   65:   const index = order.indexOf(currentGrade);
   66: 
   67:   if (index < 0 || index >= order.length - 1) {
   68:     return null;
   69:   }
   70: 
   71:   return order[index + 1];
   72: }
   73: 
   74: export function gradeGap(
   75:   workingGrade: GradeLabel | null,
   76:   targetGrade: GradeLabel | null,
   77:   boundarySet: GradeBoundarySet,
   78: ): number | null {
   79:   if (!workingGrade || !targetGrade) return null;
   80: 
   81:   const order = getGradeOrder(boundarySet.qualification);
   82:   const workingIndex = order.indexOf(workingGrade);
   83:   const targetIndex = order.indexOf(targetGrade);
   84: 
   85:   if (workingIndex < 0 || targetIndex < 0) return null;
   86: 
   87:   return workingIndex - targetIndex;
   88: }
   89: 
   90: function boundaryForGrade(
   91:   grade: GradeLabel,
   92:   boundarySet: GradeBoundarySet,
   93: ) {
   94:   return boundarySet.boundaries.find(
   95:     (boundary) => boundary.grade === grade,
   96:   );
   97: }
   98: 
   99: function latestMarkedExam(
  100:   evidence: AnalyticsEvidence[],
  101: ): AnalyticsEvidence | null {
  102:   return (
  103:     evidence
  104:       .filter(
  105:         (item) =>
  106:           item.type === "written_exam" &&
  107:           item.graded &&
  108:           typeof item.rawScore === "number" &&
  109:           typeof item.totalMarks === "number" &&
  110:           item.totalMarks > 0,
  111:       )
  112:       .sort(
  113:         (a, b) =>
  114:           (b.completedAt?.getTime() ?? 0) -
  115:           (a.completedAt?.getTime() ?? 0),
  116:       )[0] || null
  117:   );
  118: }
  119: 
  120: export function calculateGradeProgress({
  121:   evidence,
  122:   targetGrade,
  123:   boundarySet,
  124: }: {
  125:   evidence: AnalyticsEvidence[];
  126:   targetGrade: GradeLabel | null;
  127:   boundarySet: GradeBoundarySet;
  128: }): GradeProgressAnalytics {
  129:   const workingPercentage =
  130:     calculateWeightedPercentage(evidence);
  131: 
  132:   const workingGrade =
  133:     workingPercentage === null
  134:       ? null
  135:       : gradeFromPercentage(
  136:           workingPercentage,
  137:           boundarySet,
  138:         );
  139: 
  140:   const followingGrade = workingGrade
  141:     ? nextGrade(workingGrade, boundarySet)
  142:     : null;
  143: 
  144:   const nextBoundary = followingGrade
  145:     ? boundaryForGrade(followingGrade, boundarySet)
  146:     : null;
  147: 
  148:   const currentBoundary = workingGrade
  149:     ? boundaryForGrade(workingGrade, boundarySet)
  150:     : null;
  151: 
  152:   const percentagePointsToNextGrade =
  153:     workingPercentage !== null && nextBoundary
  154:       ? Math.max(
  155:           0,
  156:           nextBoundary.minimumPercentage -
  157:             workingPercentage,
  158:         )
  159:       : null;
  160: 
  161:   const exam = latestMarkedExam(evidence);
  162: 
  163:   let marksToNextGrade: number | null = null;
  164:   let marksAboveCurrentBoundary: number | null = null;
  165: 
  166:   if (
  167:     exam &&
  168:     workingGrade &&
  169:     typeof exam.rawScore === "number" &&
  170:     typeof exam.totalMarks === "number"
  171:   ) {
  172:     if (nextBoundary) {
  173:       const nextMark = Math.ceil(
  174:         (nextBoundary.minimumPercentage / 100) *
  175:           exam.totalMarks,
  176:       );
  177: 
  178:       marksToNextGrade = Math.max(
  179:         0,
  180:         nextMark - exam.rawScore,
  181:       );
  182:     }
  183: 
  184:     if (currentBoundary) {
  185:       const currentMark = Math.ceil(
  186:         (currentBoundary.minimumPercentage / 100) *
  187:           exam.totalMarks,
  188:       );
  189: 
  190:       marksAboveCurrentBoundary = Math.max(
  191:         0,
  192:         exam.rawScore - currentMark,
  193:       );
  194:     }
  195:   }
  196: 
  197:   return {
  198:     workingGrade,
  199:     workingPercentage,
  200:     targetGrade,
  201:     gradeGap: gradeGap(
  202:       workingGrade,
  203:       targetGrade,
  204:       boundarySet,
  205:     ),
  206:     nextGrade: followingGrade,
  207:     percentagePointsToNextGrade,
  208:     marksToNextGrade,
  209:     marksToNextGradeAssessmentTitle:
  210:       exam?.title || null,
  211:     marksAboveCurrentBoundary,
  212:     boundarySet,
  213:   };
  214: }

    1: import type {

    8: function trendText(
    9:   trend: PerformanceTrend,
   10: ): string {
   11:   switch (trend) {
   12:     case "strong_improvement":
   13:       return "Recent performance is improving strongly.";
   14:     case "improving":
   15:       return "Recent performance is improving.";
   16:     case "declining":
   17:       return "Recent performance has declined and should be reviewed.";
   18:     case "stable":
   19:       return "Recent performance is broadly stable.";
   20:     default:
   21:       return "More graded evidence is needed before a reliable trend can be identified.";
   22:   }
   23: }
   24: 
   25: export function buildAnalyticsInterpretation({
   26:   grade,
   27:   trend,
   28:   strongestTopics,
   29:   weakestTopics,
   30: }: {
   31:   grade: GradeProgressAnalytics;
   32:   trend: PerformanceTrend;
   33:   strongestTopics: TopicMastery[];
   34:   weakestTopics: TopicMastery[];
   35: }): StudentAnalyticsInterpretation {
   36:   const strengths = strongestTopics
   37:     .slice(0, 3)
   38:     .map(
   39:       (topic) =>
   40:         `${topic.topic}: ${topic.weightedPercentage}% mastery`,
   41:     );
   42: 
   43:   const priorities = weakestTopics
   44:     .filter((topic) => topic.status !== "secure")
   45:     .slice(0, 3)
   46:     .map(
   47:       (topic) =>
   48:         `${topic.topic}: ${topic.weightedPercentage}% mastery`,
   49:     );
   50: 
   51:   const nextActions: string[] = [];
   52: 
   53:   if (grade.nextGrade) {
   54:     if (
   55:       grade.marksToNextGrade !== null &&
   56:       grade.marksToNextGradeAssessmentTitle
   57:     ) {
   58:       nextActions.push(
   59:         `On the latest marked exam (${grade.marksToNextGradeAssessmentTitle}), ${grade.marksToNextGrade} more mark${
   60:           grade.marksToNextGrade === 1 ? "" : "s"
   61:         } would reach the indicative ${grade.nextGrade} boundary.`,
   62:       );
   63:     } else if (
   64:       grade.percentagePointsToNextGrade !== null
   65:     ) {
   66:       nextActions.push(
   67:         `Improve the weighted assessment score by approximately ${grade.percentagePointsToNextGrade} percentage point${
   68:           grade.percentagePointsToNextGrade === 1
   69:             ? ""
   70:             : "s"
   71:         } to reach the next indicative grade band.`,
   72:       );
   73:     }
   74:   }
   75: 
   76:   if (weakestTopics[0]) {
   77:     nextActions.push(
   78:       `Prioritise ${weakestTopics[0].topic}; it is currently the highest-impact weak area.`,
   79:     );
   80:   }
   81: 
   82:   nextActions.push(
   83:     "Complete further exam-style assessment to strengthen the reliability of the working-grade estimate.",
   84:   );
   85: 
   86:   const targetText = grade.targetGrade
   87:     ? ` against a target of ${grade.targetGrade}`
   88:     : "";
   89: 
   90:   const headline = grade.workingGrade
   91:     ? `Working at ${grade.workingGrade}${targetText}`
   92:     : "Working grade awaiting evidence";
   93: 
   94:   const nextGradeText =
   95:     grade.nextGrade &&
   96:     grade.percentagePointsToNextGrade !== null
   97:       ? ` The next indicative grade is ${grade.nextGrade}, approximately ${grade.percentagePointsToNextGrade} percentage point${
   98:           grade.percentagePointsToNextGrade === 1
   99:             ? ""
  100:             : "s"
  101:         } away.`
  102:       : "";
  103: 
  104:   const priorityText = weakestTopics[0]
  105:     ? ` ${weakestTopics[0].topic} is currently the main priority area.`
  106:     : "";
  107: 
  108:   return {
  109:     headline,
  110:     summary: `${trendText(trend)}${nextGradeText}${priorityText}`,
  111:     strengths,
  112:     priorities,
  113:     nextActions,
  114:   };
  115: }

  101: export function buildInterventionEffectivenessSummary(
  102:   items: InterventionEffectivenessItem[],
  103: ): InterventionEffectivenessSummary {
  104:   const improving = items.filter(
  105:     (item) => item.effectivenessStatus === "improving",
  106:   ).length;

  109:     (item) => item.effectivenessStatus === "limited_change",

  113:     (item) => item.effectivenessStatus === "declining",
  114:   ).length;
  115: 
  116:   const awaitingEvidence = items.filter(
  117:     (item) => item.effectivenessStatus === "awaiting_evidence",
  118:   ).length;
  119: 
  120:   const baselineNeeded = items.filter(
  121:     (item) => item.effectivenessStatus === "baseline_needed",
  122:   ).length;
  123: 
  124:   const reviewReady = improving + limitedChange + declining;
  125: 
  126:   const successfulRate =
  127:     reviewReady > 0
  128:       ? Math.round((improving / reviewReady) * 100)
  129:       : null;
  130: 
  131:   return {
  132:     total: items.length,
  133:     improving,
  134:     limitedChange,
  135:     declining,
  136:     awaitingEvidence,
  137:     baselineNeeded,
  138:     reviewReady,
  139:     successfulRate,
  140:     items: [...items].sort((first, second) => {
  141:       const statusDifference =
  142:         statusRank(first.effectivenessStatus) -
  143:         statusRank(second.effectivenessStatus);
  144: 
  145:       if (statusDifference !== 0) {
  146:         return statusDifference;
  147:       }
  148: 
  149:       return first.studentName.localeCompare(second.studentName);
  150:     }),
  151:   };
  152: }

   12: function gradeValue(value: string | null): number | null {
   13:   if (!value) return null;
   14: 
   15:   const cleaned = value.trim().toUpperCase();
   16:   const numeric = Number(cleaned);
   17: 
   18:   if (Number.isFinite(numeric)) {
   19:     return numeric;
   20:   }

   23:     E: 1,
   24:     D: 2,
   25:     C: 3,
   26:     B: 4,
   27:     A: 5,
   28:     "A*": 6,
   29:   };
   30:

  129: function determineImpactStatus(
  130:   baseline: InterventionAnalyticsBaseline | null,
  131:   current: InterventionAnalyticsBaseline,
  132: ): InterventionImpactStatus {
  133:   if (!baseline) return "baseline_missing";
  134: 
  135:   if (current.evidenceCount <= baseline.evidenceCount) {
  136:     return "awaiting_new_evidence";
  137:   }
  138: 
  139:   const attainment =
  140:     current.weightedPercentage - baseline.weightedPercentage;
  141:   const completion =
  142:     current.completionRate - baseline.completionRate;
  143:   const topic =
  144:     baseline.topicMastery !== null && current.topicMastery !== null
  145:       ? current.topicMastery - baseline.topicMastery
  146:       : null;
  147: 
  148:   const baselineGrade = gradeValue(baseline.workingGrade);
  149:   const currentGrade = gradeValue(current.workingGrade);
  150:   const grade =
  151:     baselineGrade !== null && currentGrade !== null
  152:       ? currentGrade - baselineGrade
  153:       : null;
  154: 
  155:   const positive = [
  156:     attainment >= 5,
  157:     completion >= 5,
  158:     topic !== null && topic >= 5,
  159:     grade !== null && grade > 0,
  160:   ].filter(Boolean).length;
  161: 
  162:   const negative = [
  163:     attainment <= -5,
  164:     completion <= -5,
  165:     topic !== null && topic <= -5,
  166:     grade !== null && grade < 0,
  167:   ].filter(Boolean).length;
  168: 
  169:   if (positive >= 2 && negative === 0) return "improving";
  170:   if (negative >= 2 && positive === 0) return "declining";
  171:   if (positive > 0 && negative > 0) return "mixed";
  172: 
  173:   return "no_change";
  174: }
  175: 
  176: function summary(status: InterventionImpactStatus): string {
  177:   switch (status) {
  178:     case "baseline_missing":
  179:       return "No reliable before-intervention baseline is available for this older intervention.";
  180:     case "awaiting_new_evidence":
  181:       return "The baseline is captured, but no new graded evidence is available yet.";
  182:     case "improving":
  183:       return "Post-intervention evidence shows improvement across multiple indicators.";
  184:     case "declining":
  185:       return "Post-intervention evidence has weakened across multiple indicators.";
  186:     case "mixed":
  187:       return "Some indicators improved while others weakened.";
  188:     default:
  189:       return "New evidence exists, but there is no material overall change yet.";
  190:   }
  191: }
  192: 
  193: function nextAction(status: InterventionImpactStatus): string {

   14: function changeText(
   15:   label: string,
   16:   value: number | null,
   17:   suffix = "",
   18: ): string | null {
   19:   if (value === null || value === 0) {
   20:     return null;
   21:   }
   22: 
   23:   const direction =
   24:     value > 0 ? "increased" : "decreased";
   25: 
   26:   return `${label} ${direction} by ${Math.abs(value)}${suffix}.`;
   27: }

   29: export function buildInterventionReviewCycle(
   30:   impact: InterventionImpact,
   31: ): InterventionReviewCycle {
   32:   const allChanges = [
   33:     changeText("Attainment", impact.attainmentChange, "%"),
   34:     changeText("Completion", impact.completionChange, "%"),
   35:     changeText("Topic mastery", impact.topicMasteryChange, "%"),
   36:     changeText("Working grade", impact.workingGradeChange),
   37:   ].filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value));
   38: 
   39:   const successSignals = allChanges.filter(
   40:     (value) => value.includes("increased"),
   41:   );
   42: 
   43:   const concernSignals = allChanges.filter(
   44:     (value) => value.includes("decreased"),

   46: 
   47:   if (!impact.baseline) {

   53:       evidenceReady: false,
   54:       reassessmentRecommended: false,

   56:       recommendedDecision: "continue",

    1: import {
    2:   TOPIC_DEVELOPING_THRESHOLD,
    3:   TOPIC_SECURE_THRESHOLD,
    4: } from "@/data/analytics/analyticsConfig";
    5: import { getRecencyMultiplier } from "@/data/analytics/analyticsConfig";
    6: import type {
    7:   AnalyticsEvidence,
    8:   TopicMastery,
    9: } from "@/types/analytics";
   10: 
   11: function normaliseTopic(topic: string): string {
   12:   const cleaned = topic.trim();
   13: 
   14:   return cleaned || "General Computer Science";
   15: }
   16: 
   17: export function buildTopicMastery(
   18:   evidence: AnalyticsEvidence[],
   19: ): TopicMastery[] {
   20:   const graded = evidence.filter(
   21:     (item) =>
   22:       item.graded &&
   23:       typeof item.percentage === "number",
   24:   );
   25: 
   26:   const byTopic = new Map<
   27:     string,
   28:     AnalyticsEvidence[]
   29:   >();
   30: 
   31:   for (const item of graded) {
   32:     const topic = normaliseTopic(item.topic);
   33:     const current = byTopic.get(topic) || [];
   34: 
   35:     current.push(item);
   36:     byTopic.set(topic, current);
   37:   }
   38: 
   39:   const rows: TopicMastery[] = [];
   40: 
   41:   for (const [topic, items] of byTopic) {
   42:     let weightedTotal = 0;
   43:     let totalWeight = 0;
   44: 
   45:     for (const item of items) {
   46:       const weight =
   47:         item.weight *
   48:         getRecencyMultiplier(item.completedAt);
   49: 
   50:       weightedTotal +=
   51:         (item.percentage as number) * weight;
   52: 
   53:       totalWeight += weight;
   54:     }
   55: 
   56:     const weightedPercentage =
   57:       totalWeight > 0
   58:         ? Math.round(weightedTotal / totalWeight)
   59:         : 0;
   60: 
   61:     const recent = [...items].sort(
   62:       (a, b) =>
   63:         (b.completedAt?.getTime() ?? 0) -
   64:         (a.completedAt?.getTime() ?? 0),
   65:     )[0];
   66: 
   67:     const recentPercentage =
   68:       recent?.percentage ?? weightedPercentage;
   69: 
   70:     const status =
   71:       weightedPercentage >= TOPIC_SECURE_THRESHOLD
   72:         ? "secure"
   73:         : weightedPercentage >=
   74:             TOPIC_DEVELOPING_THRESHOLD
   75:           ? "developing"
   76:           : "priority";
   77: 
   78:     rows.push({
   79:       topic,
   80:       evidenceCount: items.length,
   81:       weightedPercentage,
   82:       recentPercentage,
   83:       status,
   84:     });
   85:   }
   86: 
   87:   return rows.sort(
   88:     (a, b) =>
   89:       b.weightedPercentage - a.weightedPercentage,
   90:   );
   91: }

   57: function extractYearNumber(
   58:   value: unknown,
   59: ): number | null {
   60:   const text = safeString(value);
   61: 
   62:   if (!text) {
   63:     return null;
   64:   }
   65: 
   66:   const match = text.match(
   67:     /\b(?:year\s*)?(7|8|9|10|11|12|13)\b/i,
   68:   );
   69: 
   70:   if (!match) {
   71:     return null;
   72:   }
   73: 
   74:   const year = Number(match[1]);
   75: 
   76:   return Number.isFinite(year)
   77:     ? year
   78:     : null;
   79: }

   81: function qualificationFromYear(
   82:   year: number | null,
   83: ): AnalyticsQualification | null {
   84:   if (year === null) {
   85:     return null;
   86:   }
   87: 
   88:   if (year <= 11) {
   89:     return "GCSE";
   90:   }
   91: 
   92:   if (year >= 12) {
   93:     return "A_LEVEL";
   94:   }
   95: 
   96:   return null;
   97: }

   99: function inferQualificationFromAssignments(
  100:   assignments: UnifiedAssignment[],
  101: ): AnalyticsQualification | null {
  102:   const years = assignments
  103:     .map((assignment) =>
  104:       extractYearNumber(
  105:         assignment.className,
  106:       ),
  107:     )
  108:     .filter(
  109:       (year): year is number =>
  110:         year !== null,
  111:     );
  112: 
  113:   if (
  114:     years.some(
  115:       (year) => year <= 11,
  116:     )
  117:   ) {
  118:     return "GCSE";
  119:   }
  120: 
  121:   if (
  122:     years.some(
  123:       (year) => year >= 12,
  124:     )
  125:   ) {
  126:     return "A_LEVEL";
  127:   }
  128: 
  129:   return null;
  130: }

  132: function normaliseQualification(
  133:   profile: Record<string, unknown>,
  134:   assignments: UnifiedAssignment[],
  135: ): AnalyticsQualification {
  136:   /*
  137:    * Canonical student curriculum selection takes precedence.
  138:    *
  139:    * A learner can remain enrolled in legacy or mixed-year class records,
  140:    * so inferring qualification from class year before reading the canonical
  141:    * users/{uid}.qualification field can incorrectly downgrade an A-level
  142:    * learner to GCSE (or vice versa).
  143:    *
  144:    * The profile field is the student's explicit CS Master curriculum choice
  145:    * and is already validated during onboarding/profile updates.
  146:    */
  147:   const explicitQualification =
  148:     safeString(
  149:       profile.qualification,
  150:     )
  151:       .trim()
  152:       .toUpperCase();
  153: 
  154:   if (
  155:     explicitQualification === "GCSE"
  156:   ) {
  157:     return "GCSE";
  158:   }
  159: 
  160:   if (
  161:     explicitQualification ===
  162:       "A_LEVEL" ||
  163:     explicitQualification ===
  164:       "A-LEVEL" ||
  165:     explicitQualification ===
  166:       "A LEVEL" ||
  167:     explicitQualification ===
  168:       "ALEVEL"
  169:   ) {
  170:     return "A_LEVEL";
  171:   }
  172: 
  173:   /*
  174:    * Legacy fallback only.
  175:    *
  176:    * Older profiles may pre-date the canonical qualification field. In that
  177:    * case, infer from year/class evidence, then from older course/level fields.
  178:    */
  179:   for (const value of [
  180:     profile.yearGroup,
  181:     profile.year,
  182:     profile.schoolYear,
  183:     profile.classYear,
  184:   ]) {
  185:     const result =
  186:       qualificationFromYear(
  187:         extractYearNumber(value),
  188:       );
  189: 
  190:     if (result) {
  191:       return result;
  192:     }
  193:   }
  194: 
  195:   const fromAssignments =
  196:     inferQualificationFromAssignments(
  197:       assignments,
  198:     );
  199: 
  200:   if (fromAssignments) {
  201:     return fromAssignments;
  202:   }
  203: 
  204:   const raw =
  205:     safeString(
  206:       profile.course,
  207:     ) ||
  208:     safeString(
  209:       profile.level,
  210:     ) ||
  211:     safeString(
  212:       profile.keyStage,
  213:     );
  214: 
  215:   const normalised =
  216:     raw.toLowerCase();
  217: 
  218:   if (
  219:     normalised.includes("gcse") ||
  220:     normalised.includes("ks4") ||
  221:     normalised.includes(
  222:       "key stage 4",
  223:     )
  224:   ) {
  225:     return "GCSE";
  226:   }
  227: 
  228:   if (
  229:     normalised.includes(
  230:       "a level",
  231:     ) ||
  232:     normalised.includes(
  233:       "a-level",
  234:     ) ||
  235:     normalised === "alevel" ||
  236:     normalised === "a_level" ||
  237:     normalised.includes("ks5") ||
  238:     normalised.includes(
  239:       "key stage 5",
  240:     )
  241:   ) {
  242:     return "A_LEVEL";
  243:   }
  244: 
  245:   return "GCSE";
  246: }

  369: function resolveAnalyticsTopic(
  370:   ...candidates: Array<
  371:     string | null | undefined
  372:   >
  373: ): string | null {
  374:   for (
  375:     const candidate of candidates
  376:   ) {
  377:     const raw =
  378:       cleanAssessmentTitle(
  379:         safeString(candidate),

  381:

  383:       !raw ||

  386:       continue;
  387:     }
  388: 
  389:     const normalised =
  390:       normaliseTopic(raw);
  391: 
  392:     const topicTitle =
  393:       safeString(
  394:         normalised.topicTitle,
  395:       );
  396: 
  397:     if (
  398:       topicTitle &&
  399:       !isGenericTopicLabel(
  400:         topicTitle,
  401:       )
  402:     ) {
  403:       return topicTitle;
  404:     }
  405:   }
  406: 
  407:   return null;
  408: }

  410: function assignmentToEvidence(
  411:   assignment:
  412:     UnifiedAssignment,
  413: ): AnalyticsEvidence | null {
  414:   const type =
  415:     evidenceType(assignment);
  416: 
  417:   const graded =
  418:     (

  438:   if (

  449:     );

  455:     id:
  456:       `${assignment.kind}-${assignment.id}`,
  457: 
  458:     type,
  459: 
  460:     title:
  461:       assignment.title,
  462: 
  463:     topic:
  464:       topic ||
  465:       assignment.title,
  466: 
  467:     percentage:
  468:       typeof assignment.percentage ===
  469:       "number"
  470:         ? assignment.percentage
  471:         : null,

  475:       "number"

  477:         : null,

  480:       typeof assignment.totalMarks ===
  481:       "number"
  482:         ? assignment.totalMarks
  483:         : type === "quiz" ||
  484:             type === "ai_quiz"
  485:           ? assignment.totalQuestions
  486:           : null,
  487: 
  488:     completedAt:
  489:       assignment.completedAt,
  490: 
  491:     dueDate:
  492:       assignment.dueDate,
  493: 
  494:     weight:
  495:       ANALYTICS_EVIDENCE_WEIGHTS[
  496:         type
  497:       ],
  498: 
  499:     graded,
  500: 
  501:     sourceAssignmentId:
  502:       assignment.id,

  506:       null,

  513:       type === "written_exam"
  514:         ? "Teacher-assigned written exam"
  515:         : assignment.resourceType ||
  516:           type,

  529: async function getIndependentQuizEvidence(
  530:   studentId: string,
  531: ): Promise<AnalyticsEvidence[]> {
  532:   const snapshot =
  533:     await getDocs(

  535:         collection(

  542:           "createdAt",
  543:           "desc",
  544:         ),

  549:     AnalyticsEvidence[] = [];

  560:         safeString(
  561:           data.title,
  562:         ) ||
  563:         safeString(
  564:           data.topicTitle,
  565:         ) ||
  566:         safeString(
  567:           data.topic,

  570:

  572:         resolveAnalyticsTopic(

  589: 
  590:       const percentage =
  591:         safeNumber(
  592:           data.scorePercent,

  596:         safeNumber(

  598:         );
  599:

  601:         safeNumber(
  602:           data.totalQuestions,
  603:         );

  606:         data.createdAt instanceof
  607:         Timestamp
  608:           ? data.createdAt.toDate()
  609:           : null;

  612:         id:

  618:           rawTitle,
  619: 
  620:         topic,
  621: 
  622:         percentage,
  623: 
  624:         rawScore,
  625: 
  626:         totalMarks:
  627:           totalQuestions,
  628: 
  629:         completedAt,
  630: 
  631:         dueDate: null,
  632: 
  633:         weight:
  634:           ANALYTICS_EVIDENCE_WEIGHTS.quiz,
  635: 
  636:         graded:
  637:           percentage !== null,
  638: 
  639:         /*
  640:          * This is not a teacher assignment,
  641:          * so there is deliberately no assignment ID.
  642:          */
  643:         sourceAssignmentId:
  644:           null,
  645: 
  646:         sourceAssessmentId:
  647:           document.id,
  648: 
  649:         sourceQuestionId:
  650:           null,
  651: 
  652:         sourceQuestionNumber:
  653:           null,
  654: 
  655:         sourceLabel:
  656:           "Independent practice quiz",
  657:       });
  658:     },
  659:   );

  664: function buildMasteryEvidence(
  665:   evidence:
  666:     AnalyticsEvidence[],
  667:   examQuestionEvidence:
  668:     AnalyticsEvidence[],
  669: ): AnalyticsEvidence[] {
  670:   const examsWithQuestionEvidence =
  671:     new Set(
  672:       examQuestionEvidence
  673:         .map(
  674:           (item) =>
  675:             item.sourceAssignmentId,
  676:         )
  677:         .filter(
  678:           (
  679:             value,
  680:           ): value is string =>
  681:             Boolean(value),
  682:         ),
  683:     );
  684: 
  685:   return [
  686:     ...evidence.filter(
  687:       (item) => {
  688:         if (
  689:           item.type !==
  690:           "written_exam"
  691:         ) {
  692:           return true;
  693:         }
  694: 
  695:         if (
  696:           !item.sourceAssignmentId
  697:         ) {
  698:           return true;
  699:         }
  700: 
  701:         return !examsWithQuestionEvidence.has(
  702:           item.sourceAssignmentId,
  703:         );
  704:       },
  705:     ),
  706: 
  707:     ...examQuestionEvidence,
  708:   ];
  709: }

  711: function countEvidenceSources(
  712:   evidence:
  713:     AnalyticsEvidence[],
  714: ): AnalyticsEvidenceSourceCounts {
  715:   const counts:
  716:     AnalyticsEvidenceSourceCounts =
  717:     {
  718:       written_exam: 0,
  719:       quiz: 0,
  720:       ai_quiz: 0,
  721:       programming: 0,
  722:       lesson: 0,
  723:     };
  724: 
  725:   const ids =
  726:     new Map<
  727:       AnalyticsEvidenceType,
  728:       Set<string>
  729:     >();
  730: 
  731:   for (
  732:     const item of evidence
  733:   ) {
  734:     const key =
  735:       item.sourceAssignmentId ||
  736:       item.id;
  737: 
  738:     const current =
  739:       ids.get(item.type) ||
  740:       new Set<string>();
  741: 
  742:     current.add(key);
  743: 
  744:     ids.set(
  745:       item.type,
  746:       current,
  747:     );
  748:   }
  749: 
  750:   for (
  751:     const [
  752:       type,
  753:       values,
  754:     ] of ids.entries()
  755:   ) {
  756:     counts[type] =
  757:       values.size;
  758:   }
  759: 
  760:   return counts;
  761: }

  763: export async function getRichStudentAnalytics(
  764:   studentId: string,
  765: ): Promise<RichStudentAnalytics> {
  766:   const cleanedStudentId =
  767:     studentId.trim();
  768: 
  769:   if (!cleanedStudentId) {
  770:     throw new Error(
  771:       "A valid student account is required.",
  772:     );
  773:   }
  774: 
  775:   const [
  776:     profileSnapshot,
  777:     assignments,
  778:     storedTarget,
  779:     independentQuizEvidence,
  780:   ] = await Promise.all([
  781:     getDoc(
  782:       doc(
  783:         db,
  784:         "users",
  785:         cleanedStudentId,
  786:       ),
  787:     ),
  788: 
  789:     getUnifiedStudentAssignments(
  790:       cleanedStudentId,
  791:     ),
  792: 
  793:     getStudentTargetGrade(
  794:       cleanedStudentId,
  795:     ).catch(
  796:       () => null,
  797:     ),
  798: 
  799:     getIndependentQuizEvidence(
  800:       cleanedStudentId,
  801:     ).catch(
  802:       (error) => {
  803:         console.warn(
  804:           "Independent quiz evidence could not be loaded:",
  805:           error,
  806:         );
  807: 
  808:         return [];
  809:       },
  810:     ),
  811:   ]);
  812: 
  813:   const profile =
  814:     profileSnapshot.exists()
  815:       ? (
  816:           profileSnapshot.data() as
  817:             Record<
  818:               string,
  819:               unknown
  820:             >
  821:         )
  822:       : {};
  823: 
  824:   const qualification =
  825:     normaliseQualification(
  826:       profile,
  827:       assignments,
  828:     );
  829: 
  830:   const examBoard =
  831:     safeString(
  832:       profile.examBoard,
  833:     ) || null;
  834: 
  835:   const targetGrade =
  836:     storedTarget?.qualification ===
  837:     qualification
  838:       ? storedTarget.targetGrade
  839:       : normaliseLegacyTargetGrade(
  840:           profile.targetGrade,
  841:           qualification,
  842:         );
  843: 
  844:   const boundarySet =
  845:     getDefaultBoundarySet(
  846:       qualification,
  847:     );
  848: 
  849:   /*
  850:    * Teacher-assigned evidence.
  851:    */
  852:   const assignmentEvidence =
  853:     assignments
  854:       .map(
  855:         assignmentToEvidence,
  856:       )
  857:       .filter(
  858:         (
  859:           item,
  860:         ): item is AnalyticsEvidence =>
  861:           item !== null,
  862:       );
  863: 
  864:   /*
  865:    * Combine teacher-assigned and independent
  866:    * student-practice evidence.
  867:    */
  868:   const evidence = [
  869:     ...assignmentEvidence,
  870:     ...independentQuizEvidence,
  871:   ];
  872: 
  873:   const examQuestionEvidence =
  874:     await getWrittenExamQuestionEvidence(
  875:       cleanedStudentId,
  876:     ).catch(
  877:       (error) => {
  878:         console.warn(
  879:           "Written exam question evidence could not be loaded:",
  880:           error,
  881:         );
  882: 
  883:         return [];
  884:       },
  885:     );
  886: 
  887:   /*
  888:    * Canonicalise any question-level exam topics
  889:    * before they enter mastery calculations.
  890:    */
  891:   const normalisedExamQuestionEvidence =
  892:     examQuestionEvidence
  893:       .map(
  894:         (
  895:           item,
  896:         ): AnalyticsEvidence | null => {
  897:           const topic =
  898:             resolveAnalyticsTopic(
  899:               item.topic,
  900:               item.title,
  901:             );
  902: 
  903:           if (!topic) {
  904:             return null;
  905:           }
  906: 
  907:           return {
  908:             ...item,
  909:             topic,
  910:           };
  911:         },
  912:       )
  913:       .filter(
  914:         (
  915:           item,
  916:         ): item is AnalyticsEvidence =>
  917:           item !== null,
  918:       );
  919: 
  920:   const masteryEvidence =
  921:     buildMasteryEvidence(
  922:       evidence,
  923:       normalisedExamQuestionEvidence,
  924:     );
  925: 
  926:   /*
  927:    * Independent quizzes are genuine completed
  928:    * learning activities even though they are not
  929:    * teacher assignments.
  930:    */
  931:   const completedAssignmentCount =
  932:     assignments.filter(
  933:       isUnifiedAssignmentComplete,
  934:     ).length;
  935: 
  936:   const completedActivityCount =
  937:     completedAssignmentCount +
  938:     independentQuizEvidence.length;
  939: 
  940:   const totalActivityCount =
  941:     assignments.length +
  942:     independentQuizEvidence.length;
  943: 
  944:   const completionRate =
  945:     totalActivityCount > 0
  946:       ? Math.round(
  947:           (
  948:             completedActivityCount /
  949:             totalActivityCount
  950:           ) *
  951:             100,
  952:         )
  953:       : 0;
  954: 
  955:   const grade =
  956:     calculateGradeProgress({
  957:       evidence,
  958:       targetGrade,
  959:       boundarySet,
  960:     });
  961: 
  962:   const topics =
  963:     buildTopicMastery(
  964:       masteryEvidence,
  965:     );
  966: 
  967:   const strongestTopics =
  968:     topics.slice(0, 3);
  969: 
  970:   const weakestTopics = [
  971:     ...topics,
  972:   ]
  973:     .sort(
  974:       (a, b) =>
  975:         a.weightedPercentage -
  976:         b.weightedPercentage,
  977:     )
  978:     .slice(0, 3);
  979: 
  980:   const trendResult =
  981:     buildTrend(evidence);
  982: 
  983:   const confidence =
  984:     calculateEvidenceConfidence({
  985:       evidence,
  986:       totalActivityCount,
  987:       completedActivityCount,
  988:     });
  989: 
  990:   const interpretation =
  991:     buildAnalyticsInterpretation({
  992:       grade,
  993:       trend:
  994:         trendResult.trend,
  995:       strongestTopics,
  996:       weakestTopics,
  997:     });
  998: 
  999:   return {
 1000:     studentId:
 1001:       cleanedStudentId,
 1002: 
 1003:     qualification,
 1004: 
 1005:     examBoard,
 1006: 
 1007:     targetGrade,
 1008: 
 1009:     grade,
 1010: 
 1011:     confidence,
 1012: 
 1013:     trend:
 1014:       trendResult.trend,
 1015: 
 1016:     trendChange:
 1017:       trendResult.change,
 1018: 
 1019:     trendPoints:
 1020:       trendResult.points,
 1021: 
 1022:     topics,
 1023: 
 1024:     strongestTopics,
 1025: 
 1026:     weakestTopics,
 1027: 
 1028:     evidence,
 1029: 
 1030:     masteryEvidence,
 1031: 
 1032:     evidenceSourceCounts:
 1033:       countEvidenceSources(
 1034:         masteryEvidence,
 1035:       ),
 1036: 
 1037:     completedActivityCount,
 1038: 
 1039:     totalActivityCount,
 1040: 
 1041:     completionRate,
 1042: 
 1043:     interpretation,
 1044:   };
 1045: }

   17:   studentId?: string;

   25: function allowedGrades(
   26:   qualification: AnalyticsQualification,
   27: ): GradeLabel[] {
   28:   return qualification === "A_LEVEL"
   29:     ? ["A*", "A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]
   30:     : ["9", "8", "7", "6", "5", "4", "3", "2", "1"];
   31: }
   32: 
   33: function normaliseGrade(
   34:   value: unknown,
   35:   qualification: AnalyticsQualification,
   36: ): GradeLabel | null {
   37:   if (typeof value !== "string") return null;
   38: 
   39:   const cleaned = value.trim().toUpperCase();
   40: 
   41:   return allowedGrades(qualification).includes(cleaned as GradeLabel)
   42:     ? (cleaned as GradeLabel)
   43:     : null;
   44: }
   45: 
   46: function normaliseQualification(value: unknown): AnalyticsQualification {
   47:   return value === "A_LEVEL" ? "A_LEVEL" : "GCSE";
   48: }
   49: 
   50: export function targetGradeDocumentId(studentId: string): string {
   51:   return studentId.trim();
   52: }
   53: 
   54: export async function getStudentTargetGrade(
   55:   studentId: string,
   56: ): Promise<TargetGradeRecord | null> {
   57:   const cleanedStudentId = studentId.trim();
   58: 
   59:   if (!cleanedStudentId) return null;
   60: 
   61:   const snapshot = await getDoc(
   62:     doc(db, "studentTargets", targetGradeDocumentId(cleanedStudentId)),
   63:   );
   64: 
   65:   if (!snapshot.exists()) return null;
   66: 
   67:   const data = snapshot.data() as FirestoreTargetGrade;
   68:   const qualification = normaliseQualification(data.qualification);
   69: 
   70:   return {
   71:     studentId: cleanedStudentId,
   72:     targetGrade: normaliseGrade(data.targetGrade, qualification),
   73:     qualification,
   74:     teacherId:
   75:       typeof data.teacherId === "string" ? data.teacherId : "",
   76:     classId:
   77:       typeof data.classId === "string" ? data.classId : "",
   78:     updatedAt:
   79:       data.updatedAt instanceof Timestamp
   80:         ? data.updatedAt.toDate()
   81:         : null,
   82:   };
   83: }

   85: export async function saveStudentTargetGrade({
   86:   studentId,
   87:   targetGrade,
   88:   qualification,
   89:   teacherId,
   90:   classId,
   91: }: {
   92:   studentId: string;
   93:   targetGrade: GradeLabel | null;
   94:   qualification: AnalyticsQualification;
   95:   teacherId: string;
   96:   classId: string;
   97: }): Promise<void> {
   98:   const cleanedStudentId = studentId.trim();
   99:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
  100:   const cleanedClassId = classId.trim();
  101: 
  102:   if (!cleanedStudentId) {
  103:     throw new Error("Select a valid student.");
  104:   }
  105: 
  106:   if (!cleanedTeacherId) {
  107:     throw new Error("A teacher account is required.");
  108:   }
  109: 
  110:   if (!cleanedClassId) {
  111:     throw new Error("A class is required.");
  112:   }
  113: 
  114:   if (
  115:     targetGrade !== null &&
  116:     !allowedGrades(qualification).includes(targetGrade)
  117:   ) {
  118:     throw new Error("The target grade is not valid for this qualification.");
  119:   }
  120: 
  121:   await setDoc(
  122:     doc(db, "studentTargets", targetGradeDocumentId(cleanedStudentId)),
  123:     {
  124:       studentId: cleanedStudentId,
  125:       targetGrade,
  126:       qualification,
  127:       teacherId: cleanedTeacherId,
  128:       classId: cleanedClassId,
  129:       updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  130:     },
  131:     { merge: true },
  132:   );
  133: }

  138:   return allowedGrades(qualification);

  104: function weakestTopicForStudent(

  159: function classTopics(
  160:   classItem: TeacherClassAnalytics,
  161: ): {
  162:   priority: ClassTopicAnalytics[];
  163:   strongest: ClassTopicAnalytics[];
  164: } {
  165:   const withEvidence = classItem.topicAnalytics.filter(
  166:     (topic) => topic.evidenceCount > 0,
  167:   );
  168: 
  169:   return {
  170:     /*
  171:      * "Priority" must mean that evidence actually needs attention.
  172:      * Secure topics must never be pulled into this list merely to fill
  173:      * four display slots.
  174:      *
  175:      * <50  = priority
  176:      * 50-69 = developing / watch
  177:      * 70+  = secure
  178:      *
  179:      * The action centre includes priority + developing topics (<70).
  180:      */
  181:     priority: [...withEvidence]
  182:       .filter(
  183:         (topic) =>
  184:           topic.weightedPercentage <
  185:           70,
  186:       )
  187:       .sort(
  188:         (first, second) =>
  189:           first.weightedPercentage -
  190:           second.weightedPercentage,
  191:       )
  192:       .slice(0, 4),
  193: 
  194:     strongest: [...withEvidence]
  195:       .filter(
  196:         (topic) =>
  197:           topic.weightedPercentage >=
  198:           70,
  199:       )
  200:       .sort(
  201:         (first, second) =>
  202:           second.weightedPercentage -
  203:           first.weightedPercentage,
  204:       )
  205:       .slice(0, 4),
  206:   };
  207: }

  209: function normaliseClass(
  210:   classItem: TeacherClassAnalytics,
  211: ): TeacherActionClass {
  212:   const topics = classTopics(classItem);
  213: 
  214:   return {
  215:     classId: classItem.classId,
  216:     className: classItem.className,
  217:     yearGroup: classItem.yearGroup,
  218:     studentCount: classItem.studentCount,
  219:     studentsWithEvidence: classItem.studentsWithEvidence,
  220:     averageWorkingGrade: classItem.averageWorkingGrade || "â€”",
  221:     averageTargetGrade: classItem.averageTargetGrade || "Not set",
  222:     averageWeightedPercentage: classItem.averageWeightedPercentage,
  223:     averageCompletionRate: classItem.averageCompletionRate,
  224:     onOrAboveTargetPercentage: classItem.onOrAboveTargetPercentage,
  225:     highPriorityCount: classItem.highPriorityCount,
  226:     decliningCount: classItem.decliningCount,
  227:     lowEvidenceCount: classItem.lowEvidenceCount,
  228:     priorityTopics: topics.priority,
  229:     strongestTopics: topics.strongest,
  230:   };

  232: 
  233: function aggregateTopics(
  234:   portfolio: TeacherAnalyticsPortfolio,
  235: ): ClassTopicAnalytics[] {
  236:   const groups = new Map<
  237:     string,
  238:     {
  239:       values: number[];
  240:       evidenceCount: number;
  241:       studentCount: number;
  242:     }
  243:   >();
  244: 
  245:   portfolio.classes
  246:     .flatMap((classItem) => classItem.topicAnalytics)
  247:     .forEach((topic) => {
  248:       if (topic.evidenceCount <= 0) return;
  249: 
  250:       const current = groups.get(topic.topic) || {
  251:         values: [],
  252:         evidenceCount: 0,
  253:         studentCount: 0,
  254:       };
  255: 
  256:       current.values.push(topic.weightedPercentage);
  257:       current.evidenceCount += topic.evidenceCount;
  258:       current.studentCount += topic.studentCount;
  259: 
  260:       groups.set(topic.topic, current);
  261:     });
  262: 
  263:   return Array.from(groups.entries()).map(([topic, group]) => {
  264:     const percentage =
  265:       group.values.length > 0
  266:         ? Math.round(
  267:             group.values.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0) /
  268:               group.values.length,
  269:           )
  270:         : 0;
  271: 
  272:     return {
  273:       topic,
  274:       weightedPercentage: percentage,
  275:       recentPercentage: percentage,
  276:       evidenceCount: group.evidenceCount,
  277:       studentCount: group.studentCount,
  278:       status:
  279:         percentage >= 70
  280:           ? "secure"
  281:           : percentage >= 50
  282:             ? "developing"
  283:             : "priority",
  284:     };
  285:   });
  286: }

  288: export async function getTeacherAnalyticsActionCentre(
  289:   teacherId: string,
  290: ): Promise<TeacherAnalyticsActionCentre> {
  291:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
  292: 
  293:   if (!cleanedTeacherId) {
  294:     throw new Error("A teacher account is required.");
  295:   }
  296: 
  297:   const [portfolio, interventions] = await Promise.all([
  298:     getTeacherAnalyticsPortfolio(cleanedTeacherId),
  299:     getTeacherInterventions(cleanedTeacherId),
  300:   ]);
  301: 
  302:   const allStudentRows = portfolio.classes.flatMap((classItem) =>
  303:     classItem.students.map((student) => ({
  304:       student,
  305:       classItem,
  306:     })),
  307:   );
  308: 
  309:   /*
  310:    * A learner can be in more than one class in the same school.
  311:    * Use the highest-priority class row when calculating unique-student
  312:    * headline metrics, while keeping class-specific rows for action lists.
  313:    */
  314:   const uniqueStudents = new Map<string, TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow>();
  315: 
  316:   allStudentRows.forEach(({ student }) => {
  317:     const current = uniqueStudents.get(student.studentId);
  318: 
  319:     if (
  320:       !current ||
  321:       priorityRank(student.interventionPriority) >
  322:         priorityRank(current.interventionPriority)
  323:     ) {
  324:       uniqueStudents.set(student.studentId, student);
  325:     }
  326:   });
  327: 
  328:   const uniqueRows = Array.from(uniqueStudents.values());
  329: 
  330:   const studentsWithEvidence = uniqueRows.filter(
  331:     (student) => student.workingGrade !== null,
  332:   ).length;
  333: 
  334:   const studentsWithTargets = uniqueRows.filter(
  335:     (student) => student.targetGrade !== null,
  336:   );
  337: 
  338:   const studentsBelowTarget = studentsWithTargets.filter(
  339:     (student) =>
  340:       student.gradeGap !== null && student.gradeGap < 0,
  341:   ).length;
  342: 
  343:   const studentsOnOrAboveTarget = studentsWithTargets.filter(
  344:     (student) =>
  345:       student.gradeGap !== null && student.gradeGap >= 0,
  346:   ).length;
  347: 
  348:   const priorityStudents = allStudentRows
  349:     .map(({ student, classItem }) =>
  350:       normaliseStudent({
  351:         student,
  352:         classItem,
  353:       }),
  354:     )
  355:     .filter(
  356:       (student) =>
  357:         student.priority !== "none" ||
  358:         student.gradeGap === null ||
  359:         student.gradeGap < 0 ||
  360:         student.trend === "declining" ||
  361:         student.completionRate < 80 ||
  362:         student.confidence === "low" ||
  363:         student.confidence === "insufficient",
  364:     )
  365:     .sort((first, second) => {
  366:       const priorityDifference =
  367:         priorityRank(second.priority) - priorityRank(first.priority);
  368: 
  369:       if (priorityDifference !== 0) return priorityDifference;
  370: 
  371:       const firstGap = first.gradeGap ?? 0;
  372:       const secondGap = second.gradeGap ?? 0;
  373: 
  374:       if (firstGap !== secondGap) return firstGap - secondGap;
  375: 
  376:       return first.completionRate - second.completionRate;
  377:     });
  378: 
  379:   const classRows = portfolio.classes.map(normaliseClass);
  380:   const allTopics = aggregateTopics(portfolio);
  381: 
  382:   return {
  383:     teacherId: cleanedTeacherId,
  384:     classCount: portfolio.classCount,
  385:     studentCount: portfolio.uniqueStudentCount,
  386:     studentsWithEvidence,
  387:     studentsWithoutEvidence: Math.max(
  388:       0,
  389:       portfolio.uniqueStudentCount - studentsWithEvidence,
  390:     ),
  391:     highPriorityCount: uniqueRows.filter(
  392:       (student) => student.interventionPriority === "high",
  393:     ).length,
  394:     decliningCount: uniqueRows.filter(
  395:       (student) => student.trend === "declining",
  396:     ).length,
  397:     lowEvidenceCount: uniqueRows.filter(
  398:       (student) =>
  399:         student.confidence === "low" ||
  400:         student.confidence === "insufficient",
  401:     ).length,
  402:     studentsWithTargets: studentsWithTargets.length,
  403:     studentsBelowTarget,
  404:     studentsOnOrAboveTarget,
  405:     studentsWithoutTargets: Math.max(
  406:       0,
  407:       portfolio.uniqueStudentCount - studentsWithTargets.length,
  408:     ),
  409:     averageCompletionRate:
  410:       uniqueRows.length > 0
  411:         ? Math.round(
  412:             uniqueRows.reduce(
  413:               (total, student) => total + student.completionRate,
  414:               0,
  415:             ) / uniqueRows.length,
  416:           )
  417:         : 0,
  418:     activeInterventions: interventions.filter(
  419:       (intervention) => intervention.status === "active",
  420:     ).length,
  421:     completedInterventions: interventions.filter(
  422:       (intervention) => intervention.status === "completed",
  423:     ).length,
  424:     priorityStudents,
  425:     classes: classRows,
  426:     priorityTopics: [...allTopics]
  427:       .filter(
  428:         (topic) =>
  429:           topic.weightedPercentage <
  430:           70,
  431:       )
  432:       .sort(
  433:         (first, second) =>
  434:           first.weightedPercentage -
  435:           second.weightedPercentage,
  436:       )
  437:       .slice(0, 6),
  438: 
  439:     strongestTopics: [...allTopics]
  440:       .filter(
  441:         (topic) =>
  442:           topic.weightedPercentage >=
  443:           70,
  444:       )
  445:       .sort(
  446:         (first, second) =>
  447:           second.weightedPercentage -
  448:           first.weightedPercentage,
  449:       )
  450:       .slice(0, 6),
  451:   };
  452: }

    1: import type { TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow } from "@/types/teacherAnalytics";

    3:   TeacherActionRecommendation,
    4:   TeacherActionType,

    7: function chooseActionType(
    8:   row: TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow,
    9: ): TeacherActionType {
   10:   if (
   11:     row.interventionPriority === "high" ||
   12:     (row.gradeGap !== null && row.gradeGap <= -2)
   13:   ) {
   14:     return "intervention";
   15:   }
   16: 
   17:   if (row.trend === "declining") {
   18:     return "quiz";
   19:   }
   20: 
   21:   const weakestTopic = [...row.analytics.topics].sort(
   22:     (first, second) =>
   23:       first.weightedPercentage - second.weightedPercentage,
   24:   )[0];
   25: 
   26:   if (
   27:     weakestTopic &&
   28:     weakestTopic.weightedPercentage < 50
   29:   ) {
   30:     return "lesson";
   31:   }
   32: 
   33:   if (row.completionRate < 70) {
   34:     return "monitor";
   35:   }
   36: 
   37:   return "monitor";
   38: }
   39: 
   40: export function buildTeacherActionRecommendation(
   41:   row: TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow,
   42: ): TeacherActionRecommendation {
   43:   const weakestTopic = [...row.analytics.topics].sort(
   44:     (first, second) =>
   45:       first.weightedPercentage - second.weightedPercentage,
   46:   )[0];
   47: 
   48:   const focusTopic =
   49:     weakestTopic?.topic || "General Computer Science";
   50: 
   51:   const type = chooseActionType(row);
   52: 
   53:   const targetText = row.targetGrade
   54:     ? `Working at ${row.workingGrade || "â€”"} against target ${row.targetGrade}.`
   55:     : `Working grade ${row.workingGrade || "â€”"}; target grade is not set.`;
   56: 
   57:   const gapText =
   58:     row.gradeGap !== null && row.gradeGap < 0
   59:       ? ` The learner is ${Math.abs(row.gradeGap)} grade step${
   60:           Math.abs(row.gradeGap) === 1 ? "" : "s"
   61:         } below target.`
   62:       : "";
   63: 
   64:   const trendText =
   65:     row.trend === "declining"
   66:       ? " Recent performance is declining."
   67:       : "";
   68: 
   69:   const masteryText = weakestTopic
   70:     ? ` ${focusTopic} is currently the weakest assessed area at ${weakestTopic.weightedPercentage}% mastery.`
   71:     : "";
   72: 
   73:   const reason = `${targetText}${gapText}${trendText}${masteryText}`.trim();
   74: 
   75:   if (type === "intervention") {
   76:     return {
   77:       type,
   78:       title: `Create targeted intervention: ${focusTopic}`,
   79:       reason,
   80:       focusTopic,
   81:       suggestedInstruction:
   82:         `Prioritise ${focusTopic}. Re-teach the misconception, use guided practice, then check understanding with a short reassessment. Review whether the grade gap and mastery score improve afterwards.`,
   83:       priority: row.interventionPriority,
   84:     };
   85:   }
   86: 
   87:   if (type === "quiz") {
   88:     return {
   89:       type,
   90:       title: `Reassess ${focusTopic}`,
   91:       reason,
   92:       focusTopic,
   93:       suggestedInstruction:
   94:         `Assign a short retrieval quiz on ${focusTopic}, review incorrect answers and compare the new result with the learner's recent evidence.`,
   95:       priority: row.interventionPriority,
   96:     };
   97:   }
   98: 
   99:   if (type === "lesson") {
  100:     return {
  101:       type,
  102:       title: `Assign targeted lesson: ${focusTopic}`,
  103:       reason,
  104:       focusTopic,
  105:       suggestedInstruction:
  106:         `Assign an exact CS Master lesson covering ${focusTopic}. Ask the learner to complete guided practice and the checkpoint before reassessment.`,
  107:       priority: row.interventionPriority,
  108:     };
  109:   }
  110: 
  111:   return {
  112:     type,
  113:     title: "Monitor and review",
  114:     reason,
  115:     focusTopic,
  116:     suggestedInstruction:
  117:       "Continue collecting graded evidence. Review completion, trend and mastery again after the next assessment.",
  118:     priority: row.interventionPriority,
  119:   };
  120: }

   58: function toDate(value: FirestoreDate): Date | null {
   59:   if (!value) return null;
   60: 
   61:   if (value instanceof Date) {
   62:     return value;
   63:   }
   64: 
   65:   if (value instanceof Timestamp) {
   66:     return value.toDate();

   70:     const parsed = new Date(value);
   71: 
   72:     return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime())
   73:       ? null
   74:       : parsed;
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   return null;
   78: }

  202: function normaliseLegacyTargetGrade(
  203:   value: unknown,
  204:   qualification: AnalyticsQualification,

  218:           "8",

  233: function isPlaceholderStudentName(value: string): boolean {
  234:   const normalised = value.trim().toLowerCase();
  235: 
  236:   return (
  237:     !normalised ||
  238:     normalised === "student" ||
  239:     normalised === "unnamed student" ||
  240:     normalised === "unknown student"
  241:   );

  244: async function getStudentIdentity(
  245:   studentId: string,
  246:   classItem: TeacherClass,
  247: ): Promise<StudentIdentity> {
  248:   const embedded =
  249:     classItem.students?.find(
  250:       (student) =>
  251:         student.studentId === studentId,
  252:     );
  253: 
  254:   /*
  255:    * Prefer the canonical user profile. Older class records can contain
  256:    * placeholder names such as "Unnamed Student", so the embedded class
  257:    * snapshot is only used as a fallback.
  258:    */
  259:   try {
  260:     const snapshot =
  261:       await getDoc(
  262:         doc(db, "users", studentId),
  263:       );
  264: 
  265:     if (snapshot.exists()) {
  266:       const data = snapshot.data();
  267: 
  268:       const profileName =
  269:         safeString(data.name);
  270: 
  271:       const profileEmail =
  272:         safeString(data.email);
  273: 
  274:       if (
  275:         !isPlaceholderStudentName(
  276:           profileName,
  277:         )
  278:       ) {
  279:         return {
  280:           id: studentId,
  281:           name: profileName,
  282:           email:
  283:             profileEmail ||
  284:             embedded?.email ||
  285:             "",
  286:         };
  287:       }
  288:     }
  289:   } catch {
  290:     /*
  291:      * A teacher may legitimately be denied a direct read of users/{studentId}
  292:      * by tenant rules. Identity is already embedded in the teacher-owned class
  293:      * snapshot, so permission denial is a normal fallback rather than an error.
  294:      */
  295:   }
  296: 
  297:   const embeddedName =
  298:     embedded?.displayName || "";
  299: 
  300:   return {
  301:     id: studentId,
  302:     name:
  303:       !isPlaceholderStudentName(
  304:         embeddedName,
  305:       )
  306:         ? embeddedName
  307:         : "Student",
  308:     email:
  309:       embedded?.email || "",
  310:   };
  311: }

  313: /*
  314:  * IMPORTANT:
  315:  *
  316:  * Teacher analytics must NOT call the student-facing
  317:  * getUnifiedStudentAssignments()/getRichStudentAnalytics()
  318:  * pipeline.
  319:  *
  320:  * That pipeline performs direct student-context reads
  321:  * (including "not yet created" result/progress documents).
  322:  * Those are valid for the student, but some are correctly
  323:  * rejected when another account performs the same get.
  324:  *
  325:  * Instead this function reads only teacher-owned collections
  326:  * with queries constrained by teacherId, then filters the

  329: async function getTeacherOwnedStudentAnalytics({
  330:   teacherId,

  390:           teacherId,
