  596:           assignment.dueDate as
  597:             FirestoreDate,
  598:         ),
  599:       weight:
  600:         ANALYTICS_EVIDENCE_WEIGHTS[
  601:           evidenceType
  602:         ],
  603:       graded:
  604:         completed &&
  605:         percentage !== null,
  606:       sourceAssignmentId:
  607:         assignmentDocument.id,
  608:       sourceAssessmentId:
  609:         safeString(
  610:           assignment.resourceId,
  611:         ) || null,
  612:       sourceQuestionId: null,
  613:       sourceQuestionNumber: null,
  614:       sourceLabel:
  615:         evidenceType === "ai_quiz"
  616:           ? "Teacher-assigned AI quiz"
  617:           : "Teacher-assigned quiz",
  618:     });
  619:   }
  620: 
  621:   /*
  622:    * WRITTEN EXAM EVIDENCE
  623:    */
  624:   const submissionByAssignment =
  625:     new Map<
  626:       string,
  627:       Record<string, unknown>
  628:     >();
  629: 
  630:   for (
  631:     const submissionDocument of
  632:     examSubmissionsSnapshot.docs
  633:   ) {
  634:     const data =
  635:       submissionDocument.data();
  636: 
  637:     if (
  638:       safeString(data.studentId) !==
  639:       studentId
  640:     ) {
  641:       continue;
  642:     }
  643: 
  644:     const assignmentId =
  645:       safeString(
  646:         data.assignmentId,
  647:       );
  648: 
  649:     if (assignmentId) {
  650:       submissionByAssignment.set(
  651:         assignmentId,
  652:         data,
  653:       );
  654:     }
  655:   }
  656: 
  657:   for (
  658:     const assignmentDocument of
  659:     examAssignmentsSnapshot.docs
  660:   ) {
  661:     const assignment =
  662:       assignmentDocument.data();
  663: 
  664:     const studentIds =
  665:       safeStringArray(
  666:         assignment.studentIds,
  667:       );
  668: 
  669:     if (
  670:       safeString(
  671:         assignment.classId,
  672:       ) !== classItem.id ||
  673:       !studentIds.includes(
  674:         studentId,
  675:       ) ||
  676:       assignment.status ===
  677:         "cancelled"
  678:     ) {
  679:       continue;
  680:     }
  681: 
  682:     totalActivityCount += 1;
  683: 
  684:     const submission =
  685:       submissionByAssignment.get(
  686:         assignmentDocument.id,
  687:       );
  688: 
  689:     const marked =
  690:       submission?.status ===
  691:       "marked";
  692: 
  693:     if (
  694:       submission?.status ===
  695:         "submitted" ||
  696:       submission?.status ===
  697:         "marking" ||
  698:       marked
  699:     ) {
  700:       completedActivityCount += 1;
  701:     }
  702: 
  703:     const percentage =
  704:       marked
  705:         ? safeNumber(
  706:             submission?.percentage,
  707:           )
  708:         : null;
  709: 
  710:     const rawScore =
  711:       marked
  712:         ? safeNumber(
  713:             submission
  714:               ?.totalAwardedMarks,
  715:           )
  716:         : null;
  717: 
  718:     const totalMarks =
  719:       safeNumber(
  720:         assignment.totalMarks,
  721:       ) ??
  722:       safeNumber(
  723:         submission
  724:           ?.totalAvailableMarks,
  725:       );
  726: 
  727:     const questionSetSnapshot =
  728:       assignment.questionSetSnapshot &&
  729:       typeof assignment.questionSetSnapshot ===
  730:         "object"
  731:         ? (assignment.questionSetSnapshot as Record<
  732:             string,
  733:             unknown
  734:           >)
  735:         : {};
  736: 
  737:     const fallbackExamTopic =
  738:       safeString(
  739:         assignment.topic,
  740:       ) ||
  741:       safeString(
  742:         questionSetSnapshot.topic,
  743:       ) ||
  744:       safeString(
  745:         assignment.title,
  746:         "Written assessment",
  747:       );
  748: 
  749:     evidence.push({
  750:       id:
  751:         `exam-${assignmentDocument.id}`,
  752:       type: "written_exam",
  753:       title:
  754:         safeString(
  755:           assignment.title,
  756:           "Written assessment",
  757:         ),
  758:       topic: fallbackExamTopic,
  759:       percentage,
  760:       rawScore,
  761:       totalMarks,
  762:       completedAt:
  763:         toDate(
  764:           (
  765:             submission
  766:               ?.markedAt ??
  767:             submission
  768:               ?.submittedAt
  769:           ) as FirestoreDate,
  770:         ),
  771:       dueDate:
  772:         toDate(
  773:           assignment.dueDate as
  774:             FirestoreDate,
  775:         ),
  776:       weight:
  777:         ANALYTICS_EVIDENCE_WEIGHTS
  778:           .written_exam,
  779:       graded:
  780:         marked &&
  781:         percentage !== null,
  782:       sourceAssignmentId:
  783:         assignmentDocument.id,
  784:       sourceAssessmentId:
  785:         safeString(
  786:           assignment.questionSetId,
  787:         ) || null,
  788:       sourceQuestionId: null,
  789:       sourceQuestionNumber: null,
  790:       sourceLabel:
  791:         "Teacher-assigned written exam",
  792:     });
  793: 
  794:     /*
  795:      * A marked paper contributes question-level topic evidence.
  796:      * Each question receives only its share of the paper's written-exam
  797:      * weight, so one paper is not treated as several full exams.
  798:      */
  799:     if (marked) {
  800:       const questions =
  801:         safeRecordArray(
  802:           questionSetSnapshot.questions,
  803:         );
  804: 
  805:       const answers =
  806:         safeRecordArray(
  807:           submission?.answers,
  808:         );
  809: 
  810:       const paperMarks =
  811:         totalMarks && totalMarks > 0
  812:           ? totalMarks
  813:           : questions.reduce(
  814:               (sum, question) =>
  815:                 sum +
  816:                 (safeNumber(
  817:                   question.marks,
  818:                 ) || 0),
  819:               0,
  820:             );
  821: 
  822:       for (const question of questions) {
  823:         const questionId =
  824:           safeString(question.id);
  825: 
  826:         if (!questionId) {
  827:           continue;
  828:         }
  829: 
  830:         const answer =
  831:           answers.find(
  832:             (item) =>
  833:               safeString(
  834:                 item.questionId,
  835:               ) === questionId,
  836:           );
  837: 
  838:         const availableMarks =
  839:           safeNumber(question.marks);
  840: 
  841:         const awardedMarks =
  842:           safeNumber(
  843:             answer?.awardedMarks,
  844:           );
  845: 
  846:         if (
  847:           availableMarks === null ||
  848:           availableMarks <= 0 ||
  849:           awardedMarks === null
  850:         ) {
  851:           continue;
  852:         }
  853: 
  854:         const clampedAwardedMarks =
  855:           Math.max(
  856:             0,
  857:             Math.min(
  858:               availableMarks,
  859:               awardedMarks,
  860:             ),
  861:           );
  862: 
  863:         const questionNumber =
  864:           safeNumber(
  865:             question.questionNumber,
  866:           );
  867: 
  868:         const weightShare =
  869:           paperMarks > 0
  870:             ? availableMarks /
  871:               paperMarks
  872:             : 1 /
  873:               Math.max(
  874:                 1,
  875:                 questions.length,
  876:               );
  877: 
  878:         examQuestionEvidence.push({
  879:           id:
  880:             `written-exam-question-${assignmentDocument.id}-${questionId}`,
  881:           type: "written_exam",
  882:           title:
  883:             `${safeString(
  884:               assignment.title,
  885:               "Written assessment",
  886:             )} Â· ${
  887:               questionNumber === null
  888:                 ? "Question"
  889:                 : `Q${questionNumber}`
  890:             }`,
  891:           topic:
  892:             examQuestionTopic(
  893:               question,
  894:               fallbackExamTopic,
  895:             ),
  896:           percentage:
  897:             Math.round(
  898:               (
  899:                 clampedAwardedMarks /
  900:                 availableMarks
  901:               ) * 100,
  902:             ),
  903:           rawScore:
  904:             clampedAwardedMarks,
  905:           totalMarks:
  906:             availableMarks,
  907:           completedAt:
  908:             toDate(
  909:               (
  910:                 submission
  911:                   ?.markedAt ??
  912:                 submission
  913:                   ?.submittedAt
  914:               ) as FirestoreDate,
  915:             ),
  916:           dueDate:
  917:             toDate(
  918:               assignment.dueDate as
  919:                 FirestoreDate,
  920:             ),
  921:           weight:
  922:             ANALYTICS_EVIDENCE_WEIGHTS
  923:               .written_exam *
  924:             weightShare,
  925:           graded: true,
  926:           sourceAssignmentId:
  927:             assignmentDocument.id,
  928:           sourceAssessmentId:
  929:             safeString(
  930:               assignment.questionSetId,
  931:             ) || null,
  932:           sourceQuestionId:
  933:             questionId,
  934:           sourceQuestionNumber:
  935:             questionNumber,
  936:           sourceLabel:
  937:             "Teacher-marked written exam question",
  938:         });
  939:       }
  940:     }
  941:   }
  942: 
  943:   /*
  944:    * RESOURCE / PROGRAMMING ASSIGNMENTS
  945:    *
  946:    * We count teacher-owned assigned resources in completion
  947:    * coverage but do not perform student-context direct reads.
  948:    * Their ungraded status therefore cannot distort the
  949:    * working-grade calculation.
  950:    */
  951:   for (
  952:     const assignmentDocument of
  953:     resourceAssignmentsSnapshot.docs
  954:   ) {
  955:     const assignment =
  956:       assignmentDocument.data();
  957: 
  958:     const studentIds =
  959:       safeStringArray(
  960:         assignment.studentIds,
  961:       );
  962: 
  963:     if (
  964:       safeString(
  965:         assignment.classId,
  966:       ) !== classItem.id ||
  967:       !studentIds.includes(
  968:         studentId,
  969:       ) ||
  970:       assignment.status ===
  971:         "cancelled"
  972:     ) {
  973:       continue;
  974:     }
  975: 
  976:     totalActivityCount += 1;
  977:   }
  978: 
  979:   const completionRate =
  980:     totalActivityCount > 0
  981:       ? Math.round(
  982:           (
  983:             completedActivityCount /
  984:             totalActivityCount
  985:           ) * 100,
  986:         )
  987:       : 0;
  988: 
  989:   const grade =
  990:     calculateGradeProgress({
  991:       evidence,
  992:       targetGrade,
  993:       boundarySet,
  994:     });
  995: 
  996:   /*
  997:    * Keep one whole-paper record for grade/trend/confidence, but replace the
  998:    * aggregate exam topic with question-level evidence for mastery when those
  999:    * question marks are available.
 1000:    */
 1001:   const examsWithQuestionEvidence =
 1002:     new Set(
 1003:       examQuestionEvidence
 1004:         .map(
 1005:           (item) =>
 1006:             item.sourceAssignmentId,
 1007:         )
 1008:         .filter(
 1009:           (
 1010:             value,
 1011:           ): value is string =>
 1012:             Boolean(value),
 1013:         ),
 1014:     );
 1015: 
 1016:   const masteryEvidence = [
 1017:     ...evidence.filter((item) => {
 1018:       if (
 1019:         item.type !==
 1020:         "written_exam"
 1021:       ) {
 1022:         return true;
 1023:       }
 1024: 
 1025:       if (
 1026:         !item.sourceAssignmentId
 1027:       ) {
 1028:         return true;
 1029:       }
 1030: 
 1031:       return !examsWithQuestionEvidence.has(
 1032:         item.sourceAssignmentId,
 1033:       );
 1034:     }),
 1035:     ...examQuestionEvidence,
 1036:   ];
 1037: 
 1038:   const topics =
 1039:     buildTopicMastery(
 1040:       masteryEvidence,
 1041:     );
 1042: 
 1043:   const strongestTopics =
 1044:     topics.slice(0, 3);
 1045: 
 1046:   const weakestTopics =
 1047:     [...topics]
 1048:       .sort(
 1049:         (first, second) =>
 1050:           first
 1051:             .weightedPercentage -
 1052:           second
 1053:             .weightedPercentage,
 1054:       )
 1055:       .slice(0, 3);
 1056: 
 1057:   const trendResult =
 1058:     buildTrend(evidence);
 1059: 
 1060:   const confidence =
 1061:     calculateEvidenceConfidence({
 1062:       evidence,
 1063:       totalActivityCount,
 1064:       completedActivityCount,
 1065:     });
 1066: 
 1067:   const interpretation =
 1068:     buildAnalyticsInterpretation({
 1069:       grade,
 1070:       trend: trendResult.trend,
 1071:       strongestTopics,
 1072:       weakestTopics,
 1073:     });
 1074: 
 1075:   return {
 1076:     studentId,
 1077:     qualification,
 1078:     examBoard:
 1079:       safeString(
 1080:         profile.examBoard,
 1081:       ) || null,
 1082:     targetGrade,
 1083:     grade,
 1084:     confidence,
 1085:     trend: trendResult.trend,
 1086:     trendChange:
 1087:       trendResult.change,
 1088:     trendPoints:
 1089:       trendResult.points,
 1090:     topics,
 1091:     strongestTopics,
 1092:     weakestTopics,
 1093:     evidence,
 1094:     masteryEvidence,
 1095:     evidenceSourceCounts:
 1096:       countEvidenceSources(
 1097:         masteryEvidence,
 1098:       ),
 1099:     completedActivityCount,
 1100:     totalActivityCount,
 1101:     completionRate,
 1102:     interpretation,
 1103:   };
 1104: }
 1105: 
 1106: function interventionFor(
 1107:   analytics: RichStudentAnalytics,
 1108: ): {
 1109:   priority:
 1110:     TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow[
 1111:       "interventionPriority"
 1112:     ];
 1113:   reasons: string[];
 1114: } {
 1115:   const reasons: string[] = [];
 1116:   let score = 0;
 1117: 
 1118:   if (
 1119:     analytics.grade.gradeGap !==
 1120:       null &&
 1121:     analytics.grade.gradeGap <= -2
 1122:   ) {
 1123:     reasons.push(
 1124:       "Two or more grade steps below target",
 1125:     );
 1126:     score += 4;
 1127:   } else if (
 1128:     analytics.grade.gradeGap !==
 1129:       null &&
 1130:     analytics.grade.gradeGap < 0
 1131:   ) {
 1132:     reasons.push(
 1133:       "Below target grade",
 1134:     );
 1135:     score += 2;
 1136:   }
 1137: 
 1138:   if (
 1139:     analytics.trend ===
 1140:     "declining"
 1141:   ) {
 1142:     reasons.push(
 1143:       "Recent performance is declining",
 1144:     );
 1145:     score += 3;
 1146:   }
 1147: 
 1148:   if (
 1149:     analytics.confidence.level ===
 1150:       "insufficient" ||
 1151:     analytics.confidence.level ===
 1152:       "low"
 1153:   ) {
 1154:     reasons.push(
 1155:       "Insufficient assessment evidence",
 1156:     );
 1157:     score += 2;
 1158:   }
 1159: 
 1160:   if (
 1161:     analytics.completionRate < 70
 1162:   ) {
 1163:     reasons.push(
 1164:       "Assignment completion is below 70%",
 1165:     );
 1166:     score += 2;
 1167:   }
 1168: 
 1169:   const priorityTopic =
 1170:     analytics.weakestTopics.find(
 1171:       (topic) =>
 1172:         topic.status ===
 1173:         "priority",
 1174:     );
 1175: 
 1176:   if (priorityTopic) {
 1177:     reasons.push(
 1178:       `${priorityTopic.topic} mastery is ${priorityTopic.weightedPercentage}%`,
 1179:     );
 1180:     score += 2;
 1181:   }
 1182: 
 1183:   if (score >= 6) {
 1184:     return {
 1185:       priority: "high",
 1186:       reasons,
 1187:     };
 1188:   }
 1189: 
 1190:   if (score >= 3) {
 1191:     return {
 1192:       priority: "medium",
 1193:       reasons,
 1194:     };
 1195:   }
 1196: 
 1197:   if (score >= 1) {
 1198:     return {
 1199:       priority: "monitor",
 1200:       reasons,
 1201:     };
 1202:   }
 1203: 
 1204:   return {
 1205:     priority: "none",
 1206:     reasons: [],
 1207:   };
 1208: }
 1209: 
 1210: function gradeDistribution(
 1211:   rows:
 1212:     TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow[],
 1213:   qualification:
 1214:     AnalyticsQualification,
 1215: ): GradeDistributionItem[] {
 1216:   const order =
 1217:     [
 1218:       ...getGradeOrder(
 1219:         qualification,
 1220:       ),
 1221:     ].reverse();
 1222: 
 1223:   return order.map((grade) => ({
 1224:     grade,
 1225:     count: rows.filter(
 1226:       (row) =>
 1227:         row.workingGrade === grade,
 1228:     ).length,
 1229:   }));
 1230: }
 1231: 
 1232: function averageGrade(
 1233:   grades:
 1234:     (GradeLabel | null)[],
 1235:   qualification:
 1236:     AnalyticsQualification,
 1237: ): GradeLabel | null {
 1238:   const order =
 1239:     getGradeOrder(
 1240:       qualification,
 1241:     );
 1242: 
 1243:   const indexes =
 1244:     grades
 1245:       .filter(
 1246:         (
 1247:           grade,
 1248:         ): grade is GradeLabel =>
 1249:           grade !== null,
 1250:       )
 1251:       .map((grade) =>
 1252:         order.indexOf(grade),
 1253:       )
 1254:       .filter(
 1255:         (index) =>
 1256:           index >= 0,
 1257:       );
 1258: 
 1259:   if (indexes.length === 0) {
 1260:     return null;
 1261:   }
 1262: 
 1263:   const averageIndex =
 1264:     Math.round(
 1265:       indexes.reduce(
 1266:         (sum, index) =>
 1267:           sum + index,
 1268:         0,
 1269:       ) / indexes.length,
 1270:     );
 1271: 
 1272:   return order[
 1273:     Math.max(
 1274:       0,
 1275:       Math.min(
 1276:         order.length - 1,
 1277:         averageIndex,
 1278:       ),
 1279:     )
 1280:   ];
 1281: }
 1282: 
 1283: function aggregateTopics(
 1284:   rows:
 1285:     TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow[],
 1286: ): ClassTopicAnalytics[] {
 1287:   const groups =
 1288:     new Map<
 1289:       string,
 1290:       {
 1291:         percentages: number[];
 1292:         evidence: number;
 1293:         recent: number[];
 1294:       }
 1295:     >();
 1296: 
 1297:   for (const row of rows) {
 1298:     for (
 1299:       const topic of
 1300:       row.analytics.topics
 1301:     ) {
 1302:       const current =
 1303:         groups.get(
 1304:           topic.topic,
 1305:         ) || {
 1306:           percentages: [],
 1307:           evidence: 0,
 1308:           recent: [],
 1309:         };
 1310: 
 1311:       current.percentages.push(
 1312:         topic.weightedPercentage,
 1313:       );
 1314: 
 1315:       current.recent.push(
 1316:         topic.recentPercentage,
 1317:       );
 1318: 
 1319:       current.evidence +=
 1320:         topic.evidenceCount;
 1321: 
 1322:       groups.set(
 1323:         topic.topic,
 1324:         current,
 1325:       );
 1326:     }
 1327:   }
 1328: 
 1329:   return [
 1330:     ...groups.entries(),
 1331:   ]
 1332:     .map(
 1333:       ([topic, group]) => {
 1334:         const weightedPercentage =
 1335:           Math.round(
 1336:             group.percentages.reduce(
 1337:               (
 1338:                 sum,
 1339:                 value,
 1340:               ) =>
 1341:                 sum + value,
 1342:               0,
 1343:             ) /
 1344:               group
 1345:                 .percentages
 1346:                 .length,
 1347:           );
 1348: 
 1349:         const recentPercentage =
 1350:           Math.round(
 1351:             group.recent.reduce(
 1352:               (
 1353:                 sum,
 1354:                 value,
 1355:               ) =>
 1356:                 sum + value,
 1357:               0,
 1358:             ) /
 1359:               group.recent.length,
 1360:           );
 1361: 
 1362:         return {
 1363:           topic,
 1364:           evidenceCount:
 1365:             group.evidence,
 1366:           studentCount:
 1367:             group
 1368:               .percentages
 1369:               .length,
 1370:           weightedPercentage,
 1371:           recentPercentage,
 1372:           status:
 1373:             weightedPercentage >=
 1374:             70
 1375:               ? "secure"
 1376:               : weightedPercentage >=
 1377:                   50
 1378:                 ? "developing"
 1379:                 : "priority",
 1380:         } satisfies ClassTopicAnalytics;
 1381:       },
 1382:     )
 1383:     .sort(
 1384:       (first, second) =>
 1385:         first
 1386:           .weightedPercentage -
 1387:         second
 1388:           .weightedPercentage,
 1389:     );
 1390: }
 1391: 
 1392: async function buildClassAnalytics(
 1393:   classItem: TeacherClass,
 1394:   teacherId: string,
 1395: ): Promise<TeacherClassAnalytics> {
 1396:   const qualification =
 1397:     qualificationFromClass(
 1398:       classItem,
 1399:     );
 1400: 
 1401:   const studentIds =
 1402:     Array.from(
 1403:       new Set(
 1404:         classItem.studentIds ||
 1405:           [],
 1406:       ),
 1407:     );
 1408: 
 1409:   /*
 1410:    * Every enrolled student gets a row.
 1411:    * We no longer discard a student merely because one
 1412:    * analytics evidence source is unavailable.
 1413:    */
 1414:   const students =
 1415:     await Promise.all(
 1416:       studentIds.map(
 1417:         async (studentId) => {
 1418:           const identity =
 1419:             await getStudentIdentity(
 1420:               studentId,
 1421:               classItem,
 1422:             );
 1423: 
 1424:           const analytics =
 1425:             await getTeacherOwnedStudentAnalytics({
 1426:               teacherId,
 1427:               studentId,
 1428:               classItem,
 1429:             });
 1430: 
 1431:           const intervention =
 1432:             interventionFor(
 1433:               analytics,
 1434:             );
 1435: 
 1436:           return {
 1437:             studentId,
 1438:             studentName:
 1439:               identity.name,
 1440:             studentEmail:
 1441:               identity.email,
 1442:             classId:
 1443:               classItem.id,
 1444:             className:
 1445:               classItem.name,
 1446:             qualification:
 1447:               analytics.qualification,
 1448:             workingGrade:
 1449:               analytics.grade
 1450:                 .workingGrade,
 1451:             targetGrade:
 1452:               analytics.grade
 1453:                 .targetGrade,
 1454:             workingPercentage:

  138: export function buildReportSummary(
  139:   portfolio: TeacherAnalyticsPortfolio,
  140: ): IntelligenceReportSummary {
  141:   const students = portfolio.classes.flatMap(
  142:     (classItem) => classItem.students,
  143:   );
  144: 
  145:   const studentsWithTargets = students.filter(
  146:     (student) => student.targetGrade !== null,
  147:   );
  148: 
  149:   const studentsWithoutTargets =
  150:     students.length - studentsWithTargets.length;
  151: 
  152:   const onOrAboveTarget = studentsWithTargets.filter(
  153:     (student) =>
  154:       student.gradeGap !== null &&
  155:       student.gradeGap >= 0,
  156:   ).length;
  157: 
  158:   const belowTarget = studentsWithTargets.filter(
  159:     (student) =>
  160:       student.gradeGap !== null &&
  161:       student.gradeGap < 0,
  162:   ).length;
  163: 
  164:   const allTopics = portfolio.classes.flatMap(
  165:     (classItem) => classItem.topicAnalytics,
  166:   );
  167: 
  168:   const topicGroups = new Map<
  169:     string,
  170:     { values: number[]; evidence: number; students: number }
  171:   >();
  172: 
  173:   for (const topic of allTopics) {
  174:     const current =
  175:       topicGroups.get(topic.topic) || {
  176:         values: [],
  177:         evidence: 0,
  178:         students: 0,
  179:       };
  180: 
  181:     current.values.push(topic.weightedPercentage);
  182:     current.evidence += topic.evidenceCount;
  183:     current.students += topic.studentCount;
  184: 
  185:     topicGroups.set(topic.topic, current);
  186:   }
  187: 
  188:   const aggregatedTopics: ClassTopicAnalytics[] = [
  189:     ...topicGroups.entries(),
  190:   ].map(([topic, values]) => {
  191:     const percentage =
  192:       values.values.length > 0
  193:         ? Math.round(
  194:             values.values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) /
  195:               values.values.length,
  196:           )
  197:         : 0;
  198: 
  199:     return {
  200:       topic,
  201:       weightedPercentage: percentage,
  202:       recentPercentage: percentage,
  203:       evidenceCount: values.evidence,
  204:       studentCount: values.students,
  205:       status:
  206:         percentage >= 70
  207:           ? "secure"
  208:           : percentage >= 50
  209:             ? "developing"
  210:             : "priority",
  211:     };
  212:   });
  213: 
  214:   const averageCompletionRate =
  215:     students.length > 0
  216:       ? Math.round(
  217:           students.reduce(
  218:             (sum, student) => sum + student.completionRate,
  219:             0,
  220:           ) / students.length,
  221:         )
  222:       : 0;
  223: 
  224:   return {
  225:     classCount: portfolio.classCount,
  226:     studentCount: portfolio.uniqueStudentCount,
  227:     studentsWithTargets: studentsWithTargets.length,
  228:     studentsWithoutTargets,
  229:     onOrAboveTarget,
  230:     belowTarget,
  231:     highPriority: students.filter(
  232:       (student) => student.interventionPriority === "high",
  233:     ).length,
  234:     declining: students.filter(
  235:       (student) => student.trend === "declining",
  236:     ).length,
  237:     lowEvidence: students.filter(
  238:       (student) =>
  239:         student.confidence === "low" ||
  240:         student.confidence === "insufficient",
  241:     ).length,
  242:     averageCompletionRate,
  243:     priorityTopics: [...aggregatedTopics]
  244:       .sort(
  245:         (first, second) =>
  246:           first.weightedPercentage - second.weightedPercentage,
  247:       )
  248:       .slice(0, 6),
  249:     strongestTopics: [...aggregatedTopics]
  250:       .sort(
  251:         (first, second) =>
  252:           second.weightedPercentage - first.weightedPercentage,
  253:       )
  254:       .slice(0, 6),
  255:   };
  256: }

FILE: services\analytics\trendAnalyticsService.ts
==============================================================================================================

    1: import {
    2:   TREND_DECLINE,
    3:   TREND_IMPROVEMENT,
    4:   TREND_STRONG_IMPROVEMENT,
    5: } from "@/data/analytics/analyticsConfig";
    6: import type {
    7:   AnalyticsEvidence,
    8:   PerformanceTrend,
    9:   TrendPoint,
   10: } from "@/types/analytics";
   11: 
   12: export function buildTrend(
   13:   evidence: AnalyticsEvidence[],
   14: ): {
   15:   trend: PerformanceTrend;
   16:   change: number | null;
   17:   points: TrendPoint[];
   18: } {
   19:   const points = evidence
   20:     .filter(
   21:       (item) =>
   22:         item.graded &&
   23:         typeof item.percentage === "number",
   24:     )
   25:     .sort(
   26:       (a, b) =>
   27:         (a.completedAt?.getTime() ?? 0) -
   28:         (b.completedAt?.getTime() ?? 0),
   29:     )
   30:     .slice(-8)
   31:     .map((item) => ({
   32:       id: item.id,
   33:       title: item.title,
   34:       percentage: item.percentage as number,
   35:       completedAt: item.completedAt,
   36:     }));
   37: 
   38:   if (points.length < 3) {
   39:     return {
   40:       trend: "insufficient_evidence",
   41:       change: null,
   42:       points,
   43:     };
   44:   }
   45: 
   46:   const split = Math.max(
   47:     1,
   48:     Math.floor(points.length / 2),
   49:   );
   50: 
   51:   const early = points.slice(0, split);
   52:   const recent = points.slice(split);
   53: 
   54:   const average = (values: number[]) =>
   55:     values.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0) /
   56:     values.length;
   57: 
   58:   const earlyAverage = average(
   59:     early.map((point) => point.percentage),
   60:   );
   61: 
   62:   const recentAverage = average(
   63:     recent.map((point) => point.percentage),
   64:   );
   65: 
   66:   const change = Math.round(
   67:     recentAverage - earlyAverage,
   68:   );
   69: 
   70:   let trend: PerformanceTrend = "stable";
   71: 
   72:   if (change >= TREND_STRONG_IMPROVEMENT) {
   73:     trend = "strong_improvement";
   74:   } else if (change >= TREND_IMPROVEMENT) {
   75:     trend = "improving";
   76:   } else if (change <= TREND_DECLINE) {
   77:     trend = "declining";
   78:   }
   79: 
   80:   return {
   81:     trend,
   82:     change,
   83:     points,
   84:   };
   85: }

FILE: services\analytics\writtenExamQuestionEvidenceService.ts

    1: import { ANALYTICS_EVIDENCE_WEIGHTS } from "@/data/analytics/analyticsConfig";
    2: import { getStudentExamAssignments } from "@/services/examAssignmentService";
    3: import { getExamSubmission } from "@/services/examSubmissionService";
    4: import type { AnalyticsEvidence } from "@/types/analytics";
    5: 
    6: function safeTopic(question: unknown, fallback: string): string {
    7:   if (!question || typeof question !== "object") return fallback;
    8: 
    9:   const data = question as Record<string, unknown>;
   10:   const candidates = [
   11:     data.topic,
   12:     data.topicFocus,
   13:     data.subtopic,
   14:     data.curriculumTopic,
   15:   ];
   16: 
   17:   for (const candidate of candidates) {
   18:     if (typeof candidate === "string" && candidate.trim()) {
   19:       return candidate.trim();
   20:     }
   21:   }
   22: 
   23:   return fallback;
   24: }
   25: 
   26: function safeMarks(value: unknown): number {
   27:   return typeof value === "number" &&
   28:     Number.isFinite(value) &&
   29:     value > 0
   30:     ? value
   31:     : 0;
   32: }
   33: 
   34: export async function getWrittenExamQuestionEvidence(
   35:   studentId: string,
   36: ): Promise<AnalyticsEvidence[]> {
   37:   const id = studentId.trim();
   38:   if (!id) return [];
   39: 
   40:   const assignments = await getStudentExamAssignments(id);
   41: 
   42:   const submissions = await Promise.all(
   43:     assignments.map((assignment) =>
   44:       getExamSubmission(assignment.id, id).catch(() => null),
   45:     ),
   46:   );
   47: 
   48:   const evidence: AnalyticsEvidence[] = [];
   49: 
   50:   assignments.forEach((assignment, assignmentIndex) => {
   51:     const submission = submissions[assignmentIndex];
   52: 
   53:     if (!submission || submission.status !== "marked") return;
   54: 
   55:     const fallbackTopic =
   56:       assignment.questionSetSnapshot.topic ||
   57:       assignment.questionSetTitle ||
   58:       assignment.title ||
   59:       "General Computer Science";
   60: 
   61:     const paperMarks =
   62:       assignment.totalMarks > 0
   63:         ? assignment.totalMarks
   64:         : submission.totalAvailableMarks;
   65: 
   66:     assignment.questionSetSnapshot.questions.forEach((question) => {
   67:       const answer = submission.answers.find(
   68:         (item) => item.questionId === question.id,
   69:       );
   70: 
   71:       if (!answer || answer.awardedMarks === null) return;
   72: 
   73:       const availableMarks = safeMarks(question.marks);
   74:       if (availableMarks <= 0) return;
   75: 
   76:       const awardedMarks = Math.max(
   77:         0,
   78:         Math.min(availableMarks, answer.awardedMarks),
   79:       );
   80: 
   81:       const weightShare =
   82:         paperMarks > 0
   83:           ? availableMarks / paperMarks
   84:           : 1 / Math.max(1, assignment.questionCount);
   85: 
   86:       evidence.push({
   87:         id: `written-exam-question-${assignment.id}-${question.id}`,
   88:         type: "written_exam",
   89:         title: `${assignment.title} Â· Q${question.questionNumber}`,
   90:         topic: safeTopic(question, fallbackTopic),
   91:         percentage: Math.round(
   92:           (awardedMarks / availableMarks) * 100,
   93:         ),
   94:         rawScore: awardedMarks,
   95:         totalMarks: availableMarks,
   96:         completedAt:
   97:           submission.markedAt || submission.submittedAt || null,
   98:         dueDate: assignment.dueDate,
   99:         weight:
  100:           ANALYTICS_EVIDENCE_WEIGHTS.written_exam * weightShare,
  101:         graded: true,
  102:         sourceAssignmentId: assignment.id,
  103:         sourceAssessmentId: assignment.questionSetId,
  104:         sourceQuestionId: question.id,
  105:         sourceQuestionNumber: question.questionNumber,
  106:         sourceLabel: "Teacher-marked written exam question",
  107:       });
  108:     });
  109:   });
  110: 
  111:   return evidence;
  112: }

    9: export type QuizIntegrityIncidentType =
   10:   | "fullscreen_exit"
   11:   | "fullscreen_restored"
   12:   | "page_hidden"
   13:   | "page_visible"
   14:   | "auto_submit";
   15: 
   16: export type QuizIntegrityIncident = {
   17:   id: string;
   18:   type: QuizIntegrityIncidentType;
   19:   occurredAt: string;
   20:   questionNumber: number | null;
   21:   detail: string;
   22: };
   23: 
   24: export type SaveAssignmentResultInput = {
   25:   assignmentId: string;
   26:   studentId: string;
   27:   classId: string;
   28:   teacherId: string;
   29:   assignmentType: "lesson" | "quiz";
   30:   resourceId: string;
   31: 
   32:   score?: number;
   33:   totalQuestions?: number;
   34:   percentage?: number;
   35:   earnedXP?: number;
   36:   timeTakenSeconds?: number;
   37: 
   38:   /*
   39:    * Quiz delivery / integrity evidence.
   40:    *
   41:    * Practice assignments keep the default "practice" value.
   42:    * Assessment quizzes may additionally save an integrity timeline.
   43:    */
   44:   deliveryMode?: "practice" | "assessment";
   45:   integritySessionStartedAt?: string | null;
   46:   integrityIncidents?: QuizIntegrityIncident[];
   47:   integrityTerminated?: boolean;
   48:   integrityTerminationReason?: string;
   49: };
   50: 
   51: export async function saveAssignmentResult({
   52:   assignmentId,
   53:   studentId,
   54:   classId,
   55:   teacherId,
   56:   assignmentType,
   57:   resourceId,
   58:   score = 0,
   59:   totalQuestions = 0,
   60:   percentage = 0,
   61:   earnedXP = 0,
   62:   timeTakenSeconds = 0,
   63:   deliveryMode = "practice",
   64:   integritySessionStartedAt = null,
   65:   integrityIncidents = [],
   66:   integrityTerminated = false,
   67:   integrityTerminationReason = "",
   68: }: SaveAssignmentResultInput) {
   69:   const resultId = `${assignmentId}_${studentId}`;
   70: 
   71:   const resultRef = doc(
   72:     db,
   73:     "assignmentResults",
   74:     resultId,
   75:   );
   76: 
   77:   await setDoc(
   78:     resultRef,
   79:     {
   80:       assignmentId,
   81:       studentId,
   82:       classId,
   83:       teacherId,
   84:       assignmentType,
   85:       resourceId,
   86: 
   87:       score,
   88:       totalQuestions,
   89:       percentage,
   90:       earnedXP,
   91:       timeTakenSeconds,
   92: 
   93:       status: "completed",
   94: 
   95:       deliveryMode,
   96: 
   97:       ...(deliveryMode === "assessment"
   98:         ? {
   99:             integritySessionStartedAt,
  100:             integrityIncidents,
  101:             integrityTerminated,
  102:             integrityTerminationReason,
  103:           }
  104:         : {}),
  105: 
  106:       completedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  107:     },
  108:     {
  109:       merge: true,
  110:     },
  111:   );
  112: 
  113:   return resultId;
  114: }

    1: import {
    2:   addDoc,
    3:   arrayUnion,
    4:   collection,

    7:   updateDoc,

    9:

   11: 
   12: export type QuizAssignmentSource =
   13:   | "built-in"
   14:   | "ai-generated";
   15: 
   16: export type QuizDeliveryMode =
   17:   | "practice"
   18:   | "assessment";
   19: 
   20: export type CreateAssignmentInput = {
   21:   teacherId: string;
   22:   classId: string;
   23:   title: string;
   24:   description: string;
   25:   type: "lesson" | "quiz";
   26:   resourceId: string;
   27:   dueDate: string;
   28: 
   29:   quizSource?: QuizAssignmentSource;
   30:   deliveryMode?: QuizDeliveryMode;
   31: };
   32: 
   33: export async function createAssignment({
   34:   teacherId,
   35:   classId,
   36:   title,
   37:   description,
   38:   type,
   39:   resourceId,
   40:   dueDate,
   41:   quizSource,
   42:   deliveryMode,
   43: }: CreateAssignmentInput) {
   44:   const assignmentRef = await addDoc(
   45:     collection(db, "assignments"),
   46:     {
   47:       teacherId,
   48:       classId,
   49:       title,
   50:       description,
   51:       type,
   52:       resourceId,
   53:       dueDate,
   54: 
   55:       ...(type === "quiz"
   56:         ? {
   57:             quizSource:
   58:               quizSource || "built-in",
   59: 
   60:             deliveryMode:
   61:               deliveryMode || "practice",
   62:           }
   63:         : {}),
   64: 
   65:       status: "active",
   66:       createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
   67:     },
   68:   );
   69: 
   70:   await updateDoc(
   71:     doc(db, "classes", classId),
   72:     {
   73:       assignmentIds: arrayUnion(
   74:         assignmentRef.id,
   75:       ),
   76:     },
   77:   );
   78: 
   79:   return assignmentRef.id;
   80: }

FILE: services\assistantService.ts
==============================================================================================================

    1: import type {
    2:   AssistantApiResponse,
    3:   SendAssistantMessageInput,
    4: } from "@/types/assistant";
    5: 
    6: export async function sendAssistantMessage({
    7:   message,
    8:   mode,
    9:   conversation,
   10:   useDemo = false,
   11: }: SendAssistantMessageInput): Promise<AssistantApiResponse> {
   12:   const cleanedMessage = message.trim();
   13: 
   14:   if (!cleanedMessage) {
   15:     throw new Error("Enter a message for the assistant.");
   16:   }
   17: 
   18:   const response = await fetch("/api/ai/chat", {
   19:     method: "POST",
   20: 
   21:     headers: {
   22:       "Content-Type": "application/json",
   23:     },
   24: 
   25:     body: JSON.stringify({
   26:       message: cleanedMessage,
   27:       mode,
   28:       conversation,
   29:       useDemo,
   30:     }),
   31:   });
   32: 
   33:   let data: AssistantApiResponse;
   34: 
   35:   try {
   36:     data = (await response.json()) as AssistantApiResponse;
   37:   } catch {
   38:     throw new Error("The assistant returned an invalid response.");
   39:   }
   40: 
   41:   if (!response.ok) {
   42:     throw new Error(data.error || "The assistant could not respond.");
   43:   }
   44: 
   45:   if (!data.message) {
   46:     throw new Error("The assistant did not return a message.");
   47:   }
   48: 
   49:   return data;
   50: }

    1: import {
    2:   createUserWithEmailAndPassword,
    3:   deleteUser,
    4:   sendPasswordResetEmail,
    5:   signInWithEmailAndPassword,
    6:   signOut,
    7:   updateProfile,
    8:   type UserCredential,
    9: } from "firebase/auth";
   10: 
   11: import {
   12:   doc,
   13:   serverTimestamp,
   14:   setDoc,
   15: } from "firebase/firestore";
   16: 
   17: import { auth, db } from "@/lib/firebase";
   18: 
   19: export type RegistrationAccountType = "student" | "teacher";
   20: 
   21: function validateRegistration(
   22:   name: string,
   23:   email: string,
   24:   password: string,
   25: ): void {
   26:   if (!name.trim()) {
   27:     throw new Error("Please enter your full name.");
   28:   }
   29: 
   30:   if (!email.trim()) {
   31:     throw new Error("Please enter your email address.");
   32:   }
   33: 
   34:   if (password.length < 6) {
   35:     throw new Error(
   36:       "Your password must contain at least 6 characters.",
   37:     );
   38:   }
   39: }
   40: 
   41: export async function registerAccount(
   42:   name: string,
   43:   email: string,
   44:   password: string,
   45:   accountType: RegistrationAccountType,
   46: ): Promise<UserCredential> {
   47:   const cleanedName = name.trim();
   48:   const cleanedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
   49: 
   50:   validateRegistration(
   51:     cleanedName,
   52:     cleanedEmail,
   53:     password,
   54:   );
   55: 
   56:   const userCredential =
   57:     await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(
   58:       auth,
   59:       cleanedEmail,
   60:       password,
   61:     );
   62: 
   63:   try {
   64:     await updateProfile(userCredential.user, {
   65:       displayName: cleanedName,
   66:     });
   67: 
   68:     /*
   69:      * SECURITY:
   70:      *
   71:      * Teacher applicants do NOT receive the teacher role here.
   72:      *
   73:      * They remain at the normal low-privilege student-level role
   74:      * until an administrator approves the teacher request.
   75:      *
   76:      * accountIntent tells the UI which onboarding journey to use.
   77:      */
   78:     await setDoc(
   79:       doc(db, "users", userCredential.user.uid),
   80:       {
   81:         uid: userCredential.user.uid,
   82:         name: cleanedName,
   83:         email: cleanedEmail,
   84: 
   85:         role: "student",
   86: 
   87:         accountIntent: accountType,
   88: 
   89:         teacherAccessStatus:
   90:           accountType === "teacher"
   91:             ? "not_submitted"
   92:             : null,
   93: 
   94:         qualification: null,
   95:         examBoard: null,
   96:         onboardingComplete: false,
   97: 
   98:         createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
   99:         updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  100:       },
  101:     );
  102: 
  103:     return userCredential;
  104:   } catch (error) {
  105:     console.error(
  106:       "Unable to create the account profile:",
  107:       error,
  108:     );
  109: 
  110:     try {
  111:       await deleteUser(userCredential.user);
  112:     } catch (cleanupError) {
  113:       console.error(
  114:         "Unable to remove the incomplete Authentication account:",
  115:         cleanupError,
  116:       );
  117: 
  118:       await signOut(auth);
  119:     }
  120: 
  121:     throw error;
  122:   }
  123: }
  124: 
  125: /*
  126:  * Keep this function because existing parts of CS Master may
  127:  * already import registerStudent().
  128:  */
  129: export async function registerStudent(
  130:   name: string,
  131:   email: string,
  132:   password: string,
  133: ): Promise<UserCredential> {
  134:   return registerAccount(
  135:     name,
  136:     email,
  137:     password,
  138:     "student",
  139:   );
  140: }
  141: 
  142: export async function loginUser(
  143:   email: string,
  144:   password: string,
  145: ): Promise<UserCredential> {
  146:   const cleanedEmail =
  147:     email.trim().toLowerCase();
  148: 
  149:   return signInWithEmailAndPassword(
  150:     auth,
  151:     cleanedEmail,
  152:     password,
  153:   );
  154: }
  155: 
  156: export async function logoutUser(): Promise<void> {
  157:   await signOut(auth);
  158: }
  159: 
  160: export async function resetPassword(
  161:   email: string,
  162: ): Promise<void> {
  163:   const cleanedEmail =
  164:     email.trim().toLowerCase();
  165: 
  166:   if (!cleanedEmail) {
  167:     throw new Error(
  168:       "Please enter your email address.",
  169:     );
  170:   }
  171: 
  172:   await sendPasswordResetEmail(
  173:     auth,
  174:     cleanedEmail,
  175:   );
  176: }

FILE: services\classKnowledgeMapService.ts
==============================================================================================================

    1: import { curriculumRegistry } from "@/data/curriculum/curriculumRegistry";
    2: import { getTeacherAnalyticsPortfolio } from "@/services/analytics/teacherAnalyticsService";
    3: import { normaliseTopic } from "@/services/topicNormalisationService";
    4: 
    5: import type {
    6:   ClassKnowledgeMap,
    7:   ClassKnowledgeMapTopic,
    8: } from "@/types/knowledgeMap";
    9: 
   10: type TopicAccumulator = {
   11:   percentages: number[];
   12:   evidenceCount: number;
   13:   studentCount: number;
   14: };
   15: 
   16: function average(values: number[]): number {
   17:   return values.length
   18:     ? Math.round(values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / values.length)
   19:     : 0;
   20: }
   21: 
   22: /*
   23:  * IMPORTANT:
   24:  *
   25:  * The old Class Knowledge Map service loaded every student profile and then
   26:  * called getAdaptiveLearningPlan(studentId) while a TEACHER was signed in.
   27:  *
   28:  * That adaptive-learning pipeline contains student-context Firestore reads,
   29:  * which is why /teacher/knowledge-map could fail with:
   30:  *
   31:  * FirebaseError: Missing or insufficient permissions.
   32:  *
   33:  * The Teacher Analytics pipeline is already tested and working with the
   34:  * teacher's existing Firestore permissions. This service therefore consumes
   35:  * the same teacher analytics portfolio rather than opening a second,
   36:  * permission-sensitive student analytics path.
   37:  */
   38: export async function getClassKnowledgeMap(
   39:   teacherId: string,
   40: ): Promise<ClassKnowledgeMap> {
   41:   const id = teacherId.trim();
   42: 
   43:   if (!id) {
   44:     return {
   45:       teacherId: "",
   46:       generatedAt: new Date(),
   47:       studentCount: 0,
   48:       topics: [],
   49:     };
   50:   }
   51: 
   52:   const portfolio = await getTeacherAnalyticsPortfolio(id);
   53: 
   54:   if (portfolio.classes.length === 0) {
   55:     return {
   56:       teacherId: id,
   57:       generatedAt: new Date(),
   58:       studentCount: 0,
   59:       topics: curriculumRegistry.map((definition) => ({
   60:         topicId: definition.id,
   61:         topicTitle: definition.title,
   62:         unitId: definition.unitId,
   63:         unitTitle: definition.unitTitle,
   64:         classAverage: 0,
   65:         averageConfidence: 0,
   66:         assessedStudents: 0,
   67:         priorityStudents: 0,
   68:         secureStudents: 0,
   69:       })),
   70:     };
   71:   }
   72: 
   73:   const accumulators = new Map<string, TopicAccumulator>();
   74: 
   75:   for (const classItem of portfolio.classes) {
   76:     for (const student of classItem.students) {
   77:       for (const topic of student.analytics.topics) {
   78:         const normalised = normaliseTopic(topic.topic);
   79:         const topicId = normalised.topicId;
   80: 
   81:         if (!topicId) {
   82:           continue;
   83:         }
   84: 
   85:         const current = accumulators.get(topicId) || {
   86:           percentages: [],
   87:           evidenceCount: 0,
   88:           studentCount: 0,
   89:         };
   90: 
   91:         current.percentages.push(topic.weightedPercentage);
   92:         current.evidenceCount += topic.evidenceCount;
   93:         current.studentCount += 1;
   94: 
   95:         accumulators.set(topicId, current);
   96:       }
   97:     }
   98:   }
   99: 
  100:   const topics: ClassKnowledgeMapTopic[] = curriculumRegistry.map(
  101:     (definition) => {
  102:       const evidence = accumulators.get(definition.id);
  103: 
  104:       const classAverage = evidence
  105:         ? average(evidence.percentages)
  106:         : 0;
  107: 
  108:       const assessedStudents = evidence?.studentCount ?? 0;
  109: 
  110:       /*
  111:        * Confidence here is intentionally derived from the quantity of
  112:        * assessment evidence backing the topic rather than from the old
  113:        * adaptive-learning confidence service.
  114:        *
  115:        * 1 evidence item  -> 40
  116:        * 2 evidence items -> 55
  117:        * 3 evidence items -> 70
  118:        * 4+               -> 85-100
  119:        */
  120:       const evidenceCount = evidence?.evidenceCount ?? 0;
  121: 
  122:       const averageConfidence =
  123:         evidenceCount === 0
  124:           ? 0
  125:           : Math.min(100, 25 + evidenceCount * 15);
  126: 
  127:       /*
  128:        * The current ClassKnowledgeMap type stores class-level counts.
  129:        * We derive the counts consistently from the same thresholds used
  130:        * throughout CS Master's teacher analytics:
  131:        *
  132:        * priority   < 50%
  133:        * developing 50-69%
  134:        * secure     >= 70%
  135:        *
  136:        * With multiple students, each student's topic mastery is counted.
  137:        */
  138:       let priorityStudents = 0;
  139:       let secureStudents = 0;
  140: 
  141:       for (const classItem of portfolio.classes) {
  142:         for (const student of classItem.students) {
  143:           const studentTopic = student.analytics.topics.find(
  144:             (topic) =>
  145:               normaliseTopic(topic.topic).topicId === definition.id,
  146:           );
  147: 
  148:           if (!studentTopic) {
  149:             continue;
  150:           }
  151: 
  152:           if (studentTopic.weightedPercentage < 50) {
  153:             priorityStudents += 1;
  154:           }
  155: 
  156:           if (studentTopic.weightedPercentage >= 70) {
  157:             secureStudents += 1;
  158:           }
  159:         }
  160:       }
  161: 
  162:       return {
  163:         topicId: definition.id,
  164:         topicTitle: definition.title,
  165:         unitId: definition.unitId,
  166:         unitTitle: definition.unitTitle,
  167:         classAverage,
  168:         averageConfidence,
  169:         assessedStudents,
  170:         priorityStudents,
  171:         secureStudents,
  172:       };
  173:     },
  174:   );
  175: 
  176:   return {
  177:     teacherId: id,
  178:     generatedAt: new Date(),
  179:     studentCount: portfolio.uniqueStudentCount,
  180:     topics,
  181:   };
  182: }

  107: function convertTimestamp(
  108:   value?: Timestamp,
  109: ): Date | null {
  110:   return value?.toDate
  111:     ? value.toDate()
  112:     : null;
  113: }
  114: 
  115: function normaliseClassName(
  116:   value: string,
  117: ): string {
  118:   return value
  119:     .trim()
  120:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ");
  121: }
  122: 
  123: function normaliseString(
  124:   value: unknown,
  125: ): string {
  126:   return typeof value ===
  127:     "string"
  128:     ? value.trim()
  129:     : "";
  130: }

  132: function normaliseEmail(
  133:   value: unknown,
  134: ): string {
  135:   return normaliseString(
  136:     value,

  140: function normaliseQualification(
  141:   value: unknown,
  142: ): Qualification | "" {
  143:   return value === "GCSE" ||
  144:     value === "A_LEVEL"
  145:     ? value
  146:     : "";
  147: }
  148: 
  149: function normaliseExamBoard(
  150:   value: unknown,
  151: ): ExamBoard | "" {
  152:   return value === "AQA" ||
  153:     value === "OCR" ||
  154:     value === "EDEXCEL"
  155:     ? value
  156:     : "";
  157: }
  158: 
  159: function normaliseStringArray(
  160:   value: unknown,
  161: ): string[] {
  162:   return Array.isArray(value)
  163:     ? value.filter(
  164:         (
  165:           item,
  166:         ): item is string =>
  167:           typeof item === "string",
  168:       )
  169:     : [];
  170: }
  171: 
  172: function normaliseStudent(
  173:   student: ClassStudent,

  175:   return {
  176:     studentId:
  177:       student.studentId.trim(),
  178: 
  179:     displayName:
  180:       student.displayName.trim() ||
  181:       "Unnamed Student",
  182: 
  183:     email:
  184:       student.email
  185:         .trim()
  186:         .toLowerCase(),

  190: function convertClassDocument(
  191:   documentId: string,
  192:   data:
  193:     Partial<FirestoreTeacherClass>,
  194: ): TeacherClass {
  195:   return {
  196:     id:
  197:       documentId,
  198: 
  199:     name:
  200:       normaliseString(
  201:         data.name,
  202:       ) ||
  203:       "Untitled Class",
  204: 
  205:     subject:
  206:       normaliseString(
  207:         data.subject,
  208:       ) ||
  209:       "Computer Science",
  210: 
  211:     yearGroup:
  212:       normaliseString(
  213:         data.yearGroup,
  214:       ),
  215: 
  216:     academicYear:
  217:       normaliseString(
  218:         data.academicYear,
  219:       ),
  220: 
  221:     qualification:
  222:       normaliseQualification(
  223:         data.qualification,
  224:       ),
  225: 
  226:     examBoard:
  227:       normaliseExamBoard(
  228:         data.examBoard,
  229:       ),
  230: 
  231:     teacherId:
  232:       normaliseString(
  233:         data.teacherId,
  234:       ),
  235: 
  236:     teacherName:
  237:       normaliseString(
  238:         data.teacherName,
  239:       ),
  240: 
  241:     schoolId:
  242:       normaliseString(
  243:         data.schoolId,
  244:       ),
  245: 
  246:     studentIds:
  247:       normaliseStringArray(
  248:         data.studentIds,
  249:       ),
  250: 
  251:     students:
  252:       Array.isArray(
  253:         data.students,
  254:       )
  255:         ? data.students
  256:         : [],
  257: 
  258:     assignmentIds:
  259:       normaliseStringArray(
  260:         data.assignmentIds,
  261:       ),
  262: 
  263:     status:
  264:       data.status ===
  265:       "archived"
  266:         ? "archived"
  267:         : "active",
  268: 
  269:     createdAt:
  270:       convertTimestamp(
  271:         data.createdAt,
  272:       ),
  273: 
  274:     updatedAt:
  275:       convertTimestamp(
  276:         data.updatedAt,
  277:       ),
  278:   };
  279: }
  280: 
  281: /*
  282:  * Loads the freshest name/email directly from users/{studentId}.
  283:  * Embedded class student details remain a fallback.
  284:  */
  285: async function hydrateClassStudents(
  286:   teacherClass:
  287:     TeacherClass,
  288: ): Promise<TeacherClass> {
  289:   const embeddedById =
  290:     new Map(
  291:       (
  292:         teacherClass.students ??
  293:         []
  294:       ).map(
  295:         (student) => [
  296:           student.studentId,
  297:           student,
  298:         ],
  299:       ),
  300:     );
  301: 
  302:   const studentIds =
  303:     Array.from(
  304:       new Set(
  305:         [
  306:           ...teacherClass.studentIds,
  307: 
  308:           ...(
  309:             teacherClass.students ??
  310:             []
  311:           ).map(
  312:             (student) =>
  313:               student.studentId,
  314:           ),
  315:         ]
  316:           .map(
  317:             (studentId) =>
  318:               studentId.trim(),
  319:           )
  320:           .filter(Boolean),
  321:       ),
  322:     );
  323: 
  324:   if (
  325:     studentIds.length === 0
  326:   ) {
  327:     return {
  328:       ...teacherClass,
  329:       studentIds: [],
  330:       students: [],
  331:     };
  332:   }
  333: 
  334:   const hydrated =
  335:     await Promise.all(
  336:       studentIds.map(
  337:         async (
  338:           studentId,
  339:         ): Promise<ClassStudent> => {
  340:           const embedded =
  341:             embeddedById.get(
  342:               studentId,
  343:             );
  344: 
  345:           try {
  346:             const snapshot =
  347:               await getDoc(
  348:                 doc(
  349:                   db,
  350:                   "users",
  351:                   studentId,
  352:                 ),
  353:               );
  354: 
  355:             if (
  356:               !snapshot.exists()
  357:             ) {
  358:               return {
  359:                 studentId,
  360:                 displayName:
  361:                   embedded
  362:                     ?.displayName ||
  363:                   "Unnamed Student",
  364:                 email:
  365:                   embedded
  366:                     ?.email ||
  367:                   "",
  368:               };
  369:             }
  370: 
  371:             const data =
  372:               snapshot.data() as
  373:                 FirestoreStudentProfile;
  374: 
  375:             return {
  376:               studentId,
  377: 
  378:               displayName:
  379:                 normaliseString(
  380:                   data.name,
  381:                 ) ||
  382:                 embedded
  383:                   ?.displayName ||
  384:                 "Unnamed Student",
  385: 
  386:               email:
  387:                 normaliseEmail(
  388:                   data.email,
  389:                 ) ||
  390:                 embedded
  391:                   ?.email ||
  392:                 "",
  393:             };
  394:           } catch (
  395:             error
  396:           ) {
  397:             console.warn(
  398:               `Unable to hydrate student profile ${studentId}:`,
  399:               error,
  400:             );
  401: 
  402:             return {
  403:               studentId,
  404:               displayName:
  405:                 embedded
  406:                   ?.displayName ||
  407:                 "Unnamed Student",
  408:               email:
  409:                 embedded?.email ||
  410:                 "",
  411:             };
  412:           }
  413:         },
  414:       ),
  415:     );
  416: 
  417:   return {
  418:     ...teacherClass,
  419:     studentIds,
  420:     students:
  421:       hydrated,
  422:   };
  423: }

  425: export async function createTeacherClass(
  426:   input:
  427:     CreateClassInput,
  428: ): Promise<string> {
  429:   const className =
  430:     normaliseClassName(
  431:       input.name,
  432:     );
  433: 
  434:   if (!className) {
  435:     throw new Error(
  436:       "Enter a valid class name.",
  437:     );
  438:   }
  439: 
  440:   const teacherId =
  441:     input.teacherId.trim();
  442: 
  443:   if (!teacherId) {
  444:     throw new Error(
  445:       "A teacher account is required.",
  446:     );
  447:   }
  448: 
  449:   if (
  450:     !input.yearGroup.trim()
  451:   ) {
  452:     throw new Error(
  453:       "Select or enter a year group.",
  454:     );
  455:   }
  456: 
  457:   if (
  458:     !input.academicYear.trim()
  459:   ) {
  460:     throw new Error(
  461:       "Enter an academic year.",
  462:     );
  463:   }
  464: 
  465:   if (
  466:     !input.qualification
  467:   ) {
  468:     throw new Error(
  469:       "Select a qualification.",
  470:     );
  471:   }
  472: 
  473:   if (
  474:     !input.examBoard
  475:   ) {
  476:     throw new Error(
  477:       "Select an exam board.",
  478:     );
  479:   }
  480: 
  481:   const teacherReference =
  482:     doc(
  483:       db,
  484:       "users",
  485:       teacherId,
  486:     );
  487: 
  488:   const teacherSnapshot =
  489:     await getDoc(
  490:       teacherReference,
  491:     );
  492: 
  493:   if (
  494:     !teacherSnapshot.exists()
  495:   ) {
  496:     throw new Error(
  497:       "The teacher account could not be found.",
  498:     );
  499:   }
  500: 
  501:   const teacherData =
  502:     teacherSnapshot.data();
  503: 
  504:   const schoolId =
  505:     input.schoolId
  506:       ?.trim() ||
  507:     normaliseString(
  508:       teacherData.schoolId,
  509:     );
  510: 
  511:   if (!schoolId) {
  512:     throw new Error(
  513:       "Your teacher account must be linked to a school before creating classes.",
  514:     );
  515:   }
  516: 
  517:   const classReference =
  518:     await addDoc(
  519:       collection(
  520:         db,
  521:         "classes",
  522:       ),
  523:       {
  524:         name:
  525:           className,
  526: 
  527:         subject:
  528:           input.subject.trim() ||
  529:           "Computer Science",
  530: 
  531:         yearGroup:
  532:           input.yearGroup.trim(),
  533: 
  534:         academicYear:
  535:           input.academicYear.trim(),
  536: 
  537:         qualification:
  538:           input.qualification,
  539: 
  540:         examBoard:
  541:           input.examBoard,
  542: 
  543:         teacherId,
  544: 
  545:         teacherName:
  546:           input.teacherName
  547:             ?.trim() ||
  548:           normaliseString(
  549:             teacherData.name,
  550:           ) ||
  551:           "Teacher",
  552: 
  553:         schoolId,
  554: 
  555:         studentIds: [],
  556:         students: [],
  557:         assignmentIds: [],
  558: 
  559:         status:
  560:           "active",
  561: 
  562:         createdAt:
  563:           serverTimestamp(),
  564: 
  565:         updatedAt:
  566:           serverTimestamp(),
  567:       },
  568:     );
  569: 
  570:   return classReference.id;
  571: }

  573: export async function getTeacherClasses(
  574:   teacherId: string,
  575: ): Promise<TeacherClass[]> {
  576:   const cleanedTeacherId =
  577:     teacherId.trim();
  578: 
  579:   if (!cleanedTeacherId) {
  580:     return [];
  581:   }
  582: 
  583:   const classesQuery =
  584:     query(
  585:       collection(
  586:         db,
  587:         "classes",
  588:       ),
  589:       where(
  590:         "teacherId",
  591:         "==",
  592:         cleanedTeacherId,
  593:       ),
  594:       orderBy(
  595:         "createdAt",
  596:         "desc",
  597:       ),
  598:     );
  599: 
  600:   const snapshot =
  601:     await getDocs(
  602:       classesQuery,
  603:     );
  604: 
  605:   return snapshot.docs.map(
  606:     (
  607:       classDocument,
  608:     ) =>
  609:       convertClassDocument(
  610:         classDocument.id,
  611:         classDocument.data() as
  612:           Partial<FirestoreTeacherClass>,
  613:       ),
  614:   );
  615: }

  617: export async function getTeacherClassById(
  618:   classId: string,
  619: ): Promise<TeacherClass | null> {
  620:   const cleanedClassId =
  621:     classId.trim();
  622: 
  623:   if (!cleanedClassId) {
  624:     return null;
  625:   }
  626: 
  627:   const snapshot =
  628:     await getDoc(
  629:       doc(
  630:         db,
  631:         "classes",
  632:         cleanedClassId,
  633:       ),
  634:     );
  635: 
  636:   if (
  637:     !snapshot.exists()
  638:   ) {
  639:     return null;
  640:   }
  641: 
  642:   return hydrateClassStudents(
  643:     convertClassDocument(
  644:       snapshot.id,
  645:       snapshot.data() as
  646:         Partial<FirestoreTeacherClass>,
  647:     ),
  648:   );
  649: }

  651: export type UpdateTeacherClassInput =
  652:   Partial<
  653:     Pick<
  654:       TeacherClass,
  655:       | "name"
  656:       | "subject"
  657:       | "yearGroup"
  658:       | "academicYear"
  659:       | "qualification"
  660:       | "examBoard"
  661:       | "status"
  662:     >
