  665: export async function updateTeacherClass(
  666:   classId: string,
  667:   updates:
  668:     UpdateTeacherClassInput,
  669: ): Promise<void> {
  670:   const cleanedClassId =
  671:     classId.trim();
  672: 
  673:   if (!cleanedClassId) {
  674:     throw new Error(
  675:       "A valid class is required.",
  676:     );
  677:   }
  678: 
  679:   const updateData:
  680:     Record<
  681:       string,
  682:       unknown
  683:     > = {};
  684: 
  685:   if (
  686:     updates.name !==
  687:     undefined
  688:   ) {
  689:     const name =
  690:       normaliseClassName(
  691:         updates.name,
  692:       );
  693: 
  694:     if (!name) {
  695:       throw new Error(
  696:         "Enter a valid class name.",
  697:       );
  698:     }
  699: 
  700:     updateData.name =
  701:       name;
  702:   }
  703: 
  704:   if (
  705:     updates.subject !==
  706:     undefined
  707:   ) {
  708:     updateData.subject =
  709:       updates.subject.trim() ||
  710:       "Computer Science";
  711:   }
  712: 
  713:   if (
  714:     updates.yearGroup !==
  715:     undefined
  716:   ) {
  717:     if (
  718:       !updates.yearGroup.trim()
  719:     ) {
  720:       throw new Error(
  721:         "Enter a year group.",
  722:       );
  723:     }
  724: 
  725:     updateData.yearGroup =
  726:       updates.yearGroup.trim();
  727:   }
  728: 
  729:   if (
  730:     updates.academicYear !==
  731:     undefined
  732:   ) {
  733:     if (
  734:       !updates.academicYear.trim()
  735:     ) {
  736:       throw new Error(
  737:         "Enter an academic year.",
  738:       );
  739:     }
  740: 
  741:     updateData.academicYear =
  742:       updates.academicYear.trim();
  743:   }
  744: 
  745:   if (
  746:     updates.qualification !==
  747:     undefined
  748:   ) {
  749:     if (
  750:       updates.qualification !==
  751:         "GCSE" &&
  752:       updates.qualification !==
  753:         "A_LEVEL"
  754:     ) {
  755:       throw new Error(
  756:         "Select GCSE or A Level.",
  757:       );
  758:     }
  759: 
  760:     updateData.qualification =
  761:       updates.qualification;
  762:   }
  763: 
  764:   if (
  765:     updates.examBoard !==
  766:     undefined
  767:   ) {
  768:     if (
  769:       updates.examBoard !==
  770:         "AQA" &&
  771:       updates.examBoard !==
  772:         "OCR" &&
  773:       updates.examBoard !==
  774:         "EDEXCEL"
  775:     ) {
  776:       throw new Error(
  777:         "Select AQA, OCR or Edexcel.",
  778:       );
  779:     }
  780: 
  781:     updateData.examBoard =
  782:       updates.examBoard;
  783:   }
  784: 
  785:   if (
  786:     updates.status !==
  787:     undefined
  788:   ) {
  789:     updateData.status =
  790:       updates.status;
  791:   }
  792: 
  793:   const classReference =
  794:     doc(
  795:       db,
  796:       "classes",
  797:       cleanedClassId,
  798:     );
  799: 
  800:   const classSnapshot =
  801:     await getDoc(
  802:       classReference,
  803:     );
  804: 
  805:   if (
  806:     !classSnapshot.exists()
  807:   ) {
  808:     throw new Error(
  809:       "The class could not be found.",
  810:     );
  811:   }
  812: 
  813:   const existingClass =
  814:     classSnapshot.data() as
  815:       Partial<FirestoreTeacherClass>;
  816: 
  817:   /*
  818:    * T1A -> T1B compatibility:
  819:    * legacy classes created before school tenancy may still lack schoolId.
  820:    * Adopt the owning teacher's current school during the first settings
  821:    * update so the tenant security rule remains satisfied.
  822:    */
  823:   if (
  824:     !normaliseString(
  825:       existingClass.schoolId,
  826:     )
  827:   ) {
  828:     const ownerId =
  829:       normaliseString(
  830:         existingClass.teacherId,
  831:       );
  832: 
  833:     if (ownerId) {
  834:       const ownerSnapshot =
  835:         await getDoc(
  836:           doc(
  837:             db,
  838:             "users",
  839:             ownerId,
  840:           ),
  841:         );
  842: 
  843:       const ownerSchoolId =
  844:         ownerSnapshot.exists()
  845:           ? normaliseString(
  846:               ownerSnapshot.data()
  847:                 .schoolId,
  848:             )
  849:           : "";
  850: 
  851:       if (ownerSchoolId) {
  852:         updateData.schoolId =
  853:           ownerSchoolId;
  854:       }
  855:     }
  856:   }
  857: 
  858:   await updateDoc(
  859:     classReference,
  860:     {
  861:       ...updateData,
  862:       updatedAt:
  863:         serverTimestamp(),
  864:     },
  865:   );
  866: }
  867: 
  868: /*
  869:  * Enrolment updates both the class and student profile atomically.
  870:  * Same-school membership is verified inside the transaction.
  871:  */
  872: export async function addStudentToClass(
  873:   classId: string,
  874:   student:
  875:     ClassStudent,
  876: ): Promise<void> {
  877:   const cleanedClassId =
  878:     classId.trim();
  879: 
  880:   const cleanedStudent =
  881:     normaliseStudent(
  882:       student,
  883:     );
  884: 
  885:   if (!cleanedClassId) {
  886:     throw new Error(
  887:       "A valid class is required.",
  888:     );
  889:   }
  890: 
  891:   if (
  892:     !cleanedStudent.studentId
  893:   ) {
  894:     throw new Error(
  895:       "A valid student account is required.",
  896:     );
  897:   }
  898: 
  899:   const classReference =
  900:     doc(
  901:       db,
  902:       "classes",
  903:       cleanedClassId,
  904:     );
  905: 
  906:   const studentReference =
  907:     doc(
  908:       db,
  909:       "users",
  910:       cleanedStudent.studentId,
  911:     );
  912: 
  913:   await runTransaction(
  914:     db,
  915:     async (
  916:       transaction,
  917:     ) => {
  918:       const [
  919:         classSnapshot,
  920:         studentSnapshot,
  921:       ] =
  922:         await Promise.all([
  923:           transaction.get(
  924:             classReference,
  925:           ),
  926:           transaction.get(
  927:             studentReference,
  928:           ),
  929:         ]);
  930: 
  931:       if (
  932:         !classSnapshot.exists()
  933:       ) {
  934:         throw new Error(
  935:           "The selected class could not be found.",
  936:         );
  937:       }
  938: 
  939:       if (
  940:         !studentSnapshot.exists()
  941:       ) {
  942:         throw new Error(
  943:           "The selected student account could not be found.",
  944:         );
  945:       }
  946: 
  947:       const classData =
  948:         classSnapshot.data() as
  949:           Partial<FirestoreTeacherClass>;
  950: 
  951:       const studentData =
  952:         studentSnapshot.data() as
  953:           FirestoreStudentProfile;
  954: 
  955:       if (
  956:         studentData.role !==
  957:         "student"
  958:       ) {
  959:         throw new Error(
  960:           "Only student accounts can be enrolled.",
  961:         );
  962:       }
  963: 
  964:       let classSchoolId =
  965:         normaliseString(
  966:           classData.schoolId,
  967:         );
  968: 
  969:       /*
  970:        * Legacy classes created before schoolId existed can adopt their
  971:        * owning teacher's current school on the next enrolment.
  972:        */
  973:       if (!classSchoolId) {
  974:         const ownerId =
  975:           normaliseString(
  976:             classData.teacherId,
  977:           );
  978: 
  979:         if (ownerId) {
  980:           const teacherSnapshot =
  981:             await transaction.get(
  982:               doc(
  983:                 db,
  984:                 "users",
  985:                 ownerId,
  986:               ),
  987:             );
  988: 
  989:           if (
  990:             teacherSnapshot.exists()
  991:           ) {
  992:             classSchoolId =
  993:               normaliseString(
  994:                 teacherSnapshot.data()
  995:                   .schoolId,
  996:               );
  997:           }
  998:         }
  999:       }
 1000: 
 1001:       const studentSchoolId =
 1002:         normaliseString(
 1003:           studentData.schoolId,
 1004:         );
 1005: 
 1006:       if (!classSchoolId) {
 1007:         throw new Error(
 1008:           "This class is not linked to a school yet.",
 1009:         );
 1010:       }
 1011: 
 1012:       if (!studentSchoolId) {
 1013:         throw new Error(
 1014:           "This student is not linked to your school.",
 1015:         );
 1016:       }
 1017: 
 1018:       if (
 1019:         studentSchoolId !==
 1020:         classSchoolId
 1021:       ) {
 1022:         throw new Error(
 1023:           "This student belongs to a different school and cannot be enrolled in this class.",
 1024:         );
 1025:       }
 1026: 
 1027:       const verifiedStudent:
 1028:         ClassStudent = {
 1029:         studentId:
 1030:           cleanedStudent.studentId,
 1031: 
 1032:         displayName:
 1033:           normaliseString(
 1034:             studentData.name,
 1035:           ) ||
 1036:           cleanedStudent.displayName ||
 1037:           "Unnamed Student",
 1038: 
 1039:         email:
 1040:           normaliseEmail(
 1041:             studentData.email,
 1042:           ) ||
 1043:           cleanedStudent.email ||
 1044:           "",
 1045:       };
 1046: 
 1047:       const existingStudentIds =
 1048:         normaliseStringArray(
 1049:           classData.studentIds,
 1050:         );
 1051: 
 1052:       const existingStudents =
 1053:         Array.isArray(
 1054:           classData.students,
 1055:         )
 1056:           ? classData.students
 1057:           : [];
 1058: 
 1059:       if (
 1060:         existingStudentIds.includes(
 1061:           verifiedStudent.studentId,
 1062:         )
 1063:       ) {
 1064:         throw new Error(
 1065:           "This student is already enrolled in the class.",
 1066:         );
 1067:       }
 1068: 
 1069:       const updatedStudents =
 1070:         [
 1071:           ...existingStudents.filter(
 1072:             (
 1073:               existingStudent,
 1074:             ) =>
 1075:               existingStudent.studentId !==
 1076:               verifiedStudent.studentId,
 1077:           ),
 1078:           verifiedStudent,
 1079:         ];
 1080: 
 1081:       const currentClassIds =
 1082:         normaliseStringArray(
 1083:           studentData.classIds,
 1084:         );
 1085: 
 1086:       transaction.update(
 1087:         classReference,
 1088:         {
 1089:           schoolId:
 1090:             classSchoolId,
 1091: 
 1092:           studentIds: [
 1093:             ...existingStudentIds,
 1094:             verifiedStudent.studentId,
 1095:           ],
 1096: 
 1097:           students:
 1098:             updatedStudents,
 1099: 
 1100:           updatedAt:
 1101:             serverTimestamp(),
 1102:         },
 1103:       );
 1104: 
 1105:       transaction.update(
 1106:         studentReference,
 1107:         {
 1108:           classIds:
 1109:             Array.from(
 1110:               new Set([
 1111:                 ...currentClassIds,
 1112:                 cleanedClassId,
 1113:               ]),
 1114:             ),
 1115: 
 1116:           updatedAt:
 1117:             serverTimestamp(),
 1118:         },
 1119:       );
 1120:     },
 1121:   );
 1122: }
 1123: 
 1124: export async function removeStudentFromClass(
 1125:   classId: string,
 1126:   student:
 1127:     ClassStudent,
 1128: ): Promise<void> {
 1129:   const cleanedClassId =
 1130:     classId.trim();
 1131: 
 1132:   const cleanedStudent =
 1133:     normaliseStudent(
 1134:       student,
 1135:     );
 1136: 
 1137:   if (
 1138:     !cleanedClassId ||
 1139:     !cleanedStudent.studentId
 1140:   ) {
 1141:     throw new Error(
 1142:       "A valid class and student are required.",
 1143:     );
 1144:   }
 1145: 
 1146:   const classReference =
 1147:     doc(
 1148:       db,
 1149:       "classes",
 1150:       cleanedClassId,
 1151:     );
 1152: 
 1153:   const studentReference =
 1154:     doc(
 1155:       db,
 1156:       "users",
 1157:       cleanedStudent.studentId,
 1158:     );
 1159: 
 1160:   await runTransaction(
 1161:     db,
 1162:     async (
 1163:       transaction,
 1164:     ) => {
 1165:       const [
 1166:         classSnapshot,
 1167:         studentSnapshot,
 1168:       ] =
 1169:         await Promise.all([
 1170:           transaction.get(
 1171:             classReference,
 1172:           ),
 1173:           transaction.get(
 1174:             studentReference,
 1175:           ),
 1176:         ]);
 1177: 
 1178:       if (
 1179:         !classSnapshot.exists()
 1180:       ) {
 1181:         throw new Error(
 1182:           "The selected class could not be found.",
 1183:         );
 1184:       }
 1185: 
 1186:       const classData =
 1187:         classSnapshot.data() as
 1188:           Partial<FirestoreTeacherClass>;
 1189: 
 1190:       const updatedStudentIds =
 1191:         normaliseStringArray(
 1192:           classData.studentIds,
 1193:         ).filter(
 1194:           (
 1195:             studentId,
 1196:           ) =>
 1197:             studentId !==
 1198:             cleanedStudent.studentId,
 1199:         );
 1200: 
 1201:       const updatedStudents =
 1202:         (
 1203:           Array.isArray(
 1204:             classData.students,
 1205:           )
 1206:             ? classData.students
 1207:             : []
 1208:         ).filter(
 1209:           (
 1210:             classStudent,
 1211:           ) =>
 1212:             classStudent.studentId !==
 1213:             cleanedStudent.studentId,
 1214:         );
 1215: 
 1216:       transaction.update(
 1217:         classReference,
 1218:         {
 1219:           studentIds:
 1220:             updatedStudentIds,
 1221: 
 1222:           students:
 1223:             updatedStudents,
 1224: 
 1225:           updatedAt:
 1226:             serverTimestamp(),
 1227:         },
 1228:       );
 1229: 
 1230:       if (
 1231:         studentSnapshot.exists()
 1232:       ) {
 1233:         const studentData =
 1234:           studentSnapshot.data() as
 1235:             FirestoreStudentProfile;
 1236: 
 1237:         const currentClassIds =
 1238:           normaliseStringArray(
 1239:             studentData.classIds,
 1240:           );
 1241: 
 1242:         transaction.update(
 1243:           studentReference,
 1244:           {
 1245:             classIds:
 1246:               currentClassIds.filter(
 1247:                 (
 1248:                   studentClassId,
 1249:                 ) =>
 1250:                   studentClassId !==
 1251:                   cleanedClassId,
 1252:               ),
 1253: 
 1254:             updatedAt:
 1255:               serverTimestamp(),
 1256:           },
 1257:         );
 1258:       }
 1259:     },
 1260:   );
 1261: }
 1262: 
 1263: export async function archiveTeacherClass(
 1264:   classId: string,
 1265: ): Promise<void> {
 1266:   await updateTeacherClass(
 1267:     classId,
 1268:     {
 1269:       status:
 1270:         "archived",
 1271:     },
 1272:   );
 1273: }
 1274: 
 1275: export async function restoreTeacherClass(
 1276:   classId: string,
 1277: ): Promise<void> {
 1278:   await updateTeacherClass(
 1279:     classId,
 1280:     {
 1281:       status:
 1282:         "active",
 1283:     },
 1284:   );
 1285: }
 1286: 
 1287: /*
 1288:  * Permanent deletion is intentionally conservative.
 1289:  * Classes with students or assignment references should be archived
 1290:  * instead so school history is not accidentally severed.
 1291:  */
 1292: export async function deleteTeacherClass(
 1293:   classId: string,
 1294: ): Promise<void> {
 1295:   const cleanedClassId =
 1296:     classId.trim();
 1297: 
 1298:   if (!cleanedClassId) {
 1299:     throw new Error(
 1300:       "A valid class is required.",
 1301:     );
 1302:   }
 1303: 
 1304:   const reference =
 1305:     doc(
 1306:       db,
 1307:       "classes",
 1308:       cleanedClassId,
 1309:     );
 1310: 
 1311:   const snapshot =
 1312:     await getDoc(
 1313:       reference,
 1314:     );
 1315: 
 1316:   if (
 1317:     !snapshot.exists()
 1318:   ) {
 1319:     return;
 1320:   }
 1321: 
 1322:   const teacherClass =
 1323:     convertClassDocument(
 1324:       snapshot.id,
 1325:       snapshot.data() as
 1326:         Partial<FirestoreTeacherClass>,
 1327:     );
 1328: 
 1329:   if (
 1330:     teacherClass.studentIds
 1331:       .length > 0
 1332:   ) {
 1333:     throw new Error(
 1334:       "Remove students before permanently deleting this class. Archive it instead if you need to preserve history.",
 1335:     );
 1336:   }
 1337: 
 1338:   if (
 1339:     teacherClass.assignmentIds
 1340:       .length > 0
 1341:   ) {
 1342:     throw new Error(
 1343:       "This class has assignment history and cannot be permanently deleted. Archive it instead.",
 1344:     );
 1345:   }
 1346: 
 1347:   await deleteDoc(
 1348:     reference,
 1349:   );
 1350: }

    1: import { arrayUnion, doc, getDoc, updateDoc } from "firebase/firestore";
    2: import { db } from "@/lib/firebase";
    3: 
    4: export async function addStudentToClass(classId: string, studentId: string) {
    5:   const classRef = doc(db, "classes", classId);
    6:   const studentRef = doc(db, "users", studentId);
    7: 
    8:   const [classSnapshot, studentSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
    9:     getDoc(classRef),
   10:     getDoc(studentRef),
   11:   ]);
   12: 
   13:   if (!classSnapshot.exists()) {
   14:     throw new Error("Class not found.");
   15:   }
   16: 
   17:   if (!studentSnapshot.exists()) {
   18:     throw new Error("Student not found.");
   19:   }
   20: 
   21:   const studentData = studentSnapshot.data();
   22: 
   23:   if (studentData.role !== "student") {
   24:     throw new Error("Only student accounts can be added to a class.");
   25:   }
   26: 
   27:   await Promise.all([
   28:     updateDoc(classRef, {
   29:       studentIds: arrayUnion(studentId),
   30:     }),
   31: 
   32:     updateDoc(studentRef, {
   33:       classIds: arrayUnion(classId),
   34:     }),
   35:   ]);
   36: }

   39: export const cpuCycleSteps: CPUCycleStep[] = [
   40:   {
   41:     stage: "ready",
   42:     title: "Ready",
   43:     explanation:
   44:       "The program counter stores the address of the next instruction.",
   45:     activeRegisters: ["PC"],

   47:   {
   48:     stage: "pc-to-mar",
   49:     title: "Copy PC to MAR",

   54:   {

   59:     activeRegisters: ["MAR", "MDR"],

   63:     title: "Copy MDR to CIR",

   65:       "The fetched instruction is copied from the memory data register into the current instruction register.",
   66:     activeRegisters: ["MDR", "CIR"],
   67:   },
   68:   {

   70:     title: "Increment PC",
   71:     explanation:

   73:     activeRegisters: ["PC"],
   74:   },
   75:   {
   76:     stage: "decode",
   77:     title: "Decode",
   78:     explanation:
   79:       "The control unit decodes the instruction in the current instruction register.",
   80:     activeRegisters: ["CIR"],
   81:   },
   82:   {
   83:     stage: "execute",
   84:     title: "Execute",
   85:     explanation:
   86:       "The processor carries out the decoded instruction. The accumulator may store the result.",
   87:     activeRegisters: ["CIR", "ACC"],
   88:   },
   89:   {
   90:     stage: "complete",
   91:     title: "Cycle complete",
   92:     explanation:
   93:       "The instruction has been executed. The processor is ready to fetch the next instruction.",
   94:     activeRegisters: ["PC", "ACC"],
   95:   },
   96: ];
   97: 
   98: export function getCycleStep(stage: CPUCycleStage): CPUCycleStep {
   99:   return cpuCycleSteps.find((step) => step.stage === stage) ?? cpuCycleSteps[0];
  100: }
  101: 
  102: export function getMemoryInstruction(address: number): string {
  103:   return (
  104:     cpuMemory.find((location) => location.address === address)?.instruction ??
  105:     "NO INSTRUCTION"
  106:   );
  107: }
  108: 
  109: export function executeInstruction(
  110:   instruction: string,
  111:   accumulator: number,
  112: ): number {
  113:   const [operation, rawValue] = instruction.split(" ");
  114:   const value = Number(rawValue);
  115: 
  116:   if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
  117:     return accumulator;
  118:   }
  119: 
  120:   if (operation === "LOAD") {
  121:     return value;
  122:   }
  123: 
  124:   if (operation === "ADD") {
  125:     return accumulator + value;
  126:   }
  127: 
  128:   if (operation === "SUB") {
  129:     return accumulator - value;
  130:   }
  131: 
  132:   return accumulator;
  133: }

FILE: services\curriculumCoverageService.ts

    1: import {
    2:   getCurriculumDefinition,
    3:   type CurriculumDefinition,
    4:   type CurriculumUnitDefinition,
    5: } from "@/data/curriculum/curriculumMap";
    6: import { topicLibrary } from "@/data/curriculum/topics";
    7: import type { Topic } from "@/types/curriculum";
    8: import type { ExamBoard, Qualification } from "@/types/user";
    9: 
   10: export type CurriculumUnitCoverage = {
   11:   unit: CurriculumUnitDefinition;
   12:   topics: Topic[];
   13:   missingTopicIds: string[];
   14:   lessonCount: number;
   15: };
   16: 
   17: export type CurriculumCoverage = {
   18:   curriculum: CurriculumDefinition;
   19:   units: CurriculumUnitCoverage[];
   20:   mappedTopicCount: number;
   21:   availableTopicCount: number;
   22:   lessonCount: number;
   23:   missingTopicIds: string[];
   24:   complete: boolean;
   25: };
   26: 
   27: export function getCurriculumCoverage(
   28:   qualification: Qualification,
   29:   examBoard: ExamBoard,
   30: ): CurriculumCoverage | null {
   31:   const curriculum =
   32:     getCurriculumDefinition(
   33:       qualification,
   34:       examBoard,
   35:     );
   36: 
   37:   if (!curriculum) {
   38:     return null;
   39:   }
   40: 
   41:   const units: CurriculumUnitCoverage[] =
   42:     curriculum.units.map((unit) => {
   43:       const topics = unit.topicIds
   44:         .map((topicId) =>
   45:           topicLibrary[topicId],
   46:         )
   47:         .filter(
   48:           (topic): topic is Topic =>
   49:             Boolean(topic) &&
   50:             topic.status !== "coming-soon" &&
   51:             topic.lessons.length > 0,
   52:         );
   53: 
   54:       const missingTopicIds =
   55:         unit.topicIds.filter(
   56:           (topicId) =>
   57:             !topicLibrary[topicId] ||
   58:             topicLibrary[topicId].status ===
   59:               "coming-soon" ||
   60:             topicLibrary[topicId].lessons.length === 0,
   61:         );
   62: 
   63:       return {
   64:         unit,
   65:         topics,
   66:         missingTopicIds,
   67:         lessonCount: topics.reduce(
   68:           (total, topic) =>
   69:             total + topic.lessons.length,
   70:           0,
   71:         ),
   72:       };
   73:     });
   74: 
   75:   const mappedTopicIds = Array.from(
   76:     new Set(
   77:       curriculum.units.flatMap(
   78:         (unit) => unit.topicIds,
   79:       ),
   80:     ),
   81:   );
   82: 
   83:   const availableTopicIds = Array.from(
   84:     new Set(
   85:       units.flatMap((unit) =>
   86:         unit.topics.map(
   87:           (topic) => topic.id,
   88:         ),
   89:       ),
   90:     ),
   91:   );
   92: 
   93:   const missingTopicIds = Array.from(
   94:     new Set(
   95:       units.flatMap(
   96:         (unit) =>
   97:           unit.missingTopicIds,
   98:       ),
   99:     ),
  100:   );
  101: 
  102:   return {
  103:     curriculum,
  104:     units,
  105:     mappedTopicCount:
  106:       mappedTopicIds.length,
  107:     availableTopicCount:
  108:       availableTopicIds.length,
  109:     lessonCount: units.reduce(
  110:       (total, unit) =>
  111:         total + unit.lessonCount,
  112:       0,
  113:     ),
  114:     missingTopicIds,
  115:     complete:
  116:       missingTopicIds.length === 0,
  117:   };
  118: }

   58:

   60:      * The five-second fullscreen rule is deliberately fixed.

  105: function validateInput(input: CreateExamAssignmentInput) {
  106:   if (!input.teacherId.trim()) {

  111:     throw new Error("Select a class.");

  113:

  115:     throw new Error("A question set is required.");

  119:     throw new Error("Enter an assignment title.");
  120:   }

  127:   }

  136: function sameCalendarDay(
  137:   first: Date | null,
  138:   second: Date,
  139: ): boolean {
  140:   if (!first) {
  141:     return false;
  142:   }
  143: 
  144:   return (
  145:     first.getFullYear() === second.getFullYear() &&
  146:     first.getMonth() === second.getMonth() &&
  147:     first.getDate() === second.getDate()
  148:   );
  149: }

  151: async function findExistingExamAssignment(
  152:   input: CreateExamAssignmentInput,
  153: ): Promise<ExamAssignment | null> {
  154:   const snapshot = await getDocs(
  155:     query(
  156:       collection(db, "examAssignments"),
  157:       where(
  158:         "teacherId",
  159:         "==",
  160:         input.teacherId.trim(),
  161:       ),
  162:     ),
  163:   );
  164: 
  165:   const assignments = snapshot.docs.map(
  166:     (document) =>
  167:       convertAssignment(
  168:         document.id,
  169:         document.data() as FirestoreExamAssignment,
  170:       ),
  171:   );
  172: 
  173:   return (
  174:     assignments.find(
  175:       (assignment) =>
  176:         assignment.status === "active" &&
  177:         assignment.classId === input.classId.trim() &&
  178:         assignment.questionSetId ===
  179:           input.questionSetId.trim() &&
  180:         sameCalendarDay(
  181:           assignment.dueDate,
  182:           input.dueDate,
  183:         ),
  184:     ) || null
  185:   );
  186: }

  188: export async function createExamAssignment(

  192: 
  193:   const existing =
  194:     await findExistingExamAssignment(input);
  195: 
  196:   if (existing) {
  197:     throw new Error(
  198:       "This paper is already assigned to that class with the same due date.",
  199:     );
  200:   }
  201: 
  202:   const studentIds = Array.from(
  203:     new Set(
  204:       input.studentIds
  205:         .map((id) => id.trim())
  206:         .filter(Boolean),
  207:     ),
  208:   );
  209: 
  210:   const reference = await addDoc(
  211:     collection(db, "examAssignments"),
  212:     {
  213:       teacherId: input.teacherId.trim(),
  214:       teacherName:
  215:         input.teacherName?.trim() || "Teacher",
  216:       classId: input.classId.trim(),
  217:       className: input.className.trim(),
  218:       studentIds,
  219:       questionSetId: input.questionSetId.trim(),
  220:       questionSetTitle:
  221:         input.questionSetTitle.trim(),
  222:       questionSetSnapshot:
  223:         input.questionSetSnapshot,
  224:       title: input.title.trim(),
  225:       instructions:
  226:         input.instructions?.trim() || "",
  227:       dueDate: Timestamp.fromDate(input.dueDate),
  228:       status: "active",

  177:     status: "draft",

  179:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),

  275: export async function startExamIntegritySession({

  406: export async function terminateExamForIntegrity({
  407:   assignmentId,
  408:   studentId,
  409:   answers,
  410:   questionNumber,
  411:   reason,
  412: }: {
  413:   assignmentId: string;
  414:   studentId: string;
  415:   answers: StudentExamAnswer[];
  416:   questionNumber: number | null;
  417:   reason: string;
  418: }): Promise<void> {
  419:   const reference = doc(
  420:     db,
  421:     "examSubmissions",
  422:     createSubmissionId(
  423:       assignmentId,
  424:       studentId,
  425:     ),
  426:   );
  427: 
  428:   const terminationIncident = {
  429:     id: incidentId(
  430:       "integrity_termination",
  431:     ),
  432:     type:
  433:       "integrity_termination" as const,
  434:     occurredAt: Timestamp.now(),
  435:     questionNumber:
  436:       questionNumber ?? null,
  437:     detail: reason.trim(),
  438:   };
  439: 
  440:   await runTransaction(
  441:     db,
  442:     async (transaction) => {
  443:       const snapshot =
  444:         await transaction.get(reference);
  445: 
  446:       if (!snapshot.exists()) {
  447:         throw new Error(
  448:           "Submission not found.",
  449:         );
  450:       }
  451: 
  452:       const status =
  453:         snapshot.data().status;
  454: 
  455:       if (
  456:         ["submitted", "marking", "marked"].includes(
  457:           status,
  458:         )
  459:       ) {
  460:         return;
  461:       }
  462: 
  463:       const currentIncidents =
  464:         Array.isArray(
  465:           snapshot.data()
  466:             .integrityIncidents,
  467:         )
  468:           ? snapshot.data()
  469:               .integrityIncidents
  470:           : [];
  471: 
  472:       transaction.update(
  473:         reference,
  474:         {
  475:           answers,
  476:           status: "submitted",
  477:           submittedAt:
  478:             serverTimestamp(),
  479: 
  480:           integrityTerminated: true,
  481:           integrityTerminationReason:
  482:             reason.trim(),
  483: 
  484:           integrityLastQuestionNumber:
  485:             questionNumber ?? null,
  486: 
  487:           integrityIncidents: [
  488:             ...currentIncidents,
  489:             terminationIncident,
  490:           ],
  491: 
  492:           updatedAt:
  493:             serverTimestamp(),
  494:         },
  495:       );
  496:     },
  497:   );
  498: }

  582: export async function getAssignmentSubmissions(
  583:   assignmentId: string,
  584:   teacherId: string,
  585: ): Promise<ExamSubmission[]> {
  586:   const cleanedAssignmentId =
  587:     assignmentId.trim();
  588: 
  589:   const cleanedTeacherId =
  590:     teacherId.trim();
  591: 
  592:   if (
  593:     !cleanedAssignmentId ||
  594:     !cleanedTeacherId
  595:   ) {
  596:     return [];
  597:   }
  598: 
  599:   const snapshot = await getDocs(
  600:     query(
  601:       collection(
  602:         db,
  603:         "examSubmissions",
  604:       ),
  605:       where(
  606:         "assignmentId",
  607:         "==",
  608:         cleanedAssignmentId,
  609:       ),
  610:       where(
  611:         "teacherId",
  612:         "==",
  613:         cleanedTeacherId,
  614:       ),
  615:     ),
  616:   );
  617: 
  618:   return snapshot.docs
  619:     .map((document) =>
  620:       convertSubmission(
  621:         document.id,
  622:         document.data() as FirestoreExamSubmission,
  623:       ),
  624:     )
  625:     .sort((first, second) =>
  626:       first.studentName.localeCompare(
  627:         second.studentName,
  628:         "en-GB",
  629:         {
  630:           sensitivity: "base",
  631:         },
  632:       ),
  633:     );
  634: }

  636: export async function saveDraftMarking({
  637:   assignmentId,
  638:   studentId,
  639:   answers,
  640:   overallFeedback,
  641: }: {
  642:   assignmentId: string;
  643:   studentId: string;
  644:   answers: StudentExamAnswer[];
  645:   overallFeedback: string;
  646: }): Promise<void> {
  647:   const totalAwardedMarks =
  648:     answers.reduce(
  649:       (sum, answer) =>
  650:         sum +
  651:         (answer.awardedMarks || 0),
  652:       0,
  653:     );
  654: 
  655:   await updateDoc(
  656:     doc(
  657:       db,
  658:       "examSubmissions",
  659:       createSubmissionId(
  660:         assignmentId,
  661:         studentId,
  662:       ),
  663:     ),
  664:     {
  665:       answers,
  666:       overallFeedback:
  667:         overallFeedback.trim(),
  668:       totalAwardedMarks,
  669:       status: "marking",
  670:       updatedAt:
  671:         serverTimestamp(),
  672:     },
  673:   );
  674: }
  675: 
  676: export async function finaliseExamMarking({
  677:   assignmentId,
  678:   studentId,
  679:   answers,
  680:   overallFeedback,
  681:   totalAvailableMarks,
  682: }: {
  683:   assignmentId: string;
  684:   studentId: string;
  685:   answers: StudentExamAnswer[];
  686:   overallFeedback: string;
  687:   totalAvailableMarks: number;
  688: }): Promise<void> {
  689:   const assignmentReference = doc(
  690:     db,
  691:     "examAssignments",
  692:     assignmentId,
  693:   );
  694: 
  695:   const submissionReference = doc(
  696:     db,
  697:     "examSubmissions",
  698:     createSubmissionId(
  699:       assignmentId,
  700:       studentId,
  701:     ),
  702:   );
  703: 
  704:   const totalAwardedMarks =
  705:     answers.reduce(
  706:       (sum, answer) =>
  707:         sum +
  708:         (answer.awardedMarks ?? 0),
  709:       0,
  710:     );
  711: 
  712:   const safeAwardedMarks =
  713:     Math.min(
  714:       totalAvailableMarks,
  715:       Math.max(
  716:         0,
  717:         totalAwardedMarks,
  718:       ),
  719:     );
  720: 
  721:   const percentage =
  722:     totalAvailableMarks > 0
  723:       ? Math.round(
  724:           (safeAwardedMarks /
  725:             totalAvailableMarks) *
  726:             100,
  727:         )
  728:       : 0;
  729: 
  730:   await runTransaction(
  731:     db,
  732:     async (transaction) => {
  733:       const [
  734:         submissionSnapshot,
  735:         assignmentSnapshot,
  736:       ] = await Promise.all([
  737:         transaction.get(
  738:           submissionReference,
  739:         ),
  740:         transaction.get(
  741:           assignmentReference,
  742:         ),
  743:       ]);
  744: 
  745:       if (
  746:         !submissionSnapshot.exists()
  747:       ) {
  748:         throw new Error(
  749:           "Submission not found.",
  750:         );
  751:       }
  752: 
  753:       if (
  754:         !assignmentSnapshot.exists()
  755:       ) {
  756:         throw new Error(
  757:           "Assignment not found.",
  758:         );
  759:       }
  760: 
  761:       const submissionData =
  762:         submissionSnapshot.data();
  763: 
  764:       const assignmentData =
  765:         assignmentSnapshot.data();
  766: 
  767:       const alreadyMarked =
  768:         submissionData.status ===
  769:         "marked";
  770: 
  771:       transaction.update(
  772:         submissionReference,
  773:         {
  774:           answers,
  775:           overallFeedback:
  776:             overallFeedback.trim(),
  777:           totalAwardedMarks:
  778:             safeAwardedMarks,
  779:           totalAvailableMarks,
  780:           percentage,
  781:           status: "marked",
  782:           markedAt:
  783:             serverTimestamp(),
  784:           updatedAt:
  785:             serverTimestamp(),
  786:         },
  787:       );
  788: 
  789:       if (!alreadyMarked) {
  790:         const currentMarkedCount =
  791:           typeof assignmentData.markedCount ===
  792:           "number"
  793:             ? assignmentData.markedCount
  794:             : 0;
  795: 
  796:         const studentCount =
  797:           Array.isArray(
  798:             assignmentData.studentIds,
  799:           )
  800:             ? assignmentData
  801:                 .studentIds.length
  802:             : 0;
  803: 
  804:         transaction.update(
  805:           assignmentReference,
  806:           {
  807:             markedCount:
  808:               Math.min(
  809:                 currentMarkedCount +
  810:                   1,
  811:                 studentCount,
  812:               ),
  813:             updatedAt:
  814:               serverTimestamp(),
  815:           },
  816:         );
  817:       }
  818:     },
  819:   );
  820: }

FILE: services\examTrainerAnalyticsService.ts
==============================================================================================================

    1: import { getExamTrainerHistory } from "@/services/examTrainerAttemptService";
    2: import type {
    3:   ExamTrainerDashboardSummary,
    4:   ExamTrainerHistoryItem,
    5: } from "@/types/examTrainer";
    6: 
    7: function average(values: number[]): number {
    8:   if (values.length === 0) return 0;
    9:   return Math.round(
   10:     values.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0) / values.length,
   11:   );
   12: }
   13: 
   14: function gradeFromPercentage(value: number): string {
   15:   if (value >= 90) return "9";
   16:   if (value >= 80) return "8";
   17:   if (value >= 70) return "7";
   18:   if (value >= 60) return "6";
   19:   if (value >= 50) return "5";
   20:   if (value >= 40) return "4";
   21:   if (value >= 30) return "3";
   22:   if (value >= 20) return "2";
   23:   return "1";
   24: }
   25: 
   26: function topicFrequency(
   27:   history: ExamTrainerHistoryItem[],
   28:   key: "priorityTopics",
   29: ): Map<string, number> {
   30:   const counts = new Map<string, number>();
   31: 
   32:   history.forEach((attempt) => {
   33:     attempt[key].forEach((topic) => {
   34:       counts.set(topic, (counts.get(topic) ?? 0) + 1);
   35:     });
   36:   });
   37: 
   38:   return counts;
   39: }
   40: 
   41: export async function getExamTrainerDashboardSummary(
   42:   studentId: string,
   43: ): Promise<ExamTrainerDashboardSummary> {
   44:   const history = await getExamTrainerHistory(studentId);
   45:   const percentages = history.map((attempt) => attempt.percentage);
   46:   const recent = percentages.slice(0, 3);
   47:   const previous = percentages.slice(3, 6);
   48: 
   49:   const weakestCounts = topicFrequency(history, "priorityTopics");
   50:   const weakestTopic =
   51:     [...weakestCounts.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0]?.[0] ?? null;
   52: 
   53:   const topicPerformance = new Map<string, number[]>();
   54: 
   55:   history.forEach((attempt) => {
   56:     if (
   57:       attempt.selectedTopic !== "all" &&
   58:       !attempt.priorityTopics.includes(attempt.selectedTopic)
   59:     ) {
   60:       topicPerformance.set(attempt.selectedTopic, [
   61:         ...(topicPerformance.get(attempt.selectedTopic) ?? []),
   62:         attempt.percentage,
   63:       ]);
   64:     }
   65:   });
   66: 
   67:   const strongestTopic =
   68:     [...topicPerformance.entries()]
   69:       .map(([topic, scores]) => ({
   70:         topic,
   71:         average: average(scores),
   72:       }))
   73:       .sort((a, b) => b.average - a.average)[0]?.topic ?? null;
   74: 
   75:   const bestPercentage = percentages.length ? Math.max(...percentages) : 0;
   76: 
   77:   return {
   78:     completedAttempts: history.length,
   79:     averagePercentage: average(percentages),
   80:     bestPercentage,
   81:     bestGrade: gradeFromPercentage(bestPercentage),
   82:     latestPercentage: percentages[0] ?? 0,
   83:     weakestTopic,
   84:     strongestTopic,
   85:     recentTrend: average(recent) - average(previous),
   86:   };
   87: }

   25: export async function getExamTrainerAdaptiveEvidence(
   26:   studentId: string,
   27: ): Promise<AdaptiveEvidence[]> {
   28:   const snapshot = await getDocs(
   29:     query(
   30:       collection(db, "users", studentId, "examTrainerResults"),
   31:       orderBy("createdAt", "desc"),
   32:     ),
   33:   );
   34: 
   35:   const evidence: AdaptiveEvidence[] = [];
   36: 
   37:   snapshot.docs.forEach((document) => {
   38:     const data = document.data() as ExamTrainerResultDocument;
   39:     const completedAt =
   40:       data.completedAt instanceof Timestamp
   41:         ? data.completedAt.toDate()

   44:           : null;
   45: 
   46:     if (Array.isArray(data.topicScores) && data.topicScores.length > 0) {
   47:       data.topicScores.forEach((topicScore, index) => {
   48:         if (!topicScore.topic) return;
   49: 
   50:         evidence.push({
   51:           id: `exam-trainer-${document.id}-${index}`,
   52:           topic: topicScore.topic,
   53:           source: "exam",
   54:           score:
   55:             typeof topicScore.percentage === "number"
   56:               ? topicScore.percentage
   57:               : 0,
   58:           completedAt,
   59:           weight: 1.25,
   60:         });
   61:       });
   62: 
   63:       return;
   64:     }
   65: 
   66:     evidence.push({
   67:       id: `exam-trainer-${document.id}`,
   68:       topic: data.topic || "Mixed Topics",
   69:       source: "exam",
   70:       score:
   71:         typeof data.scorePercent === "number"
   72:           ? data.scorePercent
   73:           : typeof data.percentage === "number"
   74:             ? data.percentage
   75:             : 0,
   76:       completedAt,
   77:       weight: 1.25,
   78:     });
   79:   });
   80: 
   81:   return evidence;
   82: }

FILE: services\examTrainerService.ts
==============================================================================================================

    1: import { indicativeGradeFromPercentage } from "@/services/qualificationGradeService";
    2: import type { Qualification } from "@/types/user";
    3: 
    4: import type {
    5:   ExamTrainerAnswer,
    6:   ExamTrainerDifficulty,
    7:   ExamTrainerMarkedAnswer,
    8:   ExamTrainerQuestion,
    9:   ExamTrainerReport,
   10: } from "@/types/examTrainer";
   11: 
   12: function normalise(value: string): string {
   13:   return value.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
   14: }
   15: 
   16: function automaticMark(
   17:   question: ExamTrainerQuestion,
   18:   response: string,
   19: ): ExamTrainerMarkedAnswer | null {
   20:   const accepted = [
   21:     question.correctAnswer,
   22:     ...(question.acceptedAnswers ?? []),
   23:   ].filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value));
   24: 
   25:   if (question.type !== "multiple-choice" && accepted.length === 0) {
   26:     return null;
   27:   }
   28: 
   29:   const correct = accepted.some(
   30:     (answer) => normalise(answer) === normalise(response),
   31:   );
   32: 
   33:   return {
   34:     questionId: question.id,
   35:     awardedMarks: correct ? question.marks : 0,
   36:     maximumMarks: question.marks,
   37:     percentage: correct ? 100 : 0,
   38:     feedback: correct
   39:       ? "Correct. You have matched the expected answer."
   40:       : "This answer does not match the expected response.",
   41:     matchedPoints: correct ? question.markScheme : [],
   42:     missingPoints: correct ? [] : question.markScheme,
   43:     improvedAnswer: question.modelAnswer,
   44:     mode: "automatic",
   45:   };
   46: }
   47: 
   48: async function markWrittenAnswer(
   49:   question: ExamTrainerQuestion,
   50:   response: string,
   51: ): Promise<ExamTrainerMarkedAnswer> {
   52:   const apiResponse = await fetch("/api/ai/mark-lesson-question", {
   53:     method: "POST",
   54:     headers: {
   55:       "Content-Type": "application/json",
   56:     },
   57:     body: JSON.stringify({
   58:       topic: question.topic,
   59:       lessonTitle: "Exam Question Trainer",
   60:       question: question.question,
   61:       maximumMarks: question.marks,
   62:       modelAnswer: question.modelAnswer,
   63:       markScheme: question.markScheme,
   64:       guidance: question.examinerGuidance ?? [],
   65:       studentResponse: response,
   66:     }),
   67:   });
   68: 
   69:   const result = (await apiResponse.json()) as {
   70:     awardedMarks?: number;
   71:     maximumMarks?: number;
   72:     percentage?: number;
   73:     feedback?: string;
   74:     matchedPoints?: string[];
   75:     missingPoints?: string[];
   76:     improvedAnswer?: string;
   77:     mode?: "ai" | "demo";
   78:     error?: string;
   79:   };
   80: 
   81:   if (!apiResponse.ok || typeof result.awardedMarks !== "number") {
   82:     throw new Error(result.error || "The written answer could not be marked.");
   83:   }
   84: 
   85:   return {
   86:     questionId: question.id,
   87:     awardedMarks: result.awardedMarks,
   88:     maximumMarks: result.maximumMarks ?? question.marks,
   89:     percentage:
   90:       result.percentage ??
   91:       Math.round((result.awardedMarks / question.marks) * 100),
   92:     feedback: result.feedback ?? "Your answer has been marked.",
   93:     matchedPoints: result.matchedPoints ?? [],
   94:     missingPoints: result.missingPoints ?? [],
   95:     improvedAnswer: result.improvedAnswer ?? question.modelAnswer,
   96:     mode: result.mode ?? "demo",
   97:   };
   98: }
   99: 
  100: export function buildExamQuestions({
  101:   topic,
  102:   difficulty,
  103:   count,
  104:   questionBank,
  105: }: {
  106:   topic: string;
  107:   difficulty: ExamTrainerDifficulty | "all";
  108:   count: number;
  109:   questionBank: ExamTrainerQuestion[];
  110: }): ExamTrainerQuestion[] {
  111:   const filtered = questionBank.filter((question) => {
  112:     const topicMatches = topic === "all" || question.topic === topic;
  113:     const difficultyMatches =
  114:       difficulty === "all" || question.difficulty === difficulty;
  115: 
  116:     return topicMatches && difficultyMatches;
  117:   });
  118: 
  119:   const shuffled = [...filtered].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
  120:   return shuffled.slice(0, Math.max(1, Math.min(count, shuffled.length)));
  121: }
  122: 
  123: export async function markExamTrainerAttempt({
  124:   questions,
  125:   answers,
  126:   qualification,
  127: }: {
  128:   questions: ExamTrainerQuestion[];
  129:   answers: ExamTrainerAnswer[];
  130:   qualification?: Qualification | "";
  131: }): Promise<ExamTrainerReport> {
  132:   const markedAnswers = await Promise.all(
  133:     questions.map(async (question) => {
  134:       const response =
  135:         answers.find((answer) => answer.questionId === question.id)?.response ??
  136:         "";
  137: 
  138:       if (!response.trim()) {
  139:         return {
  140:           questionId: question.id,
  141:           awardedMarks: 0,
  142:           maximumMarks: question.marks,
  143:           percentage: 0,
  144:           feedback: "No answer was provided.",
  145:           matchedPoints: [],
  146:           missingPoints: question.markScheme,
  147:           improvedAnswer: question.modelAnswer,
  148:           mode: "automatic" as const,
  149:         };
  150:       }
  151: 
  152:       const automatic = automaticMark(question, response);
  153: 
  154:       if (automatic) {
  155:         return automatic;
  156:       }
  157: 
  158:       try {
  159:         return await markWrittenAnswer(question, response);
  160:       } catch {
  161:         return {
  162:           questionId: question.id,
  163:           awardedMarks: 0,
  164:           maximumMarks: question.marks,
  165:           percentage: 0,
  166:           feedback:
  167:             "Automatic marking was unavailable. Review the model answer and mark scheme.",
  168:           matchedPoints: [],
  169:           missingPoints: question.markScheme,
  170:           improvedAnswer: question.modelAnswer,
  171:           mode: "demo" as const,
  172:         };
  173:       }
  174:     }),
  175:   );
  176: 
  177:   const totalAwardedMarks = markedAnswers.reduce(
  178:     (total, answer) => total + answer.awardedMarks,
  179:     0,
  180:   );
  181: 
  182:   const totalAvailableMarks = questions.reduce(
  183:     (total, question) => total + question.marks,
  184:     0,
  185:   );
  186: 
  187:   const percentage =
  188:     totalAvailableMarks > 0
  189:       ? Math.round((totalAwardedMarks / totalAvailableMarks) * 100)
  190:       : 0;
  191: 
  192:   const topicMap = new Map<
  193:     string,
  194:     { awardedMarks: number; availableMarks: number }
  195:   >();
  196: 
  197:   questions.forEach((question) => {
  198:     const marked = markedAnswers.find(
  199:       (answer) => answer.questionId === question.id,
  200:     );
  201: 
  202:     const existing = topicMap.get(question.topic) ?? {
  203:       awardedMarks: 0,
  204:       availableMarks: 0,
  205:     };
  206: 
  207:     topicMap.set(question.topic, {
  208:       awardedMarks: existing.awardedMarks + (marked?.awardedMarks ?? 0),
  209:       availableMarks: existing.availableMarks + question.marks,
  210:     });
  211:   });
  212: 
  213:   const topicScores = Array.from(topicMap.entries())
  214:     .map(([topic, values]) => ({
  215:       topic,
  216:       awardedMarks: values.awardedMarks,
  217:       availableMarks: values.availableMarks,
  218:       percentage:
  219:         values.availableMarks > 0
  220:           ? Math.round((values.awardedMarks / values.availableMarks) * 100)
  221:           : 0,
  222:     }))
  223:     .sort((first, second) => second.percentage - first.percentage);
  224: 
  225: 
  226:   return {
  227:     totalAwardedMarks,
  228:     totalAvailableMarks,
  229:     percentage,
  230:     grade: indicativeGradeFromPercentage(percentage, qualification),
  231:     topicScores,
  232:     strongestTopics: topicScores
  233:       .filter((topic) => topic.percentage >= 70)
  234:       .map((topic) => topic.topic),
  235:     priorityTopics: topicScores
  236:       .filter((topic) => topic.percentage < 60)
  237:       .map((topic) => topic.topic),
  238:     markedAnswers,
  239:   };
  240: }

FILE: services\interventionAnalyticsService.ts
==============================================================================================================

    1: import { collection, getDocs, query, where } from "firebase/firestore";
    2: import { db } from "@/lib/firebase";
    3: import { getStudentAnalytics } from "@/services/studentAnalyticsService";
    4: import {
    5:   getAllStudents,
    6:   type StudentDirectoryRecord,
    7: } from "@/services/studentProfileService";
    8: 
    9: export type InterventionCandidate = {
   10:   student: StudentDirectoryRecord;
   11:   classId: string;
   12:   className: string;
   13:   combinedAverage: number;
   14:   predictedGrade: string;
   15:   improvementTrend: number;
   16:   overdueAssignments: number;
   17:   awaitingMarking: number;
   18:   priorityTopic: string;
   19:   priorityTopicScore: number;
   20:   recommendation: string;
   21:   priority: "high" | "medium" | "low";
   22: };
   23: 
   24: export async function getInterventionCandidates(
   25:   teacherId: string,
   26: ): Promise<InterventionCandidate[]> {
   27:   if (!teacherId.trim()) return [];
   28:   const classSnap = await getDocs(
   29:     query(
   30:       collection(db, "classes"),
   31:       where("teacherId", "==", teacherId.trim()),
   32:     ),
   33:   );
   34:   const classNames = new Map(
   35:     classSnap.docs.map((d) => [
   36:       d.id,
   37:       typeof d.data().name === "string" ? d.data().name : "Class",
   38:     ]),
   39:   );
   40:   const classIds = new Set(classNames.keys());
   41:   const students = (await getAllStudents()).filter((student) =>
   42:     student.classIds.some((id) => classIds.has(id)),
   43:   );
   44:   const candidates = await Promise.all(
   45:     students.map(async (student) => {
   46:       const analytics = await getStudentAnalytics(student.uid, teacherId);
   47:       if (!analytics) return null;
   48:       const weak = analytics.weakestTopics[0];
   49:       const classId = student.classIds.find((id) => classIds.has(id)) || "";
   50:       const avg = analytics.metrics.combinedAssessmentAverage;
   51:       const overdue = analytics.metrics.overdueAssignments;
   52:       const trend = analytics.metrics.improvementTrend;
   53:       return {
   54:         student,
   55:         classId,
   56:         className: classNames.get(classId) || "",
   57:         combinedAverage: avg,
   58:         predictedGrade: analytics.metrics.predictedGrade,
   59:         improvementTrend: trend,
   60:         overdueAssignments: overdue,
   61:         awaitingMarking: analytics.metrics.awaitingMarkingExamAssignments,
   62:         priorityTopic: weak?.topic || "General revision",
   63:         priorityTopicScore: weak?.averageScore || avg,
   64:         recommendation:
   65:           analytics.recommendations[0]?.description ||
   66:           "Continue targeted revision and assessment practice.",
   67:         priority:
   68:           avg < 40 || overdue > 0
   69:             ? "high"
   70:             : avg < 60 || trend < 0
   71:               ? "medium"
   72:               : "low",
   73:       } satisfies InterventionCandidate;
   74:     }),
   75:   );
   76:   const weight = { high: 0, medium: 1, low: 2 };
   77:   return candidates
   78:     .filter((item): item is InterventionCandidate => item !== null)
   79:     .sort(
   80:       (a, b) =>
   81:         weight[a.priority] - weight[b.priority] ||
   82:         a.combinedAverage - b.combinedAverage,
   83:     );
   84: }

   67: function buildSteps(input: CreateInterventionInput): InterventionStep[] {
   68:   const xp = Math.max(0, input.xpPerStep || 25);
   69:   const steps: InterventionStep[] = [];
   70:   const add = (
   71:     type: InterventionStep["type"],
   72:     title: string,
   73:     description: string,

   81:       title,

   83:       href,
   84:       sourceId,
   85:       sourceCollection,
   86:       status: "not_started",
   87:       xpReward: xp,
   88:       completedAt: null,
   89:     });
   90:   };
   91:   if (input.pathway === "lesson" || input.pathway === "complete")
   92:     add(
   93:       "lesson",
   94:       `Review ${input.topic}`,
   95:       "Revisit the core knowledge and examples.",
   96:       input.lessonHref?.trim() ||
   97:         `/learn?search=${encodeURIComponent(input.topic)}`,
   98:     );
   99:   if (input.pathway === "quiz" || input.pathway === "complete")
  100:     add(
  101:       "quiz",
  102:       `Retrieval quiz: ${input.topic}`,
  103:       "Complete retrieval practice and correct misconceptions.",
  104:       input.quizAssignmentId?.trim()
  105:         ? `/assignments/quiz/${input.quizAssignmentId.trim()}`
  106:         : `/quiz?topic=${encodeURIComponent(input.topic)}`,
  107:       input.quizAssignmentId?.trim() || "",
  108:       input.quizAssignmentId?.trim() ? "assignments" : "",
  109:     );
  110:   if (input.pathway === "exam" || input.pathway === "complete")
  111:     add(
  112:       "exam",
  113:       `Exam practice: ${input.topic}`,
  114:       "Attempt an exam-style question and review the mark scheme.",
  115:       input.examAssignmentId?.trim()
  116:         ? `/assignments/exam/${input.examAssignmentId.trim()}`
  117:         : "/assignments?filter=exams",
  118:       input.examAssignmentId?.trim() || "",
  119:       input.examAssignmentId?.trim() ? "examAssignments" : "",
  120:     );
  121:   if (input.pathway === "complete")
  122:     add(
  123:       "review",
  124:       "Review progress",
  125:       "Reflect on feedback and agree the next target.",
  126:       "/revision-plan",

  129: }
  130: 
  131: export async function createIntervention(
  132:   input: CreateInterventionInput,
  133: ): Promise<string> {
  134:   if (
  135:     !input.teacherId.trim() ||
  136:     !input.studentId.trim() ||
  137:     !input.title.trim() ||
  138:     !input.topic.trim()
  139:   )
  140:     throw new Error("Teacher, student, title and topic are required.");
  141:   if (!(input.dueDate instanceof Date) || Number.isNaN(input.dueDate.getTime()))
  142:     throw new Error("Select a valid due date.");
  143:   const existing = await getDocs(
  144:     query(
  145:       collection(db, "interventions"),
  146:       where("teacherId", "==", input.teacherId.trim()),
  147:       where("studentId", "==", input.studentId.trim()),
  148:     ),
  149:   );
  150:   if (
  151:     existing.docs.some(
  152:       (d) =>
  153:         d.data().status === "active" &&
  154:         String(d.data().topic || "").toLowerCase() ===
  155:           input.topic.trim().toLowerCase(),
  156:     )
  157:   )
  158:     throw new Error(
  159:       "An active intervention already exists for this student and topic.",
  160:     );
  161:   const baselineScore = clamp(input.baselineScore);
  162:   const ref = await addDoc(collection(db, "interventions"), {
  163:     teacherId: input.teacherId.trim(),
  164:     teacherName: input.teacherName?.trim() || "Teacher",
  165:     studentId: input.studentId.trim(),
  166:     studentName: input.studentName.trim(),
  167:     studentEmail: input.studentEmail?.trim() || "",
  168:     classId: input.classId?.trim() || "",
  169:     className: input.className?.trim() || "",
  170:     title: input.title.trim(),
  171:     topic: input.topic.trim(),
  172:     reason: input.reason.trim(),
  173:     priority: input.priority,
  174:     status: "active",
  175:     baselineScore,
  176:     currentScore: baselineScore,
  177:     impact: 0,
  178:     dueDate: Timestamp.fromDate(input.dueDate),
  179:     steps: buildSteps(input),
  180:     createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
  181:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  182:     completedAt: null,
  183:   });
  184:   return ref.id;
  185: }
  186:

  193:     : null;
  194: }

  196: export async function getTeacherInterventions(

  200:   const snap = await getDocs(
  201:     query(
  202:       collection(db, "interventions"),
  203:       where("teacherId", "==", teacherId.trim()),
  204:       orderBy("createdAt", "desc"),
  205:     ),

  209: 
  210: async function linkedStatus(
  211:   intervention: Intervention,
  212:   step: InterventionStep,
  213: ): Promise<InterventionStepStatus> {
  214:   if (!step.sourceId || !step.sourceCollection) return step.status;
  215:   if (step.sourceCollection === "assignments") {
  216:     const snap = await getDoc(
  217:       doc(
  218:         db,
  219:         "assignmentResults",
  220:         `${step.sourceId}_${intervention.studentId}`,
  221:       ),
  222:     );
  223:     return snap.exists() && snap.data().status === "completed"
  224:       ? "completed"
  225:       : step.status;
  226:   }
  227:   if (step.sourceCollection === "examAssignments") {
  228:     const snap = await getDoc(
  229:       doc(db, "examSubmissions", `${step.sourceId}_${intervention.studentId}`),
  230:     );
  231:     if (!snap.exists()) return step.status;
  232:     const status = snap.data().status;
  233:     if (status === "marked") return "completed";
  234:     if (["in_progress", "submitted", "marking"].includes(status))
  235:       return "in_progress";
  236:   }
  237:   return step.status;
  238: }
  239: 
  240: export async function getStudentInterventions(
  241:   studentId: string,
  242: ): Promise<Intervention[]> {
  243:   if (!studentId.trim()) return [];
  244:   const snap = await getDocs(
  245:     query(
  246:       collection(db, "interventions"),
  247:       where("studentId", "==", studentId.trim()),
  248:       orderBy("createdAt", "desc"),
  249:     ),
  250:   );
  251:   const items = snap.docs.map((d) =>
  252:     convert(d.id, d.data() as FirestoreIntervention),
  253:   );
  254:   return Promise.all(
  255:     items.map(async (item) => ({
  256:       ...item,
  257:       steps: await Promise.all(
  258:         item.steps.map(async (step) => ({
  259:           ...step,
  260:           status: await linkedStatus(item, step),
  261:         })),
  262:       ),
  263:     })),
  264:   );
  265: }
  266: 
  267: export async function updateInterventionStep(
  268:   interventionId: string,
  269:   studentId: string,
  270:   stepId: string,
  271:   status: InterventionStepStatus,
  272: ): Promise<void> {
  273:   const item = await getInterventionById(interventionId);
  274:   if (!item || item.studentId !== studentId)
  275:     throw new Error("Intervention not found for this student.");
  276:   const steps = item.steps.map((step) =>
  277:     step.id === stepId
  278:       ? {
  279:           ...step,
  280:           status,
  281:           completedAt: status === "completed" ? new Date() : null,
  282:         }
  283:       : step,
  284:   );
  285:   const allCompleted = steps.every((step) => step.status === "completed");
  286:   await updateDoc(doc(db, "interventions", interventionId), {
  287:     steps: steps.map((step) => ({
  288:       ...step,
  289:       completedAt: step.completedAt
  290:         ? Timestamp.fromDate(step.completedAt)
  291:         : null,
  292:     })),
  293:     status: allCompleted ? "completed" : "active",
  294:     completedAt: allCompleted ? serverTimestamp() : null,
  295:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  296:   });
  297: }
  298: 
  299: export async function updateInterventionStatus(
  300:   id: string,
  301:   status: InterventionStatus,
  302: ): Promise<void> {
  303:   await updateDoc(doc(db, "interventions", id), {
  304:     status,
  305:     completedAt: status === "completed" ? serverTimestamp() : null,
  306:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  307:   });
  308: }
  309: 
  310: export async function updateInterventionImpact(
  311:   id: string,
  312:   currentScore: number,
  313: ): Promise<void> {
  314:   const item = await getInterventionById(id);
  315:   if (!item) throw new Error("Intervention not found.");
  316:   const score = clamp(currentScore);
  317:   await updateDoc(doc(db, "interventions", id), {
  318:     currentScore: score,
  319:     impact: score - item.baselineScore,
  320:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  321:   });
  322: }

    1: import { curriculumRegistry } from "@/data/curriculum/curriculumRegistry";
    2: import { getAdaptiveLearningPlan } from "@/services/adaptiveLearningService";
    3: import { getRichStudentAnalytics } from "@/services/analytics/richStudentAnalyticsService";
    4: import { normaliseTopic } from "@/services/topicNormalisationService";
    5: import type {
    6:   KnowledgeMap,
    7:   KnowledgeMapTopic,
    8:   KnowledgeMapUnit,
    9: } from "@/types/knowledgeMap";
   10: import type {
   11:   AnalyticsEvidence,
   12:   AnalyticsEvidenceType,
   13:   TopicMastery,
   14: } from "@/types/analytics";
   15: 
   16: function evidenceSources(
   17:   evidence: AnalyticsEvidence[],
   18: ): AnalyticsEvidenceType[] {
   19:   return Array.from(new Set(evidence.map((item) => item.type)));
   20: }
   21: 
   22: export async function getKnowledgeMap(
   23:   studentId: string,
   24: ): Promise<KnowledgeMap> {
   25:   const id = studentId.trim();
   26: 
   27:   if (!id) {
   28:     throw new Error("A valid student account is required.");
   29:   }
   30: 
   31:   const [plan, analytics] = await Promise.all([
   32:     getAdaptiveLearningPlan(id),
   33:     getRichStudentAnalytics(id),
   34:   ]);
   35: 
   36:   const masteryByTopicId = new Map(
   37:     plan.topics.map((mastery) => [
   38:       normaliseTopic(mastery.topic).topicId,
   39:       mastery,
   40:     ]),
   41:   );
   42: 
   43:   const analyticsMasteryByTopicId = new Map<string, TopicMastery>(
   44:     analytics.topics.map((mastery) => [
   45:       normaliseTopic(mastery.topic).topicId,
   46:       mastery,
   47:     ]),
   48:   );
   49: 
   50:   const analyticsEvidenceByTopicId =
   51:     new Map<string, AnalyticsEvidence[]>();
   52: 
   53:   for (const evidence of analytics.masteryEvidence) {
   54:     const topicId = normaliseTopic(evidence.topic).topicId;
   55:     const current = analyticsEvidenceByTopicId.get(topicId) || [];
   56:     current.push(evidence);
   57:     analyticsEvidenceByTopicId.set(topicId, current);
   58:   }
   59: 
   60:   const unitsById = new Map<string, KnowledgeMapUnit>();
   61: 
   62:   curriculumRegistry.forEach((definition) => {
   63:     const mastery = masteryByTopicId.get(definition.id) || null;
   64: 
   65:     const nextAction =
   66:       plan.actions.find(
   67:         (action) =>
   68:           normaliseTopic(action.topic).topicId === definition.id,
   69:       ) || null;
   70: 
   71:     const analyticsMastery =
   72:       analyticsMasteryByTopicId.get(definition.id) || null;
   73: 
   74:     const analyticsEvidence =
   75:       analyticsEvidenceByTopicId.get(definition.id) || [];
   76: 
   77:     const mapTopic: KnowledgeMapTopic = {
   78:       definition,
   79:       mastery,
   80:       nextAction,
   81:       analyticsMastery,
   82:       analyticsEvidence,
   83:       evidenceSources: evidenceSources(analyticsEvidence),
   84:       writtenExamEvidenceCount: analyticsEvidence.filter(
   85:         (item) => item.type === "written_exam",
   86:       ).length,
   87:     };
   88: 
   89:     const existing = unitsById.get(definition.unitId);
   90: 
   91:     if (existing) {
   92:       existing.topics.push(mapTopic);
   93:     } else {
   94:       unitsById.set(definition.unitId, {
   95:         id: definition.unitId,
   96:         title: definition.unitTitle,
   97:         topics: [mapTopic],
   98:       });
   99:     }
  100:   });
  101: 
  102:   const knownTopicIds = new Set(
  103:     curriculumRegistry.map((topic) => topic.id),
  104:   );
  105: 
  106:   const unclassifiedTopics = plan.topics.filter(
  107:     (mastery) =>
  108:       !knownTopicIds.has(normaliseTopic(mastery.topic).topicId),
  109:   );
  110: 
  111:   const units = Array.from(unitsById.values()).map((unit) => ({
  112:     ...unit,
  113:     topics: [...unit.topics].sort(
  114:       (a, b) =>
  115:         a.definition.displayOrder - b.definition.displayOrder,
  116:     ),
  117:   }));
  118: 
  119:   return {
  120:     studentId: id,
  121:     generatedAt: new Date(),
  122:     units,
  123:     unclassifiedTopics,
  124:   };
  125: }

    1: import { topicLibrary } from "@/data/curriculum/topics";
    2: import type { Lesson, Topic } from "@/types/curriculum";
    3: 
    4: const LESSON_RESOURCE_SEPARATOR = "::";
    5: 
    6: export type LessonAssignmentIdentity = {
    7:   topicId: string;
    8:   lessonId: string;
    9: };
   10: 
   11: export type LessonAssignmentOption = {
   12:   topicId: string;
   13:   topicTitle: string;
   14:   lesson: Lesson;
   15: };
   16: 
   17: export function createLessonAssignmentResourceId(
   18:   topicId: string,
   19:   lessonId: string,
   20: ): string {
   21:   return `${topicId}${LESSON_RESOURCE_SEPARATOR}${lessonId}`;
   22: }
   23: 
   24: export function parseLessonAssignmentResourceId(
   25:   resourceId: string,
   26: ): LessonAssignmentIdentity | null {
   27:   const separatorIndex = resourceId.indexOf(
   28:     LESSON_RESOURCE_SEPARATOR,
   29:   );
   30: 
   31:   if (separatorIndex <= 0) {
   32:     return null;
   33:   }
   34: 
   35:   const topicId = resourceId.slice(0, separatorIndex).trim();
   36:   const lessonId = resourceId
   37:     .slice(separatorIndex + LESSON_RESOURCE_SEPARATOR.length)
   38:     .trim();
   39: 
   40:   if (!topicId || !lessonId) {
   41:     return null;
   42:   }
   43: 
   44:   return { topicId, lessonId };
   45: }
   46: 
   47: export function getLessonAssignmentOption(
   48:   resourceId: string,
   49: ): LessonAssignmentOption | null {
   50:   const identity = parseLessonAssignmentResourceId(resourceId);
   51: 
   52:   if (!identity) {
   53:     return null;
   54:   }
   55: 
   56:   const topic = (topicLibrary as Record<string, Topic>)[identity.topicId];
   57: 
   58:   if (!topic) {
   59:     return null;
   60:   }
   61: 
   62:   const lesson = topic.lessons.find(
   63:     (item) => item.id === identity.lessonId,
   64:   );
   65: 
   66:   if (!lesson) {
   67:     return null;
   68:   }
   69: 
   70:   return {
   71:     topicId: topic.id,
   72:     topicTitle: topic.title,
   73:     lesson,
   74:   };
   75: }
   76: 
   77: export function getLessonAssignmentHref(
   78:   resourceId: string,
   79:   assignmentId?: string,
   80: ): string | null {
   81:   const identity = parseLessonAssignmentResourceId(resourceId);
   82: 
   83:   if (!identity) {
   84:     return null;
   85:   }
   86: 
   87:   const search = new URLSearchParams({
   88:     lesson: identity.lessonId,
   89:   });
   90: 
   91:   if (assignmentId) {
   92:     search.set("assignment", assignmentId);
   93:   }
   94: 
   95:   return `/learn/${encodeURIComponent(identity.topicId)}?${search.toString()}`;
   96: }

   55: export function calculateResponseAccuracy(
   56:   responses: PracticeResponse[],
   57: ): number {
   58:   const checked = responses.filter((response) => response.checked);
   59:   if (checked.length === 0) return 0;
   60: 
   61:   const correct = checked.filter((response) => response.correct).length;
   62:   return Math.round((correct / checked.length) * 100);
   63: }
   64: 
   65: export function calculateOverallLessonAccuracy(
   66:   practiceResponses: PracticeResponse[],
   67:   checkpointResponses: PracticeResponse[],
   68:   examAccuracy = 0,
   69:   examMarked = false,
   70: ): number {
   71:   const checked = [...practiceResponses, ...checkpointResponses].filter(
   72:     (response) => response.checked,
   73:   );
   74: 
   75:   const objectiveScores = checked.map((response) =>
   76:     response.correct ? 100 : 0,
   77:   );
   78: 
   79:   const allScores = examMarked
   80:     ? [...objectiveScores, examAccuracy]
   81:     : objectiveScores;
   82: 
   83:   if (allScores.length === 0) return 0;
   84: 
   85:   return Math.round(
   86:     allScores.reduce((sum, score) => sum + score, 0) / allScores.length,
   87:   );
   88: }

   32: function toDate(value: unknown): Date | null {
   33:   if (!value) return null;
   34:   if (value instanceof Date) return value;
   35: 
   36:   if (
   37:     typeof value === "object" &&
   38:     value !== null &&
   39:     "toDate" in value &&
   40:     typeof (value as { toDate?: unknown }).toDate === "function"
   41:   ) {
   42:     return (value as { toDate: () => Date }).toDate();
   43:   }
   44: 
   45:   return null;
   46: }

   48: function progressId(assignmentId: string, studentId: string): string {
   49:   return `${assignmentId}_${studentId}`;

   52: function toChallengeSnapshot(
   53:   challengeId: string,

   69:     difficulty: challenge.difficulty,
   70:     qualifications: challenge.qualifications,
   71:     examBoards: challenge.examBoards ?? [],
   72:     xpReward: challenge.xpReward,
   73:     estimatedMinutes: challenge.estimatedMinutes,

   77: function convertAssignment(
   78:   id: string,
   79:   data: Record<string, unknown>,
   80: ): ProgrammingAssignment {
   81:   const storedSnapshot =
   82:     (data.programmingChallenge as
   83:       | ProgrammingChallengeSnapshot
   84:       | undefined) ?? null;
   85: 
   86:   const challengeId = String(
   87:     data.resourceId ?? storedSnapshot?.challengeId ?? "",
   88:   );
   89: 
   90:   const challengeSnapshot =
   91:     storedSnapshot ?? toChallengeSnapshot(challengeId);
   92: 
   93:   return {
   94:     id,
   95:     teacherId: String(data.teacherId ?? ""),
   96:     teacherName: String(data.teacherName ?? "Teacher"),
   97:     classId: String(data.classId ?? ""),
   98:     className: String(data.className ?? "Class"),
   99:     studentIds: Array.isArray(data.studentIds)
  100:       ? data.studentIds.filter(
  101:           (value): value is string => typeof value === "string",
  102:         )
  103:       : [],
  104:     studentCount:
  105:       typeof data.studentCount === "number" ? data.studentCount : 0,
  106:     completedCount:
  107:       typeof data.completedCount === "number" ? data.completedCount : 0,
  108:     challengeId,
  109:     title: String(data.resourceTitle ?? challengeSnapshot.title),
  110:     topic: String(data.resourceTopic ?? challengeSnapshot.topicId),
  111:     instructions: String(data.instructions ?? ""),
  112:     dueDate: toDate(data.dueDate),
  113:     createdAt: toDate(data.createdAt),
  114:     status: data.status === "archived" ? "archived" : "active",
  115:     challengeSnapshot,
  116:   };
  117: }

  119: export type CreateProgrammingAssignmentInput = {

  127: export async function createProgrammingAssignment({
  128:   teacherId,
  129:   classId,
  130:   challengeId,
  131:   instructions,
  132:   dueDate,
  133: }: CreateProgrammingAssignmentInput): Promise<string> {
  134:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
  135:   const cleanedClassId = classId.trim();
  136:   const cleanedChallengeId = challengeId.trim();
  137: 
  138:   if (!cleanedTeacherId || !cleanedClassId || !cleanedChallengeId) {
  139:     throw new Error(
  140:       "Teacher, class and programming challenge are required.",
  141:     );
  142:   }
  143: 
  144:   const parsedDueDate = new Date(`${dueDate}T23:59:59`);
  145: 
  146:   if (Number.isNaN(parsedDueDate.getTime())) {
  147:     throw new Error("Select a valid due date.");
  148:   }
  149: 
  150:   const challenge = getProgrammingChallengeById(cleanedChallengeId);
  151: 
  152:   if (!challenge) {
  153:     throw new Error(
  154:       "The selected programming challenge could not be found.",
  155:     );
  156:   }
  157: 
  158:   const [classSnapshot, teacherSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
  159:     getDoc(doc(db, "classes", cleanedClassId)),
  160:     getDoc(doc(db, "users", cleanedTeacherId)),
  161:   ]);
  162: 
  163:   if (!classSnapshot.exists()) {
  164:     throw new Error("The selected class could not be found.");
  165:   }
  166: 
  167:   const classData = classSnapshot.data();
  168:   const teacherData = teacherSnapshot.exists()
  169:     ? teacherSnapshot.data()
  170:     : {};
  171: 
  172:   if (
  173:     classData.teacherId &&
  174:     classData.teacherId !== cleanedTeacherId
  175:   ) {
  176:     throw new Error(
  177:       "You cannot assign work to another teacher's class.",
  178:     );
  179:   }
  180: 
  181:   const studentIds = Array.isArray(classData.studentIds)
  182:     ? Array.from(
  183:         new Set(
  184:           classData.studentIds.filter(
  185:             (value: unknown): value is string =>
  186:               typeof value === "string" && Boolean(value.trim()),
  187:           ),
  188:         ),
  189:       )
  190:     : [];
  191: 
  192:   const teacherName = String(
  193:     teacherData.name ??
  194:       teacherData.displayName ??
  195:       teacherData.fullName ??
  196:       teacherData.email ??
  197:       "Teacher",
  198:   );
  199: 
  200:   const challengeSnapshot =
  201:     toChallengeSnapshot(challenge.id);
  202: 
  203:   const assignmentReference = await addDoc(
  204:     collection(db, "classAssignments"),
  205:     {
  206:       resourceId: challenge.id,
  207:       resourceTitle: challenge.title,
  208:       resourceTopic: challenge.topicId,
  209:       resourceType: PROGRAMMING_RESOURCE_TYPE,
  210: 
  211:       teacherId: cleanedTeacherId,
  212:       teacherName,
  213: 
  214:       classId: cleanedClassId,
  215:       className: String(classData.name ?? "Untitled Class"),
  216: 
  217:       instructions:
  218:         instructions.trim() ||
  219:         `Complete the ${challenge.title} programming challenge.`,
  220: 
  221:       dueDate: Timestamp.fromDate(parsedDueDate),
  222:       status: "active",
  223: 
  224:       studentIds,
  225:       studentCount: studentIds.length,
  226:       completedCount: 0,
  227: 
  228:       programmingChallenge: challengeSnapshot,
  229: 
  230:       createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
  231:       updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  232:     },
  233:   );
  234: 
  235:   await updateDoc(doc(db, "classes", cleanedClassId), {
  236:     assignmentIds: arrayUnion(assignmentReference.id),
  237:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  238:   });
  239: 
  240:   return assignmentReference.id;
  241: }

  243: export async function getProgrammingAssignmentById(
  244:   assignmentId: string,
  245: ): Promise<ProgrammingAssignment | null> {
  246:   const cleanedId = assignmentId.trim();
  247:   if (!cleanedId) return null;
  248: 
  249:   const snapshot = await getDoc(
  250:     doc(db, "classAssignments", cleanedId),
  251:   );
  252: 
  253:   if (!snapshot.exists()) return null;
  254: 
  255:   const data = snapshot.data() as Record<string, unknown>;
  256: 
  257:   if (data.resourceType !== PROGRAMMING_RESOURCE_TYPE) {
  258:     return null;
  259:   }
  260: 
  261:   return convertAssignment(snapshot.id, data);
  262: }

  264: export async function getTeacherProgrammingAssignments(

  351:   assignmentId: string;
