  360: export async function recordProgrammingAssignmentAttempt({
  361:   assignmentId,
  362:   studentId,
  363:   code,
  364:   passed,
  365:   passedCount,
  366:   totalTests,
  367:   error = "",
  368: }: RecordProgrammingAttemptInput): Promise<void> {
  369:   const assignment =
  370:     await getProgrammingAssignmentById(assignmentId);
  371: 
  372:   if (!assignment) {
  373:     throw new Error(
  374:       "The programming assignment could not be found.",
  375:     );
  376:   }
  377: 
  378:   if (!assignment.studentIds.includes(studentId)) {
  379:     throw new Error(
  380:       "You are not enrolled in this programming assignment.",
  381:     );
  382:   }
  383: 
  384:   const id = progressId(assignmentId, studentId);
  385:   const progressReference = doc(
  386:     db,
  387:     "assignmentProgress",
  388:     id,
  389:   );
  390:   const existing = await getDoc(progressReference);
  391: 
  392:   const previousAttempts =
  393:     existing.exists() &&
  394:     typeof existing.data().programmingAttempts === "number"
  395:       ? existing.data().programmingAttempts
  396:       : 0;
  397: 
  398:   const studentSnapshot = await getDoc(
  399:     doc(db, "users", studentId),
  400:   );
  401:   const studentData = studentSnapshot.exists()
  402:     ? studentSnapshot.data()
  403:     : {};
  404: 
  405:   const percentage =
  406:     totalTests > 0
  407:       ? Math.round(
  408:           (Math.max(0, passedCount) / totalTests) * 100,
  409:         )
  410:       : 0;
  411: 
  412:   await setDoc(
  413:     progressReference,
  414:     {
  415:       assignmentId,
  416:       studentId,
  417:       studentName: String(
  418:         studentData.name ??
  419:           studentData.displayName ??
  420:           studentData.fullName ??
  421:           studentData.email ??
  422:           "Student",
  423:       ),
  424:       programmingChallengeId: assignment.challengeId,
  425:       programmingCode: code,
  426:       programmingAttempts: previousAttempts + 1,
  427:       programmingPassedCount: passedCount,
  428:       programmingTotalTests: totalTests,
  429:       programmingPercentage: percentage,
  430:       programmingLastPassed: passed,
  431:       programmingLastError: error,
  432:       updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  433:     },
  434:     { merge: true },
  435:   );
  436: 
  437:   if (passed) {
  438:     await completeStudentAssignment(
  439:       assignmentId,
  440:       studentId,
  441:     );
  442:   } else {
  443:     await startStudentAssignment(
  444:       assignmentId,
  445:       studentId,
  446:     );
  447:   }
  448: }

  450: export async function getProgrammingAssignmentResults(
  451:   assignmentId: string,
  452: ): Promise<ProgrammingAssignmentResultsSummary | null> {
  453:   const assignment =
  454:     await getProgrammingAssignmentById(assignmentId);
  455: 
  456:   if (!assignment) return null;
  457: 
  458:   const progressSnapshot = await getDocs(
  459:     query(
  460:       collection(db, "assignmentProgress"),
  461:       where("assignmentId", "==", assignmentId),
  462:     ),
  463:   );
  464: 
  465:   const progressByStudent = new Map(
  466:     progressSnapshot.docs.map((item) => [
  467:       item.data().studentId,
  468:       item.data(),
  469:     ]),
  470:   );
  471: 
  472:   const results: ProgrammingAssignmentResult[] =
  473:     await Promise.all(
  474:       assignment.studentIds.map(async (studentId) => {
  475:         const studentSnapshot = await getDoc(
  476:           doc(db, "users", studentId),
  477:         );
  478:         const studentData = studentSnapshot.exists()
  479:           ? studentSnapshot.data()
  480:           : {};
  481:         const progress = progressByStudent.get(studentId);
  482: 
  483:         const status =
  484:           progress?.status === "completed"
  485:             ? "completed"
  486:             : progress?.status === "in_progress"
  487:               ? "in_progress"
  488:               : "not_started";
  489: 
  490:         return {
  491:           studentId,
  492:           studentName: String(
  493:             progress?.studentName ??
  494:               studentData.name ??
  495:               studentData.displayName ??
  496:               studentData.fullName ??
  497:               studentData.email ??
  498:               "Student",
  499:           ),
  500:           status,
  501:           attempts:
  502:             typeof progress?.programmingAttempts === "number"
  503:               ? progress.programmingAttempts
  504:               : 0,
  505:           passedCount:
  506:             typeof progress?.programmingPassedCount === "number"
  507:               ? progress.programmingPassedCount
  508:               : 0,
  509:           totalTests:
  510:             typeof progress?.programmingTotalTests === "number"
  511:               ? progress.programmingTotalTests
  512:               : 0,
  513:           percentage:
  514:             typeof progress?.programmingPercentage === "number"
  515:               ? progress.programmingPercentage
  516:               : 0,
  517:           completedAt: toDate(progress?.completedAt),
  518:         };
  519:       }),
  520:     );
  521: 
  522:   const completed = results.filter(
  523:     (result) => result.status === "completed",
  524:   ).length;
  525: 
  526:   const inProgress = results.filter(
  527:     (result) => result.status === "in_progress",
  528:   ).length;
  529: 
  530:   const notStarted =
  531:     results.length - completed - inProgress;
  532: 
  533:   const attempted = results.filter(
  534:     (result) => result.attempts > 0,
  535:   );
  536: 
  537:   const averagePercentage =
  538:     attempted.length > 0
  539:       ? Math.round(
  540:           attempted.reduce(
  541:             (total, result) =>
  542:               total + result.percentage,
  543:             0,
  544:           ) / attempted.length,
  545:         )
  546:       : 0;
  547: 
  548:   return {
  549:     assignment,
  550:     results,
  551:     completed,
  552:     inProgress,
  553:     notStarted,
  554:     completionPercentage:
  555:       results.length > 0
  556:         ? Math.round(
  557:             (completed / results.length) * 100,
  558:           )
  559:         : 0,
  560:     averagePercentage,
  561:   };
  562: }

  565:   PROGRAMMING_RESOURCE_TYPE;

FILE: services\programmingChallengeService.ts

    1: import { allProgrammingChallenges } from "@/data/programming/challenges";
    2: import { getProgrammingCurriculumProfile } from "@/data/programming/programmingCurriculumMap";
    3: import type {
    4:   ProgrammingChallenge,
    5:   ProgrammingChallengeFilter,
    6:   ProgrammingChallengeSelectionContext,
    7:   ProgrammingSkill,
    8: } from "@/types/programming";
    9: 
   10: function matchesFilter(
   11:   challenge: ProgrammingChallenge,
   12:   filter: ProgrammingChallengeFilter,
   13: ): boolean {
   14:   if (challenge.mode !== filter.mode) return false;
   15:   if (challenge.difficulty !== filter.difficulty) return false;
   16:   if (!challenge.qualifications.includes(filter.qualification)) return false;
   17: 
   18:   if (
   19:     filter.examBoard &&
   20:     challenge.examBoards &&
   21:     !challenge.examBoards.includes(filter.examBoard)
   22:   ) {
   23:     return false;
   24:   }
   25: 
   26:   if (
   27:     filter.topicId &&
   28:     !challenge.curriculumTopicIds.includes(filter.topicId) &&
   29:     challenge.topicId !== filter.topicId
   30:   ) {
   31:     return false;
   32:   }
   33: 
   34:   if (filter.skill && !challenge.skills.includes(filter.skill)) {
   35:     return false;
   36:   }
   37: 
   38:   return true;
   39: }
   40: 
   41: export function getProgrammingChallenges(
   42:   filter: ProgrammingChallengeFilter,
   43: ): ProgrammingChallenge[] {
   44:   return allProgrammingChallenges.filter((challenge) =>
   45:     matchesFilter(challenge, filter),
   46:   );
   47: }
   48: 
   49: function weakSkillScore(
   50:   challenge: ProgrammingChallenge,
   51:   preferredWeakSkills: ProgrammingSkill[],
   52: ): number {
   53:   return challenge.skills.reduce(
   54:     (score, skill) =>
   55:       score + (preferredWeakSkills.includes(skill) ? 5 : 0),
   56:     0,
   57:   );
   58: }
   59: 
   60: export function chooseNextProgrammingChallenge(
   61:   context: ProgrammingChallengeSelectionContext,
   62: ): ProgrammingChallenge | null {
   63:   const matches = getProgrammingChallenges(context);
   64:   if (matches.length === 0) return null;
   65: 
   66:   const completed = new Set(context.completedChallengeIds ?? []);
   67:   const recent = new Set(context.recentChallengeIds ?? []);
   68:   const weakSkills = context.preferredWeakSkills ?? [];
   69: 
   70:   const curriculumProfile = getProgrammingCurriculumProfile(
   71:     context.qualification,
   72:     context.examBoard ?? null,
   73:   );
   74: 
   75:   const prioritySkills = curriculumProfile?.prioritySkills ?? [];
   76: 
   77:   return [...matches].sort((a, b) => {
   78:     const aCompleted = completed.has(a.id) ? 1 : 0;
   79:     const bCompleted = completed.has(b.id) ? 1 : 0;
   80:     if (aCompleted !== bCompleted) return aCompleted - bCompleted;
   81: 
   82:     const aRecent = recent.has(a.id) ? 1 : 0;
   83:     const bRecent = recent.has(b.id) ? 1 : 0;
   84:     if (aRecent !== bRecent) return aRecent - bRecent;
   85: 
   86:     const aWeak = weakSkillScore(a, weakSkills);
   87:     const bWeak = weakSkillScore(b, weakSkills);
   88:     if (aWeak !== bWeak) return bWeak - aWeak;
   89: 
   90:     const aPriority = a.skills.filter((skill) =>
   91:       prioritySkills.includes(skill)
   92:     ).length;
   93: 
   94:     const bPriority = b.skills.filter((skill) =>
   95:       prioritySkills.includes(skill)
   96:     ).length;
   97: 
   98:     if (aPriority !== bPriority) return bPriority - aPriority;
   99: 
  100:     return a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
  101:   })[0];
  102: }

   30: export async function completeLesson({
   31:   uid,
   32:   lessonId,
   33:   topicId,
   34:   xpReward = 50,
   35:   progress,
   36: }: CompleteLessonInput): Promise<
   37:   LessonCompletionSummary & {
   38:     unlockedAchievements: ReturnType<typeof getUnlockedAchievements>;
   39:   }

   56:     progress.checkpointResponses,
   57:   );

   62:     progress.practiceResponses,
   63:     progress.checkpointResponses,
   64:     examAccuracy,
   65:     true,

   69: 
   70:   const reviewAt = calculateLessonReviewDate(overallAccuracy);
   71: 
   72:   const completedAt = new Date();
   73: 
   74:   const examMarking = progress.examMarking;
   75: 
   76:   const firestoreExamMarking = {
   77:     ...examMarking,
   78: 
   79:     markedAt: examMarking.markedAt
   80:       ? Timestamp.fromDate(examMarking.markedAt)
   81:       : serverTimestamp(),
   82:   };
   83: 
   84:   return runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
   85:     /*
   86:      * All reads must happen before any writes.
   87:      */
   88:     const [userSnapshot, progressSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
   89:       transaction.get(userReference),
   90: 
   91:       transaction.get(progressReference),
   92:     ]);
   93: 
   94:     if (!userSnapshot.exists()) {
   95:       throw new Error("User profile not found.");
   96:     }
   97: 
   98:     const profile = userSnapshot.data();
   99: 
  100:     const completedLessons: string[] = Array.isArray(profile.completedLessons)
  101:       ? profile.completedLessons.filter(
  102:           (lessonValue): lessonValue is string =>
  103:             typeof lessonValue === "string",
  104:         )
  105:       : [];
  106: 
  107:     const progressAlreadyCompleted =
  108:       progressSnapshot.exists() &&
  109:       progressSnapshot.data().status === "completed";
  110: 
  111:     const alreadyCompleted =
  112:       completedLessons.includes(lessonId) || progressAlreadyCompleted;
  113: 
  114:     const currentXP =
  115:       typeof profile.xp === "number" && Number.isFinite(profile.xp)
  116:         ? profile.xp
  117:         : 0;
  118: 
  119:     const badges: string[] = Array.isArray(profile.badges)
  120:       ? profile.badges.filter(
  121:           (badgeValue): badgeValue is string => typeof badgeValue === "string",
  122:         )
  123:       : [];
  124: 
  125:     const updatedProfile = {
  126:       ...profile,
  127: 
  128:       xp: alreadyCompleted ? currentXP : currentXP + xpReward,
  129: 
  130:       completedLessons: alreadyCompleted
  131:         ? completedLessons
  132:         : [...completedLessons, lessonId],
  133: 
  134:       badges,
  135:     };
  136: 
  137:     const unlockedAchievements = alreadyCompleted
  138:       ? []
  139:       : getUnlockedAchievements(updatedProfile);
  140: 
  141:     /*
  142:      * Writes begin after all reads.
  143:      */
  144:     transaction.set(
  145:       progressReference,
  146:       {
  147:         studentId: uid,
  148:         lessonId,
  149:         topicId,
  150: 
  151:         currentStepIndex: progress.currentStepIndex,
  152: 
  153:         completedStepIds: progress.completedStepIds,
  154: 
  155:         practiceResponses: progress.practiceResponses,
  156: 
  157:         checkpointResponses: progress.checkpointResponses,
  158: 
  159:         examResponse: progress.examResponse,
  160: 
  161:         examMarking: firestoreExamMarking,
  162: 
  163:         reflection: progress.reflection,
  164: 
  165:         audioEnabled: progress.audioEnabled,
  166: 
  167:         audioRate: progress.audioRate,
  168: 
  169:         selectedVoiceName: progress.selectedVoiceName,
  170: 
  171:         practiceAccuracy,
  172:         checkpointAccuracy,
  173:         examAccuracy,
  174:         overallAccuracy,
  175:         masteryImpact,
  176: 
  177:         reviewAt: Timestamp.fromDate(reviewAt),
  178: 
  179:         status: "completed",
  180: 
  181:         startedAt: progress.startedAt
  182:           ? Timestamp.fromDate(progress.startedAt)
  183:           : serverTimestamp(),
  184: 
  185:         completedAt: Timestamp.fromDate(completedAt),
  186: 
  187:         updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  188:       },
  189:       {
  190:         merge: true,
  191:       },
  192:     );
  193: 
  194:     if (!alreadyCompleted) {
  195:       const achievementIds = unlockedAchievements.map(
  196:         (achievement) => achievement.id,
  197:       );
  198: 
  199:       const userUpdate: {
  200:         completedLessons: ReturnType<typeof arrayUnion>;
  201:         xp: number;
  202:         updatedAt: ReturnType<typeof serverTimestamp>;
  203:         badges?: ReturnType<typeof arrayUnion>;
  204:       } = {
  205:         completedLessons: arrayUnion(lessonId),
  206: 
  207:         xp: currentXP + xpReward,
  208: 
  209:         updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  210:       };
  211: 
  212:       /*
  213:        * Avoid calling arrayUnion()
  214:        * with no values.
  215:        */
  216:       if (achievementIds.length > 0) {
  217:         userUpdate.badges = arrayUnion(...achievementIds);
  218:       }
  219: 
  220:       transaction.update(userReference, userUpdate);
  221:     }
  222: 
  223:     return {
  224:       alreadyCompleted,
  225: 
  226:       xpAwarded: alreadyCompleted ? 0 : xpReward,
  227: 
  228:       practiceAccuracy,
  229:       checkpointAccuracy,
  230:       examAccuracy,
  231:       overallAccuracy,
  232:       masteryImpact,
  233:       reviewAt,
  234:       unlockedAchievements,
  235:     };
  236:   });
  237: }

    1: import type {
    2:   PythonRunRequest,
    3:   PythonRunResult,
    4: } from "@/types/programming";
    5: 
    6: type ReadyMessage = {
    7:   type: "ready";
    8: };
    9: 
   10: type InitialisationErrorMessage = {
   11:   type: "initialisation-error";
   12:   error: string;
   13: };
   14: 
   15: type ResultMessage = {
   16:   type: "result";
   17:   id: string;
   18:   stdout: string;
   19:   stderr: string;
   20:   error: string;
   21: };
   22: 
   23: type WorkerResponse =
   24:   | ReadyMessage
   25:   | InitialisationErrorMessage
   26:   | ResultMessage;
   27: 
   28: let worker: Worker | null = null;
   29: 
   30: let readyPromise: Promise<void> | null = null;
   31: 
   32: let requestCounter = 0;
   33: 
   34: const STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 45_000;
   35: 
   36: function resetWorker() {
   37:   if (worker) {
   38:     worker.terminate();
   39:   }
   40: 
   41:   worker = null;
   42:   readyPromise = null;
   43: }
   44: 
   45: function createWorker(): Worker {
   46:   return new Worker(
   47:     "/workers/python-runner.mjs",
   48:     {
   49:       type: "module",
   50:     },
   51:   );
   52: }
   53: 
   54: function ensureWorker(): {
   55:   worker: Worker;
   56:   ready: Promise<void>;
   57: } {
   58:   if (typeof window === "undefined") {
   59:     throw new Error(
   60:       "Python execution is only available in the browser.",
   61:     );
   62:   }
   63: 
   64:   if (worker && readyPromise) {
   65:     return {
   66:       worker,
   67:       ready: readyPromise,
   68:     };
   69:   }
   70: 
   71:   worker = createWorker();
   72: 
   73:   const activeWorker = worker;
   74: 
   75:   readyPromise = new Promise<void>(
   76:     (resolve, reject) => {
   77:       let settled = false;
   78: 
   79:       const cleanup = () => {
   80:         window.clearTimeout(startupTimer);
   81: 
   82:         activeWorker.removeEventListener(
   83:           "message",
   84:           handleMessage,
   85:         );
   86: 
   87:         activeWorker.removeEventListener(
   88:           "error",
   89:           handleError,
   90:         );
   91:       };
   92: 
   93:       const succeed = () => {
   94:         if (settled) return;
   95: 
   96:         settled = true;
   97:         cleanup();
   98:         resolve();
   99:       };
  100: 
  101:       const fail = (message: string) => {
  102:         if (settled) return;
  103: 
  104:         settled = true;
  105:         cleanup();
  106: 
  107:         resetWorker();
  108: 
  109:         reject(
  110:           new Error(message),
  111:         );
  112:       };
  113: 
  114:       const handleMessage = (
  115:         event: MessageEvent<WorkerResponse>,
  116:       ) => {
  117:         const message = event.data;
  118: 
  119:         if (message.type === "ready") {
  120:           succeed();
  121:           return;
  122:         }
  123: 
  124:         if (
  125:           message.type ===
  126:           "initialisation-error"
  127:         ) {
  128:           fail(
  129:             message.error ||
  130:               "The Python runtime could not be loaded.",
  131:           );
  132:         }
  133:       };
  134: 
  135:       const handleError = (
  136:         event: ErrorEvent,
  137:       ) => {
  138:         fail(
  139:           event.message ||
  140:             "The Python worker stopped while loading.",
  141:         );
  142:       };
  143: 
  144:       const startupTimer =
  145:         window.setTimeout(() => {
  146:           fail(
  147:             "The Python runtime took too long to initialise.",
  148:           );
  149:         }, STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS);
  150: 
  151:       activeWorker.addEventListener(
  152:         "message",
  153:         handleMessage,
  154:       );
  155: 
  156:       activeWorker.addEventListener(
  157:         "error",
  158:         handleError,
  159:       );
  160:     },
  161:   );
  162: 
  163:   return {
  164:     worker,
  165:     ready: readyPromise,
  166:   };
  167: }
  168: 
  169: export async function runPython({
  170:   code,
  171:   stdin = "",
  172:   timeoutMs = 3000,
  173: }: PythonRunRequest): Promise<PythonRunResult> {
  174:   const startedAt = performance.now();
  175: 
  176:   const runner = ensureWorker();
  177: 
  178:   /*
  179:    * Runtime loading is deliberately separate
  180:    * from student-code execution.
  181:    */
  182:   await runner.ready;
  183: 
  184:   const activeWorker = runner.worker;
  185: 
  186:   const id =
  187:     `python-${Date.now()}-${requestCounter++}`;
  188: 
  189:   return new Promise<PythonRunResult>(
  190:     (resolve) => {
  191:       let settled = false;
  192: 
  193:       const finish = (
  194:         result: Omit<
  195:           PythonRunResult,
  196:           "durationMs"
  197:         >,
  198:       ) => {
  199:         if (settled) return;
  200: 
  201:         settled = true;
  202: 
  203:         cleanup();
  204: 
  205:         resolve({
  206:           ...result,
  207:           durationMs: Math.round(
  208:             performance.now() -
  209:               startedAt,
  210:           ),
  211:         });
  212:       };
  213: 
  214:       const handleMessage = (
  215:         event: MessageEvent<WorkerResponse>,
  216:       ) => {
  217:         const message = event.data;
  218: 
  219:         if (
  220:           message.type !== "result" ||
  221:           message.id !== id
  222:         ) {
  223:           return;
  224:         }
  225: 
  226:         finish({
  227:           stdout:
  228:             message.stdout ?? "",
  229:           stderr:
  230:             message.stderr ?? "",
  231:           error:
  232:             message.error ?? "",
  233:           timedOut: false,
  234:         });
  235:       };
  236: 
  237:       const handleError = (
  238:         event: ErrorEvent,
  239:       ) => {
  240:         finish({
  241:           stdout: "",
  242:           stderr: "",
  243:           error:
  244:             event.message ||
  245:             "The Python worker stopped unexpectedly.",
  246:           timedOut: false,
  247:         });
  248: 
  249:         resetWorker();
  250:       };
  251: 
  252:       const executionTimer =
  253:         window.setTimeout(() => {
  254:           /*
  255:            * Infinite-loop or long-running
  256:            * student code: terminate the worker.
  257:            *
  258:            * The next execution will initialise
  259:            * a fresh Python runtime.
  260:            */
  261:           resetWorker();
  262: 
  263:           finish({
  264:             stdout: "",
  265:             stderr: "",
  266:             error:
  267:               `Execution stopped after ${timeoutMs} ms.`,
  268:             timedOut: true,
  269:           });
  270:         }, timeoutMs);
  271: 
  272:       function cleanup() {
  273:         window.clearTimeout(
  274:           executionTimer,
  275:         );
  276: 
  277:         activeWorker.removeEventListener(
  278:           "message",
  279:           handleMessage,
  280:         );
  281: 
  282:         activeWorker.removeEventListener(
  283:           "error",
  284:           handleError,
  285:         );
  286:       }
  287: 
  288:       activeWorker.addEventListener(
  289:         "message",
  290:         handleMessage,
  291:       );
  292: 
  293:       activeWorker.addEventListener(
  294:         "error",
  295:         handleError,
  296:       );
  297: 
  298:       activeWorker.postMessage({
  299:         type: "run",
  300:         id,
  301:         code,
  302:         stdin,
  303:       });
  304:     },
  305:   );
  306: }
  307: 
  308: export function stopPythonRunner() {
  309:   resetWorker();
  310: }

    1: import type { Qualification } from "@/types/user";
    2: 
    3: /*
    4:  * These bands are an internal learning-progress heuristic only.
    5:  *
    6:  * They are deliberately NOT described as official examination grade
    7:  * boundaries. Real grade boundaries vary by board, paper and series.
    8:  */
    9: export function indicativeGradeFromPercentage(
   10:   percentage: number,
   11:   qualification: Qualification | "" | undefined,
   12: ): string {
   13:   const value = Math.max(
   14:     0,
   15:     Math.min(100, Math.round(percentage)),
   16:   );
   17: 
   18:   if (qualification === "A_LEVEL") {
   19:     if (value >= 90) return "A*";
   20:     if (value >= 80) return "A";
   21:     if (value >= 70) return "B";
   22:     if (value >= 60) return "C";
   23:     if (value >= 50) return "D";
   24:     if (value >= 40) return "E";
   25:     return "U";
   26:   }
   27: 
   28:   if (value >= 90) return "9";
   29:   if (value >= 80) return "8";
   30:   if (value >= 70) return "7";
   31:   if (value >= 60) return "6";
   32:   if (value >= 50) return "5";
   33:   if (value >= 40) return "4";
   34:   if (value >= 30) return "3";
   35:   if (value >= 20) return "2";
   36:   return "1";
   37: }
   38: 
   39: export function isIndicativeGradeForQualification(
   40:   grade: string,
   41:   qualification: Qualification | "" | undefined,
   42: ): boolean {
   43:   if (qualification === "A_LEVEL") {
   44:     return ["A*", "A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "U"].includes(
   45:       grade,
   46:     );
   47:   }
   48: 
   49:   return ["9", "8", "7", "6", "5", "4", "3", "2", "1"].includes(
   50:     grade,
   51:   );
   52: }

   41: function convertDate(value: FirestoreDate): Date | null {
   42:   if (!value) return null;
   43:   if (value instanceof Date) return value;
   44:   if (value instanceof Timestamp) return value.toDate();
   45: 
   46:   if (typeof value === "string") {
   47:     const parsedDate = new Date(value);
   48:     return Number.isNaN(parsedDate.getTime()) ? null : parsedDate;
   49:   }
   50: 
   51:   return null;
   52: }

   54: function removeDuplicateIds(values: string[]): string[] {
   55:   return Array.from(
   56:     new Set(values.map((value) => value.trim()).filter(Boolean)),
   57:   );
   58: }

   64: async function getStudentClassIds(studentId: string): Promise<string[]> {
   65:   const userSnapshot = await getDoc(doc(db, "users", studentId));
   66: 
   67:   if (!userSnapshot.exists()) return [];
   68: 
   69:   const data = userSnapshot.data();
   70: 
   71:   if (!Array.isArray(data.classIds)) return [];
   72: 
   73:   return removeDuplicateIds(
   74:     data.classIds.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === "string"),
   75:   );
   76: }

   78: function splitIntoChunks(values: string[], chunkSize: number): string[][] {
   79:   const chunks: string[][] = [];
   80: 
   81:   for (let index = 0; index < values.length; index += chunkSize) {
   82:     chunks.push(values.slice(index, index + chunkSize));
   83:   }
   84: 
   85:   return chunks;
   86: }

   88: export async function getStudentQuizAssignments(
   89:   studentId: string,
   90: ): Promise<StudentQuizAssignment[]> {
   91:   const cleanedStudentId = studentId.trim();
   92: 
   93:   if (!cleanedStudentId) return [];
   94: 
   95:   const classIds = await getStudentClassIds(cleanedStudentId);
   96: 
   97:   if (classIds.length === 0) return [];
   98: 
   99:   const classIdChunks = splitIntoChunks(classIds, 30);
  100: 
  101:   const assignmentSnapshots = await Promise.all(
  102:     classIdChunks.map((chunk) =>
  103:       getDocs(
  104:         query(
  105:           collection(db, "assignments"),
  106:           where("classId", "in", chunk),
  107:           where("type", "==", "quiz"),
  108:         ),
  109:       ),
  110:     ),
  111:   );
  112: 
  113:   const assignmentDocuments = assignmentSnapshots.flatMap(
  114:     (snapshot) => snapshot.docs,
  115:   );
  116: 
  117:   const uniqueAssignmentDocuments = Array.from(
  118:     new Map(
  119:       assignmentDocuments.map((assignmentDocument) => [
  120:         assignmentDocument.id,
  121:         assignmentDocument,
  122:       ]),
  123:     ).values(),
  124:   );
  125: 
  126:   const loadedAssignments = await Promise.all(
  127:     uniqueAssignmentDocuments.map(async (assignmentDocument) => {
  128:       const assignment = assignmentDocument.data();
  129:       const assignmentId = assignmentDocument.id;
  130:       const resultId = `${assignmentId}_${cleanedStudentId}`;
  131:       const resultReference = doc(db, "assignmentResults", resultId);
  132: 
  133:       const classReference =
  134:         typeof assignment.classId === "string" && assignment.classId.trim()
  135:           ? doc(db, "classes", assignment.classId)
  136:           : null;
  137: 
  138:       const [resultSnapshot, classSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
  139:         getDoc(resultReference),
  140:         classReference ? getDoc(classReference) : Promise.resolve(null),
  141:       ]);
  142: 
  143:       const result = resultSnapshot.exists() ? resultSnapshot.data() : null;
  144:       const classData = classSnapshot?.exists() ? classSnapshot.data() : null;
  145:       const completed = result?.status === "completed";
  146: 
  147:       return {
  148:         id: assignmentId,
  149:         teacherId:
  150:           typeof assignment.teacherId === "string" ? assignment.teacherId : "",
  151:         classId:
  152:           typeof assignment.classId === "string" ? assignment.classId : "",
  153:         title:
  154:           typeof assignment.title === "string" && assignment.title.trim()
  155:             ? assignment.title
  156:             : "Untitled Quiz",
  157:         description:
  158:           typeof assignment.description === "string"
  159:             ? assignment.description
  160:             : "",
  161:         resourceId:
  162:           typeof assignment.resourceId === "string"
  163:             ? assignment.resourceId
  164:             : "",
  165:         type: "quiz" as const,
  166:         quizSource: normaliseQuizSource(assignment.quizSource),
  167:         dueDate: convertDate(assignment.dueDate),
  168:         createdAt: convertDate(assignment.createdAt),
  169:         status:
  170:           typeof assignment.status === "string" ? assignment.status : "active",
  171:         className:
  172:           typeof classData?.name === "string" && classData.name.trim()
  173:             ? classData.name
  174:             : "Assigned class",
  175:         teacherName: "Teacher",
  176:         resultStatus: completed ? "completed" : "not_started",
  177:         score: typeof result?.score === "number" ? result.score : 0,
  178:         totalQuestions:
  179:           typeof result?.totalQuestions === "number"
  180:             ? result.totalQuestions
  181:             : 0,
  182:         percentage:
  183:           typeof result?.percentage === "number" ? result.percentage : 0,
  184:         earnedXP: typeof result?.earnedXP === "number" ? result.earnedXP : 0,
  185:         timeTakenSeconds:
  186:           typeof result?.timeTakenSeconds === "number"
  187:             ? result.timeTakenSeconds
  188:             : 0,
  189:         completedAt: convertDate(result?.completedAt),
  190:       } satisfies StudentQuizAssignment;
  191:     }),
  192:   );
  193: 
  194:   return loadedAssignments
  195:     .filter(
  196:       (assignment) =>
  197:         assignment.status !== "cancelled" &&
  198:         Boolean(assignment.resourceId.trim()),
  199:     )
  200:     .sort((first, second) => {
  201:       const firstDueDate = first.dueDate?.getTime() ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
  202:       const secondDueDate =
  203:         second.dueDate?.getTime() ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
  204: 
  205:       if (firstDueDate !== secondDueDate) return firstDueDate - secondDueDate;
  206: 
  207:       const firstCreatedAt = first.createdAt?.getTime() ?? 0;
  208:       const secondCreatedAt = second.createdAt?.getTime() ?? 0;
  209: 
  210:       return secondCreatedAt - firstCreatedAt;
  211:     });
  212: }

   15: 
   16: function createQuizResultId(quizId: string, uid: string): string {
   17:   const safeQuizId = quizId.trim().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, "-");
   18: 
   19:   return `${safeQuizId}_${uid}`;
   20: }
   21: 
   22: export async function saveQuizResult({
   23:   uid,
   24:   quizId,
   25:   topicId,
   26:   title,
   27:   scorePercent,
   28:   correctCount,
   29:   totalQuestions,
   30:   earnedXP,
   31: }: SaveQuizResultParams): Promise<string> {
   32:   const cleanedUid = uid.trim();
   33:   const cleanedQuizId = quizId.trim();
   34: 
   35:   if (!cleanedUid) {
   36:     throw new Error("A valid student account is required.");
   37:   }
   38: 
   39:   if (!cleanedQuizId) {
   40:     throw new Error("A valid quiz is required.");
   41:   }
   42: 
   43:   const safeScorePercent = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(scorePercent)));
   44: 
   45:   const safeCorrectCount = Math.max(
   46:     0,
   47:     Math.min(Math.round(correctCount), Math.round(totalQuestions)),
   48:   );
   49: 
   50:   const safeTotalQuestions = Math.max(0, Math.round(totalQuestions));
   51: 
   52:   const safeEarnedXP = Math.max(0, Math.round(earnedXP));
   53: 
   54:   const resultId = createQuizResultId(cleanedQuizId, cleanedUid);
   55: 
   56:   const resultReference = doc(db, "users", cleanedUid, "quizResults", resultId);
   57: 
   58:   const userReference = doc(db, "users", cleanedUid);
   59: 
   60:   const batch = writeBatch(db);
   61: 
   62:   /*
   63:    * The uid field is required by the current
   64:    * Firestore security rules.
   65:    *
   66:    * A deterministic result ID prevents repeated
   67:    * page renders from creating duplicate quiz results.
   68:    */
   69:   batch.set(
   70:     resultReference,
   71:     {
   72:       uid: cleanedUid,
   73:       quizId: cleanedQuizId,
   74:       topicId: topicId.trim(),
   75:       title: title.trim() || "Untitled Quiz",
   76:       scorePercent: safeScorePercent,
   77:       correctCount: safeCorrectCount,
   78:       totalQuestions: safeTotalQuestions,
   79:       earnedXP: safeEarnedXP,
   80:       status: "completed",
   81:       completedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   82:       createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
   83:       updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   84:     },
   85:     {
   86:       merge: true,
   87:     },
   88:   );
   89: 
   90:   /*
   91:    * Award XP once for this save operation.
   92:    */
   93:   batch.update(userReference, {
   94:     xp: increment(safeEarnedXP),
   95:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   96:   });
   97: 
   98:   await batch.commit();
   99: 
  100:   return resultId;
  101: }

   14: function emptyEvidenceCounts(): AnalyticsEvidenceSourceCounts {
   15:   return {
   16:     written_exam: 0,
   17:     quiz: 0,

   24: function combineEvidenceCounts(
   25:   rows: AnalyticsEvidenceSourceCounts[],
   26: ): AnalyticsEvidenceSourceCounts {
   27:   return rows.reduce(
   28:     (totals, row) => ({
   29:       written_exam: totals.written_exam + row.written_exam,
   30:       quiz: totals.quiz + row.quiz,
   31:       ai_quiz: totals.ai_quiz + row.ai_quiz,
   32:       programming: totals.programming + row.programming,
   33:       lesson: totals.lesson + row.lesson,
   34:     }),
   35:     emptyEvidenceCounts(),
   36:   );
   37: }

   39: function buildEvidenceWarnings({
   40:   studentsWithEvidence,
   41:   studentCount,
   42:   lowEvidenceCount,
   43:   sourceCounts,
   44: }: {
   45:   studentsWithEvidence: number;
   46:   studentCount: number;
   47:   lowEvidenceCount: number;
   48:   sourceCounts: AnalyticsEvidenceSourceCounts;
   49: }): string[] {
   50:   const warnings: string[] = [];
   51: 
   52:   if (studentCount === 0) {
   53:     warnings.push("This class has no enrolled students.");
   54:     return warnings;
   55:   }
   56: 
   57:   if (studentsWithEvidence === 0) {
   58:     warnings.push(
   59:       "No graded attainment evidence is available yet. Do not draw class-performance conclusions until assessed work has been completed.",
   60:     );
   61:   } else if (studentsWithEvidence < studentCount) {
   62:     warnings.push(
   63:       `${studentCount - studentsWithEvidence} learner${
   64:         studentCount - studentsWithEvidence === 1 ? "" : "s"
   65:       } currently have no graded attainment evidence.`,
   66:     );
   67:   }
   68: 
   69:   if (lowEvidenceCount > 0) {
   70:     warnings.push(
   71:       `${lowEvidenceCount} learner${
   72:         lowEvidenceCount === 1 ? " has" : "s have"
   73:       } low or insufficient evidence confidence.`,
   74:     );
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   const assessedSources =
   78:     sourceCounts.written_exam +
   79:     sourceCounts.quiz +
   80:     sourceCounts.ai_quiz;
   81: 
   82:   if (assessedSources === 0) {
   83:     warnings.push(
   84:       "The class has no written-exam or quiz evidence in the current analytics portfolio.",
   85:     );
   86:   }
   87: 
   88:   return warnings;
   89: }
   90: 
   91: function priorityStudents(
   92:   students: Array<{
   93:     studentId: string;
   94:     studentName: string;
   95:     workingGrade: ReportPriorityStudent["workingGrade"];
   96:     targetGrade: ReportPriorityStudent["targetGrade"];
   97:     gradeGap: number | null;
   98:     completionRate: number;
   99:     confidence: unknown;
  100:     interventionPriority: ReportPriorityStudent["priority"];
  101:     analytics: {
  102:       topics: Array<{
  103:         topic: string;
  104:         weightedPercentage: number;
  105:       }>;
  106:     };
  107:   }>,
  108: ): ReportPriorityStudent[] {
  109:   const rank = {
  110:     high: 0,
  111:     medium: 1,
  112:     monitor: 2,
  113:     none: 3,
  114:   };
  115: 
  116:   return students
  117:     .map((student) => {
  118:       const weakest = [...student.analytics.topics].sort(
  119:         (first, second) =>
  120:           first.weightedPercentage - second.weightedPercentage,
  121:       )[0];
  122: 
  123:       return {
  124:         studentId: student.studentId,
  125:         studentName: student.studentName,
  126:         workingGrade: student.workingGrade,
  127:         targetGrade: student.targetGrade,
  128:         gradeGap: student.gradeGap,
  129:         completionRate: student.completionRate,
  130:         confidence: String(student.confidence),
  131:         priority: student.interventionPriority,
  132:         weakestTopic: weakest?.topic || "No topic evidence",
  133:         weakestTopicPercentage: weakest?.weightedPercentage ?? null,
  134:       };
  135:     })
  136:     .filter((student) => student.priority !== "none")
  137:     .sort((first, second) => {
  138:       const difference = rank[first.priority] - rank[second.priority];
  139:       if (difference !== 0) return difference;
  140: 
  141:       return (
  142:         (first.weakestTopicPercentage ?? 101) -
  143:         (second.weakestTopicPercentage ?? 101)
  144:       );
  145:     })
  146:     .slice(0, 8);
  147: }

  194: export async function buildClassProgressReport({
  195:   teacherId,
  196:   classId,
  197: }: {
  198:   teacherId: string;
  199:   classId: string;
  200: }): Promise<ClassProgressReport | null> {
  201:   const portfolio = await getTeacherAnalyticsPortfolio(teacherId);
  202:   const classAnalytics = portfolio.classes.find(
  203:     (item) => item.classId === classId,
  204:   );
  205: 
  206:   if (!classAnalytics) return null;
  207: 
  208:   const sortedTopics = [...classAnalytics.topicAnalytics].sort(
  209:     (first, second) =>
  210:       second.weightedPercentage - first.weightedPercentage,
  211:   );
  212: 
  213:   const evidenceSourceCounts = combineEvidenceCounts(
  214:     classAnalytics.students.map(
  215:       (student) => student.analytics.evidenceSourceCounts,
  216:     ),
  217:   );
  218: 
  219:   const teacherExamAssignments = await getTeacherExamAssignments(
  220:     teacherId,
  221:   );
  222: 
  223:   const classExamAssignments = teacherExamAssignments.filter(
  224:     (assignment) =>
  225:       assignment.classId === classId &&
  226:       assignment.status !== "cancelled",
  227:   );
  228: 
  229:   const examSummaries = await Promise.all(
  230:     classExamAssignments.map(async (assignment) => {
  231:       const submissions = await getAssignmentSubmissions(
  232:         assignment.id,
  233:         teacherId,
  234:       );
  235: 
  236:       return examSummary(
  237:         assignment.id,
  238:         assignment.title,
  239:         buildExamClassIntelligence(
  240:           assignment,
  241:           submissions,
  242:         ),
  243:       );
  244:     }),
  245:   );
  246: 
  247:   const evidenceWarnings = buildEvidenceWarnings({
  248:     studentsWithEvidence: classAnalytics.studentsWithEvidence,
  249:     studentCount: classAnalytics.studentCount,
  250:     lowEvidenceCount: classAnalytics.lowEvidenceCount,
  251:     sourceCounts: evidenceSourceCounts,
  252:   });
  253: 
  254:   const teacherInterpretation: string[] = [];
  255:   const recommendedActions: string[] = [];
  256: 
  257:   if (classAnalytics.averageWeightedPercentage !== null) {
  258:     teacherInterpretation.push(
  259:       `Current weighted class attainment is ${classAnalytics.averageWeightedPercentage}%.`,
  260:     );
  261:   }
  262: 
  263:   if (classAnalytics.onOrAboveTargetPercentage < 60) {
  264:     teacherInterpretation.push(
  265:       `${classAnalytics.onOrAboveTargetPercentage}% of learners with targets are currently working on or above target.`,
  266:     );
  267:     recommendedActions.push(
  268:       "Review below-target learners and separate curriculum gaps from low-evidence or completion issues.",
  269:     );
  270:   }
  271: 
  272:   if (classAnalytics.decliningCount > 0) {
  273:     teacherInterpretation.push(
  274:       `${classAnalytics.decliningCount} learner${
  275:         classAnalytics.decliningCount === 1 ? " has" : "s have"
  276:       } a declining recent trend.`,
  277:     );
  278:     recommendedActions.push(
  279:       "Review declining learners before the next assessment cycle and identify whether the decline is topic-specific.",
  280:     );
  281:   }
  282: 
  283:   if (classAnalytics.lowEvidenceCount > 0) {
  284:     recommendedActions.push(
  285:       "Collect additional graded evidence for learners with low evidence confidence before making high-stakes progress judgements.",
  286:     );
  287:   }
  288: 
  289:   if (sortedTopics.length > 0) {
  290:     const weakest = sortedTopics[sortedTopics.length - 1];
  291: 
  292:     teacherInterpretation.push(
  293:       `${weakest.topic} is the current lowest class curriculum area at ${weakest.weightedPercentage}% mastery.`,
  294:     );
  295: 
  296:     if (weakest.weightedPercentage < 50) {
  297:       recommendedActions.push(
  298:         `Prioritise reteaching or targeted reassessment in ${weakest.topic}.`,
  299:       );
  300:     }
  301:   }
  302: 
  303:   const usableExam = examSummaries
  304:     .filter((exam) => exam.markedCount > 0)
  305:     .sort(
  306:       (first, second) =>
  307:         (first.classAverage ?? 101) -
  308:         (second.classAverage ?? 101),
  309:     )[0];
  310: 
  311:   if (usableExam?.weakestTopic) {
  312:     teacherInterpretation.push(
  313:       `Written-exam QLA currently identifies ${usableExam.weakestTopic} as a priority area in ${usableExam.title}.`,
  314:     );
  315:   }
  316: 
  317:   return {
  318:     classId: classAnalytics.classId,
  319:     className: classAnalytics.className,
  320:     generatedAt: new Date(),
  321:     studentCount: classAnalytics.studentCount,
  322:     studentsWithEvidence: classAnalytics.studentsWithEvidence,
  323: 
  324:     averageWorkingGrade: classAnalytics.averageWorkingGrade,
  325:     averageTargetGrade: classAnalytics.averageTargetGrade,
  326:     averageWeightedPercentage: classAnalytics.averageWeightedPercentage,
  327:     averageCompletionRate: classAnalytics.averageCompletionRate,
  328:     onOrAboveTargetPercentage: classAnalytics.onOrAboveTargetPercentage,
  329: 
  330:     highPriorityCount: classAnalytics.highPriorityCount,
  331:     decliningCount: classAnalytics.decliningCount,
  332:     lowEvidenceCount: classAnalytics.lowEvidenceCount,
  333:     targetNotSetCount: classAnalytics.targetNotSetCount,
  334: 
  335:     gradeDistribution: classAnalytics.gradeDistribution,
  336:     strongestTopics: sortedTopics.slice(0, 4).map((topic) => ({
  337:       topic: topic.topic,
  338:       mastery: topic.weightedPercentage,
  339:     })),
  340:     priorityTopics: [...sortedTopics]
  341:       .reverse()
  342:       .slice(0, 4)
  343:       .map((topic) => ({
  344:         topic: topic.topic,
  345:         mastery: topic.weightedPercentage,
  346:       })),
  347:     priorityStudents: priorityStudents(classAnalytics.students),
  348: 
  349:     evidenceSourceCounts,
  350:     evidenceWarnings,
  351: 
  352:     writtenExamCount: classExamAssignments.length,
  353:     examSummaries,
  354: 
  355:     teacherInterpretation,
  356:     recommendedActions,
  357:   };
  358: }

  251:           `Attempted ${question.attemptedStudents}/${question.markedStudents}`,
  252:           `Omitted ${question.omittedStudents} (${question.omissionPercentage ?? "â€”"}%)`,
  253:           `Zero marks ${question.zeroMarkStudents}`,
  254:           `Full marks ${question.fullMarkStudents}`,
  255:           `Marks lost ${question.marksLost}`,
  256:           `Discrimination ${question.discriminationIndex ?? "insufficient"} (${question.discriminationLabel})`,
  257:           `Interpretation ${question.difficulty}`,
  258:           `Question: ${question.questionText}`,
  259:         ]
  260:           .filter(Boolean)
  261:           .join("; "),
  262:       ]);
  263:     },
  264:   );
  265: 
  266:   return [
  267:     headers.map(csvCell).join(","),
  268:     ...rows.map((row) =>
  269:       row.map(csvCell).join(","),
  270:     ),
  271:   ].join("\r\n");
  272: }
  273: 
  274: export function downloadExamQuestionLevelAnalysisCsv({
  275:   assignment,
  276:   intelligence,
  277: }: {
  278:   assignment: ExamAssignment;
  279:   intelligence: ExamClassIntelligence;
  280: }): void {
  281:   if (typeof window === "undefined") {
  282:     return;
  283:   }
  284: 
  285:   const csv =
  286:     buildExamQuestionLevelAnalysisCsv({
  287:       assignment,
  288:       intelligence,
  289:     });
  290: 
  291:   const blob = new Blob(
  292:     ["\uFEFF", csv],
  293:     {
  294:       type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;",
  295:     },
  296:   );
  297: 
  298:   const url =
  299:     URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  300: 
  301:   const link =
  302:     document.createElement("a");
  303: 
  304:   link.href = url;
  305:   link.download =
  306:     `${safeFileName(assignment.className)}-` +
  307:     `${safeFileName(assignment.title)}-final-qla.csv`;
  308: 
  309:   document.body.appendChild(link);
  310:   link.click();
  311:   link.remove();
  312: 
  313:   window.setTimeout(() => {
  314:     URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  315:   }, 0);
  316: }

    1: import type {
    2:   TeacherInterventionPlan,

    4: 
    5: function csvCell(value: unknown): string {
    6:   const text = String(value ?? "");
    7: 
    8:   if (
    9:     text.includes(",") ||
   10:     text.includes('"') ||
   11:     text.includes("\n")
   12:   ) {
   13:     return `"${text.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
   14:   }
   15: 
   16:   return text;
   17: }
   18: 
   19: export function buildInterventionCohortCsv(
   20:   plan: TeacherInterventionPlan,
   21: ): string {
   22:   const rows: string[][] = [
   23:     [
   24:       "Topic",
   25:       "Priority",
   26:       "Strategy",
   27:       "Student",
   28:       "Student score",
   29:       "Group average",
   30:       "Lowest score",
   31:       "Rationale",
   32:       "Evidence caution",
   33:       "Recommended sequence",
   34:     ],
   35:   ];
   36: 
   37:   plan.groups.forEach((group) => {
   38:     const sequence = group.steps
   39:       .map((step) => `${step.order}. ${step.label}: ${step.description}`)
   40:       .join(" | ");
   41: 
   42:     group.students.forEach((student) => {
   43:       rows.push([
   44:         group.topic,
   45:         group.priority,
   46:         group.strategy,
   47:         student.name,
   48:         `${student.averageScore}%`,
   49:         `${group.averageScore}%`,
   50:         `${group.lowestScore}%`,
   51:         group.rationale,
   52:         group.evidenceCaution,
   53:         sequence,
   54:       ]);
   55:     });
   56:   });
   57: 
   58:   return rows
   59:     .map((row) => row.map(csvCell).join(","))
   60:     .join("\n");
   61: }
   62: 
   63: export function interventionCohortFilename(): string {
   64:   const date = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
   65:   return `cs-master-intervention-cohorts-${date}.csv`;
   66: }

FILE: services\reporting\studentProgressReportService.ts

    1: import { getTeacherStudentAnalytics } from "@/services/analytics/teacherAnalyticsService";
    2: import { getTeacherStudentInterventionHistory } from "@/services/teacherStudentInterventionHistoryService";
    3: import type {
    4:   AnalyticsEvidenceSourceCounts,
    5: } from "@/types/analytics";
    6: import type { StudentProgressReport } from "@/types/reporting";
    7: 
    8: function evidenceWarnings({
    9:   confidence,
   10:   evidenceCounts,
   11:   completionRate,
   12: }: {
   13:   confidence: string;
   14:   evidenceCounts: AnalyticsEvidenceSourceCounts;
   15:   completionRate: number;
   16: }): string[] {
   17:   const warnings: string[] = [];
   18: 
   19:   if (
   20:     confidence === "insufficient" ||
   21:     confidence === "low"
   22:   ) {
   23:     warnings.push(
   24:       "Evidence confidence is currently low. Treat the working grade and topic priorities cautiously until more graded evidence is available.",
   25:     );
   26:   }
   27: 
   28:   if (
   29:     evidenceCounts.written_exam === 0 &&
   30:     evidenceCounts.quiz === 0 &&
   31:     evidenceCounts.ai_quiz === 0
   32:   ) {
   33:     warnings.push(
   34:       "No written-exam or quiz evidence is currently contributing to this report.",
   35:     );
   36:   }
   37: 
   38:   if (completionRate < 70) {
   39:     warnings.push(
   40:       "Low assignment completion may make the current attainment picture unrepresentative.",
   41:     );
   42:   }
   43: 
   44:   return warnings;
   45: }
   46: 
   47: export async function buildStudentProgressReport({
   48:   teacherId,
   49:   studentId,
   50: }: {
   51:   teacherId: string;
   52:   studentId: string;
   53: }): Promise<StudentProgressReport | null> {
   54:   const analytics = await getTeacherStudentAnalytics({
   55:     teacherId,
   56:     studentId,
   57:   });
   58: 
   59:   if (!analytics) {
   60:     return null;
   61:   }
   62: 
   63:   const interventions =
   64:     await getTeacherStudentInterventionHistory({
   65:       teacherId,
   66:       studentId,
   67:     });
   68: 
   69:   const sortedTopics = [...analytics.analytics.topics].sort(
   70:     (first, second) =>
   71:       second.weightedPercentage - first.weightedPercentage,
   72:   );
   73: 
   74:   const strengths = sortedTopics
   75:     .filter((topic) => topic.evidenceCount > 0)
   76:     .slice(0, 3)
   77:     .map((topic) => ({
   78:       topic: topic.topic,
   79:       mastery: topic.weightedPercentage,
   80:     }));
   81: 
   82:   const priorities = [...sortedTopics]
   83:     .filter((topic) => topic.evidenceCount > 0)
   84:     .reverse()
   85:     .slice(0, 3)
   86:     .map((topic) => ({
   87:       topic: topic.topic,
   88:       mastery: topic.weightedPercentage,
   89:     }));
   90: 
   91:   const recentEvidence = [...analytics.analytics.evidence]
   92:     .filter(
   93:       (item) =>
   94:         item.graded === true &&
   95:         item.percentage !== null,
   96:     )
   97:     .sort(
   98:       (first, second) =>
   99:         (second.completedAt?.getTime() ?? 0) -
  100:         (first.completedAt?.getTime() ?? 0),
  101:     )
  102:     .slice(0, 8)
  103:     .map((item) => ({
  104:       title: item.title,
  105:       percentage: item.percentage,
  106:       completedAt: item.completedAt,
  107:     }));
  108: 
  109:   const evidenceSourceCounts =
  110:     analytics.analytics.evidenceSourceCounts;
  111: 
  112:   const reportEvidenceWarnings = evidenceWarnings({
  113:     confidence: String(analytics.confidence),
  114:     evidenceCounts: evidenceSourceCounts,
  115:     completionRate: analytics.completionRate,
  116:   });
  117: 
  118:   const teacherCommentary: string[] = [];
  119:   const studentNextSteps: string[] = [];
  120: 
  121:   if (analytics.targetGrade) {
  122:     teacherCommentary.push(
  123:       analytics.gradeGap !== null &&
  124:         analytics.gradeGap < 0
  125:         ? `${analytics.studentName} is currently working below the target grade and needs focused support to close the gap.`
  126:         : `${analytics.studentName} is currently working at or above the target grade.`,
  127:     );
  128:   } else {
  129:     teacherCommentary.push(
  130:       "No target grade is currently set, so target-gap interpretation is unavailable.",
  131:     );
  132:   }
  133: 
  134:   if (analytics.trend === "declining") {
  135:     teacherCommentary.push(
  136:       "Recent performance is declining and should be reviewed alongside the learner's weakest assessed topics.",
  137:     );
  138:   }
  139: 
  140:   if (priorities[0]) {
  141:     studentNextSteps.push(
  142:       `Prioritise ${priorities[0].topic}, currently at ${priorities[0].mastery}% mastery.`,
  143:     );
  144:   }
  145: 
  146:   if (analytics.marksToNextGrade !== null) {
  147:     studentNextSteps.push(
  148:       `Aim to gain approximately ${analytics.marksToNextGrade} more mark${
  149:         analytics.marksToNextGrade === 1 ? "" : "s"
  150:       } to reach the next indicative grade boundary.`,
  151:     );
  152:   }
  153: 
  154:   if (analytics.completionRate < 80) {
  155:     studentNextSteps.push(
  156:       "Improve assignment completion so that progress decisions are based on stronger evidence.",
  157:     );
  158:   }
  159: 
  160:   if (interventions.some((item) => item.status === "active")) {
  161:     teacherCommentary.push(
  162:       "This learner currently has an active intervention; review subsequent graded evidence before deciding whether to close or escalate support.",
  163:     );
  164:   }
  165: 
  166:   return {
  167:     studentId: analytics.studentId,
  168:     studentName: analytics.studentName,
  169:     studentEmail: analytics.studentEmail,
  170:     classId: analytics.classId,
  171:     className: analytics.className,
  172:     generatedAt: new Date(),
  173: 
  174:     workingGrade: analytics.workingGrade,
  175:     targetGrade: analytics.targetGrade,
  176:     gradeGap: analytics.gradeGap,
  177:     workingPercentage: analytics.workingPercentage,
  178:     nextGrade: analytics.nextGrade,
  179:     marksToNextGrade: analytics.marksToNextGrade,
  180: 
  181:     trend: analytics.trend,
  182:     completionRate: analytics.completionRate,
  183:     confidence: analytics.confidence,
  184: 
  185:     strengths,
  186:     priorities,
  187:     recentEvidence,
  188: 
  189:     evidenceSourceCounts,
  190:     evidenceWarnings: reportEvidenceWarnings,
  191: 
  192:     interventionSummary: {
  193:       active: interventions.filter(
  194:         (item) => item.status === "active",
  195:       ).length,
  196:       completed: interventions.filter(
  197:         (item) => item.status === "completed",
  198:       ).length,
  199:       cancelled: interventions.filter(
  200:         (item) => item.status === "cancelled",
  201:       ).length,
  202:     },
  203: 
  204:     teacherCommentary,
  205:     studentNextSteps,
  206:   };
  207: }

  166: function validateAssignmentInput(input: CreateResourceAssignmentInput): void {
  167:   if (!input.resourceId.trim()) {
  168:     throw new Error("A valid teaching resource is required.");
  169:   }
  170: 
  171:   if (!input.teacherId.trim()) {
  172:     throw new Error("A valid teacher account is required.");
  173:   }
  174: 
  175:   if (!input.classId.trim()) {
  176:     throw new Error("Select a class before assigning the resource.");
  177:   }
  178: 
  179:   if (!input.className.trim()) {
  180:     throw new Error("The selected class does not have a valid name.");
  181:   }
  182: 
  183:   if (
  184:     !(input.dueDate instanceof Date) ||
  185:     Number.isNaN(input.dueDate.getTime())
  186:   ) {
  187:     throw new Error("Select a valid due date.");
  188:   }
  189: 
  190:   const today = new Date();
  191: 
  192:   today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  193: 
  194:   if (input.dueDate < today) {
  195:     throw new Error("The due date cannot be in the past.");
  196:   }
  197: }

  199: export async function createResourceAssignment(

  357: export async function startStudentAssignment(
  358:   assignmentId: string,
  359:   studentId: string,
  360: ): Promise<void> {
  361:   if (!assignmentId.trim() || !studentId.trim()) {
  362:     throw new Error("A valid assignment and student are required.");
  363:   }
  364: 
  365:   const progressId = createProgressDocumentId(assignmentId, studentId);

  370: 
  371:   if (
  372:     existingProgress.exists() &&
  373:     existingProgress.data().status === "completed"
  374:   ) {
  375:     return;
  376:   }
  377: 
  378:   await setDoc(
  379:     progressReference,
  380:     {
  381:       assignmentId,
  382:       studentId,
  383: 
  384:       status: "in_progress",
  385: 
  386:       startedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  387:       completedAt: null,
  388:       updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  389:     },
  390:     {
  391:       merge: true,
  392:     },
  393:   );
  394: }

  396: export async function completeStudentAssignment(
  397:   assignmentId: string,
  398:   studentId: string,
  399: ): Promise<void> {
  400:   if (!assignmentId.trim() || !studentId.trim()) {
  401:     throw new Error("A valid assignment and student are required.");
  402:   }
  403: 
  404:   const assignmentReference = doc(db, "classAssignments", assignmentId);
  405: 
  406:   const progressId = createProgressDocumentId(assignmentId, studentId);
  407: 
  408:   const progressReference = doc(db, "assignmentProgress", progressId);
  409: 
  410:   await runTransaction(db, async (transaction) => {
  411:     const assignmentSnapshot = await transaction.get(assignmentReference);
  412: 
  413:     if (!assignmentSnapshot.exists()) {
  414:       throw new Error("This assignment could not be found.");
  415:     }
  416: 
  417:     const assignmentData =
  418:       assignmentSnapshot.data() as FirestoreResourceAssignment;
  419: 
  420:     if (!assignmentData.studentIds?.includes(studentId)) {
  421:       throw new Error("You are not enrolled in this assignment.");
  422:     }
  423: 
  424:     const progressSnapshot = await transaction.get(progressReference);
  425: 
  426:     const alreadyCompleted =
  427:       progressSnapshot.exists() &&
  428:       progressSnapshot.data().status === "completed";
  429: 
  430:     if (alreadyCompleted) {
  431:       return;
  432:     }
  433: 
  434:     transaction.set(
  435:       progressReference,
  436:       {
  437:         assignmentId,
  438:         studentId,
  439: 
  440:         status: "completed",
  441: 
  442:         startedAt: progressSnapshot.exists()
  443:           ? (progressSnapshot.data().startedAt ?? serverTimestamp())
  444:           : serverTimestamp(),
  445: 
  446:         completedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  447:         updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  448:       },
  449:       {
  450:         merge: true,
  451:       },
  452:     );
  453: 
  454:     const currentCompletedCount = assignmentData.completedCount ?? 0;
  455: 
  456:     const maximumCompletedCount =
  457:       assignmentData.studentCount ?? assignmentData.studentIds.length;
  458: 
  459:     transaction.update(assignmentReference, {
  460:       completedCount: Math.min(
  461:         currentCompletedCount + 1,
  462:         maximumCompletedCount,
  463:       ),
  464: 
  465:       updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  466:     });
  467:   });
  468: }

   15: function normaliseCode(value: string): string {
   16:   return value
   17:     .trim()
   18:     .toUpperCase()
   19:     .replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, "");
   20: }
   21: 
   22: function generateCode(): string {
   23:   const alphabet =
   24:     "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";
   25: 
   26:   let value = "";
   27: 
   28:   for (
   29:     let index = 0;
   30:     index < 8;
   31:     index += 1
   32:   ) {
   33:     value +=
   34:       alphabet[
   35:         Math.floor(
   36:           Math.random() *
   37:             alphabet.length,
   38:         )
   39:       ];
   40:   }
   41: 
   42:   return value;
   43: }
   44: 
   45: function timestampToDate(
   46:   value: unknown,
   47: ): Date | null {
   48:   return value instanceof Timestamp
   49:     ? value.toDate()
   50:     : null;
   51: }

   53: export async function createSchoolInvite({
   54:   schoolId,
   55:   createdBy,
   56:   role,
   57: }: {
   58:   schoolId: string;
   59:   createdBy: string;
   60:   role: SchoolInviteRole;
   61: }): Promise<string> {
   62:   const cleanedSchoolId =
   63:     schoolId.trim();
   64: 
   65:   const cleanedCreatedBy =
   66:     createdBy.trim();
   67: 
   68:   if (
   69:     !cleanedSchoolId ||
   70:     !cleanedCreatedBy
   71:   ) {
   72:     throw new Error(
   73:       "A valid school and teacher account are required.",
   74:     );
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   /*
   78:    * Do NOT pre-read the randomly generated invite document.
   79:    * Firestore rules correctly deny arbitrary reads of non-existent
   80:    * invite documents, which causes the permissions error before
   81:    * creation. The random 8-character code space is extremely large.
   82:    */
   83:   const code =
   84:     generateCode();
   85: 
   86:   const expiresAt =
   87:     new Date();
   88: 
   89:   expiresAt.setDate(
   90:     expiresAt.getDate() + 14,
   91:   );
   92: 
   93:   const inviteRef =
   94:     doc(
   95:       db,
   96:       "schoolInvites",
   97:       code,
   98:     );
   99: 
  100:   const batch =
  101:     writeBatch(db);
  102: 
  103:   batch.set(
  104:     inviteRef,
  105:     {
  106:       code,
  107:       schoolId:
  108:         cleanedSchoolId,
  109:       role,
  110:       createdBy:
  111:         cleanedCreatedBy,
  112:       status:
  113:         "active",
  114:       expiresAt:
  115:         Timestamp.fromDate(
  116:           expiresAt,
  117:         ),
  118:       usedBy:
  119:         "",
  120:       createdAt:
  121:         serverTimestamp(),
  122:       updatedAt:
  123:         serverTimestamp(),
  124:     },
  125:   );
  126: 
  127:   await batch.commit();
  128: 
  129:   return code;
  130: }

  132: export async function acceptSchoolInvite({
  133:   code,
  134:   userId,
  135: }: {
  136:   code: string;

  172:     throw new Error(

  174:     );
  175:   }
  176: 
  177:   const invite =
  178:     inviteSnapshot.data();
  179: 
  180:   if (
  181:     invite.status !==
  182:     "active"
  183:   ) {
  184:     throw new Error(
  185:       "This school join code is no longer active.",
  186:     );
  187:   }
  188:

  190:     timestampToDate(
  191:       invite.expiresAt,
  192:     );
  193: 
  194:   if (
  195:     expiresAt &&
  196:     expiresAt.getTime() <
  197:       Date.now()
  198:   ) {
  199:     throw new Error(
  200:       "This school join code has expired.",
  201:     );
  202:   }
  203: 
  204:   const schoolId =
  205:     typeof invite.schoolId ===
  206:     "string"
  207:       ? invite.schoolId.trim()
  208:       : "";
  209: 
  210:   const role:
  211:     SchoolInviteRole =
  212:     invite.role ===
  213:     "teacher"
  214:       ? "teacher"
  215:       : "student";
  216: 
  217:   if (!schoolId) {
  218:     throw new Error(
  219:       "This school invitation is invalid.",
  220:     );
  221:   }
  222: 
  223:   const userRef =
  224:     doc(
  225:       db,
  226:       "users",
  227:       cleanedUserId,
  228:     );
  229: 
  230:   const userSnapshot =
  231:     await getDoc(
  232:       userRef,
  233:     );
  234: 
  235:   if (
  236:     !userSnapshot.exists()
  237:   ) {
  238:     throw new Error(
  239:       "Your CS Master profile could not be found.",
  240:     );
  241:   }
  242: 
  243:   const userData =
  244:     userSnapshot.data();
  245: 
  246:   const existingSchoolId =
  247:     typeof userData.schoolId ===
  248:     "string"
  249:       ? userData.schoolId.trim()
  250:       : "";
  251: 
  252:   if (
  253:     existingSchoolId &&
  254:     existingSchoolId !==

  258:       "Your account already belongs to another school. Use the school transfer process instead.",
  259:     );
  260:   }
  261:

  263:     role === "teacher" &&

  265:       "teacher" &&

  275:     doc(

  278:       schoolId,
  279:       "members",
  280:       cleanedUserId,
  281:     );
  282:

  284:     writeBatch(db);
  285: 
  286:   batch.set(
  287:     membershipRef,
  288:     {
  289:       schoolId,
  290:       userId:
  291:         cleanedUserId,
  292:       role,
  293:       status:
  294:         "active",
  295:       inviteId:
  296:         cleanedCode,
  297:       joinedAt:
  298:         serverTimestamp(),
  299:       leftAt:
  300:         null,

   30:   value: unknown,

   37: function safeStringArray(
   38:   value: unknown,
   39: ): string[] {
   40:   return Array.isArray(value)
   41:     ? value.filter(
   42:         (item): item is string =>
   43:           typeof item === "string",
   44:       )
   45:     : [];
   46: }
   47: 
   48: function timestampToDate(
   49:   value: unknown,
   50: ): Date | null {
   51:   return value instanceof Timestamp
   52:     ? value.toDate()
   53:     : null;
   54: }
   55: 
   56: /*
   57:  * T1H tenant-safe directory rule:
   58:  *
   59:  * A school membership document is the authoritative proof that a user belongs
   60:  * to the requested school. A direct users/{uid} read is useful enrichment, but
   61:  * it must not be required for the directory to load because Firestore may
   62:  * correctly restrict cross-profile reads.
   63:  *
   64:  * If the user document cannot be read, the service falls back to identity and
   65:  * course fields stored on the school membership document.
   66:  */
   67: export async function getSchoolMembers(
   68:   schoolId: string,
   69: ): Promise<SchoolMemberRecord[]> {
   70:   const cleanedSchoolId =
   71:     schoolId.trim();
   72: 
   73:   if (!cleanedSchoolId) {
   74:     return [];
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   const membershipSnapshot =
   78:     await getDocs(
   79:       collection(
   80:         db,
   81:         "schools",
   82:         cleanedSchoolId,
   83:         "members",
   84:       ),
   85:     );
   86: 
   87:   const members =
   88:     await Promise.all(
   89:       membershipSnapshot.docs.map(
   90:         async (
   91:           membershipDocument,
   92:         ) => {
   93:           const membership =
   94:             membershipDocument.data();
   95: 
   96:           const userSnapshot =
   97:             await getDoc(
   98:               doc(
   99:                 db,
  100:                 "users",
  101:                 membershipDocument.id,
  102:               ),
  103:             ).catch(() => null);
  104: 
  105:           const user =
  106:             userSnapshot?.exists()
  107:               ? userSnapshot.data()
  108:               : {};
  109: 
  110:           return {
  111:             uid:
  112:               membershipDocument.id,
  113: 
  114:             name:
  115:               safeString(
  116:                 user.name,
  117:               ) ||
  118:               safeString(
  119:                 membership.name,
  120:               ) ||
  121:               safeString(
  122:                 membership.displayName,
  123:               ) ||
  124:               "Unnamed member",
  125: 
  126:             email:
  127:               (
  128:                 safeString(
  129:                   user.email,
  130:                 ) ||
  131:                 safeString(
  132:                   membership.email,
  133:                 )
  134:               ).toLowerCase(),
  135: 
  136:             role:
  137:               safeString(
  138:                 user.role,
  139:               ) ||
  140:               safeString(
  141:                 membership.userRole,
  142:               ),
  143: 
  144:             membershipRole:
  145:               safeString(
  146:                 membership.role,
  147:               ),
  148: 
  149:             status:
  150:               safeString(
  151:                 membership.status,
  152:               ) ||
  153:               "active",
  154: 
  155:             qualification:
  156:               safeString(
  157:                 user.qualification,
  158:               ) ||
  159:               safeString(
  160:                 membership.qualification,
  161:               ),
  162: 
  163:             examBoard:
  164:               safeString(
  165:                 user.examBoard,
  166:               ) ||
  167:               safeString(
  168:                 membership.examBoard,
  169:               ),
  170: 
  171:             currentCourse:
  172:               safeString(
  173:                 user.currentCourse,
  174:               ) ||
  175:               safeString(
  176:                 membership.currentCourse,
  177:               ),
  178: 
  179:             classIds:
  180:               safeStringArray(
  181:                 user.classIds,
  182:               ).length > 0
  183:                 ? safeStringArray(
  184:                     user.classIds,
  185:                   )
  186:                 : safeStringArray(
  187:                     membership.classIds,
  188:                   ),
  189: 
  190:             joinedAt:
  191:               timestampToDate(
  192:                 membership.joinedAt,
  193:               ),
  194:           };
  195:         },
  196:       ),
  197:     );
  198: 
  199:   return members.sort(
  200:     (
  201:       first,
  202:       second,
  203:     ) =>
  204:       first.name.localeCompare(
  205:         second.name,
  206:         "en-GB",
  207:         {
  208:           sensitivity: "base",
  209:         },
  210:       ),
  211:   );
  212: }

   14: export async function assignUserToSchool({
   15:   schoolId,
   16:   userId,
   17:   role,
   18: }: {
   19:   schoolId: string;
   20:   userId: string;
   21:   role: SchoolMemberRole;
   22: }): Promise<void> {
   23:   const cleanedSchoolId = schoolId.trim();
   24:   const cleanedUserId = userId.trim();
   25: 
   26:   if (!cleanedSchoolId || !cleanedUserId) {
   27:     throw new Error("A valid school and user are required.");
   28:   }
   29: 
   30:   const schoolRef = doc(db, "schools", cleanedSchoolId);
   31:   const userRef = doc(db, "users", cleanedUserId);
   32: 
   33:   const [schoolSnapshot, userSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
   34:     getDoc(schoolRef),
   35:     getDoc(userRef),
   36:   ]);
   37: 
   38:   if (!schoolSnapshot.exists()) {
   39:     throw new Error("The selected school could not be found.");
   40:   }
   41:

   43:     throw new Error("The selected user account could not be found.");
   44:   }
   45: 
   46:   const memberRef = doc(
   47:     db,
   48:     "schools",
   49:     cleanedSchoolId,
   50:     "members",
   51:     cleanedUserId,
   52:   );

   55:

   57:     memberRef,

   60:       userId: cleanedUserId,
   61:       role,
   62:       status: "active",
   63:       joinedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   64:       leftAt: null,
   65:       updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   66:     },
   67:     { merge: true },
   68:   );

   71:     schoolId: cleanedSchoolId,

   80: export async function removeUserFromSchool({
   81:   schoolId,

   88:   const cleanedUserId = userId.trim();

   18: type FirestoreSchool = {
   19:   name?: unknown;
   20:   slug?: unknown;
   21:   status?: unknown;
   22:   ownerUserId?: unknown;
   23:   createdAt?: Timestamp;
   24:   updatedAt?: Timestamp;

   27: function safeString(
   28:   value: unknown,
   29: ): string {
   30:   return typeof value === "string"
   31:     ? value.trim()
   32:     : "";
   33: }
   34: 
   35: function safeStatus(
   36:   value: unknown,
   37: ): SchoolStatus {
   38:   return value === "suspended" ||
   39:     value === "archived"
   40:     ? value
   41:     : "active";
   42: }
   43: 
   44: function slugify(
   45:   value: string,
   46: ): string {
   47:   return value
   48:     .toLowerCase()
   49:     .trim()
   50:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
   51:     .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")
   52:     .slice(0, 60);
   53: }
   54: 
   55: function timestampToDate(
   56:   value: unknown,
   57: ): Date | null {
   58:   return value instanceof Timestamp
   59:     ? value.toDate()
   60:     : null;
   61: }
   62: 
   63: function convertSchool(
   64:   id: string,
   65:   data: FirestoreSchool,
   66: ): School {
   67:   return {
   68:     id,
   69:     name:
   70:       safeString(data.name) ||
   71:       "Unnamed school",
   72:     slug:
   73:       safeString(data.slug),
   74:     status:
   75:       safeStatus(data.status),
   76:     ownerUserId:
   77:       safeString(
   78:         data.ownerUserId,
   79:       ),
   80:     createdAt:
   81:       timestampToDate(
   82:         data.createdAt,
   83:       ),
   84:     updatedAt:
   85:       timestampToDate(
   86:         data.updatedAt,
   87:       ),
   88:   };
   89: }

   91: export async function getSchoolById(
   92:   schoolId: string,
   93: ): Promise<School | null> {
   94:   const cleanedSchoolId =
   95:     schoolId.trim();
   96: 
   97:   if (!cleanedSchoolId) {
   98:     return null;
   99:   }
  100: 
  101:   const snapshot =
  102:     await getDoc(
  103:       doc(
  104:         db,
  105:         "schools",
  106:         cleanedSchoolId,
  107:       ),
  108:     );
  109: 
  110:   if (!snapshot.exists()) {
  111:     return null;
  112:   }
  113: 
  114:   return convertSchool(
  115:     snapshot.id,
  116:     snapshot.data(),
  117:   );
  118: }

  120: export async function createSchool({
  121:   name,
  122:   ownerUserId,
  123: }: CreateSchoolInput): Promise<string> {
  124:   const cleanedName =
  125:     name
  126:       .trim()
  127:       .replace(/\s+/g, " ");
  128: 
  129:   const cleanedOwnerUserId =
  130:     ownerUserId.trim();
  131: 
  132:   if (!cleanedName) {
  133:     throw new Error(
  134:       "Enter a valid school name.",
  135:     );
  136:   }
  137: 
  138:   if (!cleanedOwnerUserId) {
  139:     throw new Error(
  140:       "A valid school owner account is required.",
  141:     );
  142:   }
  143: 
  144:   /*
  145:    * Read the authenticated teacher profile before creating
  146:    * any tenant records.
  147:    */
  148:   const ownerRef =
  149:     doc(
  150:       db,
  151:       "users",
  152:       cleanedOwnerUserId,
  153:     );
  154: 
  155:   const ownerSnapshot =
  156:     await getDoc(ownerRef);
  157: 
  158:   if (!ownerSnapshot.exists()) {
  159:     throw new Error(
  160:       "The school owner account could not be found.",
  161:     );
  162:   }
  163: 
  164:   const ownerData =
  165:     ownerSnapshot.data();
  166: 
  167:   const ownerRole =
  168:     safeString(
  169:       ownerData.role,
  170:     );
  171: 
  172:   if (
  173:     ownerRole !== "teacher" &&
  174:     ownerRole !== "admin"
  175:   ) {
  176:     throw new Error(
  177:       "Only an approved teacher or administrator can create a school.",
  178:     );
  179:   }
  180: 
  181:   const existingSchoolId =
  182:     safeString(
  183:       ownerData.schoolId,
  184:     );
  185: 
  186:   if (existingSchoolId) {
  187:     throw new Error(
  188:       "This account is already linked to a school.",
  189:     );
  190:   }
  191: 
  192:   /*
  193:    * Firestore generates the school ID locally before the
  194:    * batch is committed. This allows all three tenant records
  195:    * to reference exactly the same school ID.
  196:    */
  197:   const schoolRef =
  198:     doc(
  199:       collection(
  200:         db,
  201:         "schools",
  202:       ),
  203:     );
  204: 
  205:   const membershipRef =
  206:     doc(
  207:       db,
  208:       "schools",
  209:       schoolRef.id,
  210:       "members",
  211:       cleanedOwnerUserId,
  212:     );
  213: 
  214:   const batch =
  215:     writeBatch(db);
  216: 
  217:   /*
  218:    * 1. Create the school organisation.
  219:    */
  220:   batch.set(
  221:     schoolRef,
  222:     {
  223:       name:
  224:         cleanedName,
  225: 
  226:       slug:
  227:         `${slugify(
  228:           cleanedName,
  229:         )}-${schoolRef.id.slice(
  230:           0,
  231:           6,
  232:         )}`,
  233: 
  234:       status:
  235:         "active",
  236: 
  237:       ownerUserId:
  238:         cleanedOwnerUserId,
  239: 
  240:       createdAt:
  241:         serverTimestamp(),
  242: 
  243:       updatedAt:
  244:         serverTimestamp(),
  245:     },
  246:   );
  247: 
  248:   /*
  249:    * 2. Create the owner's active school-admin membership.
  250:    *
  251:    * Firestore's school creation rule checks this with
  252:    * existsAfter()/getAfter(), so it MUST be part of the
  253:    * same batch as the school creation.
  254:    */
  255:   batch.set(
  256:     membershipRef,
  257:     {
  258:       schoolId:
  259:         schoolRef.id,
  260: 
  261:       userId:
  262:         cleanedOwnerUserId,
  263: 
  264:       role:
  265:         "school_admin",
  266: 
  267:       status:
  268:         "active",
  269: 
  270:       joinedAt:
  271:         serverTimestamp(),
  272: 
  273:       leftAt:
  274:         null,
  275: 
  276:       updatedAt:
  277:         serverTimestamp(),
  278:     },
  279:   );
  280: 
  281:   /*
  282:    * 3. Link the teacher profile to the school.
  283:    *
  284:    * IMPORTANT:
  285:    * Some early development/test accounts pre-date the
  286:    * canonical uid field. Firestore's user update rule
  287:    * requires request.resource.data.uid to equal the
  288:    * authenticated user's UID.
  289:    *
  290:    * Writing uid here safely repairs those legacy profiles
  291:    * while performing the school tenancy transition.
  292:    */
  293:   batch.update(
  294:     ownerRef,
  295:     {
  296:       uid:
  297:         cleanedOwnerUserId,
  298: 
  299:       schoolId:
  300:         schoolRef.id,
  301: 
  302:       accountType:
  303:         "school",
  304: 
  305:       plan:
  306:         "school",
  307: 
  308:       updatedAt:
  309:         serverTimestamp(),
  310:     },
  311:   );
  312: 
  313:   /*
  314:    * All three writes must succeed or none of them does.
  315:    */
  316:   await batch.commit();
  317: 
  318:   return schoolRef.id;
  319: }
