    1: import type { AdaptiveTopicState } from "@/types/adaptiveLearning";
    2: 
    3: export function calculateDaysSince(date: Date | null): number {
    4:   if (!date) return 999;
    5:   return Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - date.getTime()) / 86400000));
    6: }
    7: 
    8: export function calculateReviewInterval({
    9:   masteryScore,
   10:   attempts,
   11:   state,
   12: }: {
   13:   masteryScore: number;
   14:   attempts: number;
   15:   state: AdaptiveTopicState;
   16: }): number {
   17:   if (state === "priority" || state === "new" || state === "forgetting-risk") {
   18:     return 1;
   19:   }
   20:   if (masteryScore < 50) return 2;
   21:   if (masteryScore < 70) return 4;
   22:   if (masteryScore < 85) return Math.min(10, 5 + attempts);
   23:   return Math.min(30, 10 + attempts * 2);
   24: }
   25: 
   26: export function calculateNextReviewDate({
   27:   lastPractisedAt,
   28:   intervalDays,
   29: }: {
   30:   lastPractisedAt: Date | null;
   31:   intervalDays: number;
   32: }): Date {
   33:   const date = lastPractisedAt ? new Date(lastPractisedAt) : new Date();
   34:   date.setDate(date.getDate() + intervalDays);
   35:   return date;
   36: }

   80: export async function getStudentAdaptiveAnalytics(
   81:   studentId: string,
   82: ): Promise<StudentAdaptiveAnalytics> {

   84: 
   85:   if (!cleanedStudentId) {
   86:     return emptyStudentAdaptiveAnalytics;
   87:   }
   88: 
   89:   const [
   90:     profile,
   91:     quizSnapshot,

   99:           orderBy("createdAt", "desc"),

  117:       data.createdAt instanceof Timestamp ? data.createdAt.toDate() : null;
  118:

  120:       id: document.id,
  121:       topic:
  122:         safeString(data.topic) ||
  123:         safeString(data.topicTitle) ||
  124:         safeString(data.title, "Quiz"),

  132:       const data = document.data();
  133: 
  134:       return {
  135:         id: document.id,
  136:         topic:
  137:           safeString(data.topic) ||
  138:           safeString(data.topicTitle) ||
  139:           safeString(data.quizTitle) ||
  140:           safeString(data.title, "Assigned quiz"),
  141:         percentage: safeNumber(data.percentage),
  142:         completedAt:
  143:           data.completedAt instanceof Timestamp
  144:             ? data.completedAt.toDate()
  145:             : null,
  146:       };
  147:     })
  148:     .filter((result) => result.percentage >= 0);
  149: 
  150:   const submissions = await Promise.all(
  151:     examAssignments.map((assignment) =>
  152:       getExamSubmission(assignment.id, cleanedStudentId),
  153:     ),
  154:   );
  155: 
  156:   const examResults = examAssignments
  157:     .map((assignment, index) => {
  158:       const submission = submissions[index];
  159: 
  160:       if (!submission || submission.status !== "marked") {
  161:         return null;
  162:       }
  163: 
  164:       return {
  165:         id: assignment.id,
  166:         topic:
  167:           assignment.questionSetSnapshot.topic ||
  168:           assignment.questionSetTitle ||
  169:           assignment.title,
  170:         percentage: submission.percentage,
  171:         completedAt: submission.markedAt,
  172:       };
  173:     })
  174:     .filter((result): result is NonNullable<typeof result> => result !== null);
  175: 
  176:   const awaitingMarking = submissions.filter(
  177:     (submission) =>
  178:       submission?.status === "submitted" || submission?.status === "marking",
  179:   ).length;
  180: 
  181:   const allQuizResults = [...quizResults, ...assignedQuizResults];
  182: 
  183:   const quizScores = allQuizResults.map((result) => result.percentage);
  184: 
  185:   const examScores = examResults.map((result) => result.percentage);
  186: 
  187:   const combinedResults = [
  188:     ...allQuizResults.map((result) => ({
  189:       ...result,
  190:       source: "quiz" as const,
  191:     })),
  192:     ...examResults.map((result) => ({
  193:       ...result,
  194:       source: "exam" as const,
  195:     })),
  196:   ];
  197: 
  198:   const topicGroups = new Map<string, number[]>();
  199: 
  200:   combinedResults.forEach((result) => {
  201:     const scores = topicGroups.get(result.topic) || [];
  202: 
  203:     scores.push(result.percentage);
  204: 
  205:     topicGroups.set(result.topic, scores);
  206:   });
  207: 
  208:   const topics: AdaptiveTopicInsight[] = Array.from(topicGroups.entries())
  209:     .map(([topic, scores], index) => {
  210:       const averageScore = average(scores);
  211: 
  212:       return {
  213:         id: `adaptive-topic-${index}`,
  214:         topic,
  215:         averageScore,
  216:         attempts: scores.length,
  217:         classification:
  218:           averageScore >= 70
  219:             ? ("secure" as const)
  220:             : averageScore < 50
  221:               ? ("priority" as const)
  222:               : ("developing" as const),
  223:       };
  224:     })
  225:     .sort((first, second) => second.averageScore - first.averageScore);
  226: 
  227:   const strongestTopics = topics
  228:     .filter((topic) => topic.classification === "secure")
  229:     .slice(0, 3);
  230: 
  231:   const priorityTopics = [...topics]
  232:     .filter((topic) => topic.classification === "priority")
  233:     .sort((first, second) => first.averageScore - second.averageScore)
  234:     .slice(0, 3);
  235: 
  236:   const chronological = combinedResults
  237:     .filter((result) => result.completedAt)
  238:     .sort(
  239:       (first, second) =>
  240:         (first.completedAt?.getTime() || 0) -
  241:         (second.completedAt?.getTime() || 0),
  242:     )
  243:     .map((result) => result.percentage);
  244: 
  245:   let improvementTrend = 0;
  246: 
  247:   if (chronological.length >= 2) {
  248:     const midpoint = Math.ceil(chronological.length / 2);
  249: 
  250:     improvementTrend =
  251:       average(chronological.slice(midpoint)) -
  252:       average(chronological.slice(0, midpoint));
  253:   }
  254: 
  255:   const quizAverage = average(quizScores);
  256: 
  257:   const examAverage = average(examScores);
  258: 
  259:   const combinedAverage = average([...quizScores, ...examScores]);
  260: 
  261:   const recommendations: AdaptiveRecommendation[] = [];
  262: 
  263:   const priorityTopic = priorityTopics[0];
  264: 
  265:   if (priorityTopic) {
  266:     const encodedTopic = encodeURIComponent(priorityTopic.topic);
  267: 
  268:     recommendations.push(
  269:       {
  270:         id: "priority-lesson",
  271:         title: `Review ${priorityTopic.topic}`,
  272:         description: `Current assessed performance is ${priorityTopic.averageScore}%. Revisit the core lesson before practising again.`,
  273:         topic: priorityTopic.topic,
  274:         type: "lesson",
  275:         href: `/learn?search=${encodedTopic}`,
  276:         priority: "high",
  277:       },
  278:       {
  279:         id: "priority-quiz",
  280:         title: "Complete retrieval practice",
  281:         description: `Use a short quiz on ${priorityTopic.topic} to check misconceptions immediately.`,
  282:         topic: priorityTopic.topic,
  283:         type: "quiz",
  284:         href: `/quiz?topic=${encodedTopic}`,
  285:         priority: "high",
  286:       },
  287:       {
  288:         id: "priority-exam",
  289:         title: "Attempt an exam-style question",
  290:         description: `Apply your knowledge of ${priorityTopic.topic} in a written response and compare it with the mark scheme.`,
  291:         topic: priorityTopic.topic,
  292:         type: "exam",
  293:         href: "/assignments?filter=exams",
  294:         priority: "medium",
  295:       },
  296:     );
  297:   } else {
  298:     recommendations.push({
  299:       id: "maintain",
  300:       title: "Maintain your progress",
  301:       description:
  302:         "Complete a mixed retrieval quiz and one written exam question to keep secure topics active.",
  303:       topic: strongestTopics[0]?.topic || "Computer Science",
  304:       type: "quiz",
  305:       href: "/quiz",
  306:       priority: "positive",
  307:     });
  308:   }
  309: 
  310:   return {
  311:     quizAverage,
  312:     examAverage,
  313:     combinedAverage,
  314:     currentGrade: indicativeGradeFromPercentage(
  315:       combinedAverage,
  316:       profile?.qualification,
  317:     ),
  318:     predictedGrade: indicativeGradeFromPercentage(
  319:       Math.max(
  320:         0,
  321:         Math.min(100, combinedAverage + Math.round(improvementTrend * 0.4)),
  322:       ),
  323:       profile?.qualification,
  324:     ),
  325:     improvementTrend,
  326:     completedAssessments: combinedResults.length,
  327:     awaitingMarking,
  328:     strongestTopics,
  329:     priorityTopics,
  330:     recommendations,
  331:   };
  332: }

  146: function safeNumber(value: unknown): number {
  147:   return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
  148: }
  149: 
  150: function safeString(value: unknown, fallback = ""): string {
  151:   return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value.trim() : fallback;
  152: }
  153: 
  154: function safeStringArray(value: unknown): string[] {
  155:   return Array.isArray(value)
  156:     ? value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === "string")
  157:     : [];
  158: }
  159: 
  160: function toDate(value: FirestoreDate): Date | null {
  161:   if (!value) return null;
  162:   if (value instanceof Date) {
  163:     return value;
  164:   }
  165:   if (value instanceof Timestamp) {
  166:     return value.toDate();
  167:   }
  168: 
  169:   if (typeof value === "string") {
  170:     const parsed = new Date(value);
  171:     return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? null : parsed;
  172:   }
  173: 
  174:   return null;
  175: }
  176: 
  177: function average(values: number[]): number {
  178:   if (values.length === 0) {
  179:     return 0;
  180:   }
  181: 
  182:   return Math.round(
  183:     values.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0) / values.length,
  184:   );
  185: }
  186: 
  187: function isOverdue(dueDate: Date | null, completed: boolean): boolean {
  188:   if (!dueDate || completed) {
  189:     return false;
  190:   }
  191: 
  192:   const endOfDueDate = new Date(dueDate);
  193: 
  194:   endOfDueDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
  195: 
  196:   return endOfDueDate.getTime() < Date.now();
  197: }

  199: function buildRecommendations(
  200:   metrics: StudentAnalyticsMetrics,
  201:   weakestTopics: StudentTopicPerformance[],
  202: ): StudentAnalyticsRecommendation[] {
  203:   const recommendations: StudentAnalyticsRecommendation[] = [];
  204: 
  205:   if (metrics.overdueAssignments > 0) {
  206:     recommendations.push({
  207:       id: "overdue",
  208:       priority: "high",
  209:       title: "Address overdue work",
  210:       description: `${metrics.overdueAssignments} assignment${
  211:         metrics.overdueAssignments === 1 ? " is" : "s are"
  212:       } overdue. Agree a completion plan with the student.`,
  213:       actionType: "completion",
  214:     });
  215:   }
  216: 
  217:   if (metrics.awaitingMarkingExamAssignments > 0) {
  218:     recommendations.push({
  219:       id: "awaiting-marking",
  220:       priority: "medium",
  221:       title: "Release written feedback",
  222:       description: `${metrics.awaitingMarkingExamAssignments} written assessment${
  223:         metrics.awaitingMarkingExamAssignments === 1 ? " is" : "s are"
  224:       } submitted and awaiting marking.`,
  225:       actionType: "exam",
  226:     });
  227:   }
  228: 
  229:   if (metrics.completedQuizAssignments > 0 && metrics.quizAverage < 50) {
  230:     recommendations.push({
  231:       id: "quiz-support",
  232:       priority: "high",
  233:       title: "Provide targeted quiz support",
  234:       description: `The quiz average is ${metrics.quizAverage}%. Revisit misconceptions before reassessment.`,
  235:       actionType: "quiz",
  236:     });
  237:   }
  238: 
  239:   if (metrics.completedExamAssignments > 0 && metrics.examAverage < 50) {
  240:     recommendations.push({
  241:       id: "exam-support",
  242:       priority: "high",
  243:       title: "Model written exam responses",
  244:       description: `The written exam average is ${metrics.examAverage}%. Use model answers and guided practice to improve exam technique.`,
  245:       actionType: "exam",
  246:     });
  247:   }
  248: 
  249:   if (weakestTopics.length > 0) {
  250:     recommendations.push({
  251:       id: "weakest-topic",
  252:       priority: "medium",
  253:       title: `Revisit ${weakestTopics[0].topic}`,
  254:       description: `This is currently the weakest assessed area at ${weakestTopics[0].averageScore}%. Recommend a lesson review, retrieval quiz and one exam-style question.`,
  255:       actionType: "lesson",
  256:       topic: weakestTopics[0].topic,
  257:     });
  258:   }
  259: 
  260:   if (metrics.totalAssignments > 0 && metrics.completionRate < 75) {
  261:     recommendations.push({
  262:       id: "completion",
  263:       priority: "medium",
  264:       title: "Improve assignment completion",
  265:       description: `Completion is currently ${metrics.completionRate}%. Review deadlines and barriers to completion.`,
  266:       actionType: "completion",
  267:     });
  268:   }
  269: 
  270:   if (metrics.improvementTrend >= 10) {
  271:     recommendations.push({
  272:       id: "improvement",
  273:       priority: "positive",
  274:       title: "Recognise recent improvement",
  275:       description: `Recent assessment performance has improved by approximately ${metrics.improvementTrend} percentage points.`,
  276:     });
  277:   }
  278: 
  279:   if (recommendations.length === 0) {
  280:     recommendations.push({
  281:       id: "maintain",
  282:       priority: "positive",
  283:       title: "Maintain current progress",
  284:       description:
  285:         "Continue regular retrieval practice, written exam practice and appropriately challenging work.",
  286:     });
  287:   }
  288: 
  289:   return recommendations;
  290: }

  292: export async function getStudentAnalytics(
  293:   studentId: string,
  294:   teacherId: string,
  295: ): Promise<StudentAnalyticsData | null> {
  296:   const cleanedStudentId = studentId.trim();
  297: 
  298:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
  299: 
  300:   if (!cleanedStudentId || !cleanedTeacherId) {
  301:     return null;
  302:   }
  303: 
  304:   const student = await getStudentById(cleanedStudentId);
  305: 
  306:   if (!student) {
  307:     return null;
  308:   }
  309: 
  310:   const [
  311:     classesSnapshot,
  312:     resourceAssignmentsSnapshot,
  313:     quizAssignmentsSnapshot,
  314:     quizResultsSnapshot,
  315:     examAssignmentsSnapshot,
  316:     examSubmissionsSnapshot,
  317:   ] = await Promise.all([
  318:     getDocs(
  319:       query(
  320:         collection(db, "classes"),
  321:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  322:       ),
  323:     ),
  324: 
  325:     getDocs(
  326:       query(
  327:         collection(db, "classAssignments"),
  328:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  329:       ),
  330:     ),
  331: 
  332:     getDocs(
  333:       query(
  334:         collection(db, "assignments"),
  335:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  336:       ),
  337:     ),
  338: 
  339:     getDocs(
  340:       query(
  341:         collection(db, "assignmentResults"),
  342:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  343:       ),
  344:     ),
  345: 
  346:     getDocs(
  347:       query(
  348:         collection(db, "examAssignments"),
  349:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  350:       ),
  351:     ),
  352: 
  353:     getDocs(
  354:       query(
  355:         collection(db, "examSubmissions"),
  356:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  357:       ),
  358:     ),
  359:   ]);
  360: 
  361:   const studentClassIdSet = new Set(student.classIds);
  362: 
  363:   const classes: StudentClassSummary[] = classesSnapshot.docs
  364:     .filter((classDocument) => studentClassIdSet.has(classDocument.id))
  365:     .map((classDocument) => {
  366:       const data = classDocument.data();
  367: 
  368:       return {
  369:         id: classDocument.id,
  370:         name: safeString(data.name, "Untitled class"),
  371:       };
  372:     });
  373: 
  374:   if (student.classIds.length > 0 && classes.length === 0) {
  375:     return null;
  376:   }
  377: 
  378:   const classNameById = new Map(
  379:     classes.map((studentClass) => [studentClass.id, studentClass.name]),
  380:   );
  381: 
  382:   const resourceAssignments = resourceAssignmentsSnapshot.docs.filter(
  383:     (assignmentDocument) => {
  384:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  385: 
  386:       return (
  387:         safeStringArray(data.studentIds).includes(cleanedStudentId) &&
  388:         data.status !== "cancelled"
  389:       );
  390:     },
  391:   );
  392: 
  393:   const resourceActivities = await Promise.all(
  394:     resourceAssignments.map(async (assignmentDocument) => {
  395:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  396: 
  397:       const dueDate = toDate(data.dueDate);
  398: 
  399:       const progressId = `${assignmentDocument.id}_${cleanedStudentId}`;
  400: 
  401:       const progressSnapshot = await getDoc(
  402:         doc(db, "assignmentProgress", progressId),
  403:       );
  404: 
  405:       const progress = progressSnapshot.exists()
  406:         ? progressSnapshot.data()
  407:         : null;
  408: 
  409:       const completed = progress?.status === "completed";
  410: 
  411:       const status: AnalyticsAssignmentStatus = completed
  412:         ? "completed"
  413:         : isOverdue(dueDate, false)
  414:           ? "overdue"
  415:           : progress?.status === "in_progress"
  416:             ? "in_progress"
  417:             : "not_started";
  418: 
  419:       return {
  420:         id: `resource-${assignmentDocument.id}`,
  421:         assignmentId: assignmentDocument.id,
  422:         type: "resource" as const,
  423:         title:
  424:           safeString(data.resourceTitle) ||
  425:           safeString(data.title, "Assigned resource"),
  426:         topic: safeString(data.resourceTopic, "Resource"),
  427:         className:
  428:           safeString(data.className) ||
  429:           classNameById.get(safeString(data.classId)) ||
  430:           "Assigned class",
  431:         status,
  432:         dueDate,
  433:         completedAt: toDate(progress?.completedAt),
  434:         score: null,
  435:         totalQuestions: null,
  436:         totalMarks: null,
  437:         percentage: null,
  438:         earnedXP: 0,
  439:         timeTakenSeconds: 0,
  440:       } satisfies StudentAnalyticsActivity;
  441:     }),
  442:   );
  443: 
  444:   const quizAssignments = quizAssignmentsSnapshot.docs.filter(
  445:     (assignmentDocument) => {
  446:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  447: 
  448:       return (
  449:         data.type === "quiz" &&
  450:         studentClassIdSet.has(safeString(data.classId)) &&
  451:         data.status !== "cancelled"
  452:       );
  453:     },
  454:   );
  455: 
  456:   const quizResultByAssignmentId = new Map(
  457:     quizResultsSnapshot.docs
  458:       .map((resultDocument) => {
  459:         const data = resultDocument.data();
  460: 
  461:         return {
  462:           assignmentId: safeString(data.assignmentId),
  463:           studentId: safeString(data.studentId),
  464:           assignmentType: safeString(data.assignmentType),
  465:           score: safeNumber(data.score),
  466:           totalQuestions: safeNumber(data.totalQuestions),
  467:           percentage: safeNumber(data.percentage),
  468:           earnedXP: safeNumber(data.earnedXP),
  469:           timeTakenSeconds: safeNumber(data.timeTakenSeconds),
  470:           status: safeString(data.status, "completed"),
  471:           completedAt: toDate(data.completedAt),
  472:         };
  473:       })
  474:       .filter(
  475:         (result) =>
  476:           result.studentId === cleanedStudentId &&
  477:           result.assignmentType === "quiz",
  478:       )
  479:       .map((result) => [result.assignmentId, result] as const),
  480:   );
  481: 
  482:   const quizActivities: StudentAnalyticsActivity[] = quizAssignments.map(
  483:     (assignmentDocument) => {
  484:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  485: 
  486:       const result = quizResultByAssignmentId.get(assignmentDocument.id);
  487: 
  488:       const dueDate = toDate(data.dueDate);
  489: 
  490:       const completed = result?.status === "completed";
  491: 
  492:       const status: AnalyticsAssignmentStatus = completed
  493:         ? "completed"
  494:         : isOverdue(dueDate, false)
  495:           ? "overdue"
  496:           : "not_started";
  497: 
  498:       return {
  499:         id: `quiz-${assignmentDocument.id}`,
  500:         assignmentId: assignmentDocument.id,
  501:         type: "quiz",
  502:         title: safeString(data.title, "Assigned quiz"),
  503:         topic: safeString(data.topic) || safeString(data.title, "Quiz"),
  504:         className:
  505:           classNameById.get(safeString(data.classId)) || "Assigned class",
  506:         status,
  507:         dueDate,
  508:         completedAt: result?.completedAt || null,
  509:         score: result?.score ?? null,
  510:         totalQuestions: result?.totalQuestions ?? null,
  511:         totalMarks: null,
  512:         percentage: result?.percentage ?? null,
  513:         earnedXP: result?.earnedXP ?? 0,
  514:         timeTakenSeconds: result?.timeTakenSeconds ?? 0,
  515:       };
  516:     },

  520:     .map((assignmentDocument) => {

  522:

  534:           classNameById.get(safeString(data.classId)) ||
  535:           "Assigned class",

  537:         topic:
  538:           safeString(snapshot.topic) ||
  539:           safeString(data.questionSetTitle, "Written assessment"),
  540:         studentIds: safeStringArray(data.studentIds),
  541:         dueDate: toDate(data.dueDate),
  542:         totalMarks: safeNumber(data.totalMarks),
  543:         questionCount: safeNumber(data.questionCount),
  544:         status: safeString(data.status, "active"),
  545:       };
  546:     })
  547:     .filter(
  548:       (assignment) =>
  549:         assignment.studentIds.includes(cleanedStudentId) &&
  550:         assignment.status !== "cancelled",
  551:     );
  552: 
  553:   const examSubmissionByAssignmentId = new Map<string, ExamSubmissionRecord>(
  554:     examSubmissionsSnapshot.docs
  555:       .map((submissionDocument) => {
  556:         const data = submissionDocument.data();
  557: 
  558:         return {
  559:           id: submissionDocument.id,
  560:           assignmentId: safeString(data.assignmentId),
  561:           studentId: safeString(data.studentId),
  562:           status: safeString(data.status, "not_started"),
  563:           totalAwardedMarks: safeNumber(data.totalAwardedMarks),
  564:           totalAvailableMarks: safeNumber(data.totalAvailableMarks),
  565:           percentage: safeNumber(data.percentage),
  566:           submittedAt: toDate(data.submittedAt),
  567:           markedAt: toDate(data.markedAt),
  568:           updatedAt: toDate(data.updatedAt),
  569:         };
  570:       })
  571:       .filter((submission) => submission.studentId === cleanedStudentId)
  572:       .map((submission) => [submission.assignmentId, submission]),
  573:   );
  574: 
  575:   const examActivities: StudentAnalyticsActivity[] = examAssignments.map(
  576:     (assignment) => {
  577:       const submission = examSubmissionByAssignmentId.get(assignment.id);
  578: 
  579:       const marked = submission?.status === "marked";
  580: 
  581:       const submitted =
  582:         submission?.status === "submitted" || submission?.status === "marking";
  583: 
  584:       const inProgress = submission?.status === "in_progress";
  585: 
  586:       const status: AnalyticsAssignmentStatus = marked
  587:         ? "completed"
  588:         : isOverdue(assignment.dueDate, false)
  589:           ? "overdue"
  590:           : submitted || inProgress
  591:             ? "in_progress"
  592:             : "not_started";
  593: 
  594:       return {
  595:         id: `exam-${assignment.id}`,
  596:         assignmentId: assignment.id,
  597:         type: "exam",
  598:         title: assignment.title,
  599:         topic: assignment.topic,
  600:         className: assignment.className,
  601:         status,
  602:         dueDate: assignment.dueDate,
  603:         completedAt: submission?.markedAt || submission?.submittedAt || null,
  604:         score: marked ? submission.totalAwardedMarks : null,
  605:         totalQuestions: assignment.questionCount,
  606:         totalMarks: assignment.totalMarks,
  607:         percentage: marked ? submission.percentage : null,
  608:         earnedXP: 0,
  609:         timeTakenSeconds: 0,
  610:       };
  611:     },
  612:   );
  613: 
  614:   const activities = [
  615:     ...resourceActivities,
  616:     ...quizActivities,
  617:     ...examActivities,
  618:   ].sort((first, second) => {
  619:     const firstDate =
  620:       first.completedAt?.getTime() || first.dueDate?.getTime() || 0;
  621: 
  622:     const secondDate =
  623:       second.completedAt?.getTime() || second.dueDate?.getTime() || 0;
  624: 
  625:     return secondDate - firstDate;
  626:   });
  627: 
  628:   const completedActivities = activities.filter(
  629:     (activity) => activity.status === "completed",
  630:   );
  631: 
  632:   const outstandingActivities = activities.filter(
  633:     (activity) => activity.status !== "completed",
  634:   );
  635: 
  636:   const completedQuizActivities = quizActivities.filter(
  637:     (activity) =>
  638:       activity.status === "completed" && activity.percentage !== null,
  639:   );
  640: 
  641:   const completedExamActivities = examActivities.filter(
  642:     (activity) =>
  643:       activity.status === "completed" && activity.percentage !== null,
  644:   );
  645: 
  646:   const quizScores = completedQuizActivities.map(
  647:     (activity) => activity.percentage || 0,
  648:   );
  649: 
  650:   const examScores = completedExamActivities.map(
  651:     (activity) => activity.percentage || 0,
  652:   );
  653: 
  654:   const assessedActivities = [
  655:     ...completedQuizActivities,
  656:     ...completedExamActivities,
  657:   ];
  658: 
  659:   const topicGroups = new Map<
  660:     string,
  661:     {
  662:       scores: number[];
  663:       sources: Set<AnalyticsActivityType>;
  664:     }
  665:   >();
  666: 
  667:   assessedActivities.forEach((activity) => {
  668:     const topic = activity.topic || activity.title || "Other";
  669: 
  670:     const group = topicGroups.get(topic) || {
  671:       scores: [],
  672:       sources: new Set<AnalyticsActivityType>(),
  673:     };
  674: 
  675:     group.scores.push(activity.percentage || 0);
  676: 
  677:     group.sources.add(activity.type);
  678: 
  679:     topicGroups.set(topic, group);
  680:   });
  681: 
  682:   const topicPerformance: StudentTopicPerformance[] = Array.from(
  683:     topicGroups.entries(),
  684:   )
  685:     .map(([topic, group], index): StudentTopicPerformance => {
  686:       const averageScore = average(group.scores);
  687: 
  688:       const classification: StudentTopicPerformance["classification"] =
  689:         averageScore >= 70
  690:           ? "strength"
  691:           : averageScore < 50
  692:             ? "support"
  693:             : "developing";
  694: 
  695:       return {
  696:         id: `topic-${index}`,
  697:         topic,
  698:         attempts: group.scores.length,
  699:         averageScore,
  700:         highestScore: Math.max(...group.scores),
  701:         lowestScore: Math.min(...group.scores),
  702:         classification,
  703:         sources: Array.from(group.sources),
  704:       };
  705:     })
  706:     .sort((first, second) => second.averageScore - first.averageScore);
  707: 
  708:   const chronologicalScores = assessedActivities
  709:     .filter((activity) => activity.completedAt)
  710:     .sort(
  711:       (first, second) =>
  712:         (first.completedAt?.getTime() || 0) -
  713:         (second.completedAt?.getTime() || 0),
  714:     )
  715:     .map((activity) => activity.percentage || 0);
  716: 
  717:   let improvementTrend = 0;
  718: 
  719:   if (chronologicalScores.length >= 2) {
  720:     const midpoint = Math.ceil(chronologicalScores.length / 2);
  721: 
  722:     improvementTrend =
  723:       average(chronologicalScores.slice(midpoint)) -
  724:       average(chronologicalScores.slice(0, midpoint));
  725:   }
  726: 
  727:   const totalAssignments = activities.length;
  728: 
  729:   const completedAssignments = completedActivities.length;
  730: 
  731:   const quizAverage = average(quizScores);
  732: 
  733:   const examAverage = average(examScores);
  734: 
  735:   const combinedAssessmentAverage = average([...quizScores, ...examScores]);
  736: 
  737:   const metrics: StudentAnalyticsMetrics = {
  738:     totalAssignments,
  739:     completedAssignments,
  740:     outstandingAssignments: outstandingActivities.length,
  741:     overdueAssignments: activities.filter(
  742:       (activity) => activity.status === "overdue",
  743:     ).length,
  744:     completionRate:
  745:       totalAssignments > 0
  746:         ? Math.round((completedAssignments / totalAssignments) * 100)
  747:         : 0,
  748: 
  749:     totalResourceAssignments: resourceActivities.length,
  750:     completedResourceAssignments: resourceActivities.filter(
  751:       (activity) => activity.status === "completed",
  752:     ).length,
  753: 
  754:     totalQuizAssignments: quizActivities.length,
  755:     completedQuizAssignments: completedQuizActivities.length,
  756:     quizAverage,
  757:     highestQuizScore: quizScores.length > 0 ? Math.max(...quizScores) : 0,
  758:     lowestQuizScore: quizScores.length > 0 ? Math.min(...quizScores) : 0,
  759: 
  760:     totalExamAssignments: examActivities.length,
  761:     completedExamAssignments: completedExamActivities.length,
  762:     submittedExamAssignments: examAssignments.filter((assignment) => {
  763:       const submission = examSubmissionByAssignmentId.get(assignment.id);
  764: 
  765:       return ["submitted", "marking", "marked"].includes(
  766:         submission?.status || "",
  767:       );
  768:     }).length,
  769:     awaitingMarkingExamAssignments: examAssignments.filter((assignment) => {
  770:       const submission = examSubmissionByAssignmentId.get(assignment.id);
  771: 
  772:       return (
  773:         submission?.status === "submitted" || submission?.status === "marking"
  774:       );
  775:     }).length,
  776:     examAverage,
  777:     highestExamScore: examScores.length > 0 ? Math.max(...examScores) : 0,
  778:     lowestExamScore: examScores.length > 0 ? Math.min(...examScores) : 0,
  779: 
  780:     combinedAssessmentAverage,
  781:     currentGrade: indicativeGradeFromPercentage(
  782:       combinedAssessmentAverage,
  783:       student.qualification === "A_LEVEL" ? "A_LEVEL" : "GCSE",
  784:     ),
  785:     predictedGrade: indicativeGradeFromPercentage(
  786:       Math.max(
  787:         0,
  788:         Math.min(
  789:           100,
  790:           combinedAssessmentAverage + Math.round(improvementTrend * 0.4),
  791:         ),
  792:       ),
  793:       student.qualification === "A_LEVEL" ? "A_LEVEL" : "GCSE",
  794:     ),
  795: 
  796:     totalXP: student.xp,
  797:     assignmentXP: completedQuizActivities.reduce(
  798:       (total, activity) => total + activity.earnedXP,
  799:       0,
  800:     ),
  801:     streak: student.streak,
  802:     completedLessons: student.completedLessons.length,
  803:     completedTopics: student.completedTopics.length,
  804:     completedUnits: student.completedUnits.length,
  805:     averageTimeTakenSeconds: average(
  806:       completedQuizActivities
  807:         .map((activity) => activity.timeTakenSeconds)
  808:         .filter((time) => time > 0),
  809:     ),
  810:     improvementTrend,
  811:   };
  812: 
  813:   const strongestTopics = topicPerformance
  814:     .filter((topic) => topic.classification === "strength")
  815:     .slice(0, 3);
  816: 
  817:   const weakestTopics = [...topicPerformance]
  818:     .filter((topic) => topic.classification === "support")
  819:     .sort((first, second) => first.averageScore - second.averageScore)
  820:     .slice(0, 3);
  821: 
  822:   const recentActivities = completedActivities
  823:     .filter((activity) => activity.completedAt)
  824:     .sort(
  825:       (first, second) =>
  826:         (second.completedAt?.getTime() || 0) -
  827:         (first.completedAt?.getTime() || 0),
  828:     )
  829:     .slice(0, 8);
  830: 
  831:   return {
  832:     student,
  833:     classes,
  834:     metrics,
  835:     activities,
  836:     recentActivities,
  837:     outstandingActivities,
  838:     topicPerformance,
  839:     strongestTopics,
  840:     weakestTopics,
  841:     recommendations: buildRecommendations(metrics, weakestTopics),
  842:   };
  843: }

   41: function normaliseString(value: unknown): string {
   42:   return typeof value === "string" ? value.trim() : "";
   43: }
   44: 
   45: function normaliseStringArray(value: unknown): string[] {
   46:   if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
   47:     return [];
   48:   }
   49: 
   50:   return value.filter(
   51:     (item): item is string => typeof item === "string",
   52:   );

   55: function convertToStudentRecord(
   56:   profile: Partial<UserProfile>,
   57:   fallbackUid: string,
   58: ): StudentDirectoryRecord {
   59:   const schoolId = normaliseString(profile.schoolId);
   60: 
   61:   return {
   62:     uid: normaliseString(profile.uid) || fallbackUid,
   63:     name: normaliseString(profile.name) || "Unnamed Student",
   64:     email: normaliseString(profile.email).toLowerCase(),
   65:     role: "student",
   66: 
   67:     schoolId,
   68: 
   69:     accountType: schoolId ? "school" : "individual",
   70: 
   71:     plan: schoolId
   72:       ? "school"
   73:       : profile.plan === "premium"
   74:         ? "premium"
   75:         : "free",
   76: 
   77:     qualification: normaliseString(profile.qualification),
   78:     examBoard: normaliseString(profile.examBoard),
   79:     currentCourse: normaliseString(profile.currentCourse),
   80: 
   81:     xp: typeof profile.xp === "number" ? profile.xp : 0,
   82:     streak: typeof profile.streak === "number" ? profile.streak : 0,
   83: 
   84:     classIds: normaliseStringArray(profile.classIds),
   85: 
   86:     completedLessons: normaliseStringArray(profile.completedLessons),
   87:     completedTopics: normaliseStringArray(profile.completedTopics),
   88:     completedUnits: normaliseStringArray(profile.completedUnits),
   89:   };
   90: }

   92: /**
   93:  * Returns only students belonging to one school.

   95:  * A missing schoolId deliberately returns [].

   98: export async function getAllStudents(
   99:   schoolId?: string,
  100: ): Promise<StudentDirectoryRecord[]> {
  101:   const cleanedSchoolId = schoolId?.trim() || "";
  102: 
  103:   if (!cleanedSchoolId) {
  104:     return [];
  105:   }
  106: 
  107:   const studentsQuery = query(
  108:     collection(db, "users"),
  109:     where("role", "==", "student"),

  112: 
  113:   const snapshot = await getDocs(studentsQuery);
  114: 
  115:   return snapshot.docs
  116:     .map((studentDocument) =>
  117:       convertToStudentRecord(
  118:         studentDocument.data() as Partial<UserProfile>,
  119:         studentDocument.id,

  121:     )
  122:     .sort((studentA, studentB) =>
  123:       studentA.name.localeCompare(studentB.name, "en-GB", {
  124:         sensitivity: "base",
  125:       }),
  126:     );
  127: }

  168:     cleanedExpectedSchoolId &&

  171:     return null;

  208: export function searchStudents(
  209:   students: StudentDirectoryRecord[],
  210:   searchTerm: string,
  211: ): StudentDirectoryRecord[] {

  213:

  216:   }
  217: 
  218:   return students.filter((student) => {
  219:     const values = [
  220:       student.name,
  221:       student.email,
  222:       student.qualification,
  223:       student.examBoard,
  224:       student.currentCourse,

  233: export async function addClassToStudent(

  238:   const cleanedClassId = classId.trim();
  239: 
  240:   if (!cleanedStudentId) {
  241:     throw new Error("A valid student account is required.");
  242:   }
  243: 
  244:   if (!cleanedClassId) {
  245:     throw new Error("A valid class is required.");
  246:   }
  247: 
  248:   const studentReference = doc(db, "users", cleanedStudentId);
  249:   const snapshot = await getDoc(studentReference);
  250: 
  251:   if (!snapshot.exists()) {
  252:     throw new Error(
  253:       "The selected student account could not be found.",
  254:     );
  255:   }
  256: 
  257:   const profile = snapshot.data() as Partial<UserProfile>;
  258: 
  259:   if (profile.role !== "student") {
  260:     throw new Error(
  261:       "Only student accounts can be enrolled in a class.",
  262:     );
  263:   }
  264: 
  265:   await updateDoc(studentReference, {
  266:     classIds: arrayUnion(cleanedClassId),
  267:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  268:   });

   11:     getUserProfile(id),
   12:     getStudentAdaptiveAnalytics(id),
   13:   ]);
   14:   if (!profile) throw new Error("The student profile could not be loaded.");
   15:   return {
   16:     studentId: id,
   17:     name: profile.name || "Student",
   18:     qualification: profile.qualification || "GCSE",
   19:     examBoard: profile.examBoard || "General",
   20:     currentCourse: profile.currentCourse || "Computer Science",
   21:     combinedAverage: analytics.combinedAverage,

   23:     examAverage: analytics.examAverage,

   36:       topic: t.topic,

   40:     recommendedActions: analytics.recommendations.map((r) => ({

   18: type FMsg = Omit<TutorMessage, "createdAt"> & { createdAt?: Timestamp };
   19: type FConv = {
   20:   studentId: string;
   21:   title: string;
   22:   messages?: FMsg[];
   23:   createdAt?: Timestamp;
   24:   updatedAt?: Timestamp;
   25: };
   26: const toDate = (v?: Timestamp | null) => (v?.toDate ? v.toDate() : null);
   27: const convert = (id: string, d: FConv): TutorConversation => ({
   28:   id,
   29:   studentId: d.studentId,
   30:   title: d.title || "Tutor conversation",
   31:   messages: (d.messages || []).map((m) => ({
   32:     ...m,
   33:     createdAt: toDate(m.createdAt),
   34:   })),
   35:   createdAt: toDate(d.createdAt),
   36:   updatedAt: toDate(d.updatedAt),
   37: });
   38: const mid = () =>
   39:   `message-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
   40: export async function createTutorConversation(studentId: string) {
   41:   const r = await addDoc(collection(db, "studentTutorConversations"), {
   42:     studentId: studentId.trim(),
   43:     title: "New tutor conversation",
   44:     messages: [],
   45:     createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
   46:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   47:   });
   48:   return r.id;
   49: }
   50: export async function getTutorConversation(id: string) {
   51:   const s = await getDoc(doc(db, "studentTutorConversations", id));
   52:   return s.exists() ? convert(s.id, s.data() as FConv) : null;
   53: }
   54: export async function saveTutorExchange(input: {
   55:   conversationId: string;
   56:   studentId: string;
   57:   studentMessage: string;
   58:   tutorResponse: TutorResponse;
   59: }) {
   60:   const c = await getTutorConversation(input.conversationId);
   61:   if (!c || c.studentId !== input.studentId)
   62:     throw new Error("Tutor conversation unavailable.");
   63:   const now = new Date();
   64:   const messages = [
   65:     ...c.messages,
   66:     {
   67:       id: mid(),
   68:       role: "student" as const,
   69:       content: input.studentMessage.trim(),
   70:       createdAt: now,
   71:     },
   72:     {
   73:       id: mid(),
   74:       role: "assistant" as const,
   75:       content: input.tutorResponse.reply,
   76:       createdAt: now,
   77:       mode: input.tutorResponse.mode,
   78:     },
   79:   ];
   80:   await updateDoc(doc(db, "studentTutorConversations", input.conversationId), {
   81:     title: c.messages.length
   82:       ? c.title
   83:       : input.studentMessage.trim().slice(0, 60),
   84:     messages: messages.map((m) => ({
   85:       ...m,
   86:       createdAt: Timestamp.fromDate(m.createdAt || now),
   87:     })),
   88:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   89:   });
   90: }
   91: export async function clearTutorConversation(id: string, studentId: string) {
   92:   const c = await getTutorConversation(id);
   93:   if (!c || c.studentId !== studentId)
   94:     throw new Error("Tutor conversation unavailable.");
   95:   await updateDoc(doc(db, "studentTutorConversations", id), {
   96:     title: "New tutor conversation",
   97:     messages: [],
   98:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   99:   });
  100: }
  101: export async function requestTutorResponse(input: {
  102:   studentId: string;
  103:   conversationId: string;
  104:   message: string;
  105:   history: { role: "student" | "assistant"; content: string }[];
  106:   context: TutorStudentContext;
  107: }): Promise<TutorResponse> {
  108:   const r = await fetch("/api/ai/student-tutor", {
  109:     method: "POST",
  110:     headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  111:     body: JSON.stringify(input),
  112:   });
  113:   const j = await r.json();
  114:   if (!r.ok) throw new Error(j.error || "The tutor could not respond.");
  115:   return j as TutorResponse;
  116: }

   15: function uniqueActions(actions: TeacherActionItem[]): TeacherActionItem[] {
   16:   const seen = new Set<string>();
   17: 
   18:   return actions.filter((action) => {
   19:     const key = `${action.kind}:${action.href}:${action.studentId || ""}:${action.topic || ""}`;
   20:

   22:

   25:   });

   32: 
   33:   if (input.classCount === 0) {

   50:       priority: "critical",
   51:       title: "Add students to your classes",

   53:         "There are currently no students contributing learning or assessment evidence.",
   54:       href: "/teacher/classes",
   55:       actionLabel: "Manage enrolment",
   56:     });
   57:   }

   60:     const critical = student.averageScore < 30;
   61: 
   62:     actions.push({
   63:       id: `student-support-${student.id}`,
   64:       kind: "student_support",
   65:       priority: critical ? "critical" : "high",

   72:       studentId: student.id,
   73:       studentName: student.name,
   74:       topic: student.weakTopic,
   75:       metric: `${student.averageScore}%`,
   76:     });
   77: 
   78:     if (index < 3) {
   79:       actions.push({
   80:         id: `student-intervention-${student.id}`,
   81:         kind: "student_support",
   82:         priority: critical ? "high" : "medium",
   83:         title: `Consider an intervention for ${student.name}`,

   85:           student.weakTopic || "the learner's weakest recent evidence"

   93:         studentId: student.id,
   94:         studentName: student.name,
   95:         topic: student.weakTopic,
   96:       });
   97:     }
   98:   });
   99: 
  100:   const assessedTopics = input.classPerformance.filter((topic) =>
  101:     Number.isFinite(topic.averageScore),
  102:   );
  103: 
  104:   const weakestTopic =
  105:     assessedTopics.length > 0
  106:       ? [...assessedTopics].sort(
  107:           (first, second) => first.averageScore - second.averageScore,
  108:         )[0]
  109:       : null;
  110: 
  111:   if (weakestTopic && weakestTopic.averageScore < 50) {
  112:     actions.push({
  113:       id: `reteach-${weakestTopic.id}`,
  114:       kind: "topic_reteach",
  115:       priority: weakestTopic.averageScore < 30 ? "high" : "medium",
  116:       title: `Reteach ${weakestTopic.topic}`,
  117:       description: `Current class performance is ${weakestTopic.averageScore}%. Open the class Knowledge Map before assigning follow-up work.`,
  118:       href: `/teacher/knowledge-map?topic=${encodeURIComponent(
  119:         weakestTopic.topic,
  120:       )}&source=teacher-dashboard`,
  121:       actionLabel: "Open Knowledge Map",
  122:       topic: weakestTopic.topic,
  123:       metric: `${weakestTopic.averageScore}%`,
  124:     });
  125:   }
  126: 
  127:   if (
  128:     input.studentCount > 0 &&
  129:     input.assignmentCount > 0 &&
  130:     input.completionRate < 60
  131:   ) {
  132:     actions.push({
  133:       id: "completion-critical",
  134:       kind: "completion",
  135:       priority: input.completionRate < 40 ? "high" : "medium",
  136:       title: "Assignment completion requires attention",
  137:       description: `Overall completion is ${input.completionRate}%. Review outstanding work before drawing strong attainment conclusions.`,
  138:       href: "/teacher/assignments",
  139:       actionLabel: "Review assignments",
  140:       metric: `${input.completionRate}%`,
  141:     });
  142:   } else if (
  143:     input.studentCount > 0 &&
  144:     input.assignmentCount > 0 &&
  145:     input.completionRate < 80
  146:   ) {
  147:     actions.push({
  148:       id: "completion-monitor",
  149:       kind: "completion",
  150:       priority: "low",
  151:       title: "Monitor assignment completion",
  152:       description: `Completion is currently ${input.completionRate}%. A stronger completion rate will improve the quality of teacher analytics.`,
  153:       href: "/teacher/assignments",
  154:       actionLabel: "View assignments",
  155:       metric: `${input.completionRate}%`,
  156:     });
  157:   }
  158: 
  159:   if (
  160:     input.studentCount > 0 &&
  161:     input.averageScore > 0 &&
  162:     input.averageScore < 50
  163:   ) {
  164:     actions.push({
  165:       id: "class-attainment",
  166:       kind: "evidence",
  167:       priority: input.averageScore < 35 ? "high" : "medium",
  168:       title: "Class attainment is below the review threshold",
  169:       description: `The current dashboard average is ${input.averageScore}%. Use class analytics to separate topic gaps, student priorities and evidence-quality issues.`,
  170:       href: "/teacher/analytics",
  171:       actionLabel: "Open class analytics",
  172:       metric: `${input.averageScore}%`,
  173:     });
  174:   }
  175: 
  176:   if (input.activeAssignmentCount === 0 && input.studentCount > 0) {
  177:     actions.push({
  178:       id: "no-active-assignments",
  179:       kind: "assessment",
  180:       priority: "low",
  181:       title: "No active assignments",
  182:       description:
  183:         "Create a targeted task, quiz or written assessment when you need fresh evidence.",
  184:       href: "/teacher/assignment-wizard",
  185:       actionLabel: "Create assignment",
  186:     });
  187:   }
  188: 
  189:   if (input.studentCount > 0 && assessedTopics.length === 0) {
  190:     actions.push({
  191:       id: "limited-topic-evidence",
  192:       kind: "evidence",
  193:       priority: "medium",
  194:       title: "More assessed evidence is needed",
  195:       description:
  196:         "No topic-performance evidence is available yet. Assign assessed work before relying on class-level mastery decisions.",
  197:       href: "/teacher/assignment-wizard",
  198:       actionLabel: "Create assessed work",
  199:     });
  200:   }
  201: 
  202:   const sorted = uniqueActions(actions).sort((first, second) => {
  203:     const difference =
  204:       priorityRank[first.priority] - priorityRank[second.priority];
  205: 
  206:     return difference !== 0
  207:       ? difference
  208:       : first.title.localeCompare(second.title);
  209:   });
  210: 
  211:   const criticalCount = sorted.filter(
  212:     (action) => action.priority === "critical",
  213:   ).length;
  214:   const highCount = sorted.filter(
  215:     (action) => action.priority === "high",
  216:   ).length;
  217:   const mediumCount = sorted.filter(
  218:     (action) => action.priority === "medium",
  219:   ).length;
  220:   const lowCount = sorted.filter(
  221:     (action) => action.priority === "low",
  222:   ).length;
  223: 
  224:   const headline =
  225:     criticalCount > 0
  226:       ? `${criticalCount} urgent action${
  227:           criticalCount === 1 ? "" : "s"
  228:         } require teacher attention`
  229:       : highCount > 0
  230:         ? `${highCount} high-priority action${
  231:             highCount === 1 ? "" : "s"
  232:           } to review`
  233:         : mediumCount > 0
  234:           ? "Your next teaching actions are ready"
  235:           : sorted.length > 0
  236:             ? "No urgent issues â€” continue monitoring"
  237:             : "No immediate teacher actions detected";
  238: 
  239:   return {
  240:     criticalCount,
  241:     highCount,
  242:     mediumCount,
  243:     lowCount,
  244:     totalCount: sorted.length,
  245:     headline,
  246:     actions: sorted,
  247:   };
  248: }

   47: export async function getTeacherContentLibrary(

   59:   const resourceItems: TeacherContentItem[] = resources.map((resource) => ({

   68:       resource.yearGroup === "A Level" ||

   95:     kind: "exam-paper",

   97:     description: `${set.questionCount} original exam-style questions worth ${set.totalMarks} marks.`,
   98:     topic: set.topic,
   99:     qualification: set.qualification,
  100:     examBoard: set.examBoard,
  101:     yearGroup: "",
  102:     difficulty: set.difficulty,

  106:     createdAt: set.createdAt,

  118:     const lifecycle = normaliseLifecycle(data.status);

  126:       description: typeof data.description === "string" ? data.description : "",
  127:       topic: typeof data.topicId === "string" ? data.topicId : "",

  129:       examBoard: typeof data.examBoard === "string" ? data.examBoard : "",

  135:       totalMarks: null,
  136:       createdAt: timestampToDate(data.createdAt),
  137:       updatedAt: timestampToDate(data.updatedAt),
  138:       openHref: `/teacher/quiz-library/${quizDocument.id}`,
  139:       assignHref:
  140:         lifecycle === "published"

  142:           : null,

  144:   });
  145: 
  146:   return [...resourceItems, ...quizItems, ...examItems].sort(
  147:     (a, b) =>
  148:       (b.updatedAt ?? b.createdAt ?? new Date(0)).getTime() -
  149:       (a.updatedAt ?? a.createdAt ?? new Date(0)).getTime(),

  173: export async function duplicateTeacherContent(
  174:   item: TeacherContentItem,
  175:   teacherId: string,
  176: ): Promise<string> {
  177:   const id = teacherId.trim();
  178:   if (!id) throw new Error("A teacher account is required.");
  179: 
  180:   if (item.kind === "teaching-resource") {
  181:     return duplicateTeacherResource(item.id, id);
  182:   }
  183: 
  184:   if (item.kind === "exam-paper") {
  185:     return duplicateExamQuestionSet(item.id, id);
  186:   }
  187: 
  188:   const snapshot = await getDocs(
  189:     query(collection(db, "generatedQuizzes"), where("teacherId", "==", id)),

  192:   if (!source) throw new Error("The quiz could not be found in your library.");
  193: 
  194:   const data = source.data();
  195:   const reference = await addDoc(collection(db, "generatedQuizzes"), {
  196:     ...data,
  197:     title: `${item.title} (Copy)`,
  198:     status: "draft",
  199:     createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
  200:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  201:   });
  202:   return reference.id;
  203: }
  204: 
  205: export async function deleteTeacherContent(item: TeacherContentItem): Promise<void> {
  206:   if (item.lifecycle !== "archived") {
  207:     throw new Error("Archive content before deleting it permanently.");
  208:   }
  209: 
  210:   if (item.kind === "teaching-resource") {
  211:     await deleteTeacherResource(item.id);
  212:     return;
  213:   }
  214: 
  215:   if (item.kind === "exam-paper") {
  216:     await deleteExamQuestionSet(item.id);
  217:     return;
  218:   }
  219: 
  220:   await deleteDoc(doc(db, "generatedQuizzes", item.id));
  221: }

    1: import type {

    7: type TeacherDashboardIntegrationInput = {

    9:   classCount: number;
   10:   assignmentCount: number;
   11:   activeAssignmentCount: number;
   12:   averageScore: number;
   13:   completionRate: number;
   14:   atRiskCount: number;

   17: function primaryFocus({
   18:   atRiskCount,
   19:   completionRate,
   20:   averageScore,
   21:   activeAssignmentCount,
   22: }: TeacherDashboardIntegrationInput): TeacherDashboardFocus {
   23:   if (atRiskCount > 0) return "student_support";
   24:   if (completionRate < 70) return "completion";
   25:   if (activeAssignmentCount === 0 || averageScore < 50) return "assessment";
   26:   return "monitoring";
   27: }
   28: 
   29: function headlineForFocus(focus: TeacherDashboardFocus): string {
   30:   if (focus === "student_support") return "Start with learners requiring support";
   31:   if (focus === "completion") return "Start with assignment completion";
   32:   if (focus === "assessment") return "Collect the next useful assessment evidence";
   33:   return "Review current evidence and keep the cycle moving";
   34: }
   35: 
   36: function summaryForFocus(focus: TeacherDashboardFocus): string {
   37:   if (focus === "student_support") {
   38:     return "Review the highest-priority learners first, then move into intervention planning or targeted reassessment.";
   39:   }
   40: 
   41:   if (focus === "completion") {
   42:     return "Outstanding work may be weakening the reliability of current attainment conclusions. Review completion before escalating curriculum concerns.";
   43:   }
   44: 
   45:   if (focus === "assessment") {
   46:     return "Use the assessment tools to collect stronger evidence, then return to analytics and reports to interpret the results.";
   47:   }
   48: 
   49:   return "The dashboard is in a monitoring state. Use analytics, reports and the assessment centre to maintain the review cycle.";
   50: }
   51: 
   52: export function buildTeacherDashboardIntegration(
   53:   input: TeacherDashboardIntegrationInput,
   54: ): TeacherDashboardIntegration {
   55:   const focus = primaryFocus(input);
   56: 
   57:   const signals: TeacherDashboardSignal[] = [
   58:     {
   59:       id: "support",
   60:       label: "Learners requiring support",
   61:       value: String(input.atRiskCount),
   62:       detail:
   63:         input.atRiskCount > 0
   64:           ? "Open the priority workflow before assigning broad follow-up work."
   65:           : "No current dashboard intervention alerts.",
   66:       focus: "student_support",
   67:       href: "#teacher-actions",
   68:       actionLabel: "Review actions",
   69:       severity: input.atRiskCount > 0 ? "high" : "positive",
   70:     },
   71:     {
   72:       id: "completion",
   73:       label: "Assignment completion",
   74:       value: `${input.completionRate}%`,
   75:       detail:
   76:         input.completionRate < 70
   77:           ? "Completion is low enough to affect confidence in the current evidence picture."
   78:           : "Completion is currently supporting a usable evidence picture.",
   79:       focus: "completion",
   80:       href: "/teacher/assignments",
   81:       actionLabel: "Review assignments",
   82:       severity:
   83:         input.completionRate < 50
   84:           ? "high"
   85:           : input.completionRate < 70
   86:             ? "medium"
   87:             : "positive",
   88:     },
   89:     {
   90:       id: "attainment",
   91:       label: "Current average",
   92:       value: `${input.averageScore}%`,
   93:       detail:
   94:         input.averageScore < 50
   95:           ? "Use class analytics to separate curriculum gaps from individual learner issues."
   96:           : "Review class analytics for topic-level strengths and weaknesses.",
   97:       focus: "monitoring",
   98:       href: "/teacher/analytics",
   99:       actionLabel: "Open analytics",
  100:       severity:
  101:         input.averageScore < 40
  102:           ? "high"
  103:           : input.averageScore < 60
  104:             ? "medium"
  105:             : "positive",
  106:     },
  107:     {
  108:       id: "assessment",
  109:       label: "Active assignments",
  110:       value: String(input.activeAssignmentCount),
  111:       detail: `${input.assignmentCount} total assignment${
  112:         input.assignmentCount === 1 ? "" : "s"
  113:       } across ${input.classCount} class${
  114:         input.classCount === 1 ? "" : "es"
  115:       } and ${input.studentCount} learner${
  116:         input.studentCount === 1 ? "" : "s"
  117:       }.`,
  118:       focus: "assessment",
  119:       href: "#assessment-centre",
  120:       actionLabel: "Assessment centre",
  121:       severity: input.activeAssignmentCount === 0 ? "medium" : "low",
  122:     },
  123:   ];
  124: 
  125:   return {
  126:     headline: headlineForFocus(focus),
  127:     summary: summaryForFocus(focus),
  128:     primaryFocus: focus,
  129:     signals,
  130:   };
  131: }

  150: function safeNumber(value: unknown): number {
  151:   return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
  152: }
  153: 
  154: function safeString(value: unknown, fallback = ""): string {
  155:   return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value.trim() : fallback;
  156: }
  157: 
  158: function safeStringArray(value: unknown): string[] {
  159:   return Array.isArray(value)
  160:     ? value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === "string")
  161:     : [];
  162: }
  163: 
  164: function formatActivityTime(timestamp?: Timestamp): string {
  165:   if (!timestamp) {
  166:     return "Recently";
  167:   }
  168: 
  169:   const activityDate = timestamp.toDate();
  170: 
  171:   const difference = Date.now() - activityDate.getTime();
  172: 
  173:   const minutes = Math.floor(difference / 60000);
  174: 
  175:   if (minutes < 1) {
  176:     return "Just now";
  177:   }
  178: 
  179:   if (minutes < 60) {
  180:     return `${minutes} minute${minutes === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
  181:   }
  182: 
  183:   const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  184: 
  185:   if (hours < 24) {
  186:     return `${hours} hour${hours === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
  187:   }
  188: 
  189:   const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  190: 
  191:   return `${days} day${days === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
  192: }
  193: 
  194: function isToday(timestamp?: Timestamp): boolean {
  195:   if (!timestamp) {
  196:     return false;
  197:   }
  198: 
  199:   const date = timestamp.toDate();
  200: 
  201:   const today = new Date();
  202: 
  203:   return (
  204:     date.getFullYear() === today.getFullYear() &&
  205:     date.getMonth() === today.getMonth() &&
  206:     date.getDate() === today.getDate()
  207:   );
  208: }
  209: 
  210: function calculateAverage(values: number[]): number {
  211:   if (values.length === 0) {
  212:     return 0;
  213:   }
  214: 
  215:   return Math.round(
  216:     values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / values.length,
  217:   );
  218: }
  219: 
  220: export async function getTeacherDashboardData(
  221:   teacherId: string,
  222: ): Promise<TeacherDashboardData> {
  223:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
  224: 
  225:   if (!cleanedTeacherId) {
  226:     return emptyTeacherDashboardData;
  227:   }
  228: 
  229:   const [
  230:     classesSnapshot,
  231:     assignmentsSnapshot,
  232:     assignmentResultsSnapshot,
  233:     resourceAssignmentsSnapshot,
  234:     examAssignmentsSnapshot,
  235:     examSubmissionsSnapshot,
  236:   ] = await Promise.all([
  237:     getDocs(
  238:       query(
  239:         collection(db, "classes"),
  240:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  241:       ),
  242:     ),
  243: 
  244:     getDocs(
  245:       query(
  246:         collection(db, "assignments"),
  247:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  248:       ),
  249:     ),
  250: 
  251:     getDocs(
  252:       query(
  253:         collection(db, "assignmentResults"),
  254:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  255:       ),
  256:     ),
  257: 
  258:     getDocs(
  259:       query(
  260:         collection(db, "classAssignments"),
  261:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  262:       ),
  263:     ),
  264: 
  265:     getDocs(
  266:       query(
  267:         collection(db, "examAssignments"),
  268:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  269:       ),
  270:     ),
  271: 
  272:     getDocs(
  273:       query(
  274:         collection(db, "examSubmissions"),
  275:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  276:       ),
  277:     ),
  278:   ]);
  279: 
  280:   /*
  281:    * DATA ISOLATION:
  282:    *
  283:    * A teacher's dashboard must be built only from students explicitly
  284:    * enrolled in classes owned by that teacher.
  285:    *
  286:    * Never fall back to every platform student when a teacher has no classes.
  287:    * That would expose another teacher's learners and evidence.
  288:    */
  289:   const teacherStudentIds = new Set<string>();
  290: 
  291:   classesSnapshot.docs.forEach((classDocument) => {
  292:     const data = classDocument.data();
  293: 
  294:     safeStringArray(data.studentIds).forEach((studentId) => {
  295:       teacherStudentIds.add(studentId);
  296:     });
  297:   });
  298: 
  299:   const studentSnapshots = await Promise.all(
  300:     Array.from(teacherStudentIds).map((studentId) =>
  301:       getDoc(doc(db, "users", studentId)),
  302:     ),
  303:   );
  304: 
  305:   const relevantStudents: UserRecord[] = studentSnapshots
  306:     .filter((studentSnapshot) => studentSnapshot.exists())
  307:     .map((studentSnapshot) => {
  308:       const data = studentSnapshot.data();
  309: 
  310:       return {
  311:         id: studentSnapshot.id,
  312:         name: safeString(data.name, "Student"),
  313:         role: safeString(data.role, "student"),
  314:         xp: safeNumber(data.xp),
  315:         streak: safeNumber(data.streak),
  316:         badges: safeStringArray(data.badges),
  317:         completedLessons: safeStringArray(data.completedLessons),
  318:       };
  319:     })
  320:     .filter((student) => student.role === "student");
  321: 
  322:   const relevantStudentIds = new Set(
  323:     relevantStudents.map((student) => student.id),
  324:   );
  325: 
  326:   /*
  327:    * Fetch quiz evidence only from students who belong to this teacher's
  328:    * classes. This avoids downloading platform-wide quiz results and then
  329:    * filtering them in the browser.
  330:    */
  331:   const quizResultSnapshots = await Promise.all(
  332:     Array.from(relevantStudentIds).map((studentId) =>
  333:       getDocs(collection(db, "users", studentId, "quizResults")),
  334:     ),
  335:   );
  336: 
  337:   const quizResultDocuments = quizResultSnapshots.flatMap(
  338:     (snapshot) => snapshot.docs,
  339:   );
  340: 
  341:   const assignments: AssignmentRecord[] = assignmentsSnapshot.docs.map(
  342:     (assignmentDocument) => {
  343:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  344: 
  345:       return {
  346:         id: assignmentDocument.id,
  347:         status: safeString(data.status, "active"),
  348:       };
  349:     },
  350:   );
  351: 
  352:   const resourceAssignments: ResourceAssignmentRecord[] =
  353:     resourceAssignmentsSnapshot.docs.map((assignmentDocument) => {
  354:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  355:       const studentIds = safeStringArray(data.studentIds).filter((studentId) =>
  356:         relevantStudentIds.has(studentId),
  357:       );
  358: 
  359:       const storedStudentCount = safeNumber(data.studentCount);
  360:       const storedCompletedCount = safeNumber(data.completedCount);
  361: 
  362:       return {
  363:         id: assignmentDocument.id,
  364:         status: safeString(data.status, "active"),
  365:         studentIds,
  366:         studentCount:
  367:           storedStudentCount > 0 ? storedStudentCount : studentIds.length,
  368:         completedCount: Math.min(
  369:           storedCompletedCount,
  370:           storedStudentCount > 0 ? storedStudentCount : studentIds.length,
  371:         ),
  372:       };
  373:     });
  374: 
  375:   /*
  376:    * Resource/lesson assignments store per-student completion in
  377:    * assignmentProgress/{assignmentId}_{studentId}.
  378:    *
  379:    * Read only the expected progress documents for this teacher's own
  380:    * assignments and currently enrolled learners. This keeps the dashboard
  381:    * isolated and lets Completed Today include lesson/resource completions.
  382:    */
  383:   const resourceProgressSnapshots = await Promise.all(
  384:     resourceAssignments.flatMap((assignment) =>
  385:       assignment.studentIds.map((studentId) =>
  386:         getDoc(
  387:           doc(
  388:             db,
  389:             "assignmentProgress",
  390:             `${assignment.id}_${studentId}`,
  391:           ),
  392:         ),
  393:       ),
  394:     ),
  395:   );
  396: 
  397:   const resourceAssignmentProgress: ResourceAssignmentProgressRecord[] =
  398:     resourceProgressSnapshots
  399:       .filter((progressSnapshot) => progressSnapshot.exists())
  400:       .map((progressSnapshot) => {
  401:         const data = progressSnapshot.data();
  402: 
  403:         return {
  404:           id: progressSnapshot.id,
  405:           assignmentId: safeString(data.assignmentId),
  406:           studentId: safeString(data.studentId),
  407:           status: safeString(data.status, "not_started"),
  408:           completedAt:
  409:             data.completedAt instanceof Timestamp
  410:               ? data.completedAt
  411:               : undefined,
  412:         };
  413:       })
  414:       .filter(
  415:         (progress) =>
  416:           relevantStudentIds.has(progress.studentId) &&
  417:           resourceAssignments.some(
  418:             (assignment) => assignment.id === progress.assignmentId,
  419:           ),
  420:       );
  421: 
  422:   const assignmentResults: AssignmentResultRecord[] =
  423:     assignmentResultsSnapshot.docs
  424:       .map((resultDocument) => {
  425:         const data = resultDocument.data();
  426: 
  427:         return {
  428:           id: resultDocument.id,
  429:           studentId: safeString(data.studentId),
  430:           assignmentId: safeString(data.assignmentId),
  431:           percentage: safeNumber(data.percentage),
  432:           status: safeString(data.status, "completed"),
  433:           completedAt:
  434:             data.completedAt instanceof Timestamp
  435:               ? data.completedAt
  436:               : undefined,
  437:         };
  438:       })
  439:       .filter((result) => relevantStudentIds.has(result.studentId));
  440: 
  441:   const quizResults: QuizResultRecord[] = quizResultDocuments
  442:     .map((resultDocument) => {
  443:       const data = resultDocument.data();
  444: 
  445:       return {
  446:         id: resultDocument.id,
  447:         uid: safeString(data.uid) || resultDocument.ref.parent.parent?.id || "",
  448:         studentName: safeString(data.studentName),
  449:         title: safeString(data.title, "Quiz"),
  450:         topicId: safeString(data.topicId, "Other"),
  451:         scorePercent: safeNumber(data.scorePercent),
  452:         createdAt:
  453:           data.createdAt instanceof Timestamp ? data.createdAt : undefined,
  454:       };
  455:     })
  456:     .filter(
  457:       (result) =>
  458:         Boolean(result.uid) &&
  459:         relevantStudentIds.has(result.uid),
  460:     );
  461: 
  462:   const examAssignments: ExamAssignmentRecord[] =
  463:     examAssignmentsSnapshot.docs.map((assignmentDocument) => {
  464:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  465: 
  466:       return {
  467:         id: assignmentDocument.id,
  468:         status: safeString(data.status, "active"),
  469:         studentIds: safeStringArray(data.studentIds),
  470:       };
  471:     });
  472: 
  473:   const examAssignmentIdSet = new Set(
  474:     examAssignments.map((assignment) => assignment.id),
  475:   );
  476: 
  477:   const examSubmissions: ExamSubmissionRecord[] = examSubmissionsSnapshot.docs
  478:     .map((submissionDocument) => {
  479:       const data = submissionDocument.data();
  480: 
  481:       return {
  482:         id: submissionDocument.id,
  483:         studentId: safeString(data.studentId),
  484:         studentName: safeString(data.studentName),
  485:         assignmentId: safeString(data.assignmentId),
  486:         status: safeString(data.status, "not_started"),
  487:         percentage: safeNumber(data.percentage),
  488:         topic: safeString(data.topic, "Written assessment"),
  489:         markedAt:
  490:           data.markedAt instanceof Timestamp ? data.markedAt : undefined,
  491:         submittedAt:
  492:           data.submittedAt instanceof Timestamp ? data.submittedAt : undefined,
  493:       };
  494:     })
  495:     .filter(
  496:       (submission) =>
  497:         relevantStudentIds.has(submission.studentId) &&
  498:         examAssignmentIdSet.has(submission.assignmentId),
  499:     );
  500: 
  501:   const markedExamSubmissions = examSubmissions.filter(
  502:     (submission) => submission.status === "marked",
  503:   );
  504: 
  505:   const awaitingMarkingCount = examSubmissions.filter(
  506:     (submission) =>
  507:       submission.status === "submitted" || submission.status === "marking",
  508:   ).length;
  509: 
  510:   const quizScores = quizResults.map((result) => result.scorePercent);
  511: 
  512:   const examScores = markedExamSubmissions.map(
  513:     (submission) => submission.percentage,
  514:   );
  515: 
  516:   const quizAverage = calculateAverage(quizScores);
  517: 
  518:   const examAverage = calculateAverage(examScores);
  519: 
  520:   const averageScore = calculateAverage([...quizScores, ...examScores]);
  521: 
  522:   const lessonsCompleted = relevantStudents.reduce(
  523:     (total, student) => total + student.completedLessons.length,
  524:     0,
  525:   );
  526: 
  527:   const expectedQuizSubmissions = assignments.length * relevantStudents.length;
  528: 
  529:   const expectedResourceCompletions = resourceAssignments.reduce(
  530:     (total, assignment) => total + assignment.studentCount,
  531:     0,
  532:   );
  533: 
  534:   const completedResourceCompletions = resourceAssignments.reduce(
  535:     (total, assignment) => total + assignment.completedCount,
  536:     0,
  537:   );
  538: 
  539:   const expectedExamSubmissions = examAssignments.reduce(
  540:     (total, assignment) =>
  541:       total +
  542:       assignment.studentIds.filter((studentId) =>
  543:         relevantStudentIds.has(studentId),
  544:       ).length,
  545:     0,
  546:   );
  547: 
  548:   const completedAssignmentResults = assignmentResults.filter(
  549:     (result) => result.status === "completed",
  550:   );
  551: 
  552:   const completedExamSubmissions = examSubmissions.filter(
  553:     (submission) => submission.status === "marked",
  554:   );
  555: 
  556:   const expectedSubmissions =
  557:     expectedQuizSubmissions +
  558:     expectedResourceCompletions +
  559:     expectedExamSubmissions;
  560: 
  561:   const completedSubmissions =
  562:     completedAssignmentResults.length +
  563:     completedResourceCompletions +
  564:     completedExamSubmissions.length;
  565: 
  566:   const completionRate =
  567:     expectedSubmissions > 0
  568:       ? Math.min(
  569:           100,
  570:           Math.round((completedSubmissions / expectedSubmissions) * 100),
  571:         )
  572:       : 0;
  573: 
  574:   const completedResourceProgressToday = resourceAssignmentProgress.filter(
  575:     (progress) =>
  576:       progress.status === "completed" &&
  577:       isToday(progress.completedAt),
  578:   ).length;
  579: 
  580:   const completedToday =
  581:     completedAssignmentResults.filter((result) => isToday(result.completedAt))
  582:       .length +
  583:     completedResourceProgressToday +
  584:     completedExamSubmissions.filter((submission) =>
  585:       isToday(submission.markedAt),
  586:     ).length;
  587: 
  588:   const topStudents: TopStudent[] = [...relevantStudents]
  589:     .sort((first, second) => second.xp - first.xp)
  590:     .slice(0, 5)
  591:     .map((student) => ({
  592:       id: student.id,
  593:       name: student.name,
  594:       xp: student.xp,
  595:       streak: student.streak,
  596:       badges: student.badges.length,
  597:     }));
  598: 
  599:   const quizActivities: RecentTeacherActivity[] = quizResults
  600:     .slice(0, 8)
  601:     .map((result) => {
  602:       const matchedStudent = relevantStudents.find(
  603:         (student) => student.id === result.uid,
  604:       );
  605: 
  606:       return {
  607:         id: `quiz-${result.id}`,
  608:         studentName: result.studentName || matchedStudent?.name || "Student",
  609:         activity: `Completed ${result.title}`,
  610:         result: `${result.scorePercent}%`,
  611:         time: formatActivityTime(result.createdAt),
  612:         type: "quiz" as const,
  613:       };
  614:     });
  615: 
  616:   const examActivities: RecentTeacherActivity[] = markedExamSubmissions.map(
  617:     (submission) => {
  618:       const matchedStudent = relevantStudents.find(
  619:         (student) => student.id === submission.studentId,
  620:       );
  621: 
  622:       return {
  623:         id: `exam-${submission.id}`,
  624:         studentName:
  625:           submission.studentName || matchedStudent?.name || "Student",
  626:         activity: "Completed written assessment",
  627:         result: `${submission.percentage}%`,
  628:         time: formatActivityTime(submission.markedAt || submission.submittedAt),
  629:         type: "exam" as const,
  630:       };
  631:     },
  632:   );
  633: 
  634:   const recentActivities = [...quizActivities, ...examActivities].slice(0, 8);
  635: 
  636:   const scoresByStudent = new Map<string, number[]>();
  637: 
  638:   quizResults.forEach((result) => {
  639:     if (!result.uid) {
  640:       return;
  641:     }
  642: 
  643:     const scores = scoresByStudent.get(result.uid) || [];
  644: 
  645:     scores.push(result.scorePercent);
  646: 
  647:     scoresByStudent.set(result.uid, scores);
  648:   });
  649: 
  650:   markedExamSubmissions.forEach((submission) => {
  651:     const scores = scoresByStudent.get(submission.studentId) || [];
  652: 
  653:     scores.push(submission.percentage);
  654: 
  655:     scoresByStudent.set(submission.studentId, scores);
  656:   });
  657: 
  658:   const atRiskStudents: AtRiskStudent[] = relevantStudents
  659:     .map((student) => {
  660:       const scores = scoresByStudent.get(student.id) || [];
  661: 
  662:       return {
  663:         id: student.id,
  664:         name: student.name,
  665:         weakTopic: "Combined Assessment Performance",
  666:         averageScore: calculateAverage(scores),
  667:         recommendedAction:
  668:           "Review quiz and written exam evidence, then assign targeted revision.",
  669:         hasResults: scores.length > 0,
  670:       };
  671:     })
  672:     .filter((student) => student.hasResults && student.averageScore < 50)
  673:     .sort((first, second) => first.averageScore - second.averageScore)
  674:     .slice(0, 5)
  675:     .map((student) => ({
  676:       id: student.id,
  677:       name: student.name,
  678:       weakTopic: student.weakTopic,
  679:       averageScore: student.averageScore,
  680:       recommendedAction: student.recommendedAction,
  681:     }));
  682: 
  683:   const topicGroups = new Map<string, number[]>();
  684: 
  685:   quizResults.forEach((result) => {
  686:     const topic = result.title || result.topicId || "Other";
  687: 
  688:     const scores = topicGroups.get(topic) || [];
  689: 
  690:     scores.push(result.scorePercent);
  691: 
  692:     topicGroups.set(topic, scores);
  693:   });
  694: 
  695:   markedExamSubmissions.forEach((submission) => {
  696:     const topic = submission.topic || "Written assessment";
  697: 
  698:     const scores = topicGroups.get(topic) || [];
  699: 
  700:     scores.push(submission.percentage);
  701: 
  702:     topicGroups.set(topic, scores);
  703:   });
  704: 
  705:   const classPerformance: TopicPerformance[] = Array.from(topicGroups.entries())
  706:     .map(([topic, scores], index) => ({
  707:       id: `topic-${index}`,
  708:       topic,
  709:       averageScore: calculateAverage(scores),
  710:     }))
  711:     .sort((first, second) => second.averageScore - first.averageScore);
  712: 
  713:   return {
  714:     studentCount: relevantStudents.length,
  715:     classCount: classesSnapshot.size,
  716:     assignmentCount:
  717:       assignments.length + resourceAssignments.length + examAssignments.length,
  718:     activeAssignmentCount:
  719:       assignments.filter((assignment) => assignment.status === "active")
  720:         .length +
  721:       resourceAssignments.filter((assignment) => assignment.status === "active")
  722:         .length +
  723:       examAssignments.filter((assignment) => assignment.status === "active")
  724:         .length,
  725:     examAssignmentCount: examAssignments.length,
  726:     awaitingMarkingCount,
  727:     averageScore,
  728:     quizAverage,
  729:     examAverage,
  730:     completionRate,
  731:     lessonsCompleted,
  732:     completedToday,
  733:     recentActivities,
  734:     atRiskStudents,
  735:     topStudents,
  736:     classPerformance,
  737:   };
  738: }

    1: import type {
    2:   InterventionPlanningGroup,
