    9: function normaliseTopic(value: string): string {
   10:   const cleaned = value.trim();
   11:   return cleaned || "Combined Assessment Performance";
   12: }
   13: 
   14: function average(values: number[]): number {
   15:   if (!values.length) return 0;
   16: 
   17:   return Math.round(
   18:     values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / values.length,
   19:   );
   20: }
   21: 
   22: function priorityForGroup({
   23:   averageScore,
   24:   lowestScore,
   25:   studentCount,
   26: }: {
   27:   averageScore: number;
   28:   lowestScore: number;
   29:   studentCount: number;
   30: }): InterventionPlanningPriority {
   31:   if (lowestScore < 30 || averageScore < 35 || studentCount >= 4) {
   32:     return "high";
   33:   }
   34: 
   35:   if (averageScore < 50 || studentCount >= 2) {
   36:     return "medium";
   37:   }
   38: 
   39:   return "monitor";
   40: }
   41: 
   42: function strategyForGroup({
   43:   averageScore,
   44:   lowestScore,
   45:   studentCount,
   46: }: {
   47:   averageScore: number;
   48:   lowestScore: number;
   49:   studentCount: number;
   50: }): InterventionStrategy {
   51:   if (lowestScore < 30 || averageScore < 35) {
   52:     return "reteach_then_reassess";
   53:   }
   54: 
   55:   if (averageScore < 50 || studentCount >= 2) {
   56:     return "targeted_practice";
   57:   }
   58: 
   59:   return "monitor_with_evidence";
   60: }
   61: 
   62: function rationaleForGroup({
   63:   topic,
   64:   averageScore,
   65:   lowestScore,
   66:   studentCount,
   67: }: {
   68:   topic: string;
   69:   averageScore: number;
   70:   lowestScore: number;
   71:   studentCount: number;
   72: }): string {
   73:   if (lowestScore < 30) {
   74:     return `${studentCount} learner${studentCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} need support in ${topic}; the lowest current score is ${lowestScore}%.`;
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   if (averageScore < 50) {
   78:     return `${topic} is a shared weakness for ${studentCount} learner${studentCount === 1 ? "" : "s"}, with an average of ${averageScore}%.`;
   79:   }
   80: 
   81:   return `${studentCount} learner${studentCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} have been flagged for monitoring in ${topic}.`;
   82: }
   83: 
   84: function evidenceCaution({
   85:   studentCount,
   86:   averageScore,
   87: }: {
   88:   studentCount: number;
   89:   averageScore: number;
   90: }): string {
   91:   if (studentCount === 1) {
   92:     return "This is an individual signal rather than a class-wide pattern. Review the learner's underlying evidence before changing whole-class teaching.";
   93:   }
   94: 
   95:   if (studentCount < 3) {
   96:     return "This is a small support cohort. Check whether the weakness is repeated across more than one assessed activity.";
   97:   }
   98: 
   99:   if (averageScore < 35) {
  100:     return "The group signal is strong, but the teacher should still review question-level and topic evidence before deciding the intervention.";
  101:   }
  102: 
  103:   return "Use this grouping as a planning aid and confirm it against recent assessment evidence.";
  104: }
  105: 
  106: function stepsForStrategy(
  107:   strategy: InterventionStrategy,
  108:   topic: string,
  109: ) {
  110:   if (strategy === "reteach_then_reassess") {
  111:     return [
  112:       {
  113:         id: "review",
  114:         order: 1,
  115:         label: "Review evidence",
  116:         description: `Check the Knowledge Map and recent assessment evidence for ${topic}.`,
  117:       },
  118:       {
  119:         id: "reteach",
  120:         order: 2,
  121:         label: "Reteach",
  122:         description: `Deliver a focused explanation, worked example or misconception check for ${topic}.`,
  123:       },
  124:       {
  125:         id: "reassess",
  126:         order: 3,
  127:         label: "Reassess",
  128:         description: `Assign a short targeted task or written reassessment on ${topic}.`,
  129:       },
  130:       {
  131:         id: "impact",
  132:         order: 4,
  133:         label: "Review impact",
  134:         description:
  135:           "Use the Intervention Centre to compare new evidence against the baseline.",
  136:       },
  137:     ];
  138:   }
  139: 
  140:   if (strategy === "targeted_practice") {
  141:     return [
  142:       {
  143:         id: "review",
  144:         order: 1,
  145:         label: "Check evidence",
  146:         description: `Confirm the recurring gap in ${topic}.`,
  147:       },
  148:       {
  149:         id: "practice",
  150:         order: 2,
  151:         label: "Targeted practice",
  152:         description: `Assign focused practice that isolates ${topic}.`,
  153:       },
  154:       {
  155:         id: "check",
  156:         order: 3,
  157:         label: "Check improvement",
  158:         description:
  159:           "Review the next graded evidence before escalating support.",
  160:       },
  161:     ];
  162:   }
  163: 
  164:   return [
  165:     {
  166:       id: "monitor",
  167:       order: 1,
  168:       label: "Monitor",
  169:       description: `Collect another piece of assessed evidence for ${topic}.`,
  170:     },
  171:     {
  172:       id: "review",
  173:       order: 2,
  174:       label: "Review trend",
  175:       description:
  176:         "Only create a formal intervention if the weakness is repeated or worsens.",
  177:     },
  178:   ];
  179: }

  181: function groupQuery(
  182:   students: InterventionPlanningStudent[],
  183: ): string {
  184:   const ids = students
  185:     .map((student) => student.id)
  186:     .filter(Boolean)
  187:     .join(",");
  188: 
  189:   const names = students
  190:     .map((student) => student.name)
  191:     .filter(Boolean)
  192:     .join(",");
  193: 
  194:   return `studentIds=${encodeURIComponent(ids)}&studentNames=${encodeURIComponent(names)}`;
  195: }
  196: 
  197: export function buildTeacherInterventionPlan(
  198:   students: InterventionPlanningStudent[],
  199: ): TeacherInterventionPlan {
  200:   const grouped = new Map<string, InterventionPlanningStudent[]>();
  201: 
  202:   students.forEach((student) => {
  203:     const topic = normaliseTopic(student.weakTopic);
  204:     const current = grouped.get(topic) || [];
  205: 
  206:     current.push({
  207:       ...student,
  208:       weakTopic: topic,
  209:     });
  210: 
  211:     grouped.set(topic, current);
  212:   });
  213: 
  214:   const groups: InterventionPlanningGroup[] = Array.from(grouped.entries())
  215:     .map(([topic, members]) => {
  216:       const scores = members.map((student) => student.averageScore);
  217:       const averageScore = average(scores);
  218:       const lowestScore = scores.length ? Math.min(...scores) : 0;
  219:       const priority = priorityForGroup({
  220:         averageScore,
  221:         lowestScore,
  222:         studentCount: members.length,
  223:       });
  224:       const strategy = strategyForGroup({
  225:         averageScore,
  226:         lowestScore,
  227:         studentCount: members.length,
  228:       });
  229:       const cohort = groupQuery(members);
  230: 
  231:       return {
  232:         id:
  233:           topic
  234:             .toLowerCase()
  235:             .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
  236:             .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "") || "support-group",
  237:         topic,
  238:         studentCount: members.length,
  239:         students: [...members].sort(
  240:           (first, second) => first.averageScore - second.averageScore,
  241:         ),
  242:         averageScore,
  243:         lowestScore,
  244:         priority,
  245:         strategy,
  246:         rationale: rationaleForGroup({
  247:           topic,
  248:           averageScore,
  249:           lowestScore,
  250:           studentCount: members.length,
  251:         }),
  252:         evidenceCaution: evidenceCaution({
  253:           studentCount: members.length,
  254:           averageScore,
  255:         }),
  256:         steps: stepsForStrategy(strategy, topic),
  257:         knowledgeMapHref:
  258:           `/teacher/knowledge-map?topic=${encodeURIComponent(topic)}` +
  259:           `&source=intervention-cohort&${cohort}`,
  260:         assignmentHref:
  261:           `/teacher/assignment-wizard?topic=${encodeURIComponent(topic)}` +
  262:           `&source=intervention-cohort&mode=targeted-reassessment&${cohort}`,
  263:         interventionHref:
  264:           `/teacher/interventions?topic=${encodeURIComponent(topic)}` +
  265:           `&source=intervention-cohort&${cohort}`,
  266:       };
  267:     })
  268:     .sort((first, second) => {
  269:       const priorityRank = {
  270:         high: 0,
  271:         medium: 1,
  272:         monitor: 2,
  273:       };
  274: 
  275:       const difference =
  276:         priorityRank[first.priority] - priorityRank[second.priority];
  277: 
  278:       if (difference !== 0) return difference;
  279: 
  280:       if (first.averageScore !== second.averageScore) {
  281:         return first.averageScore - second.averageScore;
  282:       }
  283: 
  284:       return second.studentCount - first.studentCount;
  285:     });
  286: 
  287:   return {
  288:     totalStudentsRequiringSupport: students.length,
  289:     highPriorityGroups: groups.filter((group) => group.priority === "high")
  290:       .length,
  291:     groupedTopics: groups.length,
  292:     averageAtRiskScore: average(
  293:       students.map((student) => student.averageScore),
  294:     ),
  295:     groups,
  296:   };
  297: }

  118: function convertDate(value: FirestoreDate): Date | null {
  119:   if (!value) return null;
  120:   if (value instanceof Date) return value;
  121:   if (value instanceof Timestamp) return value.toDate();
  122: 
  123:   if (typeof value === "string") {
  124:     const parsed = new Date(value);
  125:     return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? null : parsed;
  126:   }
  127: 
  128:   return null;
  129: }

  143: function normaliseIncident(
  144:   value: FirestoreIntegrityIncident,
  145: ): TeacherQuizIntegrityIncident {
  146:   const allowedTypes = new Set<QuizIntegrityIncidentType>([
  147:     "fullscreen_exit",
  148:     "fullscreen_restored",
  149:     "page_hidden",
  150:     "page_visible",
  151:     "auto_submit",
  152:   ]);
  153: 
  154:   const type =
  155:     typeof value.type === "string" &&
  156:     allowedTypes.has(value.type as QuizIntegrityIncidentType)
  157:       ? (value.type as QuizIntegrityIncidentType)
  158:       : "page_hidden";
  159: 
  160:   return {
  161:     id: typeof value.id === "string" ? value.id : "incident",
  162:     type,
  163:     occurredAt: convertDate(value.occurredAt as FirestoreDate),
  164:     questionNumber:
  165:       typeof value.questionNumber === "number" &&
  166:       Number.isFinite(value.questionNumber)
  167:         ? value.questionNumber
  168:         : null,
  169:     detail: typeof value.detail === "string" ? value.detail : "Integrity event recorded.",
  170:   };
  171: }

  173: function calculateCompletionPercentage(completedCount: number, studentCount: number) {
  174:   return studentCount <= 0 ? 0 : Math.round((completedCount / studentCount) * 100);
  175: }
  176: 
  177: function calculateAveragePercentage(results: FirestoreResult[]) {
  178:   if (results.length === 0) return 0;
  179:   return Math.round(
  180:     results.reduce((sum, result) => sum + safeNumber(result.percentage), 0) /
  181:       results.length,
  182:   );
  183: }
  184: 
  185: async function getQuizAssignmentResults(
  186:   assignmentId: string,
  187:   teacherId: string,
  188: ): Promise<FirestoreResult[]> {
  189:   const cleanedAssignmentId = assignmentId.trim();
  190:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
  191: 
  192:   if (!cleanedAssignmentId || !cleanedTeacherId) return [];
  193: 
  194:   const snapshot = await getDocs(
  195:     query(
  196:       collection(db, "assignmentResults"),
  197:       where("assignmentId", "==", cleanedAssignmentId),
  198:       where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  199:     ),
  200:   );
  201: 
  202:   return snapshot.docs
  203:     .map((document) => document.data() as FirestoreResult)
  204:     .filter(
  205:       (result) =>
  206:         result.assignmentType === "quiz" &&
  207:         result.status === "completed" &&
  208:         result.teacherId === cleanedTeacherId &&
  209:         result.assignmentId === cleanedAssignmentId,
  210:     );
  211: }
  212: 
  213: async function getClassInformation(classId: string): Promise<{
  214:   className: string;
  215:   studentIds: string[];
  216: }> {
  217:   const cleanedClassId = classId.trim();
  218: 
  219:   if (!cleanedClassId) {
  220:     return { className: "Unknown class", studentIds: [] };
  221:   }
  222: 
  223:   const snapshot = await getDoc(doc(db, "classes", cleanedClassId));
  224: 
  225:   if (!snapshot.exists()) {
  226:     return { className: "Unknown class", studentIds: [] };
  227:   }
  228: 
  229:   const data = snapshot.data();
  230:   const studentIds = Array.isArray(data.studentIds)
  231:     ? data.studentIds.filter(
  232:         (value): value is string => typeof value === "string" && Boolean(value.trim()),
  233:       )
  234:     : [];
  235: 
  236:   return {
  237:     className:
  238:       typeof data.name === "string" && data.name.trim()
  239:         ? data.name
  240:         : "Untitled class",
  241:     studentIds: Array.from(new Set(studentIds.map((id) => id.trim()))),
  242:   };
  243: }

  245: export async function getTeacherQuizAssignments(
  246:   teacherId: string,
  247: ): Promise<TeacherQuizAssignmentSummary[]> {
  248:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
  249:   if (!cleanedTeacherId) return [];
  250: 
  251:   const assignmentsSnapshot = await getDocs(
  252:     query(collection(db, "assignments"), where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId)),
  253:   );
  254: 
  255:   const quizDocuments = assignmentsSnapshot.docs.filter((document) => {
  256:     const data = document.data();
  257:     return data.type === "quiz" && data.teacherId === cleanedTeacherId;
  258:   });
  259: 
  260:   const summaries = await Promise.all(
  261:     quizDocuments.map(async (assignmentDocument) => {
  262:       const assignment = assignmentDocument.data() as FirestoreAssignment;
  263:       const classId = assignment.classId || "";
  264:       const [classInformation, results] = await Promise.all([
  265:         getClassInformation(classId),
  266:         getQuizAssignmentResults(assignmentDocument.id, cleanedTeacherId),
  267:       ]);
  268: 
  269:       const completedCount = new Set(
  270:         results.map((result) => result.studentId || "").filter(Boolean),
  271:       ).size;
  272: 
  273:       return {
  274:         id: assignmentDocument.id,
  275:         teacherId: assignment.teacherId || "",
  276:         classId,
  277:         className: classInformation.className,
  278:         title: assignment.title || "Untitled Quiz",
  279:         description: assignment.description || "",
  280:         resourceId: assignment.resourceId || "",
  281:         dueDate: convertDate(assignment.dueDate),
  282:         createdAt: convertDate(assignment.createdAt),
  283:         status: normaliseStatus(assignment.status),
  284:         deliveryMode: normaliseDeliveryMode(assignment.deliveryMode),
  285:         studentCount: classInformation.studentIds.length,
  286:         completedCount,
  287:         completionPercentage: calculateCompletionPercentage(
  288:           completedCount,
  289:           classInformation.studentIds.length,
  290:         ),
  291:         averagePercentage: calculateAveragePercentage(results),
  292:         integrityTerminatedCount: results.filter(
  293:           (result) => result.integrityTerminated === true,
  294:         ).length,
  295:       } satisfies TeacherQuizAssignmentSummary;
  296:     }),
  297:   );
  298: 
  299:   return summaries.sort(
  300:     (a, b) => (b.createdAt?.getTime() ?? 0) - (a.createdAt?.getTime() ?? 0),
  301:   );
  302: }
  303: 
  304: export async function getTeacherQuizAssignmentDetail(
  305:   assignmentId: string,
  306:   teacherId: string,
  307: ): Promise<TeacherQuizAssignmentDetail | null> {
  308:   const cleanedAssignmentId = assignmentId.trim();
  309:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
  310: 
  311:   if (!cleanedAssignmentId || !cleanedTeacherId) return null;
  312: 
  313:   const assignmentSnapshot = await getDoc(
  314:     doc(db, "assignments", cleanedAssignmentId),
  315:   );
  316: 
  317:   if (!assignmentSnapshot.exists()) return null;
  318: 
  319:   const assignment = assignmentSnapshot.data() as FirestoreAssignment;
  320: 
  321:   if (assignment.type !== "quiz" || assignment.teacherId !== cleanedTeacherId) {
  322:     return null;
  323:   }
  324: 
  325:   const classId = assignment.classId || "";
  326:   const [classInformation, results] = await Promise.all([
  327:     getClassInformation(classId),
  328:     getQuizAssignmentResults(cleanedAssignmentId, cleanedTeacherId),
  329:   ]);
  330: 
  331:   const resultByStudentId = new Map<string, FirestoreResult>();
  332:   results.forEach((result) => {
  333:     if (result.studentId) resultByStudentId.set(result.studentId, result);
  334:   });
  335: 
  336:   const students = await Promise.all(
  337:     classInformation.studentIds.map(async (studentId) => {
  338:       const profileSnapshot = await getDoc(doc(db, "users", studentId));
  339:       const profile = profileSnapshot.exists() ? profileSnapshot.data() : null;
  340:       const result = resultByStudentId.get(studentId);
  341: 
  342:       return {
  343:         studentId,
  344:         studentName:
  345:           typeof profile?.name === "string" && profile.name.trim()
  346:             ? profile.name
  347:             : "Student",
  348:         studentEmail:
  349:           typeof profile?.email === "string" && profile.email.trim()
  350:             ? profile.email
  351:             : "No email available",
  352:         status: result ? "completed" : "not_started",
  353:         score: safeNumber(result?.score),
  354:         totalQuestions: safeNumber(result?.totalQuestions),
  355:         percentage: safeNumber(result?.percentage),
  356: 
  357:         /*
  358:          * Integrity-terminated assessments never surface XP in the markbook.
  359:          * This also corrects older records created before the zero-XP rule
  360:          * was enforced at write time.
  361:          */
  362:         earnedXP:
  363:           result?.integrityTerminated === true
  364:             ? 0
  365:             : safeNumber(result?.earnedXP),
  366: 
  367:         timeTakenSeconds: safeNumber(result?.timeTakenSeconds),
  368:         completedAt: convertDate(result?.completedAt),
  369:         deliveryMode: normaliseDeliveryMode(result?.deliveryMode ?? assignment.deliveryMode),
  370:         integritySessionStartedAt: convertDate(result?.integritySessionStartedAt),
  371:         integrityIncidents: Array.isArray(result?.integrityIncidents)
  372:           ? result.integrityIncidents.map(normaliseIncident)
  373:           : [],
  374:         integrityTerminated: result?.integrityTerminated === true,
  375:         integrityTerminationReason:
  376:           typeof result?.integrityTerminationReason === "string"
  377:             ? result.integrityTerminationReason
  378:             : "",
  379:       } satisfies TeacherQuizStudentResult;
  380:     }),
  381:   );
  382: 
  383:   students.sort((a, b) => a.studentName.localeCompare(b.studentName));
  384: 
  385:   const completedCount = students.filter((student) => student.status === "completed").length;
  386:   const studentCount = students.length;
  387: 
  388:   return {
  389:     assignment: {
  390:       id: assignmentSnapshot.id,
  391:       teacherId: assignment.teacherId || "",
  392:       classId,
  393:       className: classInformation.className,
  394:       title: assignment.title || "Untitled Quiz",
  395:       description: assignment.description || "",
  396:       resourceId: assignment.resourceId || "",
  397:       dueDate: convertDate(assignment.dueDate),
  398:       createdAt: convertDate(assignment.createdAt),
  399:       status: normaliseStatus(assignment.status),
  400:       deliveryMode: normaliseDeliveryMode(assignment.deliveryMode),
  401:       studentCount,
  402:       completedCount,
  403:       completionPercentage: calculateCompletionPercentage(completedCount, studentCount),
  404:       averagePercentage: calculateAveragePercentage(results),
  405:       integrityTerminatedCount: students.filter((student) => student.integrityTerminated).length,
  406:     },
  407:     students,
  408:   };
  409: }

   27:     | "pending"

   32: async function findExistingRequest(
   33:   userId: string,
   34: ): Promise<ExistingTeacherRequest | null> {
   35:   const snapshot = await getDocs(
   36:     query(
   37:       collection(
   38:         db,
   39:         "teacherRequests",
   40:       ),
   41:       where(
   42:         "userId",
   43:         "==",
   44:         userId,
   45:       ),
   46:       limit(10),
   47:     ),
   48:   );
   49: 
   50:   if (snapshot.empty) {
   51:     return null;
   52:   }
   53: 
   54:   const requests =
   55:     snapshot.docs.map(
   56:       (requestDocument) => {
   57:         const data =
   58:           requestDocument.data();
   59: 
   60:         const status =
   61:           data.status === "approved" ||
   62:           data.status === "rejected"
   63:             ? data.status
   64:             : "pending";
   65: 
   66:         return {
   67:           id: requestDocument.id,
   68:           status,
   69:         } satisfies ExistingTeacherRequest;
   70:       },
   71:     );
   72: 
   73:   return (
   74:     requests.find(
   75:       (request) =>
   76:         request.status === "pending",
   77:     ) ||
   78:     requests.find(
   79:       (request) =>
   80:         request.status === "approved",
   81:     ) ||
   82:     requests[0] ||
   83:     null
   84:   );
   85: }

   87: export async function createTeacherRequest({
   88:   userId,
   89:   name,
   90:   email,
   91:   schoolName,
   92:   jobTitle,
   93:   message,
   94: }: CreateTeacherRequestInput): Promise<string> {
   95:   const cleanedUserId =
   96:     userId.trim();
   97: 
   98:   const cleanedName =
   99:     name.trim();
  100: 
  101:   const cleanedEmail =
  102:     email.trim().toLowerCase();
  103: 
  104:   const cleanedSchool =
  105:     schoolName.trim();
  106: 
  107:   const cleanedJobTitle =
  108:     jobTitle.trim();
  109: 
  110:   if (
  111:     !cleanedUserId ||
  112:     !cleanedName ||
  113:     !cleanedSchool ||
  114:     !cleanedJobTitle
  115:   ) {
  116:     throw new Error(
  117:       "Please complete all required fields.",
  118:     );
  119:   }
  120: 
  121:   const existing =
  122:     await findExistingRequest(
  123:       cleanedUserId,
  124:     );
  125: 
  126:   if (
  127:     existing?.status === "pending"
  128:   ) {
  129:     await setDoc(
  130:       doc(
  131:         db,
  132:         "users",
  133:         cleanedUserId,
  134:       ),
  135:       {
  136:         accountIntent: "teacher",
  137:         teacherAccessStatus:
  138:           "pending",
  139:         updatedAt:
  140:           serverTimestamp(),
  141:       },
  142:       {
  143:         merge: true,
  144:       },
  145:     );
  146: 
  147:     return existing.id;
  148:   }
  149: 
  150:   if (
  151:     existing?.status === "approved"
  152:   ) {
  153:     throw new Error(
  154:       "Teacher access has already been approved for this account.",
  155:     );
  156:   }
  157: 
  158:   const requestReference =
  159:     await addDoc(
  160:       collection(
  161:         db,
  162:         "teacherRequests",
  163:       ),
  164:       {
  165:         userId: cleanedUserId,
  166:         name: cleanedName,
  167:         email: cleanedEmail,
  168:         schoolName:
  169:           cleanedSchool,
  170:         jobTitle:
  171:           cleanedJobTitle,
  172:         message:
  173:           message.trim(),
  174: 
  175:         status: "pending",
  176: 
  177:         createdAt:
  178:           serverTimestamp(),
  179: 
  180:         updatedAt:
  181:           serverTimestamp(),
  182:       },
  183:     );
  184: 
  185:   await setDoc(
  186:     doc(
  187:       db,
  188:       "users",
  189:       cleanedUserId,
  190:     ),
  191:     {
  192:       accountIntent: "teacher",
  193: 
  194:       teacherAccessStatus:
  195:         "pending",
  196: 
  197:       updatedAt:
  198:         serverTimestamp(),
  199:     },
  200:     {
  201:       merge: true,
  202:     },
  203:   );
  204: 
  205:   return requestReference.id;
  206: }

  189: export async function saveTeacherResource(
  190:   teacherId: string,
  191:   resource:
  192:     GeneratedTeachingResource,
  193: ): Promise<string> {
  194:   const signedInTeacherId =
  195:     requireSignedInTeacherId();
  196: 
  197:   const cleanedTeacherId =
  198:     teacherId.trim();
  199: 
  200:   if (!cleanedTeacherId) {
  201:     throw new Error(
  202:       "A signed-in teacher is required to save this resource.",
  203:     );
  204:   }
  205: 
  206:   /*
  207:    * Prevent a caller from saving a resource under
  208:    * another teacher's UID.
  209:    */
  210:   if (
  211:     cleanedTeacherId !==
  212:     signedInTeacherId
  213:   ) {
  214:     throw new Error(
  215:       "You cannot save a resource for another teacher account.",
  216:     );
  217:   }
  218: 
  219:   const existingQuery = query(
  220:     collection(
  221:       db,
  222:       COLLECTION_NAME,
  223:     ),
  224:     where(
  225:       "teacherId",
  226:       "==",
  227:       signedInTeacherId,
  228:     ),
  229:     where(
  230:       "sourceResourceId",
  231:       "==",
  232:       resource.id,
  233:     ),
  234:   );
  235: 
  236:   const existingSnapshot =
  237:     await getDocs(
  238:       existingQuery,
  239:     );
  240: 
  241:   if (
  242:     !existingSnapshot.empty
  243:   ) {
  244:     throw new Error(
  245:       "This resource has already been saved to your library.",
  246:     );
  247:   }
  248: 
  249:   const documentReference =
  250:     await addDoc(
  251:       collection(
  252:         db,
  253:         COLLECTION_NAME,
  254:       ),
  255:       {
  256:         teacherId:
  257:           signedInTeacherId,
  258: 
  259:         sourceResourceId:
  260:           resource.id,
  261: 
  262:         title:
  263:           resource.title,
  264: 
  265:         topic:
  266:           resource.topic,
  267: 
  268:         resourceType:
  269:           resource.resourceType,
  270: 
  271:         yearGroup:
  272:           resource.yearGroup,
  273: 
  274:         examBoard:
  275:           resource.examBoard,
  276: 
  277:         duration:
  278:           resource.duration,
  279: 
  280:         difficulty:
  281:           resource.difficulty,
  282: 
  283:         content:
  284:           resource,
  285: 
  286:         status:
  287:           "draft",
  288: 
  289:         createdAt:
  290:           serverTimestamp(),
  291: 
  292:         updatedAt:
  293:           serverTimestamp(),
  294:       },
  295:     );

  297:   return documentReference.id;
  298: }

  300: export async function getTeacherResources(

  333:       ),
  334:       where(
  335:         "teacherId",
  336:         "==",
  337:         signedInTeacherId,
  338:       ),
  339:       orderBy(
  340:         "createdAt",
  341:         "desc",
  342:       ),
  343:     );
  344: 
  345:   const snapshot =
  346:     await getDocs(
  347:       resourcesQuery,
  348:     );
  349: 
  350:   return snapshot.docs.map(
  351:     (
  352:       resourceDocument,
  353:     ) => {
  354:       const data =
  355:         resourceDocument.data() as
  356:           FirestoreTeacherResource;
  357: 
  358:       /*
  359:        * Defensive validation.
  360:        *
  361:        * The Firestore query should already guarantee
  362:        * this, but we do not return a malformed record
  363:        * whose owner does not match the current user.
  364:        */
  365:       if (
  366:         data.teacherId !==
  367:         signedInTeacherId
  368:       ) {
  369:         throw new Error(
  370:           "A resource ownership mismatch was detected.",
  371:         );
  372:       }
  373: 
  374:       return {
  375:         id:
  376:           resourceDocument.id,
  377: 
  378:         teacherId:
  379:           data.teacherId,
  380: 
  381:         sourceResourceId:
  382:           data.sourceResourceId,
  383: 
  384:         title:
  385:           data.title,
  386: 
  387:         topic:
  388:           data.topic,
  389: 
  390:         resourceType:
  391:           data.resourceType,
  392: 
  393:         yearGroup:
  394:           data.yearGroup,
  395: 
  396:         examBoard:
  397:           data.examBoard,
  398: 
  399:         duration:
  400:           data.duration,
  401: 
  402:         difficulty:
  403:           data.difficulty,
  404: 
  405:         content:
  406:           data.content,
  407: 
  408:         status:
  409:           data.status,
  410: 
  411:         createdAt:
  412:           timestampToDate(
  413:             data.createdAt,
  414:           ),
  415: 
  416:         updatedAt:
  417:           timestampToDate(
  418:             data.updatedAt,
  419:           ),
  420:       };
  421:     },
  422:   );
  423: }
  424:

  492: export async function duplicateTeacherResource(
  493:   resourceDocumentId: string,
  494:   teacherId: string,
  495: ): Promise<string> {
  496:   const signedInTeacherId =
  497:     requireSignedInTeacherId();
  498: 
  499:   const cleanedTeacherId =
  500:     teacherId.trim();
  501: 
  502:   if (
  503:     !cleanedTeacherId ||
  504:     cleanedTeacherId !==
  505:       signedInTeacherId
  506:   ) {
  507:     throw new Error(
  508:       "You cannot duplicate content into another teacher's library.",
  509:     );
  510:   }
  511: 
  512:   const {
  513:     data: source,
  514:   } =
  515:     await requireOwnedTeacherResource(
  516:       resourceDocumentId,
  517:     );
  518: 
  519:   const stamp =
  520:     Date.now();
  521: 
  522:   const duplicatedTitle =
  523:     `${source.title} (Copy)`;
  524: 
  525:   const reference =
  526:     await addDoc(
  527:       collection(
  528:         db,
  529:         COLLECTION_NAME,
  530:       ),
  531:       {
  532:         teacherId:
  533:           signedInTeacherId,
  534: 
  535:         sourceResourceId:
  536:           `${source.sourceResourceId}-copy-${stamp}`,
  537: 
  538:         title:
  539:           duplicatedTitle,
  540: 
  541:         topic:
  542:           source.topic,
  543: 
  544:         resourceType:
  545:           source.resourceType,
  546: 
  547:         yearGroup:
  548:           source.yearGroup,
  549: 
  550:         examBoard:
  551:           source.examBoard,
  552: 
  553:         duration:
  554:           source.duration,
  555: 
  556:         difficulty:
  557:           source.difficulty,
  558: 
  559:         content: {
  560:           ...source.content,
  561: 
  562:           id:
  563:             `${source.content.id}-copy-${stamp}`,
  564: 
  565:           title:
  566:             duplicatedTitle,
  567:         },
  568: 
  569:         status:
  570:           "draft",
  571: 
  572:         createdAt:
  573:           serverTimestamp(),
  574: 
  575:         updatedAt:
  576:           serverTimestamp(),
  577:       },
  578:     );
  579: 
  580:   return reference.id;
  581: }
  582: 
  583: export async function deleteTeacherResource(
  584:   resourceDocumentId: string,
  585: ): Promise<void> {
  586:   const {
  587:     reference,
  588:     data,
  589:   } =
  590:     await requireOwnedTeacherResource(
  591:       resourceDocumentId,
  592:     );
  593: 
  594:   /*
  595:    * Permanent deletion is intentionally restricted
  596:    * to archived resources.
  597:    */
  598:   if (
  599:     data.status !==
  600:     "archived"
  601:   ) {
  602:     throw new Error(
  603:       "Archive this resource before deleting it permanently.",
  604:     );
  605:   }
  606: 
  607:   await deleteDoc(
  608:     reference,
  609:   );
  610: }

FILE: services\teacherStudentInterventionHistoryService.ts
==============================================================================================================

    1: import {
    2:   collection,
    3:   getDocs,
    4:   query,
    5:   Timestamp,
    6:   where,
    7: } from "firebase/firestore";
    8: 
    9: import { db } from "@/lib/firebase";
   10: import type { TeacherInterventionHistoryItem } from "@/types/teacherActionWorkflow";
   11: 
   12: function toDate(value: unknown): Date | null {
   13:   if (!value) return null;
   14: 
   15:   if (value instanceof Date) {
   16:     return value;
   17:   }
   18: 
   19:   if (value instanceof Timestamp) {
   20:     return value.toDate();
   21:   }
   22: 
   23:   if (typeof value === "string") {
   24:     const parsed = new Date(value);
   25:     return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? null : parsed;
   26:   }
   27: 
   28:   return null;
   29: }
   30: 
   31: function safeString(value: unknown, fallback = ""): string {
   32:   return typeof value === "string" && value.trim()
   33:     ? value.trim()
   34:     : fallback;
   35: }
   36: 
   37: export async function getTeacherStudentInterventionHistory({
   38:   teacherId,
   39:   studentId,
   40: }: {
   41:   teacherId: string;
   42:   studentId: string;
   43: }): Promise<TeacherInterventionHistoryItem[]> {
   44:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
   45:   const cleanedStudentId = studentId.trim();
   46: 
   47:   if (!cleanedTeacherId || !cleanedStudentId) {
   48:     return [];
   49:   }
   50: 
   51:   /*
   52:    * Query by teacherId only.
   53:    *
   54:    * This matches the existing Firestore rule proving that every returned
   55:    * intervention belongs to the signed-in teacher. We then filter the
   56:    * selected student in memory, avoiding another composite-index dependency.
   57:    */
   58:   const snapshot = await getDocs(
   59:     query(
   60:       collection(db, "interventions"),
   61:       where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
   62:     ),
   63:   );
   64: 
   65:   return snapshot.docs
   66:     .map((document) => {
   67:       const data = document.data();
   68: 
   69:       const steps = Array.isArray(data.steps) ? data.steps : [];
   70: 
   71:       const completedStepCount = steps.filter(
   72:         (step) =>
   73:           step &&
   74:           typeof step === "object" &&
   75:           "status" in step &&
   76:           (step as { status?: unknown }).status === "completed",
   77:       ).length;
   78: 
   79:       return {
   80:         id: document.id,
   81:         studentId: safeString(data.studentId),
   82:         teacherId: safeString(data.teacherId),
   83:         topic:
   84:           safeString(data.topic) ||
   85:           safeString(data.priorityTopic) ||
   86:           "General support",
   87:         title:
   88:           safeString(data.title) ||
   89:           safeString(data.recommendation) ||
   90:           "Student intervention",
   91:         status: safeString(data.status, "active"),
   92:         priority: safeString(data.priority, "monitor"),
   93:         pathway: safeString(data.pathway, "complete"),
   94:         stepCount: steps.length,
   95:         completedStepCount,
   96:         createdAt: toDate(data.createdAt),
   97:         completedAt: toDate(data.completedAt),
   98:       } satisfies TeacherInterventionHistoryItem;
   99:     })
  100:     .filter(
  101:       (item) =>
  102:         item.teacherId === cleanedTeacherId &&
  103:         item.studentId === cleanedStudentId,
  104:     )
  105:     .sort(
  106:       (first, second) =>
  107:         (second.createdAt?.getTime() ?? 0) -
  108:         (first.createdAt?.getTime() ?? 0),
  109:     );
  110: }

FILE: services\topicNormalisationService.ts
==============================================================================================================

    1: import { curriculumTopicById } from "@/data/curriculum/curriculumRegistry";
    2: import {
    3:   normaliseAliasKey,
    4:   topicAliasMap,
    5: } from "@/data/curriculum/topicAliases";
    6: import type { NormalisedTopic } from "@/types/knowledgeMap";
    7: 
    8: function removeGenericWords(value: string): string {
    9:   return value
   10:     .replace(
   11:       /\b(demo|assigned|practice|gcse|aqa|ocr|edexcel|quiz|test|exam|question|questions)\b/gi,
   12:       " ",
   13:     )
   14:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
   15:     .trim();
   16: }
   17: 
   18: function titleCase(value: string): string {
   19:   return value
   20:     .split(" ")
   21:     .filter(Boolean)
   22:     .map((word) =>
   23:       word.length <= 3 && word === word.toUpperCase()
   24:         ? word
   25:         : word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1),
   26:     )
   27:     .join(" ");
   28: }
   29: 
   30: export function normaliseTopic(rawTopic: string): NormalisedTopic {
   31:   const cleaned = removeGenericWords(rawTopic.trim());
   32:   const aliasKey = normaliseAliasKey(cleaned || rawTopic);
   33:   const directId = topicAliasMap.get(aliasKey);
   34: 
   35:   if (directId) {
   36:     const definition = curriculumTopicById.get(directId);
   37:     if (definition) {
   38:       return {
   39:         topicId: definition.id,
   40:         topicTitle: definition.title,
   41:         unitId: definition.unitId,
   42:         unitTitle: definition.unitTitle,
   43:       };
   44:     }
   45:   }
   46: 
   47:   for (const [alias, topicId] of topicAliasMap) {
   48:     if (aliasKey.includes(alias) || alias.includes(aliasKey)) {
   49:       const definition = curriculumTopicById.get(topicId);
   50:       if (definition) {
   51:         return {
   52:           topicId: definition.id,
   53:           topicTitle: definition.title,
   54:           unitId: definition.unitId,
   55:           unitTitle: definition.unitTitle,
   56:         };
   57:       }
   58:     }
   59:   }
   60: 
   61:   const fallbackTitle = titleCase(cleaned || rawTopic || "Computer Science");
   62: 
   63:   return {
   64:     topicId: normaliseAliasKey(fallbackTitle).replace(/\s+/g, "-"),
   65:     topicTitle: fallbackTitle,
   66:     unitId: "other",
   67:     unitTitle: "Other",
   68:   };
   69: }

  148:         : null,

  151:     questionCount: assignment.questionCount,

  159: export function isUnifiedAssignmentComplete(
  160:   assignment: UnifiedAssignment,
  161: ): boolean {
  162:   return assignment.kind === "exam"
  163:     ? assignment.status === "marked"
  164:     : assignment.status === "completed";
  165: }
  166: 
  167: export function isUnifiedAssignmentOverdue(
  168:   assignment: UnifiedAssignment,
  169: ): boolean {
  170:   if (!assignment.dueDate || isUnifiedAssignmentComplete(assignment)) {
  171:     return false;
  172:   }
  173: 
  174:   const dueDate = new Date(assignment.dueDate);
  175:   dueDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
  176: 
  177:   return dueDate.getTime() < Date.now();
  178: }
  179: 
  180: export async function getUnifiedStudentAssignments(
  181:   studentId: string,
  182: ): Promise<UnifiedAssignment[]> {
  183:   const [resources, quizzes, exams] = await Promise.all([
  184:     getStudentAssignments(studentId),
  185:     getStudentQuizAssignments(studentId),
  186:     getStudentExamAssignments(studentId),
  187:   ]);
  188: 
  189:   const examItems = await Promise.all(
  190:     exams.map(async (assignment) =>
  191:       convertExam(
  192:         assignment,
  193:         await getExamSubmission(
  194:           assignment.id,
  195:           studentId,
  196:         ),
  197:       ),
  198:     ),
  199:   );
  200: 
  201:   return [
  202:     ...resources.map(convertResource),
  203:     ...quizzes.map(convertQuiz),
  204:     ...examItems,
  205:   ].sort((a, b) => {
  206:     const aComplete = isUnifiedAssignmentComplete(a);
  207:     const bComplete = isUnifiedAssignmentComplete(b);
  208: 
  209:     if (aComplete !== bComplete) return aComplete ? 1 : -1;
  210: 
  211:     const aDue = a.dueDate?.getTime() ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
  212:     const bDue = b.dueDate?.getTime() ?? Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
  213: 
  214:     if (aDue !== bDue) return aDue - bDue;
  215: 
  216:     return (
  217:       (b.createdAt?.getTime() ?? 0) -
  218:       (a.createdAt?.getTime() ?? 0)
  219:     );
  220:   });
  221: }

   72: function safePercentage(completed: number, total: number): number {
   73:   if (total <= 0) return 0;
   74:   return Math.round((completed / total) * 100);
   75: }
   76: 
   77: function normaliseStatus(
   78:   value: AssignmentStatus | QuizAssignmentStatus | ExamAssignmentStatus,
   79: ): UnifiedTeacherAssignmentStatus {
   80:   if (value === "closed") return "closed";
   81:   if (value === "cancelled") return "cancelled";
   82:   return "active";
   83: }
   84: 
   85: function isOverdue(
   86:   assignment: Pick<UnifiedTeacherAssignment, "dueDate" | "status">,
   87: ): boolean {
   88:   if (assignment.status !== "active" || !assignment.dueDate) return false;
   89: 
   90:   const due = new Date(assignment.dueDate);
   91:   due.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999);
   92:   return due.getTime() < Date.now();
   93: }
   94: 
   95: function convertResourceAssignment(
   96:   assignment: ResourceAssignment,
   97: ): UnifiedTeacherAssignment {
   98:   const programming = assignment.resourceType === "programming-challenge";
   99: 
  100:   return {
  101:     key: `${programming ? "programming" : "resource"}-${assignment.id}`,
  102:     kind: programming ? "programming" : "resource",
  103:     id: assignment.id,
  104:     title: assignment.resourceTitle,
  105:     topic: assignment.resourceTopic,
  106:     description: assignment.instructions,
  107:     classId: assignment.classId,
  108:     className: assignment.className,
  109:     dueDate: assignment.dueDate,
  110:     createdAt: assignment.createdAt,
  111:     status: normaliseStatus(assignment.status),
  112:     studentCount: assignment.studentCount,
  113:     completedCount: assignment.completedCount,
  114:     completionPercentage: safePercentage(
  115:       assignment.completedCount,
  116:       assignment.studentCount,
  117:     ),
  118:     awaitingMarkingCount: 0,
  119:     averagePercentage: null,
  120:     detailHref: programming
  121:       ? `/teacher/programming-assignments/${assignment.id}`
  122:       : `/teacher/assignments/${assignment.id}`,
  123:   };
  124: }
  125: 
  126: function convertQuizAssignment(
  127:   assignment: TeacherQuizAssignmentSummary,
  128: ): UnifiedTeacherAssignment {
  129:   return {
  130:     key: `quiz-${assignment.id}`,
  131:     kind: "quiz",
  132:     id: assignment.id,
  133:     title: assignment.title,
  134:     topic:
  135:       assignment.deliveryMode === "assessment"
  136:         ? "Assessment quiz"
  137:         : "Practice quiz",
  138:     description: assignment.description,
  139:     classId: assignment.classId,
  140:     className: assignment.className,
  141:     dueDate: assignment.dueDate,
  142:     createdAt: assignment.createdAt,
  143:     status: normaliseStatus(assignment.status),
  144:     studentCount: assignment.studentCount,
  145:     completedCount: assignment.completedCount,
  146:     completionPercentage: assignment.completionPercentage,
  147:     awaitingMarkingCount: 0,
  148:     averagePercentage:
  149:       assignment.completedCount > 0 ? assignment.averagePercentage : null,
  150:     detailHref: `/teacher/quiz-assignments/${assignment.id}`,
  151:   };
  152: }
  153: 
  154: function summariseExam(
  155:   assignment: ExamAssignment,
  156:   submissions: ExamSubmission[],
  157: ): UnifiedTeacherAssignment {
  158:   const marked = submissions.filter((item) => item.status === "marked");
  159:   const awaitingMarking = submissions.filter(
  160:     (item) => item.status === "submitted" || item.status === "marking",
  161:   );
  162: 
  163:   const averagePercentage =
  164:     marked.length > 0
  165:       ? Math.round(
  166:           marked.reduce((total, item) => total + item.percentage, 0) /
  167:             marked.length,
  168:         )
  169:       : null;
  170: 
  171:   const studentCount = assignment.studentIds.length;
  172: 
  173:   return {
  174:     key: `exam-${assignment.id}`,
  175:     kind: "exam",
  176:     id: assignment.id,
  177:     title: assignment.title,
  178:     topic:
  179:       assignment.questionSetSnapshot.topic || assignment.questionSetTitle,
  180:     description: assignment.instructions,
  181:     classId: assignment.classId,
  182:     className: assignment.className,
  183:     dueDate: assignment.dueDate,
  184:     createdAt: assignment.createdAt,
  185:     status: normaliseStatus(assignment.status),
  186:     studentCount,
  187:     completedCount: marked.length,
  188:     completionPercentage: safePercentage(marked.length, studentCount),
  189:     awaitingMarkingCount: awaitingMarking.length,
  190:     averagePercentage,
  191:     detailHref: `/teacher/exam-assignments/${assignment.id}`,
  192:   };
  193: }
  194: 
  195: export async function getUnifiedTeacherAssignments(
  196:   teacherId: string,
  197: ): Promise<UnifiedTeacherAssignmentSummary> {
  198:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
  199: 
  200:   if (!cleanedTeacherId) {
  201:     return {
  202:       assignments: [],
  203:       totalAssignments: 0,
  204:       activeAssignments: 0,
  205:       overdueAssignments: 0,
  206:       completedStudentCount: 0,
  207:       totalStudentCount: 0,
  208:       awaitingMarkingCount: 0,
  209:     };
  210:   }
  211: 
  212:   const [
  213:     classes,
  214:     resources,
  215:     quizzes,
  216:     exams,
  217:   ] = await Promise.all([
  218:     getTeacherClasses(cleanedTeacherId),
  219:     getTeacherAssignments(cleanedTeacherId),
  220:     getTeacherQuizAssignments(cleanedTeacherId),
  221:     getTeacherExamAssignments(cleanedTeacherId),
  222:   ]);
  223: 
  224:   /*
  225:    * T1G integrity boundary:
  226:    * even though each assignment query is teacher-scoped, only assignments
  227:    * attached to a class owned by the authenticated teacher are admitted to
  228:    * the unified teacher portfolio. This prevents stale/corrupt class links
  229:    * from leaking into dashboard and reporting totals.
  230:    */
  231:   const ownedClassIds =
  232:     new Set(
  233:       classes.map(
  234:         (item) => item.id,
  235:       ),
  236:     );
  237: 
  238:   const examAssignments = await Promise.all(
  239:     exams.map(async (assignment) => {
  240:       const submissions = await getAssignmentSubmissions(
  241:         assignment.id,
  242:         cleanedTeacherId,
  243:       );
  244: 
  245:       return summariseExam(assignment, submissions);
  246:     }),
  247:   );
  248: 
  249:   const assignments: UnifiedTeacherAssignment[] = [
  250:     ...resources.map(convertResourceAssignment),
  251:     ...quizzes.map(convertQuizAssignment),
  252:     ...examAssignments,
  253:   ]
  254:     .filter(
  255:       (assignment) =>
  256:         ownedClassIds.has(
  257:           assignment.classId,
  258:         ),
  259:     )
  260:     .sort(
  261:     (first, second) =>
  262:       (second.createdAt?.getTime() ?? 0) -
  263:       (first.createdAt?.getTime() ?? 0),
  264:   );
  265: 
  266:   return {
  267:     assignments,
  268:     totalAssignments: assignments.length,
  269:     activeAssignments: assignments.filter((item) => item.status === "active")
  270:       .length,
  271:     overdueAssignments: assignments.filter(isOverdue).length,
  272:     completedStudentCount: assignments.reduce(
  273:       (total, item) => total + item.completedCount,
  274:       0,
  275:     ),
  276:     totalStudentCount: assignments.reduce(
  277:       (total, item) => total + item.studentCount,
  278:       0,
  279:     ),
  280:     awaitingMarkingCount: assignments.reduce(
  281:       (total, item) => total + item.awaitingMarkingCount,
  282:       0,
  283:     ),
  284:   };
  285: }
  286: 
  287: export function isUnifiedTeacherAssignmentOverdue(
  288:   assignment: UnifiedTeacherAssignment,
  289: ): boolean {
  290:   return isOverdue(assignment);
  291: }
  292: 
  293: export async function updateUnifiedTeacherAssignmentStatus(
  294:   assignment: Pick<UnifiedTeacherAssignment, "id" | "kind">,
  295:   status: UnifiedTeacherAssignmentStatus,
  296: ): Promise<void> {
  297:   const collectionName =
  298:     assignment.kind === "quiz"
  299:       ? "assignments"
  300:       : assignment.kind === "exam"
  301:         ? "examAssignments"
  302:         : "classAssignments";
  303: 
  304:   await updateDoc(doc(db, collectionName, assignment.id), {
  305:     status,
  306:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  307:   });
  308: }

  541: export async function updateUserCourseSelection(

  561:    */
  562:   const existingProfile =
  563:     await getUserProfile(
  564:       cleanedUid,
  565:     );
  566: 
  567:   if (
  568:     existingProfile?.accountIntent ===
  569:       "teacher" &&
  570:     existingProfile.role ===
  571:       "student"
  572:   ) {
  573:     throw new Error(
  574:       "Teacher applicants do not need to select a student curriculum.",
  575:     );
  576:   }
  577: 
  578:   const selection =
  579:     typeof selectionOrQualification ===
  580:     "string"
  581:       ? {
  582:           qualification:
  583:             selectionOrQualification,
  584: 
  585:           examBoard:
  586:             examBoard || "",
  587: 
  588:           currentCourse:
  589:             currentCourse || "",
  590:         }
  591:       : selectionOrQualification;
  592: 
  593:   const cleanedQualification =
  594:     selection.qualification.trim();
  595: 
  596:   const cleanedExamBoard =
  597:     selection.examBoard.trim();
  598: 
  599:   const cleanedCurrentCourse =
  600:     selection.currentCourse?.trim() ||
  601:     "";
  602: 
  603:   if (
  604:     cleanedQualification !==
  605:       "GCSE" &&
  606:     cleanedQualification !==
  607:       "A_LEVEL"
  608:   ) {
  609:     throw new Error(
  610:       "Select either GCSE or A-level.",
  611:     );
  612:   }
  613: 
  614:   if (
  615:     cleanedExamBoard !== "AQA" &&
  616:     cleanedExamBoard !== "OCR" &&
  617:     cleanedExamBoard !== "EDEXCEL"
  618:   ) {
  619:     throw new Error(
  620:       "Select AQA, OCR or Pearson Edexcel.",
  621:     );
  622:   }
  623: 
  624:   const updateData: Record<
  625:     string,
  626:     unknown
  627:   > = {
  628:     qualification:
  629:       cleanedQualification,
  630: 
  631:     examBoard:
  632:       cleanedExamBoard,
  633: 
  634:     onboardingComplete: true,
  635: 
  636:     updatedAt:
  637:       serverTimestamp(),
  638:   };
  639: 
  640:   if (cleanedCurrentCourse) {
  641:     updateData.currentCourse =
  642:       cleanedCurrentCourse;
  643:   }
  644: 
  645:   await updateDoc(
  646:     doc(
  647:       db,
  648:       "users",
  649:       cleanedUid,
  650:     ),
  651:     updateData,
  652:   );
  653: }
  654: 
  655: export async function ensureUserProfile(
  656:   firebaseUser: User,
  657: ): Promise<UserProfile> {
  658:   const reference = doc(
  659:     db,
  660:     "users",
  661:     firebaseUser.uid,
  662:   );
  663: 
  664:   const snapshot =
  665:     await getDoc(reference);
  666: 
  667:   const authenticationEmail =
  668:     normaliseEmail(
  669:       firebaseUser.email,
  670:     );
  671: 
  672:   const authenticationName =
  673:     normaliseString(
  674:       firebaseUser.displayName,
  675:     );
  676: 
  677:   if (!snapshot.exists()) {
  678:     const fallbackName =
  679:       authenticationName ||
  680:       inferNameFromEmail(
  681:         authenticationEmail,
  682:       );
  683: 
  684:     await createUserProfile({
  685:       uid: firebaseUser.uid,
  686:       name: fallbackName,
  687:       email: authenticationEmail,
  688:       role: "student",
  689:       accountIntent: "student",
  690:     });
  691: 
  692:     const createdSnapshot =
  693:       await getDoc(reference);
  694: 
  695:     if (!createdSnapshot.exists()) {
  696:       throw new Error(
  697:         "The user profile could not be created.",
  698:       );
  699:     }
  700: 
  701:     return convertUserProfile(
  702:       createdSnapshot.id,
  703:       createdSnapshot.data() as Partial<FirestoreUserProfile>,
  704:     );
  705:   }
  706: 
  707:   const existing =
  708:     snapshot.data() as Partial<FirestoreUserProfile>;
  709: 
  710:   const existingRole =
  711:     isUserRole(existing.role)
  712:       ? existing.role
  713:       : "student";
  714: 
  715:   const existingIntent =
  716:     normaliseAccountIntent(
  717:       existing.accountIntent,
  718:       existingRole,
  719:     );
  720: 
  721:   const existingStatus =
  722:     normaliseTeacherAccessStatus(
  723:       existing.teacherAccessStatus,
  724:       existingRole,
  725:       existingIntent,
  726:     );
  727: 
  728:   const existingEmail =
  729:     normaliseEmail(
  730:       existing.email,
  731:     );
  732: 
  733:   const existingName =
  734:     normaliseString(
  735:       existing.name,
  736:     );
  737: 
  738:   const repairedEmail =
  739:     existingEmail ||
  740:     authenticationEmail;
  741: 
  742:   const repairedName =
  743:     existingName ||
  744:     authenticationName ||
  745:     inferNameFromEmail(
  746:       repairedEmail,
  747:     );
  748: 
  749:   const repairData: Record<
  750:     string,
  751:     unknown
  752:   > = {};
  753: 
  754:   if (
  755:     normaliseString(
  756:       existing.uid,
  757:     ) !== firebaseUser.uid
  758:   ) {
  759:     repairData.uid =
  760:       firebaseUser.uid;
  761:   }
  762: 
  763:   if (!existingName) {
  764:     repairData.name =
  765:       repairedName;
  766:   }
  767: 
  768:   if (!existingEmail) {
  769:     repairData.email =
  770:       repairedEmail;
  771:   }
  772: 
  773:   if (
  774:     !isUserRole(
  775:       existing.role,
  776:     )
  777:   ) {
  778:     repairData.role =
  779:       "student";
  780:   }
  781: 
  782:   if (
  783:     existing.accountIntent !==
  784:       "student" &&
  785:     existing.accountIntent !==
  786:       "teacher"
  787:   ) {
  788:     repairData.accountIntent =
  789:       existingIntent;
  790:   }
  791: 
  792:   if (
  793:     existing.teacherAccessStatus !==
  794:       "not_submitted" &&
  795:     existing.teacherAccessStatus !==
  796:       "pending" &&
  797:     existing.teacherAccessStatus !==
  798:       "approved" &&
  799:     existing.teacherAccessStatus !==
  800:       "rejected"
  801:   ) {
  802:     repairData.teacherAccessStatus =
  803:       existingStatus || null;
  804:   }
  805: 
  806:   const existingSchoolId =
  807:     normaliseString(
  808:       existing.schoolId,
  809:     );
  810: 
  811:   const resolvedAccountType =
  812:     normaliseAccountType(
  813:       existing.accountType,
  814:       existingSchoolId,
  815:     );
  816: 
  817:   const resolvedPersonalPlan =
  818:     normalisePersonalPlan(
  819:       existing.personalPlan,
  820:     );
  821: 
  822:   const resolvedPlan =
  823:     normalisePlan(
  824:       existing.plan,
  825:       resolvedAccountType,
  826:       resolvedPersonalPlan,
  827:     );
  828: 
  829:   if (
  830:     existing.schoolId ===
  831:     undefined
  832:   ) {
  833:     repairData.schoolId = null;
  834:   }
  835: 
  836:   if (
  837:     existing.accountType !== "individual" &&
  838:     existing.accountType !== "school"
  839:   ) {
  840:     repairData.accountType =
  841:       resolvedAccountType;
  842:   }
  843: 
  844:   if (
  845:     existing.personalPlan !== "free" &&
  846:     existing.personalPlan !== "premium"
  847:   ) {
  848:     repairData.personalPlan =
  849:       resolvedPersonalPlan;
  850:   }
  851: 
  852:   if (
  853:     existing.plan !== "free" &&
  854:     existing.plan !== "premium" &&
  855:     existing.plan !== "school"
  856:   ) {
  857:     repairData.plan =
  858:       resolvedPlan;
  859:   }
  860: 
  861:   if (
  862:     !Array.isArray(
  863:       existing.classIds,
  864:     )
  865:   ) {
  866:     repairData.classIds = [];
  867:   }
  868: 
  869:   if (
  870:     existing.qualification ===
  871:     undefined
  872:   ) {
  873:     repairData.qualification =
  874:       null;
  875:   }
  876: 
  877:   if (
  878:     existing.examBoard ===
  879:     undefined
  880:   ) {
  881:     repairData.examBoard =
  882:       null;
  883:   }
  884: 
  885:   if (
  886:     typeof existing.currentCourse !==
  887:     "string"
  888:   ) {
  889:     repairData.currentCourse =
  890:       "";
  891:   }
  892: 
  893:   if (
  894:     typeof existing.onboardingComplete !==
  895:     "boolean"
  896:   ) {
  897:     const hasCourse =
  898:       Boolean(
  899:         normaliseString(
  900:           existing.qualification,
  901:         ),
  902:       ) &&
  903:       Boolean(
  904:         normaliseString(
  905:           existing.examBoard,
  906:         ),
  907:       );
  908: 
  909:     repairData.onboardingComplete =
  910:       existingRole === "teacher" ||
  911:       existingRole === "admin" ||
  912:       hasCourse;
  913:   }
  914: 
  915:   if (
  916:     typeof existing.xp !==
  917:     "number"
  918:   ) {
  919:     repairData.xp = 0;
  920:   }
  921: 
  922:   if (
  923:     typeof existing.streak !==
  924:     "number"
  925:   ) {
  926:     repairData.streak = 0;
  927:   }
  928: 
  929:   if (
  930:     !Array.isArray(
  931:       existing.completedLessons,
  932:     )
  933:   ) {
  934:     repairData.completedLessons =
  935:       [];
  936:   }
  937: 
  938:   if (
  939:     !Array.isArray(
  940:       existing.completedTopics,
  941:     )
  942:   ) {
  943:     repairData.completedTopics =
  944:       [];
  945:   }
  946: 
  947:   if (
  948:     !Array.isArray(
  949:       existing.completedUnits,
  950:     )
  951:   ) {
  952:     repairData.completedUnits =
  953:       [];
  954:   }
  955: 
  956:   if (
  957:     !Array.isArray(
  958:       existing.completedPapers,
  959:     )
  960:   ) {
  961:     repairData.completedPapers =
  962:       [];
  963:   }
  964: 
  965:   if (
  966:     !Array.isArray(
  967:       existing.badges,
  968:     )
  969:   ) {
  970:     repairData.badges = [];
  971:   }
  972: 
  973:   if (
  974:     Object.keys(
  975:       repairData,
  976:     ).length > 0
  977:   ) {
  978:     await setDoc(
  979:       reference,
  980:       {
  981:         ...repairData,
  982: 
  983:         updatedAt:
  984:           serverTimestamp(),
  985:       },
  986:       {
  987:         merge: true,
  988:       },
  989:     );
  990:   }
  991: 
  992:   return convertUserProfile(
  993:     snapshot.id,
  994:     {
  995:       ...existing,
  996:       ...repairData,
  997:     },
  998:   );
  999: }
 1000: 
 1001: export async function updatePersonalPlan(
 1002:   uid: string,
 1003:   personalPlan: PersonalPlan,
 1004: ): Promise<void> {
 1005:   const cleanedUid = uid.trim();
 1006: 
 1007:   if (!cleanedUid) {
 1008:     throw new Error("A valid user account is required.");
 1009:   }
 1010: 
 1011:   const profile = await getUserProfile(cleanedUid);
 1012: 
 1013:   if (!profile) {
 1014:     throw new Error("The user profile could not be found.");
 1015:   }
 1016: 
 1017:   await updateDoc(
 1018:     doc(db, "users", cleanedUid),
 1019:     {
 1020:       personalPlan,
 1021:       plan:
 1022:         profile.accountType === "school"
 1023:           ? "school"
 1024:           : personalPlan,
 1025:       updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
 1026:     },
 1027:   );
 1028: }
 1029: 
 1030: export async function getUserProfile(
 1031:   uid: string,
 1032: ): Promise<UserProfile | null> {
 1033:   const cleanedUid =
 1034:     uid.trim();
 1035: 
 1036:   if (!cleanedUid) {
 1037:     return null;
 1038:   }
 1039: 
 1040:   const snapshot =
 1041:     await getDoc(
 1042:       doc(
 1043:         db,
 1044:         "users",
 1045:         cleanedUid,
 1046:       ),
 1047:     );
 1048: 
 1049:   if (!snapshot.exists()) {
 1050:     return null;
 1051:   }
 1052: 
 1053:   return convertUserProfile(
 1054:     snapshot.id,
 1055:     snapshot.data() as Partial<FirestoreUserProfile>,
 1056:   );
 1057: }
